content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347076765036249140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲間蔣杜𭰗先生訂定地理辨正直解，錫山章氏増補閻義善成堂梓","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532444187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077256042512410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"辨僞原文","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532460571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僕弱冠失恃，先大父安溪公命習地理之學，求之十年而始得其傳，乃以所傳徧證之大江南北古今名墓，又十年而始㑹其旨。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532476955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從此益精，求之，又十年而始窮其變。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532493339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而我年則已老矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532509723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姚水親隴告成，生平學地之志已畢，","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532526107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347076765036281908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自此不復措意，夫豈不欲傅之其人？","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532526107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然天律有禁，不得妄傅，苟非忠信廉潔之人，未許與聞一二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532542491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹陽張孝廉仲馨，舟徒駱孝廉士鵬，山隂吕文學相烈，㑹稽姜公子垚，武陵胡公子泰徴，淄川畢解元世持，昔以文章行業相師，因得略聞梗槩。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532558875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此諸君子，或","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532575259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228139058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴鳳雛，或青春鶚薦，皆自置甚髙，不可二世，盖求其道以庇本根，非挟其術以為壟斷，故能三緘其口，不漏片言，庶","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532575259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878037131275/1-7241088d05fbe022.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8fjfbNcC0GQhm7MusLM56A%2Bhap8%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcbmi46/1-7241088d05fbe022.webp","fontType":1,"components":"戈𢆶㇉","variants":"幾","charPicId":"7456690878037131275"},"logicSentenceId":"7679112942532575259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不負僕之講求爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532575259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫中人以下，走四方求衣食者，僕初未嘗不憐之，然欲冐禁而傅真道，則未敢許也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532591643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵僕之得傅，有訣無書，以此","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532608027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347076765036314676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事貴在心傳，非可言聲。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532608027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古書充棟，半属偽造，故有辨正一書，昌言救世。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532624411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後復自言所得，作天元五歌，然皆荘蒙所謂糟粕，必求其精微，則亦不在此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532640795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此外别無秘本，私為一家之書。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532657179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近聞三吳两浙，都有自稱得僕真傳以衒鬻者，亦有自撰僞書，指為僕之","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532673563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228171826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘本，以瞽惑後學者。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532673563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之大，何𠩄不容？","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532689947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但恐偽託之人，心術鮮正，以不正之術謀人身家，必誤人之身家；以不正之書傳之後世，必貽禍扵後世。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532706331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僕不忍不辨，惟有識者察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532722715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華亭蒋平階大鴻氏敬告。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532739099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484372020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三、辨偽原文","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532755483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228204594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自叙：大元立五行，立法，怡扵晋，盛扵唐，一時著書立说者，類足為言理言氣云祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532755483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自宋以降，其法稍多失傳，於是诸位雜出，各持一说，以為求食之藉，而僞者曰益盛，真者曰盖失","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532771867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484404788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532771867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帷國初蔣大鴻先生獨得無極真傳，將世俗诸書辨是非，定真偽，成地理辨正一書。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532788251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自以書出，而天玉青囊之奥錯宗，變化云横，隂陽動静之理，向弓失傳，山经白七","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532804635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228286514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百年，由先生一朝大聲疾呼，散聾振瞶，恱掃百家，而道濟二世室非參天地，開盛哀，大有功扵生氏者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532804635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無何，一湾始出，百弊叢生。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532821019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今去先生本久，而著書立说者，乃㡬扵汗牛而充棟矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532837403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼其說立，率逞","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532853787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484437556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸臆，而顯與先生背者，無淪己。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532853787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有奉先生分教，取先去之書，句疏字样，張皇補苴，行且自調為功臣，為诤子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532870171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃究其恱乡所以然，與先生書不啻毫釐干里，去僇投哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532886555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百年之近，已錯亂至此，男恣金，","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532902939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228319282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乆而愈差也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532902939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不揣固陋，杜撰直解，不求字句之工，但期學者立易曉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532919323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然修望博雅君子，愛我者，本教我以不逮焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532935707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道光元年仲春之朔，無心道人減扵千墨菴。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532952091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484470324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳縣趙光照書。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532968475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077616228352050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自序：書籍傳寫之本，久則兹訛，魯魚帝虎，自古然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942532984859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即其書兵関重輕，悦者猶以為恨，而况醫者之扵疾，堪與者之扵墓宅，生死之所寄，安危之沙分，吉凶禍福，㨗若影響，一字反誤，奚","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533001243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378404404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啻千里。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533001243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為利害，可不慎㢤！","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533017627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌山也，水龍隂宅陽宅，巒頭理氣，多以别類，明白曉暢，䖏中明天玉青囊之所以结，乃堪與書之最要者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533034011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其書矢遍天下，而迄今尚喜刻夲轉衆傳寫，舛錯绐法。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533050395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533066779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759460914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，僕扵匡愛廬馆中，適見原本，因取世𠩄傳东，為正讹繆，又因原行筍略侣所以然之理，言之有未畫，悲說之流行，迷途之莫返，故不揣搏昧，増浦阐義，以𭛁明之，亦猶蒋公作歌之意云尔。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533066779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484503092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"序道光三年季冬朔，無心道人識維揚崔氏之宜雅堂。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533083163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759510066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理辨正原序蔣平階撰。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533099547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通五才之道曰儒，放天官，注地理，皆學士家窮理之本","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533115931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二調","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"業，而象纬之学正三後測至灾祥，属有國家者立事。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533115931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533132315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077525484535860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理為養告送死，生民日用所怠，孝子恙狗，允不可以不谨。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533132315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宋儒朱、蔡诸賢，間有器明見於性理書中者，砂子考、顾僧能𢾾陳切照，而未究其棺冰，㦯者進而求去。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533148699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通都","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533165083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759559218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所布管郭诸書，雖其言鑿，而去之逾逺，斯其為道顯而隠，诚所谓間世一出，非人不傳者耶。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533165083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余少失恃，牡发怙生大父安溪公，早以形家云書孜上手授，久而後知侶常之非原序","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533181467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347076969298903074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533181467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"思窮徑绝，乃得無攙子了傳扵游方之外，習其㪽传，又十年所。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533197851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扵是逺溯黄石言鳥，近考青田幕講，彼其言盖人之殊，而厥旨則一。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533214235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且视天下山川土壤，愆大荒内外，亦以一","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533230619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347076969298968610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其庶乎地學之正宗在是。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533230619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辄次舉其说以告学者，又不客顕言务己，则取當世相傳云書，行其纰缪，而折其是化，使言乡者客罪，而闻立者有所送戒，而不至扵亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533247003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨正云書所以作","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533263387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759673906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533263387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地学立有書，治於黄石，盛扵揚公，而多所惑溺而不可辛解者，則莫甚於玉尺怡谕密诸書，彚為二徧，其俎豆号與爰書，皆以云救也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533279771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于姜诸子问業员，任史立暇，旁及頃编。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533296155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378502708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂脫事哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533312539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我得此道，以釋憾於我親，泣我逰者，皆有貌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533328923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏明是徧而遽梓云以公世，其又為天下後世之引舰者加文意歟！","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533345307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"允哉儒者之用以也已。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533361691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759706674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378535476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿之書，汗牛充棟，而時代既逺，真偽相恭，非眀眼人不能識别。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533378075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以来信而可徵者，惟地理辨正一書，吾師精心致思，凡數十寒暑，深","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533394459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077575342194698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其真訣，恐其乆而傳焉失真也，為直解以闡眀之。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533394459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今扵匡君𠁅見天元五歌，反覆涵泳，以盡其妙，復手校再三，将付之剖剛，所以發蒋先生之與，而遺後學之津梁者，心良","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533410843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512262690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦而意彌厚也","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533410843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"方受。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533410843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大名三十餘年，今嵗始得拜晤扵䢴上，自謂三生之幸，莫過扵此。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533427227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不揣愚昧，謹誌數語於卷末，未識有當與否？","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533443611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"熊方受拜跋。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533459995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"跋二。","logicSentenceId":"7679112942533476379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077870759755826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378633780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"地理辨正卷之一","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943458854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲間蔣氏平階補傳，門人會稽姜垚辨正，無心道人增補。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943475238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解靑囊經","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943491622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"原本作黄石公授赤讼子述義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上卷","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943491622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古文作甚輿篇，郭氏作氣感篇，邱氏作理原論，今其削之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：天尊地卑，陽竒陰耦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943491622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一六共宗，二七同道，三八爲朋，四九爲友，五十同途。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943508006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闔闢奇偶。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943524390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五兆生成，流行終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943540774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八體宏布，子母分施。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943557158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地定位，山澤通氣，雷風相薄，水火不相射。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943573542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中五立極，臨制四方。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943589926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背一面九，三七居旁。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943606310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943622694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077575342227466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八四六，縱橫紀綱。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943622694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽以相陰，陰以含陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943639078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生於陰，柔生於剛，陰德宏濟，陽德順昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943655462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故陽本陰，陰育陽，天依形，地附氣，此之謂化始備曰：此篇以無形之氣爲天地之始，而推原道之所從來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943671846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陽氣屬天，而實兆於地之中，聖人作易以明天地之道，皆言陰陽之互爲其根者而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943688230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天髙而尊，地下而卑，然尊者有下濟之德，卑者有上行之義，一陰一陽，一奇一耦，其數參伍所以齊一，其形對待所以往來。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943704614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之匡廓，由此而成，四時之代謝，由此","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943720998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378666548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而運，萬物之化育，由此而胚。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943720998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫此陰陽竒耦之道，隨舉一物，無不有之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943737382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地無心，聖人無意，自然流露，而顯其象於河圖，遂有一六共宗，二七同道，三八爲朋，四九爲友，五十同途之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943753766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人因其象而求其義，以竒者屬陽，而有天一、天三、天五、天七、天九之名；以耦者屬陰，而有地二、地四、地六、地八、地十之名。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943770150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而有一必有二，有三必有四，有五必有六，有七必有八，有九必有十，所謂參伍之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943786534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三彼二，此三彼四，此五彼六，此七彼八，此九彼十，所謂對待之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943802918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天數與地","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943819302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078085310742554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數各得其五，此謂一成之數，而百千萬億無窮之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943819302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此而推也，天數地數各得其五，合二五而成十。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943835686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢有五即有十，猶有一即有二，陰陽自然之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943852070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有天之一，即有地之六，有地之二，即有天之七，有天之三，即有地之八，有地之四，卽有天之九，有天之五，即有地之十，此陰陽之數，以參伍而齊一者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943868454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：五位相得，𥁞此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943884838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而一六在下，則二七必在上，三八在左，則四九必在右，五居中，則十亦居中，此陰陽之賜對得而往來者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943901222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：五位相得，而名有合，蓋謂","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943917606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077485378699316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943917606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其參伍而齊一，故一奇一耦，燦然而不棼；以其對待而往來，故奇耦之間，一闔一闢，潛然而自應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943933990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此生成之所從出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943950374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，而地六成之；地二生火，而天七成之；天三生木，而地八成之；地四生金，而天九成之；天五生土，而地十成之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943966758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生一成，皆陰陽交媾之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943983142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二氣相交，而五行兆焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215943999526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"降於九天之上，升於九地之下，周流六虚，無有休息，始而終，終而復始，無三息不流行，則無一息不交媾。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944015910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當其無而其體渾然已成；當其有而其體秩然有象。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944032294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人因河圖之象","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944048678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077575342325770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數而卦體立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944048678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫河圖止有四象，而卦成八體者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944065062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋一畫成爻，爻者，交也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944081446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太始之氣，止有一陽，是名太陽一太陽一交而成太陰一，是曰两儀；太陰、太陽再交而成少陰二，少陽二，并太陰二，太陽二，是曰四象。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944097830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此河圖之顯象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944114214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四象三爻，而成八卦，三曰乾，三曰兌，三曰離，三曰震，三曰巽，三曰坎，三曰艮，三日坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944130598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋卽河圖","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944146982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY2659/7450184441890291747/1-1738849423110.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=jGcNnHGLMCn6xFKlY4Kn28btnMQ%3D","uri":"read/HY2659/2/ref/1ks59ctsngwmu/1-1738849423110.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠂉毋","variants":"每","charPicId":"7468299320748900362"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215944146982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方二數析之則有八。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944146982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此河圖之象隱而顯者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944163366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故卦之八，由於四象，爻之三，由於三交。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944179750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤二卦爲母，六卦爲子，此八卦之子母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944196134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦自爲","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944212518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512311842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母，三爻爲子，此一卦之子母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944212518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此分施造化，布满宇宙之間，於是舉陽之乾爲天，對以陰之坤爲地，謂之天地定位，天覆於上，則地載於下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944228902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此陰陽之一交而成天地者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944245286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉陽之艮爲山，對以陰之兌爲澤，謂之山澤通氣，山載於下，則澤受於上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944261670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉陽之震爲雷，對以陰之巽爲風，謂之雷風相薄，雷發於下，則風動於上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944278054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉陽之坎爲水，對以陰之離爲火，謂之水火不相射，水火平衡，形常相隔，而情常相親也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944294438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三陰三陽之各自爲交而生萬物者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944310822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢以此爲","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944327206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077991727366171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之卦，伏羲所定，本於龍馬負圖而作，寔則渾沌初分，天地開闢之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944327206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四象虚中，而成五位，此中五者，卽四象之交氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944343590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾之眞陽，坤之眞陰，皆無形，而惟土有形。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944359974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此土之下爲黃泉，皆坤地積陰之氣；此土之上爲清虚，皆乾天積陽之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944376358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而土膚之際，平鋪如掌，乃至陰至陽，乾坤交媾之處，水火、風雷、山澤諸凡天地之化機，皆露於此。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944392742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故中五者，八卦託體儲精，成形顯用之所也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944409126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故河圖誰書，同此中王以立極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944425510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖雖有四象，而先天陽升陰降，上下初分，未可謂之四","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944441894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078071456923682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944441894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自中五立極，而後四極劃然各正其方矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944458278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有四方之正位，而四維介於其間，於是八方立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944474662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"統中五皇極而爲九，分而布之，一起正北，二居西南，三居正東，四居東南，五復居中，六居西北，七居正西，八居東北，九居正南，謂之九疇。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944491046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此雖出於雒書，而實與河圖之數符合，天地之理，自然發現，無不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944507430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"布其位曰：戴九履一，左三右七，二四爲肩，六八爲足，其八方之位，適與八方之數均齊。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944523814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw4rgg/1-1759458853324.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BrX2dwnBgCvRyxcAdKV5XJcx7Dg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw4rgg/1-1759458853324.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556814053152440363"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215944540198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人即以八卦𨽾之，而次其序曰：坎一、坤二，震三、巽四、中五，乾六、兌七，艮八離九，此","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944540198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077991727398939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則四正四維，不易之定位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944540198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數雖起一，而用","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944556582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw543k/1-1759458997519.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IATElcMEEYAimpMp0KpK69J2mfU%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw543k/1-1759458997519.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556816529996808231"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215944556582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首震，蓋成位之後，少陽用事，先天主天，而後天主曰元子繼體，代父爲政也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944556582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：帝出乎震，齊乎巽，相見乎離，致役乎坤，說言乎兌，戰乎乾，勞平坎，成言乎艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944572966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一一三四五、六七、八九者，古今之禪代推移，周而復始者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944589350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震、巽、離、坤、兌、乾、坎、艮者，曰月之出没，四時之氣機，運行遷謝，循環無端者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944605734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢以此爲後天之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944622118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者大禹治水，神𪚧出雒，文王因之作後天之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944638502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈伏羲畫卦之時，未有雒書，而大禹演疇之時，未有後天","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944654886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078071456956450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦位耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944654886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竊以爲圖書必出於一時，而先天、後天卦位亦定於一曰，伏羲但有卦爻，而文王始繫之辭耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944671270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖、雒書非有二數，先天、後天非有二義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944687654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特先天之卦以陰陽之對待者言，有彼此而無方髃。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944704038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天之卦，以陰陽之流行者言，則有方隅矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944720422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至其作卦之旨，要在於隂陽之互根則一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944736806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫易之道，貴陽賤陰，則陽當爲主，而陰當爲輔，而此云陽以相陰者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944753190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽之","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944769574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881559953419/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oE71rZBTWndfvpuQFlCWAclMGkA%3D","uri":"read/HY2452/6/ref/1krg0h2ob39z3/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𤣥少","variants":"玅","charPicId":"7456690881559953419"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215944769574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不在於陽，而在於陰，陰中之陽，乃眞陽也，故陰爲之感，而陽夾應之，似乎陰反爲君，而陽反爲相。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944769574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944785958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078085310906394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經言神明之旨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944785958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然陽之所以來應乎陰者，以陰中本自有之，以類相從，故來應耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944802342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非陰含陽乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944818726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰含陽則能生陽矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944835110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一切發生之氣，皆陽司之，則皆陰出之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944851494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔即陰陽，陰陽以氣言，剛柔以質言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944867878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：乾剛坤柔，又曰：剛柔相摩，八卦相盪。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944884262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦之中，皆有陰陽，則皆有剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944900646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以陽爲剛，以陰爲柔，則宜乎剛生於柔矣，而乃云柔生於剛者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944917030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形之氣，陽剛而陰柔；有形之質，陰剛而陽柔，於有形之剛質，又生無形之柔氣，質生氣，氣還生質，故曰柔生於剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944933414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944949798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078071456989218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所以能爲相助，能爲包合，生生不息如是者，則以陰之與陽，蓋自有其德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944949798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟陰之德能宏大夫陽，以濟陽之施，故陽之德能親順夫陰，以昌陰之化。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944966182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此陰陽之","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944982566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881559953419/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oE71rZBTWndfvpuQFlCWAclMGkA%3D","uri":"read/HY2452/6/ref/1krg0h2ob39z3/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𤣥少","variants":"玅","charPicId":"7456690881559953419"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215944982566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以氣相感，見於河圖、雒書，先後天之卦象者如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944982566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是則可以知天地之道矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215944998950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之道，陽常本於陰，而陰常能育陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215945015334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故天非廓然空虚者爲天也，其氣常依於有形，而無時不下濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215945031718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地非","logicSentenceId":"7679097215945048102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887180845097/1-5fc158ad27c39189.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nicJq2kQT1PMVydH0Qa%2FVyG8n4M%3D","uri":"read/NA06444/25/ref/1kp49s1d9nt3n/1-5fc158ad27c39189.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土田儿厶","variants":"塊","charPicId":"7456690887180845097"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097215945048102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不動者爲地也，其形常附於元氣，而無時不上升。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215945048102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則天之氣常在地中，而地之氣皆天之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097215945064486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽雖曰二氣，止一","logicSentenceId":"7679097808325967898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078085310939162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808325967898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以生天生地者此氣，所以生萬物者此氣，故曰化始也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808325984282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中卷","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326000666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古文作天官篇，邱氏作天元金書符，郭氏作神契篇，今削之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：天有五星，地有五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326000666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天分星宿，地列山川。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326017050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣行於地，形麗於天。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326033434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因形察氣，以立人紀。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326049818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微天極，太乙之御。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326066202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君臨四正，南面而治。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326082586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天市東宫，少微西掖，太微南垣，旁照四極。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326098970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四七爲經，五德爲緯。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326115354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運斡坤輿，垂光乾紀。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326131738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七政樞機，流通終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326148122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地德上載，天光下臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326164506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰用陽朝，陽用陰應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326180890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相見，福祿永貞。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326197274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相乘，禍咎踵門。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326213658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之所臨，","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326230042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512393762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之所盛，形止氣蓄，萬物化生。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326230042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣感而應，鬼福及人。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326246426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故天有象，地有形，上下相須而成一體，此之謂化機。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326262810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳曰：此篇以有形之象爲天地之機，而指示氣之所從受也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326279194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文既明河圖、洛書，先天、後天八卦之理，聖人作易之旨盡於此，天地陰陽之道亦盡於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326295578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然聖人不自作易，其四象八卦皆仰法於天，故此篇專指天象以爲言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326311962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫易之八卦，取象於地之五行，而地有五行，實因天有五曜。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326328346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜凝精於上，而五行流氣於下。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326344730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之星宿，五曜之分光列象者也；地之山川，五","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326361114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078310607749129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之成形結撰者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326361114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故山川非列宿而常具列宿之形。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326377498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其形之所呈，即以知其氣之所禀。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326393882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫有是形，御是氣，物化自然，初未及乎人事，而聖人仰觀俯察，人紀從此立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326410266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爲歲星，其方爲東，其令爲春，其德爲仁。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326426650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火爲熒惑，其方爲南，其令爲夏，其德爲禮。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326443034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土爲鎭星，其方爲中央，其令爲季夏，其徳爲信。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326459418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲太白，其方爲西，其令爲秋，其德爲義。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326475802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲辰星，其方爲朔，其令爲冬，其德爲智。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326492186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範九疇所謂敬用五事，嚮用五福，五紀、八政、皇極、庶徴，皆自此出。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326508570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故聖人御世宰物，","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326524954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077947615969332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一天地之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326524954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"備言天體，則有七政以司元化，日、月、五星是也；有四垣以鎭四方，紫微、天市、太微、少微是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326541338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有二十八宿以分布周天。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326557722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒼龍七宿，角、亢、氏、房、心、尾、箕，朱鳥七宿，井、鬼、柳、星、張、翼、軫，白虎七宿，奎、婁、胃、昴、畢、觜、參，玄武七宿，斗、牛、女、虚、危、室、壁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326574106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四垣即四象，七政即陰陽五行之根本，其樞在北斗，而分之四方，爲二十八宿，故房、虚、昴星應日，心、危、畢、張應月。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326590490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角、斗、奎、井應歲星，尾、室、觜、翼應熒惑，亢、牛、婁、鬼應太白，箕、壁、參、軫應辰星，氐、女、胃、柳應鎭星，臨制其方，各","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326606874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078310607781897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一七政也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326606874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渾天周匝，雖云四方，而巳備八卦二十四","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326623258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw5gqo/1-1759459659480.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=L6ct9k8ZOgb8QSwa5AIIw5bsXUo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw5gqo/1-1759459659480.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556820595993722932"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097808326623258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之象矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326623258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非經無以立極，非緯無以嬗化。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326639642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一經一緯，眞陰眞陽之交道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326656026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交道維洛，而後天之體環周而固於外，地之體結朿而安於中，此元氣之流行，自然而成器者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326672410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其始無始，其終無終，包羅六合，入於無間，雖名陰陽，一氣而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326688794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人能得此一氣，則生者可以善其生，而死者可以善其死。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326705178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之道，蓋人紀之一端。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326721562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此端既立，則諸政以次應之，故聖人重其事，其用在地，而必求端於天，本其氣之所自來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326737946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然氣不可","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326754330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512442914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，而形可見，不可見之即寓於氣，有可見之形，形者氣之所成，而即以載氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326754330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣發於天而載之者地，氣水屬陽而載之者陰，故有陰卽有陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326770714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地得其所，則天氣歸之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326787098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地無時不交會，陰陽無時不相見。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326803482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相見而得其冲和之正，則爲福德之門；相見而不得其冲和之正，即爲相乘而名禍咎之根。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326819866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福殊塗，所争一間，良足畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326836250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且亦知星宿之所以麗於天，山川之所以列於地者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326852634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之氣無往不在，而日得天之陽精而恒爲日，月得天之陰精而恒爲月；五曜得天五氣之精","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326869018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077991727530011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而恒爲緯。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326869018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於四垣二十八宿，衆星環列，又得日月五星之精而恒爲經，此則在天之有形者，有以載天之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326885402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之氣無往不在，而山得日月五星之氣而恒爲山，川得日月五星之氣而恒爲川，此則在地之有形者，有以載地之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326901786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列宿得天之氣而生於天。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326918170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列宿與天爲一體也，山川得地之氣而生於地，山川與地爲一體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326934554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之生於天地，何獨不然？","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326950938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫萬物非能自生，借天地之氣以生。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326967322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然天地非有意於生萬物，萬物自有機焉，適與天地之氣相遇，千窅㝠恍惚","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326983706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512492066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之中，夫有所沽濡焉，夫有所绸缪焉，夫有所苞孕焉，遂使天地之氣止而不去，積之累之，與物爲一，乃勃然以生爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808326983706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之道，必使我所取之形，足以納氣，而氣不我去，則形與氣交而爲一；必使我所據之地，足以承天，而天不我隔，則地與天交而爲一。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327000090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天地形氣既合而爲一，則所葬之骨，亦與天地之氣爲一，而死魄生人，氣脉灌輸，亦無不一。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327016474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福應之來，若機張審括，所謂化機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327032858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，蓄之無門，止之無術，雖周天列宿炳耀中天，而我不蒙其照；雖大地陽和，滂流入表，","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327049242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077864841314330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而我不沾其澤。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327049242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天爲匡廓，地爲稿壤，骨爲速朽，子孫爲寄生，我未見其獲福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327065626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不愼哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327082010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不愼哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327098394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下卷","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327114778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古文作叢辰篇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：無極而太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327114778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理寓於氣，氣囿於形。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327131162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月星宿，剛氣上騰；山川草木，柔氣下凝，資陽以昌，用陰以成。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327147546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽德有象，陰德有位。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327163930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地有四勢，氣從八方。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327180314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外氣行形，内氣止生，乘風則散，界水則上。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327196698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故順五兆，用八卦，排六甲，布八門，推五運，定大氣，明地德，立人道，因變化，原終始，正之謂化成。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327213082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077619512524834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳曰：此篇申言形氣雖殊，而其理則一，示人以因形求氣，爲地理入用之凖繩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327229466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：易有太極，是生两儀。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327245850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極者，所謂象帝之先，先天地生，能生天地萬化之祖根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327262234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本無有物，無象無數，無方隅，無往不在言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327278618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極則無極可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327295002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後賢充說，慮學者以太極爲有物，故由言以明之曰：無極而太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327311386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大而天地，細四萬物，莫不各有太極，物物一太極，一物全具一天地之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327327770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人知太極，物物皆具，則地理之道，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327344154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理寓於氣，氣一太極也；氣圓於形，形一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327360538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以至日月","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327376922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077864841379866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰之剛氣上騰，以剛中有大極，故能上騰；山川草木之柔氣下凝，以柔中有太極，故能下疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327376922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資陽以昌，資之以太極也；用陰以成，用之以太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327393306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極之所顯露者謂之象，而所宣布者謂之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327409690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地無四勢，以太極乘之，而命之爲四勢；氣無八方，以太極御之，而命之爲八方。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327426074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢與方者，其象其氣，而命之爲勢爲方者其極，極豈有定耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327442458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則勢與方亦豈有定耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327458842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四勢之中各自有象，則八方之中亦各自有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327475226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此諸方之氣，皆流行之氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327491610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878188765203/1-4c4372bb92f34bb5.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NV4CxeXeVEp%2BwJFzGSoLaCP4SKo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw5tds/1-4c4372bb92f34bb5.webp","fontType":1,"components":"匚大","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690878188765203"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097808327491610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方成形，只謂之外氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327491610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟任其流行而","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327507994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300269608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無止蓄，則從八方而來者，還從八方而去，千山萬水，僅供耳目之翫，如傳舍，如過客，總不足以濬發靈機，滋荄元化，必有爲之内氣者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327507994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂内氣，非内所自有，卽外來流行之氣，於此乎止。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327524378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此一止，則八方之行形者，皆招攝翕聚乎此，是一止而無所不止。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327540762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此而言，太極乃爲眞太極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327557146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無明不止，則陽無所不資，陰無所不用，而生生不息之道在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327573530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，萬事萬物胚胎乎此。","logicSentenceId":"7679097808327589914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇所謂形止氣蓄，萬物化生，葢謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786190899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然但言止而不","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786207283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077864841445402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申明所以止之義，恐世之審氣者茫然無所措手，故舉氣之最大而流行無間者，曰風、曰水。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786207283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫風有氣，而無形，禀乎陽者也；水有形而兼有氣，禀乎陰者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786223667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然風禀乎陽，而陽中有陰焉；水稟乎陰，而陰中有陽焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786240051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者皆行氣之物。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786256435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之陽者從風而行，氣之陰者，從水而行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786272819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而行陽氣者反能散陽，以陽中有陰也；行陰氣者反能止陽，以陰中有陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786289203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大塊之間，何處無風，何處無水？","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786305587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風原不能散氣，所以嘘之使散者，病在乎乘；水原不能止氣，所以吸之使止者，竗在乎界荀能","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786321971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300302376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明乎乘與界之爲義，審氣以定大極之法，槩可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786321971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文反覆推詳，皆泛言形氣之理，至是乃實指地理之用，於是總括其全焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786338355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順五兆，以五星之正變，審象也；用八卦，以八方之衰旺，審位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786354739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排六甲，以六甲之紀年，審運也；布八門，以八風之開闔，審氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786371123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之矩矱，盡於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786387507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推五運，以五紀之盈虛，審歲也；定六氣，以六氣之代謝，審令也；謹歲時以扶地理之槖籥，盡於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786403891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則大極不失其正，而地德可明。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786420275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然聖人之明地德也，非徒邀福而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786436659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868176945163/1-13fef00ac3aaac16.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AaEhKFPvFOc8D4ee2FYweZ4h3pE%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/2/ref/1kp4at12p4h0l/1-13fef00ac3aaac16.webp","fontType":1,"components":"共皿","variants":"蓋","charPicId":"7456690868176945163"},"logicSentenceId":"7679097995786453043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之五行得其順，","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786453043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077864841510938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則人之生也，五德備其全，而五常順其性，聖賢豪傑接踵而出，而禮樂政刑無不就理，豈非人道自此立乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786453043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此亦陰陽變化自然之玅，雖有智者不能以私意妄作，夫亦深知其所以然，因之而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786469427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫卜地葬親，乃愼終之事，而子孫之世澤皆出其中，則人道之所以終，即爲人道之所以始。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786485811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則斯道也者，聖人開物成務，無有大於此者也，謂之化成，宜哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786502195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上卷推原無形之氣，爲萬物生生之始；中卷因有形之象，推測無形之氣，一形一氣，萬事萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786518579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300335144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能逃其變化，出其範圍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786534963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卷兼形兼氣，并兼理而言，實指地理之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786551347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯理雖本洛書，實則變易不一，錯綜無定，隨氣運行，隨時而在者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786567731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟非師師相授，雖窮年皓首，斷不能窺其巓末，讀者莫輕視而忽之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786584115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理辨正卷之一終。","logicSentenceId":"7679097995786600499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078310607880201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
