{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公養老看雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973611535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下諸書對不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973627919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄者，陰陽之别名，乃不云陰陽而云雌雄者，言陰陽，則陰自爲陰，陽自爲陽，疑平對待之物，互顯其情者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973644303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故善言陰陽者必言雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973660687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀雌則不必更觀其","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973677071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078310607912969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雄，而知必有雄以應之；觀雄則不必更觀其雌，而知必有雌以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973677071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地者，大雌雄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973693455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山川雌雄中之顯象者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973709839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地有至陰之氣，以招攝天之陽精，天之陽氣日下交乎地，而無形可見，止見其草木百糓，春榮秋落，蛟龍虫豸升騰蟄藏而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973726223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故聖人制婚姻，男先乎女，亦以陰之所在，陽必求之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973742607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山河大地，其可見之形皆陰也，實有不可見之陽以應之，所謂雌雄者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973758991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故地理家不曰地脉，而曰龍神，言變化無常，不可以跡求者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973775375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊經所謂陽以求陰，陰以含陽者，此雌雄","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973791759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300367912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；所謂陽本陰，陰育陽者，此雌雄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973791759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂陰用陽朝，陽用陰應者，此雌雄也；所謂資陽以昌，前陰以成者，此雌雄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973808143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公得靑囊之秘，洞徹陰陽之理，晩年其術益精，以此濟世，卽以此養生。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973824527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然其中秘密，惟有看雌雄之一法，此外更無他法。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973840911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地理之書，汗牛充棟，獨此一法，不肯筆之於書。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973857295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢口口相傅，間世一出。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973873679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢自管、郭以來，古今知者不能幾人，旣非聰明智巧可能推測，又豈閎覽博物所得與聞。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973890063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會者一言立曉，不知者累牘難明，若欲向書卷中求之，更河漢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973906447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973922831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078310608011273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰天下諸書對不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973922831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾公安親受楊公之秘，故其所言深切著明如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973939215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼公安者，豈欺我哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973955599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解雌雄者，陰陽交媾之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973971983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交媾者，天地陰陽化生萬物之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459973988367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善言陰陽者必言交媾，善言交媾者必言雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974004751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如含雌雄交媾而言陰言陽，則天不生，地不成，陰自爲陰，陽自爲陽，毫不相涉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974021135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世俗諸書，但知有地而不知有天，皆因天之氣無形可見，地之形有跡可尋耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974037519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善看雌雄者，以有形可見之地，測無形可見之天，再以無形可見之天，合","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974053903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300400680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有形可見之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974053903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫所見者在地，而必求端乎天者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974070287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本其氣之所自來耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974086671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地有至陰之氣，以招攝天之陽精，天之陽氣日下交乎地，而無形可見，只見草大百糓，春榮秋落，蛟龍虫豸，升騰蟄藏，是氣不可見而形可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974103055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以不可見之氣，即寓於有可見之形，因可見之形，卽不可見之氣亦可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974119439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天依形，地附氣，運行化育于冥冥之中，不見而彰，不動而變，無爲而成，即楊公所謂看雌雄者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974135823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看金龍動不動，次察血脉認來龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974152207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077991727595547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以下乃言看雌雄之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974168591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍者，氣之無形者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974184975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍本非金，而云金龍者，乃乾陽金氣之所生，故曰金龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974201359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動則屬陽，靜則屬陰，氣以動爲生，以靜爲死，生者可用，死者不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974217743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其動大者則大用之，其動小者則小用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974234127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此指金龍之消長言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974250511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消長旣明，斯可辨其血脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974266895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血脉卽金龍之血脉，非龍，而實龍之所自來，所謂雌雄者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974283279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀血脉之所目來，卽知龍之所自來矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974299663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察察其血脉之來自何方也，知血脉之來自何方，卽可認龍之來自何方矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974316047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此楊公看雌雄之秘訣，而非","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974332431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300433448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人倒杖步量之死格局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974332431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註辰戌丑未四金惡煞爲金龍者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974348815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：看，即看無形之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974365199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形之氣，化育萬物，干變無窮，故名之曰金龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974381583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動不動者，卽氣之盈虛消長、陰陽往來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974397967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察者，察也，卽察無形之氣消與長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974414351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知氣之消與長，卽可認金龍之得與失矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974430735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得爲動，不得卽爲不動，非山行水曲之動不動也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974447119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍分兩片陰陽取，水對三义細認踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974463503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩片卽雌雄，陰在此則陽必在彼，兩路相交也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974479887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三义","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974496271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077991727628315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽後城門界水合處，必有三义。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974496271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細認踪，卽察血脉以認來龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974512655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知三义之在何方，則知來龍之屬何脉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095459974529039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註以兩片爲左旋右旌，以三义爲生旺墓，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246902799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：山一片，水一片，空一片，實三片，來一片，往一片，來有來之用法，往有往之用法，故云龍分兩片，陰陽取也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246919183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空一片卽天一片，天運循環，元氣流行，消長不一，往來無定，全憑心法，趨其將來，避其已往，來者爲動爲陽，往者爲靜爲陰，此分空一片之雨此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246935567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實一片卽地一片。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246951951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地有背面，生死起伏行","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246968335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078208300466216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止，須憑眼力，挨生棄死，去背就面，面者爲陽爲生，背者爲陰爲死，此分實一片之兩片也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246968335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三义卽水口。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464246984719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細認踪者，細詔山上水裏之玄空，得與失也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247001103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知得與失，方知察血脉認來龍之法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247017487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江南龍來江北望，江西龍去望江東。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247033871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此所謂兩片也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247050255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍本在江南，而所望之氣脉反在江北；金龍本在江西，而所望之氣脉反在江東，葢以有形之陰質，求無形之陽氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247066639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公看雌雄之法，皆從空處爲眞龍，故立其名曰大玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247083023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖云兩片，實二","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247099407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725560329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"片也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247099407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註：江南午丁未坤爲一卦，江北子癸丑艮爲一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247115791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共一父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247132175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江西申庚酉辛戍、乾亥壬爲二卦，江東寅甲卯乙、辰、巽巳、丙爲三卦，共三父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247148559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩卦之中，互相立向者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247164943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：江南、江北、江東、江西，卽隂陽顚倒顚察血脉，認來龍之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247181327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上節雖云兩片，實三片也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247197711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍之兩片，卽已往三片，將來一片。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247214095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢彼來則此往，此往則彼來，有來自有往，有往自有來，來極則往，往極則","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247230479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078071457153058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來，來卽往之始，往卽來之源，何来兩片耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247230479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以聖人卜河洛，𤄊澗二水交華嵩。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247246863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相其陰陽，觀流泉，卜年卜世宅都宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247263247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此即周公卜洛之事，以證地理之道，惟在察血脉，認來龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247279631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人作都，不言華、嵩之脉絡，而言","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247296015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690886949552169/1-9a1b50f19e3d22e0.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9fsIozxLiiF65Iq6uVeeDM8EBs0%3D","uri":"read/NA00666/2/ref/1ktv2he56v40j/1-9a1b50f19e3d22e0.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵𢋨","variants":"瀍","charPicId":"7456690886949552169"},"logicSentenceId":"7679095464247296015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247296015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又引公劉遷豳，相隂陽，觀流泉以合觀之，見聖人作法，千古一揆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247312399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上文所云察血脉，認來龍，對三义細認踪者，楊公恐人不信此訣，特引聖人之相陰陽、觀流泉，","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247328783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078656403046410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以證千古一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247328783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晉世景純傳此術，演經立義，出玄空，朱雀發源生旺氣，一一講說開愚蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247345167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推原玄空大卦，不始於楊公，葢郭景純先得靑","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247361551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866376474643/1-5f246ce0ecabe476.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=p1Uc3hmoiFQAqKCnLquUygVkOjg%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7njwu8/1-5f246ce0ecabe476.webp","fontType":1,"components":"龷口冖二𧘇","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690866376474643"},"logicSentenceId":"7679095464247361551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之秘，演而立之，直追周公制作之精意者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247361551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃其義不過欲朱雀發源得生旺之氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247377935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來源旣得生旺，卽是來龍生旺，而諸福坐致矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247394319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來源若非生旺，則來龍亦非生旺，而禍不旋踵矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247410703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"景純當曰以此開喻愚蒙，其如愚蒙之領會者少也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247427087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308078114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註龍取生旺之氣於穴中，水取生旺之氣於穴前，又指氣之生旺爲長生帝旺、墓庫。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247443471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合三又者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247459855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上二句推原挨星之法所自來，下二句詳言向首一星之妙用。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247476239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生二兮二生三，三生萬物是玄關。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247492623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山管山兮水管水，此是陰陽不待言。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247509007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽之妙用始於一，有一爻卽有三爻，有一卦即有三卦，故曰一生二，二生三，此乃天地之玄關，萬物生生之槖籥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247525391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又恐人認山水爲一，而不知辨别，故言","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247541775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725593097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之玄關自管山，而水之立關自管水，不相混雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247541775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢山有山之陰陽，而水有水之陰陽爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247558159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通乎此義，則世之言龍穴砂水者，眞未夢見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247574543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註生旺墓三合為立關者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247590927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：一極於三，三極於九，故數始于一而終于九也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247607311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天所覆，地所載，萬事萬物不外乎此，是謂玄關。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247623695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山管山，水管水者，山有山之陰陽五行，推其順逆生死；水有水之陰陽五行，推其順逆生死。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247640079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢山自爲山，水自爲水，故云陰陽不待言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247656463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308110882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得陰陽玄妙理，知其衰旺生與死。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247672847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不問坐山與來水，但逢死氣皆無取。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247689231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節暢言地理之要，只在衰旺生死之辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247705615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰旺有運，生死乘時，陰陽玄妙之理，在乎知時而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247721999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山有坐山之氣運，來水有來水之氣運，所謂山管山，水管水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247738383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者皆須趨生而避死，從旺而去衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247754767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然欲識得此理，非眞知河洛之秘者不能。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247771151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈俗師所傳龍上五行收山，向上五行收水，順逆長生之說，所能按圖而索驥者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247787535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725625865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節承上文看金龍分兩片而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247803919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄妙是陰陽往來之玄妙，生死是氣運消長之生死，氣運消長之生死，葢以當元者爲旺，將來者爲生，方去者爲衰，去已久者爲死。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247820303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下二句總言上山下水之趨避。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247836687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天羅經十二支，後天再用干與維，八干四維輔支位，子母公孫同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247853071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅經二十四路已成之跡，人人所知，何須特舉此節？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247869455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非言羅經制造之法，葢將經經直指雌雄交媾之立","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247885839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347077947616182324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關，以明衰旺生死之作用爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247885839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支乃周天列宿之十二次舍，故曰先天地道。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247902223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法天雖有十二宫，而位分八卦，毎卦三爻，則十二宫不足以盡地之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247918607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故十干取戊巳歸中，以爲皇極，而分布八干，爲四正之輔佐。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247934991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然猶未足卦爻之數，遂以四隅四卦補成三八，於是卦爲之母，而二十四路爲之子焉；卦爲之公，而二十四路爲之孫焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247951375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得子母公孫，則雌雄之交媾在此，金龍之血脉在此，龍神之衰旺生死，亦盡平此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247967759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註：子寅辰乾丙乙一龍爲公，午申戌、坤辛、壬二龍","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247984143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725658633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲母，卯己丑、艮、庚、丁三龍爲子，酉亥未、巽、癸甲四龍爲孫，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464247984143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上二句言二十四山不易之定位，下二句分析八干四維，十二支之子母公孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248000527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支之子母公孫旣分，則某爲公、某爲孫、某爲子母，都在于斯。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248016911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山分順逆，共成四十有八局，五行卽在此中分。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248033295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宗却從陰陽出，陽從左邊團團轉，陰從右路轉相通。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248049679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人識得陰陽者，何愁大地不相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248066063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一節申言上文未盡之旨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248082447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子母公孫如何取用？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248098831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456275927074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢二十四山止應二十四局，而一山之局又有順逆不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248115215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有順子一局，卽有逆子一局，一山兩局，峕非四十八局乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248131599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此局得何五行，則龍神得何五行，五行不在此中分乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248147983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然五行之根源宗祖，非取有形可見、有跡可尋之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248164367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山分五行，乃從玄空大卦雌雄交媾之眞陰眞陽分五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248180751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論至此，玄空立卦之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248197135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幾乎盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248213519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而又恐人不知陰陽爲何物，又重言以申明之曰：如陽從左邊團團轉，則陰必從右路轉相通。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248229903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言有陰卽有陽，有陽卽有陰，所謂陰陽相見，雌雄交","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248246287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725691401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"媾，玄空大卦之秘旨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248246287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言左右，則上下四旁皆如是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248262671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽上文龍分兩片江南龍來江北望之意，而反覆言之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248279055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其余世人止從形跡上著眼，不能領會立空大卦之妙，故又發嘆曰：有人識得此理者，乃識眞陰陽、眞五行，眞血脉，眞龍神，隨所指黠，皆天機之玅，何愁大地不相逢乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248295439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不識此，雖大地當前，目迷五色，未有能得其眞者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248311823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註：陽龍左行爲順，陰龍右行爲逆，陽亥龍左行爲甲木，陰亥龍右行爲乙木之類，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248328207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456275959842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：分者，卽分兩片也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248344591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩片者，一顚一倒，一往一來，一順一逆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248360975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分得順逆顚倒，自然共成四十有八局。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248377359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然分作四十八局何益？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248393743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢九星流轉，氣運循環，八卦九宫卽從此而轉，順者順，逆者逆，故曰此中分佢五行之根源宗祖，非取有形可見，有跡可尋，二十四山所分之五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248410127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要從大玄空卦中求天心之一卦，流動九宮，則甲癸、申非盡貪狼，而與貪狼爲一例，艮、丙辛非盡破軍，而與破軍爲一例，此卽所謂星辰流轉要相逢，順逆在此中分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248426511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248442895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725756937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此，則在在之陰陽可求而得。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248442895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在在之陰陽旣可求而得，豈非定陰陽，辨順逆，元空下卦起星之根源宗祖耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248459279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要在未立向以前，將水之去來、山之入首，四面人方，仔細看到，排定方位後，用挨星之法，審其某水合，某水不合，某山合某山不合，另尋別向。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248475663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨到處處合時合運，補救直達，兼得方可。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248492047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，則向之兼左兼右、兼干兼支之法，無不在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248508431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人識得流轉變遷，隨時而在之陰陽者，何愁大地不相逢乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095464248524815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈虛消長之道，本上下無常，進退無","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331646504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456276008994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恒者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331646504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分者卽從無常無恒之中，分其進退，定其上下，辨其陰陽，分其順逆，如是無常者似乎有常，無恒者亦若有恒矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331662888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽山陽向水流陽，執定此說甚荒唐。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331679272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰山陰向水流陰，笑殺拘泥都一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331695656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能勘破個中理，玅用本來同一體，陰陽相見兩爲難，一山一水何足言。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331712040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又言所謂識得陰陽者，乃立空大卦眞隂眞陽，而非世之所謂淨陰淨陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331728424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若據淨陰淨陽之說，則陽山必須陽向而水流陽，陰山必須陰向而水流陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331744808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331761192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725806089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拘拘於此，而不知其實無益也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331761192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞陰眞陽，自有個中之玅，世人不得眞傳，無從勘破耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331777576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有明師指㸃，一言之下，立時勘破，則知不但淨陰淨陽不可分。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331793960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂眞陰眞陽者，雖有陰陽之名，而止是一物，又何從分？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331810344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣知陰陽爲一物，則隨手拈來，無非玅用。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331826728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與水爲一體，陰與陽爲一體，二十四山卦氣相通者，皆爲一體矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331843112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫淨陰淨陽者，一山止論一山之陰陽，一水止論一水之陰陽，故拘執有形，不能觸類旁通耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331859496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立空大卦：一山不論一山之陰陽，而論與此山相見之陰","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331875880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456276058146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽；一水不論一水之陰陽，而論與此水相見之陰陽，所以爲難知難能，而入於微玅之域。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331875880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此豈淨陰淨陽之說，拘於有形者所可同年而語哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331892264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：山上龍神在山，水裏龍神在水，此卽謂陽山。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331908648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水此陰陽，以來者爲陽，往者爲陰，當令者爲陽，失運者爲陰，生者爲陽，死者爲陰，非世所謂左旋右轉也，亦非以山爲陰而水爲陽也，又非以紅字爲陽，黑字爲陰也，又非以干屬陽，支屬陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331925032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此關一破，萬卷靑","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331941416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896365928459/1-1a4a856176ba8546.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oPZFGxXEF050ciyJdB6PzprbZ78%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/2/ref/1kp4at12p7a5h/1-1a4a856176ba8546.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𦬕冖𱔞","variants":"𧅺","charPicId":"7456690896365928459"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096185331941416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮈔絲八扣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331941416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽卽往來，來卽往，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331957800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078434725855241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往卽來，來與往，一氣連貫，本無二物。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331957800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須參與時偕行，與時偕極，卽往來流動之中，在在有一陰一陽，隨時而在者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331974184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時而在，乃是眞陰陽，眞五行，眞立空，眞血脉，眞龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185331990568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘拘于干支卦位，左轉右到者，何來個中之妙耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332006952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相見兩爲難者，山上排龍，水上排龍，雌雄相見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332023336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此相見非坎龍必須離水之相見，兌龍必須震水之相見，要山上排龍排到水裏，水裏排龍，排到山上、山上水裏。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332039720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或來者與往者相見，或得者與失者相見，或山與水相見，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332056104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456276090914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或水與山相見，或相見之於山，或相見之於水，或山與水都相見者，此謂之兩難。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332056104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：一山不論一山之陰陽，而論與此山相見之陰陽；一水不論一永之陰陽，而論與此水相見之陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332072488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數語真屬立玅，唯知當細細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332088872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如曉得此山此水相見之陰陽，方知山與水爲一體，陰與陽爲一體，二十四山卦氣相通者，皆為一體矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332105256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈拘拘于形跡者所可同年而語哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332121640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山雙雙起，少有時師通此義。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332138024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行分布二十四，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332154408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078946984361993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師此訣何曾記。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332154408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽上女二十四山分順逆之義，而重言以嘆美之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332170792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙雙起者，一順一逆，一山兩用，故曰雙雙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332187176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行分布者，二十四山各自爲五行，不相假借也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332203560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖如此云。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332219944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而其中實有奥義，惟得秘訣者乃能通之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332236328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師伹從書卷中搜索，必不得之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332252712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此可見二十四山成格有定，執指南者，人人能言之，而微妙之機，不可測識矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332269096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註：乾亥爲一，甲卯爲一，丁未爲一之類，釋雙雙起","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332285480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078456276156450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332285480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此處要順輪者，彼處要逆佈者，此時要順排者，彼時要逆挨者，一山兩用，故曰雙雙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332301864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且二十四山定陰陽，分五行，起星下卦之法，其秘盡在雙雙二字之內，能於此中推測，可得五行分布之奥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332318248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上龍神不下水，水裏龍神不上山。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332334632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用此量山與步水，百里江山一晌間。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332351016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽上女山管山，水管水之義，而重言以嘆美之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332367400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332383784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078946984427529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以世人之論龍神，但以山之脉絡可尋者爲龍神，卽其所而水法，亦以山龍之法下求乎水，以資其用耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332383784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知山與水乃各自有龍神也，特爲指出，以正告天下後世焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332400168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上龍神，以山爲龍者也，專以山之陰陽五行推順逆生死，而水非所論；水裏龍神，以水爲龍者也，專以水之陰陽五行，惟順逆生死，而山非所論。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332416552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔異質，燥濕殊性，分路揚鑣，不相假也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332432936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽有山龍而兼得水龍之氣者，亦山自爲山，水自爲水，非可以山之陰陽五行混入乎水之隂陽五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332449320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山則量","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332465704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079076525375488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山以辨山之純維長短，水則步水以辨水之純雜長短。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332465704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此山水分用之法，百里江山，一覽在目，此靑囊之秘訣，亦靑囊之捷訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332482088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332498472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言自曾公安剖露以來，於今幾向年矣，而世無三人知者，哀哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332514856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註論山用雙山五行，從地卦查來龍入首；論水用三合五行，從天卦查水神去來者非。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332531240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：山用順，水用逆，俗註巳明，水用逆，而星仍用順，時師未曉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332547624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此靑囊之秘訣，卽靑囊之捷訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332564008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云龍神，非來龍來脉之龍神，是挨星生旺之龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332580392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078946984460297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上陰得生旺之龍神，謂之葬著旺龍，當代發。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332596776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氷裏挨得生旺之龍神，謂之葬著天心，發豈遲者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332613160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山自爲山，水自爲水，不相假借也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332629544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有淨陰淨陽法，前後八尺不宜雜，斜正受來，陰陽取氣乘生旺方無煞。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332645928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山起頂須要知，三節四節不須拘。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332662312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要龍神得生旺，陰陽卻與穴中殊。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332678696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此淨陰淨陽，非陽龍陽向水流陽之淨陰淨陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332695080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢龍脉只從一卦來，則謂之淨，共雜他卦，卽謂之不淨。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332711464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而辨淨與不淨，尤在貼身一節，或從前來，或從後至，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332727848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079076525408256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須極淸純，不得混雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332727848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八尺，言其最近也，言此尤爲扼要，所謂血脉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332744232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一節以後，則少寛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332760616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節須純乎龍運生旺之氣，若一雜他氣，卽是煞氣，吉中有㐫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332777000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來水如此，來山亦然，須審其起頂出脉、結穴一二節之近，要得龍神生旺之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332793384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢龍頂上聚，受氣廣博，能操過福之柄。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332809768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽或直來側受之穴，結穴之虚，與來脉不同，而小不勝大，可無虞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332826152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以知山上龍神，水裏龍神，皆以來脉求生旺，而尤重在到頭一節，學者不可不愼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332842536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078881435713587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註：以左轉右轉、順逆爲陰陽者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332858920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：來山來水，處處均歸一路，卽爲浄，如出他卦，卽爲不浄。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332875304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟人首一節，更不宜夾雜，故特辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332891688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘氣收水，其法不一，或有斜受，或有正受，或陰來陽受，或陽來陰受，急來緩受，緩來急受。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332908072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要而言之，生氣在左則左，在右則右，隨地取裁，隨時兼取者耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332924456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山起頂者，穴後主山之頂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332940840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要知者，要知主山之頂屬何方位，屬何星體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332957224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴有穴頂、穴頂之方位星辰，亦要辨别淸楚，去穴遠者，不必拘拘屬","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332973608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079076525441024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何星體也，只要合乎生旺爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332973608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此生旺兼體用而言，宜細細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185332989992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大上星辰似織羅，水交三八要相過。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333006376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水發城門須要會，卻如湖裏鴈交鵞。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333022760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以天象之經緯，喻水法之交會也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333039144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列宿分布周天，而無七政以交錯其中，則乾道不成，而四時失紀矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333055528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹水流行地中，而無支流以畍割其際，則地氣不收，而立穴無據矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333071912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故二十四山之水，其間必有交道相過，然後血脉眞而金龍動，大幹小支兩水相㑹，合成","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333088296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078881435746355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三义而出，所謂城門者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333088296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湖裏鴈交鵞，言一水從左來，一水從右去，兩水相遇，如鵞鴈之一往一來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333104680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳言水龍審脉之法，而立穴之玅在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333121064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上二句取天象之經緯，喻水法之交會；下二句以鵞鴈之往來，比流神之屈曲。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333137448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然大幹小被两水相會，合成三义，必有枝流界割其間，則地氣收束，立穴有據矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333153832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂氣無界不收，龍無界不淸，脉無界不止，穴無界不的，卽此意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333170216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴貧賤在水神，水是山家血脉精。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333186600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山靜水動晝夜定，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333202984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308209186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主財祿山人丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333202984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽號御往，四大尊神在内排。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333219368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅須憑五行布，要識天機立妙處。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333235752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽水長流，吉神先人家豪富。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333252136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽各有衰旺生死，非可槩用，須用五行辨其生尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185333268520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生卽生旺，尅卽衰死，生爲吉神，死爲㐫神，要在立空大卦，故云天機玄妙處也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499418624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解山主靜，水主動，山管人丁，水管財祿，水法美。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499435008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主財祿豐盈，龍氣佳，主人丁興旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499451392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水形屈曲，曰御街，非以方位爲御街也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499467776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四大尊神卽衰旺生死，將","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499484160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078881435779123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此衰旺生死，排在乾坤艮巽水中，故曰在内排。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499484160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機卽天運吉神先入，謂當收得生旺爲先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499500544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先到先收，亦謂之先入。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499516928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請騐一家舊日墳，十墳埋下九墳貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499533312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有一墳能發福，去水來山盡合情。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499549696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：如十墳用十處，有山情好者，有水法好者，有山水無情者，有發福者，有衰敗者，地非一處，盛衰亦無一定自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499566080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公獨舉十墳埋下之句，葢屬假借之辭，申言用法之得弗得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499582464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂此十墳","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499598848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308241954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用於一處，則九墳之前後左右，來山去水，坐山朝向，乘氣收水，方位干支與此一","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499598848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866468601919/1-f2f37671b7a7098c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=P8dF9VjN%2FCF5gAneCvSvBndpxbQ%3D","uri":"read/NA01160/5/ref/1kvb9qyvig2s3/1-f2f37671b7a7098c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土𧶚","variants":"墳","charPicId":"7456690866468601919"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096185499598848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總是一般模樣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499598848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既是一般，則九墳之盛衰宜與此墳一般爲是。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499615232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃九墳敗而一墳独發者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499631616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳之形局雖同，所用之時，各有先後，時有先後，坐山朝向雖是一般，在在之陰陽各别。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499648000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽旣别，則五行之消長，氣運之盈虛，自有合與不合合情者。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499664384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟此一墳體與用，消與長，處處用得合法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499680768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗廟本是陰陽玄，得四失六難爲全。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499697152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才六建雖爲妙，","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499713536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078881435877427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得三失五盡爲偏。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499713536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因一行擾外國，遂把五行顚倒編。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499729920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以訛傳訛竟不明，所以禍福爲胡亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499746304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節旁引世俗五行之謬，以見地理之道，惟有立空大卦看雌雄之法，所以尊師傳，戒後學也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499762688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢唐以後，諸家五行雜亂而出，將以擾外國，而爲以禍中華，至今以訛傳訛，流毒萬世，曾公所以辨之深切也歟。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499779072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：宗廟五行，是唐一行所造，所云得三失五，得四失六者，非盡善之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499795456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308274722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊奥語","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499811840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐楊益筠松譔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無心道人增補直解：楊公得靑囊正訣，約其旨爲奥語，以玄空之𤧑氣，用五行之星體，而高山平地之作法，已該括於其中。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499811840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然非得眞傳口訣者，索之章句之未，終不能辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499828224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之奥語，誠哉其奥語也！","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499844608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜垚汝皐氏注：坤王乙巨門，從頭出，艮丙辛，位位是破軍，巽辰亥盡是武曲位，甲癸申，貪狼一路行。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499860992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：挨星五行，卽九星五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499877376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪、巨、祿、文、廉、武、破、","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499893760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078881435942963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔、弼，一一挨去，故曰挨星。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499893760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥空大卦五行，亦卽挨星五行，名異而實同者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499910144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行原本洛書九氣，而上應北斗，主宰天地化育之道，斡維元運，萬古而不能外也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499926528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此九星與八宫掌訣九星不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499942912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐使僧一行作卦例以擾外國，專取貪、巨、武爲三吉，其實非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499959296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫九星乃七政之根原，八卦乃乾坤之法象，皆天寶地符，精華妙氣，顧于其中分彼此，辨優劣，眞庸愚之識，詭怪之談矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499975680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止是天地流行之妙，與時相合者吉，與時相背者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185499992064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故九星八卦，本無有吉，而有時乎吉，本無","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500008448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308340258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有凶，而有時乎㐫，所以其中有趨有避，眞機妙用，全須秘密耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500008448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞知九星者，豈惟貪、巨、武爲三吉，卽破、祿、廉、文、輔、弼五凶亦有吉時。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500024832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞知八卦者，豈惟坎、離、乾坤四陽卦爲凶，卽震、巽、艮、兌四陰卦亦有凶時，斯得玄空大卦之眞訣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500041216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奥語首揭此章，乃挨星大卦之條例。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500057600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤壬乙非盡巨門，而與巨門爲一例；艮丙辛非盡破軍，而與破軍爲其例。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500073984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽辰亥非盡武曲，而與武曲爲一例；甲癸申非盡食狼，而與貪狠爲一例。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500090368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此中隠然有挨星口訣，必待眞傳，人可推測而得。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500106752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若舊注。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500123136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078859914838042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以坤王乙天干從申子辰三合爲水局，故曰文曲。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500139520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮丙辛天干從寅、午戍三合爲火局，故曰廉貞。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500155904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500172288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有云長生爲貪狼，臨官爲巨門，帝旺爲武曲，亦謬。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500188672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解挨星五行，卽九星五行，貪、巨、祿、文、廉、武、破、輔、弼，一一挨去，故曰挨星。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500205056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行原本洛書九氣，而上應北斗，主宰天地化育之道，其氣無形可見者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500221440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形之氣，爲天所行也，有形之質，爲地所行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500237824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八九，卽大五行，爲天行，氣，爲地","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500254208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078409308373026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，形之次序，非水火木金之在天成象，又非方圓直銳之在地成形，又非東木西金之方位，又非坎水離火之卦屬，故名之曰大玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500254208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行隨氣","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500270592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷，隨運轉移，天心一動，九宫便更名，非有定氣隨星分，故曰非巨門而與口門爲一例，非破軍而與破軍爲一例。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500270592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則下卦起星之誤，定卦分星之奥曉然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500286976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘拘於字義，則與立空二字之意不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500303360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左爲陽，子癸至亥王，右爲陰，午丁至巳丙。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500319744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078946984558601"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：此節言大五行陰陽交媾之例，如陽在子癸至亥壬，則陰必在午丁至巳丙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500336128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子至壬，自午至丙，路路有陽，路路有陰，以此爲例，須人自悟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500352512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非拘定左邊爲陽，右邊爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500368896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陰在左邊，則陽又在右邊矣，亦可云左右，亦可云東西，亦可云前後，亦可云南北，皆不定之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500385280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄交媾，非有死法，故曰玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500401664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊注自子丑至戍亥，左旋爲陽，自午至申未，右旋爲陰，謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500418048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解陰陽左右，是天地交媾之眞陰眞陽，如陽在","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500434432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079076525637632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于癸，隂必在午，丁陽在午，丁陰必在子，癸陽在左。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500434432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰必在右，陽在右，陰必在左。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500450816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦四隅，路路有陽，路路有陰，非拘定左邊爲陽，右邊爲陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500467200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽有一定之氣，無一定之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500483584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽雖無定所，隨時而在者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500499968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘拘於子癸午丁，亥壬巳丙，順則皆順，逆則皆逆，何來左與右耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500516352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公恐人拘定，故特辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500532736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽左右，是翻天倒地，隨時顛倒之隂陽，隨時顚倒，左右自無一定。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500549120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟曉顚倒無定之陰陽，方知陽在彼，陰必在此之竅矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500565504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079240753348645"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌與雄交會合立空，雄與雌立空卦内推。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500581888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜天曰：立空之義，見于曾序江南節注直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500598272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合玄空卽合陰陽往來之立空。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500614656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽往來之立空，總在山上水裏雌雄交會之内，故曰推也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500631040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此訣，須知氣有一定之氣，而用無一定之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500647424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與水須要明此理，水與山，禍福盡相關。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500663808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：山有山之卦氣，水有水之卦氣，脫不得陰陽交媾之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500680192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山有山之禍福，水有水之禍福，有山禍而水福，有山福而水禍，有山氷皆福，有山水皆禍，互相","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500696576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716389933108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關涉，品配爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500696576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解明此理者，卽眀雌雄交會之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500712960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此交會之理，葢以地之體主靜，天之氣主動，主動之氣生乎上，主靜之氣成乎下。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500729344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄交媾，動靜生成，此氣木無往不在，無時不有，無物不生者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500745728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂葬乘生氣，卽乗此生","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500762112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894735294527/1-a55cf9238d5b68b5.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7AYHOG2rN63q0aBYyGmJ5NzwAvY%3D","uri":"read/HY2791/2/ref/1kqj8m9zui48w/1-a55cf9238d5b68b5.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠂉㇈一米","variants":"氣","charPicId":"7456690894735294527"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096185500762112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500762112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬得此生氣，則天氣歸之，天氣歸則地氣必從之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500778496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則陰陽之道，山水之理，可得而知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500794880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與水，水與山，是言山上水裏之排龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500811264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明此理，卽明一山不論一山之陰陽，一水","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500827648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079240753414181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論一水之陰陽，而論與此山此水相見之陰陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500827648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上節所云雌與雄，雄與雌，卽是山上水裏元空。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500844032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交㑹有彼此生生之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500860416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明立空只在五行中，知此法不須尋納甲。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500876800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：九星五行，大卦之法，只明玄空二字之義，則衰旺生死，暸然指掌之間，不必尋乾納甲、坤納乙，巽納辛，民納丙，兌納丁，震納庚，離納王，坎納癸，之天父地母，一行所造卦例矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500893184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：無定無據，無方無隅，無始無終，無形無跡，無","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500909568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716389998644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往不在，無時不有。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500909568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰立空五行者，是挨星五行，卽大玄空九星五行，非諸家之五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500925952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切莫誤認。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500942336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星五行之中，有與時合者，有與時背者。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500958720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦九星，本無有凶，不合則凶；本無有吉，合時則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500975104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，則墓宅之興衰瞭然矣，何必用尋乾尋甲之法乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185500991488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顚顚倒，二十四山有珠寶，順逆行，二十四山有火坑。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185501007872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：顛倒順逆，皆言陰陽交媾之","logicSentenceId":"7679096185501024256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881559953419/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=He73Fgkz4XFpriKi8B5nJ1zZEo4%3D","uri":"read/HY2452/6/ref/1krg0h2ob39z3/1-ec2d48fb0b616d60.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𤣥少","variants":"玅","charPicId":"7456690881559953419"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096185501024256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山。","logicSentenceId":"7679096185501024256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽不一，吉凶無定，合生旺則吉，逢衰敗則凶，山山皆有珠寶，山山皆有火坑，毫釐千里，間不容髪，非眞得","logicSentenceId":"7679096185501040640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079240753479717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊之秘，何以能辨之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679096185501040640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：顛倒，卽翻天倒地之顚倒，正是陰不是陰，陽不是陽之顚倒。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187284480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下二句總論俗術之非。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187300864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"認金龍，一經一緯義不窮，動不動，直待高人施妙用。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187317248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：易云乾爲龍，乾屬金，乃指先天眞陽之氣，無形可見者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187333632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理取義于龍，正謂此耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187350016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一經一，","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187366400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
