","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896517185575/1-0ff4e0f7dd8385b4.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mR%2F8D0n0l3jl%2FmcMU9L%2FTeK3fTM%3D","uri":"read/HY2270/9/ref/1l09yclqsz09y/1-0ff4e0f7dd8385b4.webp","fontType":1,"components":"糹㐄","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690896517185575"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186187366400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽陰陽交媾之玅。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187366400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍之經緯，隨處而有，而動與不動，去取分焉，必其龍之動，而後妙用出焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187382784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不動者，不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187399168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍旣屬無形，從何可認？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187415552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"認得動處，卽知用","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187431936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716390031412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，所以有待高人也歟。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187431936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：認金龍者，卽認無形之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187448320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形之氣，日往月來，盈虛消長，經緯無窮者也，此氣從何可說？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187464704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能認得無形之氣，孰往孰來，誰消誰長，方知其動與不動。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187481088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知得動處，卽知察血脉、認來龍之法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187497472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一經一緯者，卽動者運行於上，無一息之停。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187513856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主降靜者安靜於下耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187530240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古不移，主升，升升降降，上行下效，縦横顚倒，總由動而使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187546624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如舍經而言緯，非但無氣質生成之玅理，且無用往來之氣化，孤陽不","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187563008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213109298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，緯亦空有是","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187563008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896517185575/1-0ff4e0f7dd8385b4.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mR%2F8D0n0l3jl%2FmcMU9L%2FTeK3fTM%3D","uri":"read/HY2270/9/ref/1l09yclqsz09y/1-0ff4e0f7dd8385b4.webp","fontType":1,"components":"糹㐄","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690896517185575"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186187563008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187563008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如舍緯而言經，非但無寒暑以化物，并無秋落春榮之變易，獨陰不育，經亦徒有是經矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187579392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍既屬無形，不在形跡上求，動靜曉然矣；不在干支方位上求，動靜亦曉然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187595776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一義，要識龍身行與止。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187612160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二言，來脉明堂不可偏，第三法，傳送功曹不高壓，第四奇，明堂十字有立微，第五妙，前後靑龍兩相照。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187628544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六秘八國城門鎖正氣，第七奥，要向天心尋十道，第八裁，屈曲流神認去來，第九神，任他平地與靑雲，第十眞，若有一缺非眞情。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187644928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716390064180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：上節言金龍之動不動，而此節𦂳頂龍身行與止，學者不可忽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187661312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋有動則有止，不動則雖有金龍，只云行龍，原無止氣，故高人妙用，以此爲第一。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187677696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此一著，然後其餘作法可次第而及也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187694080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來脉明堂不可偏，非謂來脉必與明堂直對，不可偏側也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187710464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如所云，則子龍必作午向，亥龍必作巳向矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187726848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍結穴，變化不一，有直結者，有橫結者，有側結者，豈容執一？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187743232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公之意，葢謂來脉自有來脉之受氣，明堂自有明堂","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187759616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881736278052/1-4d50a3930b8e8a2d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=03BoNprOj%2BwRssZIXMSwZgBbxLU%3D","uri":"read/HY1148/3/ref/1krdb8qfzh7o3/1-4d50a3930b8e8a2d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丿㇇乀","variants":"之","charPicId":"7456690881736278052"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186187759616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受氣，二者須各乘生旺，兼而收之，不可偏廢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187759616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187776000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213174834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"送功曹，乃左右護龍星辰，葢眞龍起頂必高于護砂。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187776000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃爲正結。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187792384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若左右二星，反壓本山，非龍體之五矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187808768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地亦然，貼身左右有高地掩蔽陽和，房分不利，俗術所不覺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187825152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十字立微，乃裁穴定向之法，雖云明堂，實從穴星內看十字。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187841536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明此十字，則穴之上下左右，向之偏正□㓕，盡于此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187857920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其云玄微，誠哉其立微也歟！","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187874304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後靑龍，兩相照從，案托龍虎定穴法者，此義易知。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187890688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八國，城也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187907072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八國有不滿之處，是曰城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187923456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢城門通正氣之出入，而八國鎖之，觀其鎻定之方便，知是何卦之","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187939840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716390096948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正氣，以測衰旺而定吉山也，故曰秘。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187939840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心十道，緊頂八國城門而來。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187956224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢城門旣定正氣之來踪，而又當于穴内分淸十道，乃知入穴正氣廣狹輕重、銖兩平衡之辨，故曰奥。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187972608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此兩節專言人穴測氣，非論形勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186187988992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，則與明堂十字，前後靑龍兩條，不幾于復乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188005376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屈曲流神，已是合格之地，然有此卦來則吉，彼卦來則凶者，槩以屈曲而用之，誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188021760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須有裁度，乃可變通取用，故曰裁。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188038144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上皆審氣之眞訣，至微至渺者，一著不到，將有滲漏而失眞情矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188054528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地高山，總無二法，上八句","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188070912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213207602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各是一義，未二句不過叮","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188070912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879785402409/1-7dba4d5cf12ecd91.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=npgsqsA%2Fa4cfDEjWibLAnq7ef5s%3D","uri":"read/NA06806/25/ref/1kob8rjv8u3ad/1-7dba4d5cf12ecd91.webp","fontType":1,"components":"口𡨴","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690879785402409"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186188070912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以囑之，語氣凑拍，借成干節耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188070912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解第一義：上節言無形之氣動不動，此節言有形之質止不止。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188087296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公看雌雄之法，葢以有形之質爲體，無形之氣爲用，一體一用，雖有動靜之殊，然必體立而後用行，故以龍身行止爲第一。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188103680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：形止氣蓄，萬物化生。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188120064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188136448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一言山有山之行止，水有水之行止，分定行止，然後辨其是地非地，再辨其屬何卦，氣屬何生。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188152832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716390129716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺得爲不偏，不得卽謂偏，非坎龍離水之偏不偏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188169216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三法，傳送功曹，是前後左右輔從之别名，高壓者，賓欺主之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188185600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四奇，明堂十字，乃裁穴定向之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188201984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在未立穴以前，先看四面情形，八方氣勢，次看來山來水，合何時之生旺，再看内堂外堂去來止聚之方。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188218368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則知穴之冝左冝右，冝前冝後，自有一定不可移易之穴，自有一定不可移易之向矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188234752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213240370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第五玅細看前後左右龍虎案托，左爲龍，右爲虎，前爲案，後爲托，環抱開面，相向，有情爲照。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188251136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩相照者，八方相照有情也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188267520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六秘城門二字，最難拘碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188283904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有水之城門，山有山之城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188300288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之城門有三乂，以三乂爲城門，無三乂，以水之照穴有情處爲城門，亦有以來處爲城門，亦有以去口爲城門，總以有權有力處爲是山之城門，以入首束氣處爲城門，或以過峽起頂虎爲城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188316672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有以某處來脉，卽以某處爲城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188333056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188349440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078716390162484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原平陽，以枝浜界氣爲城門，或以低田界水止處爲城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188349440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鎻正氣者，看准城門正氣鎻定在何方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188365824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第七奥天心十道，是用法之至美者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188382208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文十道從形跡上看，此節以體用合宜，山水兼得，便爲十道。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188398592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十道卽天卦之十道，非地卦之十道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188414976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地卦之十道，一九二八，三七四六，人人知之，何以云奥？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188431360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公于此節發明，要向天心尋者，眞所謂披肝露胆之說，陰陽相見之玅訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188447744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能會得其理，十道自然有處可尋，當在向上分清，不用別處尋也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188464128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213305906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第八、九、十三節，水神雖以曲爲吉，然有此處來則吉，彼處來則凶者，其中須有裁度，平地靑雲卽高山平洋。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188480512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山平洋，其用則一。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188496896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十眞者，龍穴沙水、鬼曜朝對，處處環抱朝拱，更兼山得山之用法，水得水之用法，此卽謂十眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188513280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或體好而用不能全合，或用得而體少有偏側反跳之形，總謂之缺。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188529664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上十節，須以龍眞穴的爲要。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188546048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍果眞，穴果的，止自有止，行自有行，自有明堂，自有功曹，自有傳送，自有十字，自有城門，左右自然照應，流神自然屈曲。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188562432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188578816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078999509647394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴一有不的，外面空有萬重山，卽此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188578816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明倒杖，卦坐陰陽何必想。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188595200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：此以下二節，專指山龍穴法，與平地無涉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188611584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因世人拘執浄陰浄陽之說，故一語破之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188627968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒杖非必如俗傳十二倒杖法，此後人僞造也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188644352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只接脉二字，足盡倒杖之眞訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188660736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣知接脉，便知眞穴，旣得眞穴，便有眞向，自然之陰陽已得，又何必淨陰淨陽之拘拘哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188677120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節申言裁穴定向之法，要在未立穴以前，先看山之來脉，從何起頂，從何人首，細細看准，某","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188693504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213338674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千上是來脉，某干上是入首，辨清干支夫婦，再看水之去來，某處是來源，某處是去口，某處是三乂，一一看到，然後再辨孰陰孰陽，誰得誰失，方可剪裁趨避。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188693504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦坐、倒杖等語，總言乘氣收水之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188709888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何必想三字，是言楊公不勉而中，不思而得之致。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188726272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公當時攜杖登山，隨機指點，後人神其說爲有十二種倒杖法，傳訛之至。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188742656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識掌模太極，分明必有圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188759040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：山龍眞穴，必有太極暈藏于地中。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188775424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此暈變化","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188791808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347078999509729314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同，而其理則一，非道眼孰能剖露哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188791808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：按：識掌模三字，分明是掌上起星辰類聚羣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188808192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分之太極，何曾說蓍地中之太極，果是地中之太極，與掌何相王涉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188824576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要得內極，先求外極；弗識外極，焉識內極？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188840960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣識外極，再尋內極，從此尋極，萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188857344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要求太極，先求的穴，再尋蟬翼，自有眞極。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188873728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無物卽無極，無極卽無物。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188890112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有物自有極，有極自有物。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186188906496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極以物定，物以極分。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900332544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未生物先生極，未生極先生物，極生物，物生極，極物生生，方知物物一太極。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900348928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079359213371442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知化氣，生尅制化須熟記。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900365312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：生旺之氣爲生，衰敗之氣爲尅，扶生旺之氣，勝衰敗之氣，是爲制化。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900381696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一節兼平地而言，直解知化氣，要知天地化育之氣，化□之氣，至公至平，無往不在，無時不有。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900398080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣知此氣，再細細考其所以生、所以化、所以尅制之理，苟能熟記於胸中，則天地之氣機，墓宅之興衰瞭然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900414464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅卽五行之生尅制與化，葢言以文制武，以貴治賤，以長治幼、以尊治卑之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900430848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三綱五常爲王道之制化，此哩","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900447232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079306411081743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之當然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900447232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽剛柔、水火木金爲五行之制化，此氣之當然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900463616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其事雖異，共理則一，細心參考，制化之理自得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900480000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚則補其母，實則","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900496384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868205469750/1-822465e5f6979f20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IALpuFBr10cw%2B308wtOVfg5eaM0%3D","uri":"read/HY2934/5/ref/1kux5e6im4843/1-822465e5f6979f20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵宀一𠃍丨𠃌一灬","variants":"瀉","charPicId":"7456690868205469750"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186900496384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其子，亦是制化之妙法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900496384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說五星方圓尖秀要分明，曉高低星峯須辨得。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900512768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立微鬼與曜，生死去來眞要妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900529152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏日：此三節皆論山龍形體，不須另解。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900545536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼曜之生死去來，是辨龍穴之要著也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900561920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之轉結者，背後必有","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900578304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294382619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，有穴星如許長，而鬼亦如詐長者，俗眼難辨，有反在鬼上求穴者，不知穴星是來脉爲生，鬼身是去脉爲死，察其去來，而眞僞立辨矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900578304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡龍左右，龍虎都生。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900594688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜氣向外反張，有似乎砂之飛走者，此眞氣有餘，直衝上前，而餘氣帶轉，如人當風振臂，衣袖飄揚，反向後也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900611072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在眞龍正穴，則爲曜氣，在無有穴之地，則爲砂飛，此其辨在龍穴而不在砂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900627456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解五星卽木直、金圓、土方、水曲火尖之五星。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900643840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要分明者，要說五，是正變之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900660224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079306411147279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星峯在胜方宜高，衰方宜低，是楊曾之眞誤，須高處得高處之五行，低處得低處之五行，元微者各得其宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900676608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼曜專論挨生棄死之法，向放水生旺有吉，休囚否？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900692992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：向中放水，世人莫不以來水特朝爲至吉，去水元辰走泄爲至凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900709376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知向上之水，不論去來，若合生旺，則來固吉，去亦吉；若逢休囚，則去固凶，來亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900725760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公因向上之水關係尤𦂳，其說最能誤人，故特","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900742144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294415387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900742144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：大凡向上之星，得生旺爲要。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900758528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五歌云：向首一星災福柄，向上無水去來者猶可，或有水去來者，或有水聚者，或見水光者，或合成三义者，此謂之玄關，又謂之城門，關繫盛衰之地，最爲𦂳要，可不加意细察乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900774912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重在立空得失，不重水之去來。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900791296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然來水特朝，去水走泄，其形人所易曉；生旺休囚，世所不識。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900807680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山分五行，知得榮枯死與生。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900824064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻天倒地對不同，","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900840448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079306411180047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中秘密在玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900840448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說龍立穴要分明，在人仔細辨天心。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900856832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心旣辨穴何難，伹把句中攷水看。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900873216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從外生入名爲進，定知財寶積如山；從內生出名爲退，家内錢財皆盡費。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900889600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生入尅入名爲旺，子孫高官盡富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900905984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：立空大卦之竗，只翻天倒地對不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900922368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七字。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900938752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山旣分定五行，則榮枯生死，宜有一定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900955136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其入用，有用于此時則吉，用干彼時則凶者，時之對不同者，其一也；有用之此處則吉，用之彼處則凶者，物之對不同者，又其一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900971520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其秘密之理，非傳心不可。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186900987904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294448155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心卽上文第七奥之天心，另有辨法，非時師所謂天心十道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901004288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如時師之說，又何用仔細耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901020672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心旣辨，則穴中正氣已定，而撓其權者，在向中所放之水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901037056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從外生入，從內生出。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901053440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言穴中所向之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901069824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我居于衰敗，而受外來生旺之氣，所謂從外生入也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901086208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我居於生旺，而受外來衰敗之氣，似乎我反生之，故云從內生出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901102592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言穴中所向之氣，穴中旣有生入之氣矣，而水又在衰敗之方，則水來尅我，適所以生我也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901118976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內外之氣，一生一尅，皆成生旺，兩美相合，諸福畢臻，","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901135360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079306411212815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以高官富貴，有異于常也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901135360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其中正有對不同者存焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901151744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊注所云小玄空水生向尅向爲進神，向生水尅水爲退神，非是靑，","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901168128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876187115559/1-c8fc0beb9a441ded.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6Mw3mqB%2FxpvHV2cJmlMU2ifBb4U%3D","uri":"read/HY0962/4/ref/1kvozgqzvcxlv/1-c8fc0beb9a441ded.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𰀁口冖𱔞","variants":"囊","charPicId":"7456690876187115559"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186901168128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈有兩玄空五行耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901168128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解二十四山：何山當順推五行，何山當逆挨九星。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901184512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此卽知得生死榮枯矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901200896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何山順，何山逆，有一定之氣，無一定之位，須參與時偕行，與時偕極，自有一陰一陽，隨時而在者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901217280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曉得在在之陰陽，空中分陰陽，定五行之訣可得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901233664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如生出生入，尅出尅入，乃言穴中所向之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901250048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴中所向之氣，衰旺","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901266432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294513691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有運，死生隨時，不可以一例求之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901266432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉息生旺要知因，龍歇脉寒災禍侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901282816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有他山來救助，空勞祿馬護龍行。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901299200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：此下二節總一篇之意，言先尋龍脉以定穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901315584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901331968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次論九星，以辨氣之吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901348352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一節先言形體，而以來龍之脉息爲重，外砂之","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901364736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690870126493759/1-52c97df711a373f4.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=R6TZNB3o9UPznEncONlpvoSHxUc%3D","uri":"read/NA04456/8/ref/1l09zb1sapkxf/1-52c97df711a373f4.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹䕶","variants":"𧅰","charPicId":"7456690870126493759"},"logicSentenceId":"7679096186901364736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾爲輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901364736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解生旺是氣運之生旺，知氣運之生正，方可立向消納，剪裁趨避。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901381120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘不知此氣，則趨非所趨，避非所避，空用祿馬貴人，有何益哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901397504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍眞結到落","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901413888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228023336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脈入首處，必有似有似無，呼吸浄沉之動氣，此謂之脉息，犹人身之六脉一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901413888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身之六脉，主宰血氣，流行三焦，灌漑全體。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901430272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉非他物，卽神之別名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901446656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華元化云：脉者，氣血之先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901463040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先也者，主宰乎氣血之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901479424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，脉之生旺，豈可忽乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901495808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君再把星辰辨，吉凶禍福如神見，識得此篇眞妙微。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901512192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見郭璞再出現。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901528576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：此一節乃言卦氣，而以九星大五行爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901544960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言如上節所云，雖得來龍脉息之眞穴，而吉凶禍福尙","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901561344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294546459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未能取必。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901561344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君再將挨星訣法，細審衰旺生死，而後可趨吉而避凶，轉禍而爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901577728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一篇之旨不過如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901594112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能識其微妙，前賢與後賢一般見識，一般作用，靑囊三卷，更無餘義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901610496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論楊公此篇，其言玄空大卦、挨星五行，卽靑囊經上卷陽生于陰之義，而下卷理寓于氣之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901626880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其言倒杖太極暈五星脉息，卽靑囊經中卷形止氣蓄之義，而下卷氣囿于形之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901643264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一形一氣，括盡靑囊之旨，而究其玄機正訣，如環無端，不可捉模，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901659648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228056104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰奥語宜哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901659648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解龍穴砂水，分合向背諸般，皆有形跡，可見是眞是假，人所易曉。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901676032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟大玄空五行之法，世所不知，卽古今以來，知者不過數人而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901692416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再者，楊公敎得訣者而言也，謂旣得眞訣，又得吉地，再將大五行之情性、剛柔、往來、進退、盈虛消長，細細審辨，而後趨避，如是，則體與用無所不當矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901708800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細按再辨兩字，明明敎得訣者而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901725184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂旣得眞訣，再將星辰考究明徹。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901741568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星有吉凶消長，有陰陽往","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901757952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079554294628379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來，有氣色情性，有五行，禀性有三吉五吉，有統令專令，於五常有君臣父子、夫婦昆弟，於時有秋冬春夏，於物有方圓直銳，於五待有水火木金。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901757952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星各有所司，諸物各有所禀。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901774336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君能細細考究，明徹前賢後賢一般見識，一般作用，誠哉得訛者所當辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679096186901790720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228121640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理辨正卷之三","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"武陵胡泰徵、杜陵蔣平階大鴻補傳。門人會稽姜嘉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"較正","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無心道人增補直解","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天玉經","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐楊益筠松撰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內傳上：","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江東一卦從來吉，八神四個一。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716404770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江西一卦排龍位，八神","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716421154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四個二。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716421154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南北八神共一卦，端的應無差。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716437538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天玉内傳，卽靑囊奥語，挨星五行、玄空大卦之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716453922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716470306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079601983750181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公妙用，止有一法，更無二門。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716470306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃反覆其詞，以授曾","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716486690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公安者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716486690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江南、江北，江東、江西，曾序已先下注脚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716503074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但南北東西應有四卦，而此云三卦者，緣玄空五行","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716519458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦排來，止有三卦故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716519458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江東一卦者，卦起于西，所","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716535842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂江西龍去望江東，故曰江東也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716535842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八神卽八卦之中","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716552226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經四位而起父母，故曰八神四個。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716552226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言八神之中歴曰","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716568610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716568610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一者，此一卦只管一卦之事，不能兼通他卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716584994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江西一卦者，卦起于東，反而言之，卽謂江東龍去望","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716601378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江西亦可，故曰江西也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716601378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦于八卦之中經四位而起","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716617762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079306411261967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母，故亦曰八神四個。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716617762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者，此一卦兼管二卦之事，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716634146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不能全收三卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716634146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此如坎至巽乃第四位，巽至兌","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716650530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦第四位，八卦之中各經四卦，故曰八神四個也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716650530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716666914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北八神者，乃江北一卦，所謂江南龍來江北望也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716666914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716683298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云四個者，此卦突然自起，不經位數，與東西兩卦不","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716683298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716683298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八神共一卦者，此卦包含三卦，總該入神，又非","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716699682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八神四個二之比也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716699682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫此東西南北三卦，有一卦止","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716716066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得一卦之用者，有一卦兼得二卦之用者，有一卦盡","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716716066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得三卦之用者，此謂玄空大卦，柲密寶藏，非眞傳正","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716716066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716716066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079601983782949"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"授，斷不能洞悉其妙者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716716066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗註寅至丙爲東卦，申至王爲西卦，午至坤爲南卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716732450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子至艮爲北卦，非","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716732450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716732450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江東一卦卽後天之震卦，江西一卦卽洛書。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716748834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之兌位。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716765218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣論元運，震有震之吉時，兌有兌之旺運，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716781602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今先將震之吉時而論，震爲三，天元之未運，可知，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716781602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"待震卦當令，坎坤都已過時矣，卽得不爲我吉，巽","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716781602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又屬一元，故曰四個一。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716781602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一卦只得一卦之用，不","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716797986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能兼通他卦故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716797986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然非卦之不能，時之不能也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716814370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716830754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228154408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論兌卦，兌爲七下元之首運，可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716830754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣屬首，該包三","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716847138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，卽以七數至九，亦該得三吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716847138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰二者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716863522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟玄","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716879906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空心法中只得艮兌，不得離九，故曰四個二。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716879906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716896290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦只得兼通二卦之用，不能全收三卦故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716896290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此非","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716912674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時之不能，天卦之不能也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716912674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八神者，卽坎、坤、震、巽、離、","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716929058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、兌、乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716929058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共一卦者，卽共此一卦而爲九也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716945442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能用","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716961826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一卦所建之處，卽能全收三卦，總該八神，又非","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716961826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八神四個二之所可比也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716961826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者先將九宫八卦分","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716978210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清，孰往孰來，誰消誰長，再憑掌上尋得一卦、二卦、","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716978210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079601983815717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三卦之法，知起於東，起於西，靑囊之奥得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716978210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四龍管三卦，莫與時師話，忽然知得便通仙，代代","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716994594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼓駢闐。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156716994594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四龍本是八卦，而八卦又分爲三卦，此玄空之","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717010978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘，必須口傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717010978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若俗注丙本南離而反屬東卦，壬本北","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717027362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎而反屬西卦，牽强支離，悖理之極。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717027362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且云四個一者，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717043746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰丙乙四個在一龍，四個二者，申戌壬辛四個在","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717043746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二龍，又屬無謂。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717043746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解二十四山本是八卦，此云三卦者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717060130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法將","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717076514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228219944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫分配三元，一元分得三卦，卽一二三四五六","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717076514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七八九也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717076514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然法雖如此，用要變通，不可執一三四","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717092898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五五六七八九一亦爲三卦，總要與葬時之一卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717092898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而生卽爲吉，退而衰卽爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717092898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：將來者進成。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717109282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功者退，卽此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717125666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三卦卽三般卦之三卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717142050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦周","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717158434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流六虚，無所不至，此陰彼陽，無時不易，卽八卦二","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717158434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十四龍陰陽顚倒，變化錯縱，都由此而起，故曰管也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天卦，江東掌上尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717158434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知了値千金地畫八卦誰能會？","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717174818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717191202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079601983848485"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水相對，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717191202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地東西南北，皆對待之名，所謂陰陽交媾，玄空大","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717191202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717191202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節方將山與水相對一言，畧指一班，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717207586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泄漏春光矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717207586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非分天卦于江東，分山水相對于地卦","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717223970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717223970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以辭害志，分别支離，卽同癡人說夢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717240354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗注天卦地支從天于，以向論水神旺墓；地卦天干","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717256738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從地支，以龍論山水生死，可笑","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717256738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解天卦卽玄空，江東卽玄空中之生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717256738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與水","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717273122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相對者，水上之星卽山上之星，山上之星卽生旺","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717273122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079114228252712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之星，將此生旺之星輪到城門或山上，此爲山與","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717273122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水相對，非必拘定要水與山相對，只要水上之星","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717273122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與時相對耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717273122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天卦地卦，非天父地母之俗說，切","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717289506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫誤認。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717289506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天卦卽無形之氣，運行于上，萬物生生之始","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717305890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717305890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江東者，無形氣中之生旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717322274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元各有生旺，故","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717338658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云江東江西。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717338658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣無形可見，無跡可尋，全憑往來","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717355042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消長之中，細辨某爲江東，某爲江西，在江東時，用","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717355042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江東爲令星，在江西時，用江西爲令星，隨時取用","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717355042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，曉然明白。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717355042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再查有形有跡之八方，何方來水，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717371426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079925024768038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何方去水，何方來龍，何方入首，何方高，何方低，何","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717371426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方水口三又有形無形，相交會于其間。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717371426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再查山上","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717387810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍神，水裏龍祖，雌雄相對與否。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717387810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此相對非坎龍必","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717404194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須離水之相對，兌龍必須震水之相對。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717404194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂相對","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717420578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，山上水裏與時相對也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717420578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母陰陽仔細尋，前後相兼定前後相兼兩路看，分定","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717436962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邊安。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717436962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有卦之父母，爻有爻之父母，皆陰陽交媾之妙理。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717453346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節前後指卦爻而言，一卦之中爲父母，卦前卦後，","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717469730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278114344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏旁兩路，卽爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717469730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不仔細審察，恐于父母之心","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717486114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元不眞，而隂陽有差錯矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717486114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗注以前兼後爲天卦，屬向首，後兼前爲地卦，屬龍","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717502498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家，爲兩邊者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717502498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717518882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母是隨氣建極之父母，陰陽是隨時變易","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717535266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717535266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此陰陽名有定名，位無定位，須從顚倒變","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717551650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易之中，細細辨其陰陽，分其順逆，故曰尋也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717551650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717568034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是言山上水裏之前後，山上水裏各有用法，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717568034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邊安也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717568034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邊兩路，總言山上水裏來往各得其","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717584418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079925024817190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717584418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦内八卦不出位，代代人尊貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717600802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向水流歸一路行，到處","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717617186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717617186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍行出卦無官貴，不用勞心力。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717633570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只把天醫福德","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717649954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"装，未解見榮光。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717649954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦之内有三卦，在三卦之内，則爲不出卦而吉，三","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717666338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之外，卽爲出卦而凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717666338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向須卦內之向，水須卦内之","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717682722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，二者皆歸本卦，則全美矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717682722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天醫卽巨門，福德卽武","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717699106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲，此乃一行所造小遊年卦例，以溷挨星之眞者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717699106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂世人誤認卦例爲九星五行，必不能獲福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717715490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278147112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解山得山之卦内，水得水之卦內，向得向之卦","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717731874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内，此謂不出位中二句，甚言不出卦之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717731874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行龍","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717748258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先見錯雜，水神又流出卦；來龍來水先帶駁雜，用","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717748258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法又兼巨武之差錯，内外都出，是爲眞出。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717748258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒排父母蔭龍位，山向同流水，十二陰陽一路排。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717764642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總是","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717781026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中來。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717781026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒排父母，卽顛倒顛之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717797410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽交媾，皆倒排之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717813794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717830178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向與水神必倒排以定陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717830178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二陰陽，卽備二十四","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717846562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717846562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言雖有二十四位陰陽，總不脫八卦爲父母","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717862946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079925024866342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717862946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解倒排卽顛倒山向水神，必須顚倒以定陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717879330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山或順或逆，總自顚倒中來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717895714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關天關地定，雌雄富貴此中逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717912098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻天倒地對不同，秘密","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717928482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717928482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄交媾之所，乃天地之關竅，知其關竅，而后交媾","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717944866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可定也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717944866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江南龍來江北望，江西龍去望江東，此爲翻","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717961250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天倒地，巳詳奥語注中","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717961250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作注以辰戌丑末爲關天關地，非","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717961250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278212648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679095156717961250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關卽察也，看也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683940404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關天者，察天連行消長之氣","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683956788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；關地者，看地之是地非地。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683956788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支顚飲，工雖雄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683973172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地形氣旣定，再分雌雄，再定順逆，再憑掌上排","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683989556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉凶，取其合時合連者用之，失時失合者去之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927683989556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此挨星之妙，秘宻深藏，全在玄空上着眼，不在形","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684005940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"跡上尋也，故曰對不同在玄空。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684005940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地二字，指干支","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684022324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而言，關卽關空中變易之干支，知空中變易之干","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684022324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支，卽知定雌雄、分順逆之奥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684022324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻倒是言陰可作","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684038708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，陽可作陰，陰不是陰，陽不是陽之翻倒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684038708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079925024948262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽水向盡，源流富貴水無休。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684055092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽六秀二神當，立見","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684071476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684071476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽者，丙午丁也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684087860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天玉靑囊旣重，挨星生旺矣，而此","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684104244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節提出三陽，别有深意，非筆舌所能道。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684104244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六秀者，本卦","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684120628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之二爻，故曰二神。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684120628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天玉以卦之父母爲三吉，以卦之","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684137012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子息爲六秀。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684137012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗注艮丙、巽妾、兌丁爲六秀，非","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684153396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684153396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽水向是活潑潑地，一處有一處之三陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684169780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一時有一時之三陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684169780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此處可作三陽，彼處亦可作","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684186164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278245416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽，此時有三陽，彼時亦有三陽。","logicSentenceId":"76790959276
