{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗注論方位非","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684350004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全按三才并六建，排定陰陽算。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684350004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下按玉輦捍門流，龍去","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684366388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要回頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684366388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才卽三吉，六建卽六秀。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684382772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節上二句論方位，故須","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684399156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排定陰陽；下一句論形勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684399156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉輦、捍門皆指去水，須纏","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684415540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身兠抱，謂之日回頭也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684415540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗注以長生諸位爲六建，及玉輦、捍門，俱就方位言","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684431924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684431924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解六建。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684431924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才，言來山來水干支卦位之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684448308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684464692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278310952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽算者，卽算山上水裏得失之屬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684464692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉輦、捍門皆","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684481076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指去水。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684481076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"回頭者，去而復回，有戀戀不舍之情狀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684497460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六建分明號，六龍名姓達天聰。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684513844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正山正","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684530228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"向流支上寡天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道刑杖","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684530228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下二句𦂳接上二句而言，水之取六建是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684530228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然卦之","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684546612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山向在四隅卦中，則用本卦支神之六建，在四正卦","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684546612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，又當用本卦干神之六建。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684546612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦取正山正向，而水","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684562996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又流他卦之支上，是陰差陽錯，而必有寡天刑杖之","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684562996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684562996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉四正卦而四隅卦不辨自明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684579380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節以下，專","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684595764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773633050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨于支零正陰陽純雜，亳釐千里之微。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684595764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解水法中有天建、地建、人建、馬建、祿建、財建，此","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684612148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六建乃上好格局，然恐水多則易犯差錯，故特辨","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684612148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684612148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如四正卦上有水，當用本卦干神爲六建，加","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684628532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸一卦，壬癸爲建，子爲才，又爲吉，或兼丑，或","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684628532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼亥，則有寡天刑杖之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684628532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此，則四隅之卦可","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684644916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以類推矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684644916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後五節總是辨方位，定吉凶之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684661300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六建三才，一","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684677684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神三吉，丙午巳丙，指方位干支而言，究其所以然，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684677684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278343720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必須體用兼到爲要也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684677684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共路兩神爲夫婦，詔取眞神路，仙人秘密定陰陽，便是","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684694068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其龍岡。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684694068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共路兩神，卽一干一支也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684710452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一干一支皆可爲夫婦，然","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684726836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞夫婦，有假夫婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684726836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞夫婦爲正龍，假夫婦卽非正","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684743220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684743220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巽巳爲眞夫婦，丙午亦眞夫婦，若己、丙則不","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684759604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得爲眞夫婦矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684759604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684775988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解兩神，卽一于一支，壬子亥壬，眞假之屬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684792372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"認","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684808756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取，指來山來水，兼坐向而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684808756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看准來山來水，干","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684825140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773665818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支夫婦，再辨其孰陰孰陽，是眞是假，便是分陰陽","logicSentenceId":"767909592768 {"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽二字看，零正坐向須知病。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684841524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇正神正位裝，撥水","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684857908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入零堂。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684857908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零堂正向須知好，認取來山腦水上排龍點位","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684874292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裝，積粟萬餘倉，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684874292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊天玉。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684874292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以卦内生旺之位爲正神，以出卦衰敗","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684890676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之位爲零神，故陰陽交媾，全在零正二字。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684890676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零正不明，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684907060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺必有病矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684907060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若知其故，而以正神裝在向上爲生","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684923444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，而以零神裝在水上爲剋入，則零堂正向豈不兼","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684923444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079752278376488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收其妙乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684923444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向水旣妙，而求山之腦，未必與坐向相合，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684939828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又當認取。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684939828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果來山又與坐向同在卦内，則來脈又合，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684956212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非但一向之旺氣而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684956212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟水亦然，葢山有來山之腦，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684972596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水亦有來水之源，水龍卽是山龍，亦須節節排去，黜","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684972596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位裝成。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684972596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果能步步零神，則水之來脈與水之入口同","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684988980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣，山之坐向與山之來脈同一氣，斯零正二途，别","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684988980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無間雜，而爲大地無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927684988980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解零正卽陰陽消長之道，陽長卽零轉而爲正；","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685005364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽消則正轉而爲零。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685005364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消長不一，陰陽無定，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685021748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能考","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685021748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773698586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究消長之精微，方曉坐山朝向之病不病矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685021748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐向","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685038132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂坐之得則坐，向之得則向，重在得與弗得，有重","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685038132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐與向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685038132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正神百步始成龍，水短便遭凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685054516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零神不問長和短，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685070900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685070900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此承上文而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685087284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正神正位裝向，固吉矣，然其向中來","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685103668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，須深遠悠長而后成龍，若然短淺，則氣不聚，難以","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685103668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致福。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685103668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于水則不然，一遇正神，雖一節二節，其殺立","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685120052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685120052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其零神之長短，又與正神有巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685136436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使零神而在水，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685152820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080264461385762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖短亦吉；若零神而在向，雖短亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685152820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是零神之吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685169204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在水向之分，而不係乎長短也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685169204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：正神言山上排龍，零神言水上排龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685185588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上排","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685201972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，排得正神所到之方，宜來龍來脹，實地高山俱","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685201972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，有水則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685201972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂百步者，甚言其最近也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685218356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水上排","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685234740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，排得旺神所臨之地，得水便吉，無論遠與近也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685234740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦平洋裁穴定向之要訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685251124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上之零神，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685267508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水裏之正神；水裏之零神，卽山上之正神。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685267508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上元之","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685283892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正神，卽下元之零神；下无之正神，卽上元之零神。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685283892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773731354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零正無定，隨時運行而升降者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685300276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母排來到，子息須去認生剋。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685316660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水上排龍照位分，兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685333044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更子孫，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685333044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦承上排龍而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685333044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之中氣爲父母，卦之二爻爲子","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685349428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息，而本官他卦之父母爲兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685349428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上二句言山上排龍，","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685365812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下二句言水上排龍，山上排龍，從父母排到子息，總","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685365812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是一卦，則卦氣純矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685365812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然須認其卦之生剋，若得卦之","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685382196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，則純乎吉，若得卦之剋氣，則純乎凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685382196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈可以","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685398580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其卦之純一而遂謂吉哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685398580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上排龍，來脈一路，大都","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685414964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080264461418530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只在一卦之內。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685414964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于水上排龍，則不然，水有一路來。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685431348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亦有兩三路來者，故須照位分開，而不能拘一卦","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685447732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之父母，只要旁來之水，亦在父母一氣之卦，謂之兄","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685447732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685447732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟卦內又有子孫，雖非一父母，而總是一家骨","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685464116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉，來路雖多，不害其爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685464116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶者反是。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685480500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上二句言山上排龍，下二句言水上排龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685496884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685513268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上排龍，以山爲龍者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685513268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴後有主山，卽以主山爲","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685529652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母；無主山，以人首束氣處爲父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685529652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘博换傳","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685546036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變，高低起伏、開帳結頂之處，卽爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685546036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子鳥是","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685562420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079880825110565"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形象之子息，非挨排之子息，挨排之子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679095927685562420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以主","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185011752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山入首虚挨着五行爲父母；開帳起祖之處挨着","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185011752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185011752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此處五行總要有益於主山人首者","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185028136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲生，與主山相剝相反者卽爲剋，非是主山火曜，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185028136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不取良金，祖帶廉貞無用曲水之呆去也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185028136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水上排","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185044520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，以水爲龍者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185044520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有一處來者，有兩三處來者，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185060904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有四五處來者，總以照穴有情有力處爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185060904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185077288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排龍之法，排着同元一氣者爲兄弟，挨得五吉三","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185077288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星者，亦爲兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185077288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟之左右兩爻，便爲子息，非子","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185093672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080264461484066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財官之子息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185093672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一十四山分兩路，認取五行主。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185110056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍中交戰水中裝，便是","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185126440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185126440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前面若無凶交破，莫斷爲凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185142824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星看在何公","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185159208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭仔細說蹤由。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185159208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一節專舉卦之差錯者而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185175592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路者，隂陽生死也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185191976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山，每山皆有兩路，非分開二十四山歸兩路","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185208360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185208360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路之中，須認取五行之所主。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185224744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行所主，貴在淸","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185241128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純，若龍中所受之氣，既不淸純，而吉凶交戰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185241128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘能","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185257512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以水之淸純者救之，庶龍氣遇水制伏，而交戰之凶","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185257512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079880825176101"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威可殺，柰何又將龍中交戰之卦裝入水中，則生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185257512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之雜出者不能爲福，而死氣之雜出者，適足爲禍，正","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185273896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍有不受其傷者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185273896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然水之差錯，其力足以相勝，吉","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185290280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多者吉勝凶，凶多者凶勝吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185290280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入口雖然交由，而來水","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185306664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源頭若無凶星變破，則氣猶兩平，雖不致福，亦未可","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185306664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遽斷爲凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185306664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且凶星之應，亦有公位之分，吉凶雙到","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185323048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之局，只看某房受著，便于此房斷其有禍，不受著者，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185323048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不應也，非如純凶不雜之水，房房受其殃禍之比，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185323048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故其終尤當作細認云。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185323048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079672775147520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：五行主者，山水情純，一卦之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185339432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如來龍出","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185355816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，與左鄰右舍相雜，此謂龍中交戰；水神又流出","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185355816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，與他卦干支混淆，此謂水中交戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185355816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨星又一得","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185372200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一失，裝在水中，此謂空中交戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185372200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山與水俱屬吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185388584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交戰，用又半吉半凶，如是，正龍有不受其傷者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185388584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前面言水，水上挨星，若無凶星交戰，未可遽言其","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185404968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶未二句，與公位若來之意同耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185404968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先定來山後定向，聯珠不相放，須知細覔五行蹤，富貴","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185421352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結全也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185421352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773796890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節單就山上龍神而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185437736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊、天玉原以來山所受","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185454120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣與向上所受之氣，分爲兩局，然兩局又非截然","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185454120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路，故云聯珠不相放。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185454120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此不可約畧求之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185470504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須當","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細覔蹤跡，若是富貴悠久之地，必然來山是此卦，而","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首亦是此卦，一氣淸純，方得謂之全龍耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：先定來山者，先將山上星辰用得合法，山管","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185503272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人丁，故以山爲先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185503272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後定向者，向首一星，禍福之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185519656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柄，水主財祿，故以向爲後也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185519656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山向雖有先後之分，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185536040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共用則一，故云不相放。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185536040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細覔五行踪者，要在翻天","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185552424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080264461516834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒地中細覔也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185552424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全龍者，向首是此一卦，來山亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185568808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一卦氣質清純，陰陽相配，此謂之全龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185585192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行若然翻値向，百年子孫旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185601576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽配合亦同論，富貴","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185617960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此中尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185617960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節亦上二句言山上龍神，下二句言水裏龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185634344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185650728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行翻値向者，五行之旺氣值向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185650728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻卽翻天倒地之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185667112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻，言生旺氣翻𭛬向上生入也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185667112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山管人丁，故云百年","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185683496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺，而富貴亦在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185683496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽配合，水來配合也，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185699880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦與向上之氣同論，但用法有殊耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185699880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水管財祿，故云","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185716264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079880825241637"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴此中尋，而子孫亦在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185716264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：翻卽翻天倒地之翻。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185732648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行値向者，天元九氣","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185749032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之正星翻値向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185749032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽配合者，陽水陰山，雌雄配","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185765416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，元竅相通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185765416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻倒雖有山水之分，其用則一，故","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185781800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰亦同論。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185781800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽山水隂陽顛倒顛之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185798184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東西父母三般卦，算値千金價。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185814568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四路出，高官緋紫","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185830952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人長安。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185830952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母不是未爲好，無官只豪富。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185847336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節發明用卦之理，重卦體而輕爻，重父母而輕胎","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185863720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息，葢同一生旺，而力量懸殊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185863720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言東西而南北全其","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185880104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080264461582370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185880104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青囊天王之秘，只有三般卦訣，若二十四路不","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185896488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出三般之内，則貴顯何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185896488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然卦內又當問其是卦之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185912872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母否。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185912872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高官緋紫，必是父母之氣，源大流長，所以貴","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185929256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185929256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非父母而但乘爻神子息之旺，則得氣淺薄，僅","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185945640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可豪富而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185945640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此陰彼陽，此東彼西。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185962024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名無定名，位無定","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185978408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185978408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽顚倒，變化錯縱，方是眞元空。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733185994792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186011176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞五行，真血脉，眞龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186011176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘呆法，硬派某工","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186027560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬陽，某千属陰，某山旺某元，某水旺某運者，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186027560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773862426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞諦何曾夢見耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186027560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東西卽顚倒，父曰卽陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186043944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186043944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三般卽顚倒顚天空起父母之三般，此三。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186060328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"般總由日月往來，運行遷謝，父母陰陽，隨時","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186076712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而在者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186076712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體與用各有陰陽父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186093096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用有隨","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186109480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機建極之父母，隨时變易之陰陽，體有重卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186109480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕爻，重父母而輕子息之趨避。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186109480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公恐人誤","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186125864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會，故又翻覆詳辨之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186125864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母排來看左右，向首分休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186142248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙山雙向水，零神富貟","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186158632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"永無貧，若遇正神須改絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186158632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行當分別隔向，𠤪神伸子","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347707432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當干萬細推詳，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦承上文用卦須父母而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母排來，要排來山之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186191400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍脈也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186191400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山屈曲，必不能盡屬父母，兼看左右兩爻","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186207784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子息若何。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186207784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子息敗絶不雜，又須向首所受之氣，逢","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186224168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺則休，遇衰敗則咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186224168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雙山雙向，卦氣錯雜，須得","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186240552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之外氣悉屬零神剋入相助，則雙山雙向爲水神","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186240552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所制伏，而富貴可期矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186240552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬一水路又屬正神，則生出","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186256936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋出，兩路皆空，而敗絶不能免矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186256936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公位之說，乃曰：洛","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書八卦，震、兑坎矣，而定孟、仲、季三子之，而隔向一神","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080289958625331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶在離卦之内，故云仲子天玉，畧露一班，以爲分房","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取騐之矩矱。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言仲而孟季，可以類推矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186289704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解山向乃穴之主腦，吉以萬端，從則而出，順逆","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186306088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽，從此而分。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186306088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用雙山五行之山，雙山五行之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186322472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向，卦氣巳屬兩家，左右順逆仍𡱆一氣者無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186322472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186338856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用零神，毫無夾雜，亦能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186338856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法所坐所向之方，界","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186355240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎半陰半陽之地，水神又在不零不正之間。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186355240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186371624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲謂之左非左，謂之右非右，謂之正非正，謂之零","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186371624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非零矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186371624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山向水神生出剋出，敗絶，必不能免矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186388008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去雙","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186404392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347740200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山雙向，卦氣旣屬不一，則九星從何氣而分其陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186404392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，從何卦而別其順逆乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186404392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當分則者，謂當分坐山。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186420776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得何五行，向首，得何五行，知坐山向首之五行，則","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186437160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某山吉，某山凶，某水合，某水不合，不辨而自明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186437160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云隔向一神者，帝釋是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186453544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗術分房之說，都","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186469928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以左爲長，右爲季，面前爲仲，註云隔向一神，猶在","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186469928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宫之內，葢指一時一氣，一宮一向而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186469928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186486312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運變遷，斗轉星移，則隔向一神亦隨之而變易矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186486312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔向一神旣隨之而變易，則孟仲亦隨之而更換，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186502696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080289958723635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷非左孟右季之呆法也可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186502696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行公位看順逆，接得方奇特。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186519080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮位若來見逆龍，男女","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186535464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失其蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186535464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承上文仲子一神而槩言公位之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186551848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順則生旺，逆則","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186568232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186568232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不云生死，而云順逆者，若論山上龍神，則以","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186584616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣爲順，死氣爲逆；若論水裏龍神，則又以死氣爲","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186584616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順，生氣爲逆故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186584616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解公位，卽孟仲季分房之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186601000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順逆卽往來得失","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186617384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之屬。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186617384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"接得云者，其現在與將來相接也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733186633768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現在與將","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327618100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347805736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來相接，方爲奇特。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327618100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如與過去已往者相接，便謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327634484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327634484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有半與將來相接，半與已往相接，亦謂之逆，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327650868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是有失院之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327650868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註中以生氣爲順，死氣爲逆，專","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327667252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指山上排龍而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327667252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論水裏排龍，則又以生氣爲","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327683636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得，死氣爲失，顚之倒之，所謂水用逆星仍用順，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327683636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同此意。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327683636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看父母下三吉三般卦第，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327700020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通篇皆明父母三般卦理，反覆詳盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327700020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終篇復申言","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327716404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，若曰：于言萬語，只有此一事而已，無復他說矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327716404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327732788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080289958756403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致其可嚀反覆之意云。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327732788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解三吉卽一元三吉，三般卽顚倒顛玄空起父","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327749172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母之三般。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327749172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"習是術而不知此三般起父母之奥，一","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327765556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切說玄說妙，總屬胡言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327765556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反覆可嚀，不過反覆詳盡","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327781940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327781940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内傳中","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327798324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山起八宮貪巨武輔雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327798324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四邊盡是逃亡穴，下後","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327814708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327814708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節反言以見旨興起下文之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327831092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言一行所作小遊","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327847476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347871272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年卦例，以二十四山起八宫，而取貪、巨、武、輔爲四吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327847476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若其說果是，則宜乎隨手下穴皆吉地矣，何以四邊","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327863860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡是逃亡穴，下後反令人敗绝哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327863860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則知卦例不足信，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327880244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而別有眞機，如下文所云也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327880244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解八宮卦例，以八卦之陰陽分順逆，并有以六","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327896628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十四卦每卦分得八卦定吉凶者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327896628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
