{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有挨星爲最貴，泄漏天機秘。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327929396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327945780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然安在内，家活","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327962164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當富貴；天機若然安在外，家活漸退敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327962164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星配出九星","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327978548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080660336508978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名，天下任横行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327978548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緊接上文。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733327994932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦例既不可用，惟有挨星、玄空大五行，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328011316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陰陽之最貴者。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328011316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機秘密，不可流傳于世，但可偶","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328027700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一泄漏而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328027700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安在内，不出三般卦之内也，安在外，出","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328044084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三般卦之外？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328044084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出卦不出卦，禍福逈分，安得不貴耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328060468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328076852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨星五行，非如遊年卦例，但取四吉而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328076852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人卦五","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328093236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行配出九星，上應斗約，知九星之作用，便可能行，天","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328093236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下無不響應矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328093236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦例云乎哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328109620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解法將得時得合之星，安合時合局之水，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328126004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347904040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安右內，自有富貴之應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328126004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若令星不得其所，謂之安","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328142388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在外，自有退敗之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328142388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在山在水一同論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328158772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星配","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328175156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出九星，卽八卦配出九宫，九宮分作三元，如此推","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328175156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度，行乎天下，無不響應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328175156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執定卦例之說者，宜細推","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328191540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，方知此是彼非。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328191540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云最貴者，謂法之最貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328207924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328224308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳之後，切不可浪泄天機，輕示非人，以招造物之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328224308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328240692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是法始于晉，盛于居，自五代及宋元，注書立","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328257076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說者數十百家，諸法雜出，以僞亂眞，紛紛聚訟，龍","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328257076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇莫辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328257076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于是有心者無所依歸，求食者藉爲憑信。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328273460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080110773927962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則僞者日益盛，眞者日益失矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328289844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十維乾艮巽坤王陽順星辰輪支神，坎震離兌癸，陰卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328306228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行取分定。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328306228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽歸雨略，順逆推排去。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328322612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知生知死亦知","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧，留取敎皃孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節分出玄空大卦干支定位，以足前篇父母子息","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328355380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328355380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四維之卦，以天干爲主者也，干維日陽；四正之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328371764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，以地支爲主者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328371764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支曰陰，此陰陽非交媾之陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328388148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328388148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知卦之所主，則父母子息不問而自明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328404532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽兩路，每一卦中皆有陰陽兩路可分，非將八卦分","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347936808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兩路，何者屬陰，何者屬陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其順逆推排，卽陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328437300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路分定之法，非乾艮巽坤爲陽順，坎震離、兌爲陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328437300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328437300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如此分輪，則皆順也，何云逆乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328453684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于四卦之未，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328470068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各綴一字，曰王曰癸，此又挨星秘中之秘，可以心傳，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328470068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不可以顯言者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328470068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解四維之卦，以乾坤艮巽爲主，四正之卦，以子","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328486452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午卯酉爲主，知卦之所主，卽知卦之父母子息矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328486452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此卽知何者属陽，何者屬陰，空中分陰陽，定五","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328502836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，辨順逆之法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328502836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言壬癸，是隨時而在之壬","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328519220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605407258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，非方位干支之壬癸，即在在之王癸，亦有陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328519220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路可分。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328519220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當細細揣之，自得在氣不在方之訣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328535604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽，子午卯酉，皆卦之中氣，卦之中氣爲","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328551988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母，偏傍兩爻爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328551988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地父母三般卦，時師未會話。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328568372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空大卦神仙說，本是","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328584756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此經訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328584756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不說宗枝但亂傳，開口莫胡言。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328601140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還不信此經","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328617524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文，但覆古人墳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328617524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰天地，曰東西，曰父母，曰玄空，曰挨星，異名而同實。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328633908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若于字義屑屑分疏，則支離矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328650292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節葢恐學者得傳","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328666676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080484347969576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之後，以爲太易而輕忽之，故極言贊美，以鄭重其辭，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328666676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非別有他義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328666676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說到覆古人墳，是徵信實著子得傳","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328683060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以來，洞徹玄空之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328683060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今故注此經文，駁前人之謬，直","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328699444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捷了當，畧無畏縮，皆取信干覆古人墳，葢騐之已往，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328699444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"證之將來，深信其一毫之無誤，自許心契古人，而可","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328699444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以告無罪于萬世也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328699444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：天地卽干支，父母，是變易干支之父母三般，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328715828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽翻天倒地，顚倒二十四龍之三般。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328715828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗枝者，起父母","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328732212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之宗枝也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328732212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起父母之宗枝，若不從此三般，便是僞","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328748596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605472794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328748596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此三般卦訣，秘密深藏，貴在心傳，難以言顯。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328764980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公說到覆古人墳，葢驗之已往，卽可証之將來，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328781364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深信其一亳無訛耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328781364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分郤東西兩個卦，會者傳天下，學取仙人經，一宗切莫","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328797748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂談空。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328797748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行山下問來由，入首便知蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328814132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦叮嚀告戒之語，而歸重于入首，葢入首一節，初","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328830516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年立應，尤不可不愼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328830516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：分者，卽分元空顚倒之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328846900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元空顚倒之機，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328863284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以來者爲東，往者爲西，陽者爲東，陰者爲西，動","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328863284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079814957940776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者爲東，靜者爲西，非世俗以坎離震、兌分東四也，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328863284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又非以十二支左兼右兼水法之左到右到分東","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328863284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328863284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩個是言隨時而在之陰陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328879668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能分得在","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328896052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在之陰陽，則知此陰彼陽，此東彼西之兩個矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328896052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曉","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328912436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此兩個定卦分星之奥，下卦起星之訣，畧見一","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328912436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"班矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328912436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分定子孫十二位，災禍相連値。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328928820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千災萬禍小人知。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328945204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋者","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328961588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論宗枝。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328961588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節直紏時師怢認子孫之害。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328977972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子孫自卦中分出。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733328994356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605505562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位位不同，豈如俗師干從支，支從干，二十四路止作","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329010740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二位論。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329010740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如此論法，必致葬者災禍相連値矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329027124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329043508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遭災禍，而俗師終不知所以災禍之故，胡猜亂猜，或","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329043508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云千凶，或云支凶，總非眞消息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329043508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫災禍之發，乃龍","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329059892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣受剋所致，而龍氣之受剋，實不在干支，葢有爲干","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329059892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支之宗者焉，所謂父母是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329059892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知其宗之受剋，則知干","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329076276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支亦隨之而受剋，所以不免災禍耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329076276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深言十二位分","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329092660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫之說之謬如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329092660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解當世所用雙山五行之法，呆將二十四山分","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329109044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079814957973544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作十二位，論陰陽，辨順逆，總由不知願佛顚玄空","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329109044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起父母之宗枝也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329109044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空起父母之宗枝，二十四山","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329125428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽不一，顚倒無定，隨氣運行，隨時變易，乃是","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329125428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞玄空、眞陰陽、眞五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329125428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘呆法，硬派某干屬","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329141812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，某干屬陰者，斷非知音之輩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329141812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行位中出一位，仔細秘中記。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329158196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假若來龍骨不眞，從此","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329174580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誤于人。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329174580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節又詳言出卦不出卦之密旨。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329190964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢同一出位，而有","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329207348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦内卦外之不同，若在卦内，則似出而非出，若在卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329207348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080660336607282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外，則眞出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329207348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此中有秘，當密密記之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329223732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在卦內則龍骨","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329240116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞，在卦外則龍骨不眞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733329240116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解地卦不山，天卦不合，即謂卦外；地卦出而天","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973540864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦不出，是謂卦内。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973540864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦内云者，在天心生旺之卦内","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973557248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973557248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出一位，卽己丙亥士、申庚寅甲之出一位，曉得","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973573632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出一位之眞訣，隨手拈來，無非妙用。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973573632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂不眞者，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973590016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非龍脉、石骨、水口種種之不眞，是挨星訣之眞不","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973590016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973590016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不得眞訣，所誤豈止千人而已哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973606400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出一位，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973622784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即是兼貪兼","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973622784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輔之出一位，山水錯雜，用合補救，此謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079814958006312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之骨眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973622784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又名卦內水，有三吉四吉，元空僅得其二。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973639168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽謂不真，又名卦外富，細細也之，自少悞人之作矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973655552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一個排來千百個，莫把星辰錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973671936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍要合向，向合水，水合","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973688320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王，吉位，合祿合馬合官星，本卦生旺尋，合凶合吉合祥","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973688320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑞，何法能趨避？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973688320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看大歲是何神，立地見分明，成敗定","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973704704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷何公位。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973704704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合年中是","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973721088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一個排來，變化不一，故有千百個也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973721088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍向水相合，前","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973737472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇已盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973737472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬官星在本卦生旺則應，不然則不應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973753856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973770240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見生旺爲重，而祿馬官星在所輕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973770240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080660336640050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解合而爲一，散而爲九，縱橫顚例，流轉星辰，變","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973786624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易不一，陰陽無定。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973786624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千百個者，甚言陰陽之千變無","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973803008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973803008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰錯，非爲合官合貴之錯，正言不合生旺","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973819392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973819392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍向水都合生旺，再合之以官貴，自然應騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973835776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘不合生旺空亡，祿馬貴人，有何益哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973852160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言太歲","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973868544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合，總論錯不錯之應騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973868544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排星保細看五行，看自何卦生來山，八卦不知踪，八卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973884928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星空，順逆排來各不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973884928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大卦在其中，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973901312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行總在何卦中生，不在干支中定，所謂父母子息","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973901312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079814958055464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973901312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知八卦踪跡從何而來，則九星無處排矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973917696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢星","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973934080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之順逆各有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973934080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此一卦人用或當順推，或富","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973950464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆推，有一定之氣，而無一定之用，所謂天下諸書對","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973950464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973950464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要而言之，則玄空二字之義盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973966848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解何卦生，葢言何元之生旺，何運之主張。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973983232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973999616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，天心流轉之五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733973999616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心流轉之機，總在何卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974016000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所主，何卦之所生，仔細査准，然後分陰陽，定五","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974016000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，則知何山當順推五行，何山當逆挨九星。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974016000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974032384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知何卦所生，何卦所主之踪跡，八卦九星豈非空","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974032384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605538330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974032384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此一卦用於此處當順用，於彼處當逆用。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974048768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此時當順用，於彼時當逆，此乃天卦在中之所","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974065152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974065152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚丙壬俱屬陽，順推五行詳；乙辛丁癸俱屬陰，逆推","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974081536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974081536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽順逆不同途，須向此中求。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974097920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星雙起雌雄","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974114304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異，玄關眞妙處。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974114304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此畧舉干神卦氣之例。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974130688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽四干則順推八卦，陰四干","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974147072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則逆推八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974147072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一順一逆，雖不同途，而此中有一定之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974163456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣，可深求而得者。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974163456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至其每卦之中，皆有一雌一雄","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974179840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080300733710371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙雙起之洪，乃陰陽交媾玄關妙處也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974179840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又不止一卦","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974196224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一卦之用，而己舉八干而支神之法亦在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974196224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解所言甲庚是來何地，落何宮，隨氣變易之甲","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974212608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚非東甲西庚之方位。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974212608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如拘於東西甲庚之方位，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974228992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則二十四山宜有一定，何來有時占陽，有時喚陰","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974228992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之更變耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974228992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占陽卽陽，喚陰卽陰，豈非九星雙起，一","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974245376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山兩用之元關耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974245376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東西二卦眞竒異，須知本向水本向。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974261760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本水四神奇，代代","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974278144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"著緋衣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974278144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605571098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節又重言向水各一卦氣，兼收生旺之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974294528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上有","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974310912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩神，水上有兩神，故曰四神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974310912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解二卦者，山有山之卦氣，水有水之卦氣，山有","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974327296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之用法，水有水之用法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974327296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本向本水者，水得本","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974343680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元之水，向得本元之向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974343680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上有兩神，水上有兩","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974360064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，此謂四神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974360064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四神當在陰陽交會上推算，不在","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974376448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"別處也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974376448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水得本元之水，自無上山之患，山得本元","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974392832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之山，自無下水之病矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974392832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流出卦有何全？","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974409216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一代作官員，一折，一代爲官祿，二折","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974425600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079672775245824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二代福，三折父母共長流。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974425600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬上錦衣遊，馬上斬頭水山","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974441984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦一代爲官罷，直山直水去，無翻塲務小官班。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974441984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不出卦須折，折在父母本宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974458368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若折出本宫，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974474752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖折而","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974474752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後代不發矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974474752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬上斬頭卽一折，父母便流出卦，如斬","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974491136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭而去也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974491136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木卦水又以曲折爲貴，乃許世代高官，若","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974507520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止直流，雖然本卦而官職卑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974507520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節專言曲水之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974523904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有一兩曲者，有八","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974540288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曲者。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974540288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：水曲則氣動，水折則氣活。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974556672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水法雖以","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974573056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲爲吉，然曲多則易犯，出卦必須曲曲折折，都在","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974573056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605603866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣之內，一宫之間，方爲上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974573056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錦衣云者，甚言典","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974589440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不出之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974589440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一曲一折，便屬零正混淆，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974605824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾雜，卽爲出卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974605824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有近水清純，遠水雜亂者，亦有","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974622208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠水淸純而近水錯雜者，亦謂之出卦，自有一代","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974622208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之應騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974622208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂塲務小宮者，是言直來直去之應","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974638592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974638592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內傳下：","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974654976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾山乾向水朝乾，乾峯出狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974654976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯山卯向迎源水，驟富","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974671360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右崇比。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974671360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午山午向午，來堂，大將値邊疆。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974687744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤山坤向水地","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974704128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080707358883892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流，富貴永無休。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974704128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此明玄空大卦向水兼收之法，舉四山以例其餘，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974720512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦內之淸純者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974720512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾宫卦內之山，作乾宫卦內之向，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974736896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而收乾宫卦内之水，則龍向、水三者俱歸生旺矣，非","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974736896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囘龍顧祖之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974736896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或云狀元，或云大將，或云驟富者，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974753280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦錯舉以見意，不可拘執。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974753280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：乾山者，乾運卦内之山也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974769664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾向者，乾運卦内","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974786048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974786048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾水乾峯者，水亦乾運卦内之水，峯亦乾","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974802432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運卦內之峯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974802432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然非坐水之說，其訣可以一語破","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974818816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605636634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974818816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上水上之星，卽山上之星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974835200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨得陰陽兩路行五星要分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974851584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泥鰍浪裏跳，龍門渤海","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974867968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便翻身。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974867968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽兩路，上文屢見，此重言以由明之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974884352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下二句言","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974900736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變化之易。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974900736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：辨卽辨立空變易之陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974917120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨淸玄空變易之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974917120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽，自曉陰陽順逆之兩路矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974917120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣識兩路，再辨山","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974933504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上水裏之宜忌，氣運消長之得失，陽水陰山之配","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974933504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，兼貪兼輔之得宜，目能一葬，便興魚龍變化於","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974933504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080707358965812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頃刻間也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974933504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依得四神爲第一，官職無休息。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974949888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴上八卦要知情，穴内","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974966272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦裝淸。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974966272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇本向本水四神奇，是姑置來龍，而但重向水。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974982656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974999040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節穴上八卦要知情，又從穴上逆推到來龍，以補四","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974999040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733974999040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴上是龍，穴內卽向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975015424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：依者，承上文而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975031808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文專言向水上之四","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975048192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，此節兼山向水而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975048192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴中指山，穴內言水，山","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975064576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上水裏各有兩神，故曰四神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975064576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四神先要曉得何","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975080960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080428605669402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山得何五行，何水得何五行，細細裝淸，方知山上","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975080960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得何兩神，向首得何兩神，水裏得何兩神，如是可","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975080960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得四神之㨗訣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975080960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要求富貴三般卦，出卦家貧乏。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975097344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥水來長，五行","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975113728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向中藏，辰戍丑未叩，金龍動得永不窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975113728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還借庫富，後","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975130112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧，自庫樂長春。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975130112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇甲庚壬丙一節，是四正之卦，此節又補四隅之","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975146496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975146496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此，則支水去來凶之言，當活看，不可死看矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097733975162880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549798946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍丑未雖俗云四庫，其實立空，不重墓庫之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549798946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借庫","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549815330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080707359014964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出卦也，自庫不出卦也，是重在出卦，不出卦，不重墓","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549815330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549815330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：寅申己亥，辰戍丑未，俱屬四維之爻神。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549831714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549848098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽大元空九星五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549848098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"tex {"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叩金龍向中藏者，是言水","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549864482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裏龍神得與失也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549864482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得爲動，又謂自庫，不得卽謂出","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549880866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，又謂借庫。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549880866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借庫自庫，不論水之去來，總要得五","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549897250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行生旺之氣，不必拘於庫與不庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549897250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師一見","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549913634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水來，便云立某向，收某方水來爲長生水到堂左。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549913634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水到右者，當立陽向，如右水到左者，當立陰向。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549930018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549946402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080555168645171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生官旺方水宜來，衰病死絶方水宜去，去處必須","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549946402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丑戍水方便爲歸庫。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549946402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九州一例，中外皆然，深可","lo {"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都星起何方是五行長生旺火斾相對起，高岡職位","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549979170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在學堂，捍門官國華表起，山水亦同例。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549979170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水秀峯奇出大","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549995554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，四位一般看。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734549995554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節言水上星辰，卽山上星辰，只要得生旺之氣，在","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550011938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山在水一同論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550011938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節言山上水某，左右功曹龍虎案托捍門","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550028322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080707359080500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華表，貴得生旺之氣，在山在水一囘論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550028322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離水火中天過龍墀移帝座，寶葢鳳閣四維朝寶殿","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550044706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登龍樓。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550044706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"罪刼弔殺休犯著，四墓多銷鑠。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550061090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離水火一句，乃一章之所重。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550093858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘星宿，總是得生","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550110242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則加之美名，逢死絕則稱爲惡曜，名非有定星隨","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550110242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550110242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：中天過，移帝座，卽江南龍來江北望之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550126626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550143010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘星宿名非有定星隨氣變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550143010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝釋，丙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550192162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八武，王也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550208546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微，亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550224930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝釋神之最尊，故以","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550241314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縣府名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550241314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其實陰陽二宅，得此貴之極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550257698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然其妙用","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550274082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在乎倒排，非正用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550274082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解註云：最尊最貴，貴不在乎帝釋，而貴在紫微，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550290466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與八武同到也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550290466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然其妙用在乎倒排，非正排也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550306850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550323234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云倒排，卽顚倒顚之倒排，非左旋右到之倒排也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550323234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得父母三般卦，便是眞神路。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550339618","marginNoteI
