{"lines":[{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上二句引起下文之義，言識得三卦父母，已是眞神","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550372386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路矣，猶須曉得北斗七星打劫之法，則三般卦之精。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550372386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髓方得而最上一乘之作用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550388770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗云何？","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550405154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知離宫之","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550421538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相合，卽知北斗之義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550421538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解父母是經四位之父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550437922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三般是坎至巽，巽至","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550454306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌，兌至坎，顚倒顚之三般。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550454306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此顚倒顚玄空起父","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550470690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母之三般，庚是大玄空之神路矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550470690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗者，隨時立","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550487074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550487074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時立極之氣，曰往月來，星移斗轉，縱","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550503458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080660336705586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫顚倒，總由此而使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550503458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七星者，由現在而逆推","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550519842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到第七。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550519842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此處五行正與立極之氣相反，最易發","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550536226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550536226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要相合者，要使發禍者變而爲發福，相反者轉","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550552610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而爲相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550552610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉四龍岡，作祖人財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550568994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水長百里佐君王。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550585378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水短","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550601762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550601762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取子午卯酉，以其父母氣旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550618146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言四正，則四維可以","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550634530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例推矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550634530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水短遭傷，以其出卦之故。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550650914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解四正之卦，以地支爲主，四隅之卦，以乾坤艮","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550667298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081035676385320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550667298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水二龍，均以此爲父母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550683682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節專辨","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550700066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水二龍干支卦位之父母子息，以辨力量之輕","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550700066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550700066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得陰陽兩路行，富貴達京城。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550716450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不識陰陽兩路行，萬丈","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550732834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火坑深。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550732834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比卽顚顚倒之意，皆上文所已言而詠嘆之。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550749218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此識得二字，明明對習術者而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550765602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識待，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550781986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識隨時而在之陰陽，曉得隨在之陰陽，陰陽二宅，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550781986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自能得心應手，名並管郭，流傳千古也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550781986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘不識此","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550798370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080555168792627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣，胡行亂作，火坑之深淺，豈可窮其丈尺也哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550798370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前兼龍神前兼向，聯珠莫相放。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550814754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後兼龍神後兼向，排定","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550831138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽算。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550831138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明得零神與正神，指日入靑雲；不識零神與正","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550847522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，代代絕除根。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550847522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍神向首，皆有兼前兼後之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550863906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼者，父母兼子息，子","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550880290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息兼父母，此卽正神、零神之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550880290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解前兼後兼，卽領前顧後之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550896674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前兼者，向上排。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550913058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550929442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上旣得生旺，排到來山，又生來山之生旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550945826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂之前兼。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550945826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後兼者，山上排龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550962210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上旣得生旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550978594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081035676450856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排到向首，又生向首之生旺，此謂之後兼。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550978594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前與後，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550994978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零與正，陰與陽，總要排定何處得零，何處得正，分","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550994978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"別陰陽，前後推算。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734550994978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得夫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551011362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒排父母是，眞龍子息達天聰。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551027746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順排父母倒，子息代代","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551044130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人財退。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551044130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母子息皆須倒排而不用順排。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551060514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如旺氣在坎癸，倒","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551076898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排則不用坎癸而得眞旺氣；順排則眞用坎癸而反","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551076898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得殺奄矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551076898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似是而非，毫釐千里。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551093282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空大卦，千言萬語，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551109666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟在于此。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551109666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080555168825395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解註云：旺氣在坎癸，倒排則不用坎癸而得眞","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551126050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣者，讀者須從廉武上去推求，順排則真用坎","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551126050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸而反得其殺氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551126050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看五六不知到何卦位耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551142434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一龍宫中水便行，子息受艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551158818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四三二一龍逆去，四子","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551175202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"均榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551175202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍行位遠主離郷，四位發經商。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551191586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此飾又申言本卦水須折折相顧，若一折之後，便出","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551207970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本卦，雖然得發，必受艱辛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551207970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必三四節逆去，皆在本","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551224354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，乃諸子齊發也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551224354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位遠卽出卦，一出卦卽主離鄕，若","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551240738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出卦之後，又還歸本卦，反主爲商得財而歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551240738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其應騐","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551257122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080300733808675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之不爽如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551257122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551273506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一龍者，一節水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551289890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一節之後，便流出卦，子孫","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551306274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖發，必受艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551306274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四三二一龍逆去者，巽、震、坤、坎，逆","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551322658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流而去也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551322658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位遠離鄕，言近水旣流，出卦畧遠，又還","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551339042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸本卦，見孫自有此應。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551339042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師不識挨星學，只作天心摸。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551355426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東邊財糓引歸西北到","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551371810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551371810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推老龍終日卧山中，何嘗不易逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551388194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止是自家眼不","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551404578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"的，亂把山岡覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551404578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東邊財糓二句託喻，卽江南龍來江北望之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734551420962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空","logicSentenceId":"7679097734694961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054468646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734694961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘆息世人不得眞傳，胡行亂走，㫖哉言乎！","logicSentenceId":"7679097734694977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解東引西歸，北到南推二語，眞青囊之秘，天玉","logicSentenceId":"7679097734694993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書之奥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734694993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老龍者，是玄空運行之龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695010319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄空運","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之龍，自有玄空尋覔之法，反從山岡上去𡬶覔，","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何異刻舟求劍耶！","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人不知天機秘，洩破有何益？","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695043087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汝今傳得地中仙，玄空","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695059471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙難言，翻天倒地更，玄玄，大卦不易傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695059471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有收山出煞","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣，亦兼爲汝說相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地能幾人，個個是知心。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695092239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還求","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695108623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地不種德，穩口深藏舌。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695108623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347079672775278592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇終述敘授受之意，深戒曾公安之善寶之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695125007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結語","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695141391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸重于種德。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695141391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之得傳者，不愼擇入，輕泄浪示，恐雖","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695157775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得吉地，不能實受其福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695157775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而泄天寶者，重違先師之","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695174159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒，其不干造物之怒，而自取禍咎者幾希矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695174159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此法造物之所忌，先師之所秘，恐人輕洩，故","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695190543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於篇終特又叮嚀敎戒之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695190543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穩口穩口，無取災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695206927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理辨正卷之三終。","logicSentenceId":"7679097734695223311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080660336771122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公妙訣不多言，實實作堺傳。人生禍福由天定，賢達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能安命，貧賤安墳富貴興。至憑龍穴眞龍在山中，不出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山，掛在大山間。若是沙曲星辰正，收得陽神定斷然。二孔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬便興隆，父發子傳榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淬正。直解卷乙四都天實照經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080824321212467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏口：此三節專論深山出脈，老龍幹氣生出嫩支道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此節論深山者，龍幹氣專取嫩枝之法，謂旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得嫩枝，再求真穴情形，再看主山端正，峯巒秀美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣充足，砂水朝歸，再兼用法，處處得宜，自有一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬便興之應。龍在山中不出山，掛在大山問者，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言老幹抽出嫩枝之情狀也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好龍脫刼出平洋，百十里來長。離祖離宗星辰出，此是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三眞龍骨前途節節出兒。一孫文武脉中分，直見大溪方住","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548419636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手。諸山皆不走，個個阿頭向。穴前城郭要周完。水口亂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石堆，水中此地出豪雄。若得遠來龍，脫刦發福無休歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴見陽神三摺朝，此地出官僚。不問三男并五子，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"房房起。津湖溪澗同，此看衣祿榮華斷。大水大河齊到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處，干里來龍住水口。羅星鑞住門，似大將屯軍。落頭定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三星形，非火土卽金。正脉落平三五里，見水方能止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二水相交不用砂，只要石如麻。更看硤石高山鎻，密密","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來包裏。此是軍州大地形。細說與君聽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此二節專言大幹傳變行龍盡結之穴，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"里口。都天寳照下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080894676615177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫刼龍，又名出洋龍，雖云城郭要周完，網之城郭都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在龍身上見，不必王穴上見。葢龍到脫刼岀洋，雖衆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山擁衞，而行前數節，羣支翼張，羽儀簇簇，至王幾經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫卸之后，近身數節，將結口穴時，龍之踪跡愈變，而龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之機勢愈疾，此非左右二砂所能幾及。待往龍只單","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，譬之大將匹馬間刀，所向無前，二時偏裨小狡，都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"追從不及，所以有不用砂之說也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。高山不甚重水，獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等龍穴以水爲證者何與？山剛水柔，水隨山之行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爲行，山不隨水之止以爲止，而云直見大溪方住","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548485172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非謂山脉遇水而正也，正因山脉行時，水不得不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可口，曰口人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與之俱行，則山脉息時，水不得不與之俱息，故幹龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大盡之地，自然兩水交環，有似乎干里來龍遇水而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。旣云不用砂，而又云密密包衰者，何也？夫結穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之處，雖不取必于兩砂齊抱，要之真龍煦息之際，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口口可口口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不孤行，外纒夾輔，隱隱祖從，水口星辰有時出視，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲硤石，小爲羅星，近在政里，遠之二三十里，皆不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拘。前所謂砂，指木身龍虎而言，後所謂鎻，指外護捍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門而言也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。只要石如麻，則不止謂水口而己。正言本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都天寶照經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054566950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身結穴之地。葢幹龍剝慎數十節，其波水崩洪，穿田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過硤，不止三處，若非石骨龍行，何以見眞龍結體？今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人平地暾阜，娛認來龍，指爲大地，正坐此弊也。几去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山數里，卽有高阜，或由人工，或出天造，旣無眞脉相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連，又不見石骨稷起，總不謂之龍穴。所以落平之龍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人重起星辰，必要石如麻也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。有石脉乃爲真龍，有石穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃爲眞穴。山龍五星皆結穴，其云落頭一星獨取火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士金者，大約近祖支龍，宛蜒而下，都結水木，出洋幹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結，踴躍而起，都作火土金。雖不可盡拘，而大體有如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548517940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二是者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。前章三葬便興，父潑子榮，是言山中支結，龍穉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而而局窄，往往易發。此章言發福無休歇，五子房房起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力以人七以口人乙口口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恩，是言出洋大盡，龍老而局寛，往往涯發而久長，意在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圜言表也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口姜氏曰：前章言山谷初落之穴，此言出洋盡結之穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍之法，雖不盡于此，而大畧已備干此矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上節言老龍幹結，此節言出洋盡結。大凡龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣落平，穿江渡河，脫卸淨盡，再起星峯者，謂之脫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫，又名出洋。氣勢踴躍，干變無窮，難於言狀，只可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨正。直解人卷之四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"都天寳照經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080894676697097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言其大槩情形耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下軍州總住空，何曾擇著後頭龍，只向水神朝處取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫說後無主立穴。動静中間求，須看龍到頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節以下，皆發明平洋龍格，與山龍無涉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二、楊公，唐末人。唐之言軍州，猶今之言郡縣也。葢以軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二州爲證，見城邑鄕村，人家墓宅，几落平洋，址，不論後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二龍來脉，但取水神期繞，便爲眞龍憩息之鄕。口。夫地靜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而物也，水動，物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人人口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。水之所止，卽是地脉所鍾，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動三靜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之間陰陽交媾，雌雄牡牡，化育萬物之源，所謂玄竅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548550708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相通，卽丹家玄關一竅也。此便是龍之到頭，非舍陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽父會之所，而別尋龍之到頭也。識得此竅，則知平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洋眞龍訣法，而杨公寶照之秘旨盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"看龍到頭有口訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：動靜二字，其說有三：一、山形才勢，有陰陽動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜之分；一干支卦位，有陰陽動靜之分；一、天主動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地主靜，天地有陰陽動靜之分。天主動，卽其至動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之中，亦有四時往來，陰陽動靜之分；地主靜，卽其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至靜之中，亦有起伏行止，陰陽動靜之分。天以靜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而生，地以動而成，曉得至動之中有靜，至靜之中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080824321278003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有動。看龍到頭之法過半矣，立穴之法亦過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云到頭者，非山之到頭，又非水之到頭，正謂玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空生旺，到水謂之到頭也。此到頭二字，乃空龍之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙訣，當黙黙識之。隨時變易，顚倒無定者，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，止蓄團聚，干支純粹謂之靜。靜者安定于下，動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者流行于上。觀其靜與動，氣與質，相配相得之處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便是到頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"註云：另有口訣，大畧如是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公妙訣無多說，因見黃公心性拙，全憑掌上起星辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類聚装成爲妙訣，大山喚作破軍星，五星所聚脉難分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548583476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看出身一路脉，到頭要分水土金。又從分水脉存處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便把羅經照出路，節節同行過峽眞，前去必定有好處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子字出脉子字尋，莫敎差錯丑與壬。若是陽差與陰錯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君不必費心尋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868423262219/1-e44b5f1a5d837658.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ReP1Eb3uY%2B4Kq0nDVGDOSirIL3E%3D","uri":"read/NA02752/12/ref/1l0dqv4e2kr37/1-e44b5f1a5d837658.webp","fontType":1,"components":"木屝㐄","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868423262219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子可悟楊公心訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得口傳心受，縱智過千夫，讀破萬卷，何能道隻字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054632486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耶？此書乃楊公當日裝成掌誤，傳與黃居士妙應者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大山喚作破軍星，言水法渙散迷茫之處，五星混雜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出脉未見分明，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885296701479/1-22ce6b9508613304.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=EZWyqDG1svf46otqNX5yg8K7I78%3D","uri":"read/HY1496/7/ref/1kp70c4dm9yc3/1-22ce6b9508613304.webp","fontType":1,"components":"皀无木","variants":"㮣","charPicId":"7456690885296701479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名之曰破軍，而不入龍格，只取龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神一路出身之脉，其脉又分水、土、金三星，合貪、巨、武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲吉，而餘星皆所不取。此三星者，乃形局之星，非卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻方位之貪、巨、武也。學者切莫誤認，自分水脉脊以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下，乃屬方位理氣矣，故云便把羅經照出路也。葢看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得水神龍脉旣合三吉星格，其地似可取裁，乃將指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南辨其方位，以定卦之合不合也。合卦則用之，不合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548616244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦仍未可用也。節節同行，卦無偏雜，乃評其爲過脉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峽眞，而知前去定有好穴，不然，則行龍先見駁雜，到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭何處剪裁？子字以下，乃直指看龍訣法，而舉坎卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦爲例。若出脉是子字，須行龍只在子字一宫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內，乃爲卦氣淸純。如偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左而癸與丑雜，是子癸一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，而丑字又犯一卦也。如偏于右而壬與亥雜，是壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子一卦，而亥字又犯一卦也。此爲卦中之陽差陰錯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非全美之龍，故云不必費心尋也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解水法渙散之處，五星混雜，卦爻錯亂，最難分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054665254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨，只要貼身小水，引動龍神，有干流萬派都歸此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小水之情狀者，卽是一路出身脉也。此水之星體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情形、方位、干支曲直動靜，須辨合與不合，星體合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉則用之，不合則不必用之。所謂子字出脉子字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋，總言看龍之法，理氣之要，稍有不合，卽是陰差","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽錯之龍矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子癸午丁天元宫，卯乙酉辛一路同。若有山水一同到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半穴乾坤艮巽宮。取得輔星成五吉，山中有此是眞龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此承上節羅經□過峽，詳言方位理氣，卽天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081352849817635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉玄空大卦之作用也。其法分子午卯酉爲天元宮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥爲人元宮，辰戌丑未爲地元宮，隱然天元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙理，引而不發，欲使學者得訣方悟，其敢妄泄天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘犯造物之忌哉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"！此取四仲之支爲天元宮者，非此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四支皆屬天元，乃謂此四支之中有天元者存也。而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其本文又不正言子午卯酉，乙辛丁癸，必錯舉子癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午丁卯乙酉辛者。此其立言之法，己備出脉審峽，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦分星之𡪖旨。觀一路同三字，同中微異，須加剖别，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已在言外，下文乃全露其機云：此八宫同到，半穴乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054698022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮巽宮矣。一同到，非謂此八宮一同到也，亦非謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宮之山與八宮之水一同到也。謂此四支中任舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一支，與此四干中一干比肩同到，卽雜乾坤艮巽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣矣。葢子午卯酉本是四正之龍，而與八支同到，卽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一半四隅之龍，不可不辨。辨之不清，則欲取天元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而非純乎天元矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。末二句輔星五吉，指天元宮最親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者言。葢天元龍雖包諸卦，而九星止有三吉，恐日久","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發洩太盡，末肩衰徴，故須兼收輔弼宮龍神合氣入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴，以成五吉，然後一元而兼兩元，龍力悠遠不替矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081352849899555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故目之曰眞龍，極其贊美之辭也。此節言山者皆指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，葢平洋以水爲山水也，卽有山矣。輔星卽是九星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中左輔右弼，葢有二例。一則九宮卦例，以一白配貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狼，二黑配巨門，三碧配祿存，四綠配文曲，五黃配廉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貞，六白配武曲，七赤配破軍，八白配左輔，九紫配右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弼。此天玉經玄空大卦之定理也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。一則八宮卦例，將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼二星并一宮分配八卦，製爲掌訣。二十四山系","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於纳甲之下，五起貪狼，爲立向消水之用。陽宅、天醫、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德亦同此訣。竊以之彰往察來，皆無明驗。葢卽天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054730790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉所辨二十四山起八宮，唐一行所造，後人指爲滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蠻經者也。二說眞僞判然，不可誤認。五吉卽三吉，葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形局九星，以水、土、金三星爲貪、巨、武三吉，而輔弼爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入穴收氣之用。方位九星亦有三吉，雖以貪狼統龍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而毎宫自有三吉，不專取巨武。此節天元宮兼輔爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五吉，中有隱語，非筆墨所敢盡。旣云五吉，則分輔弼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作兩星，以配九宫，其非八宫之訣明矣。若在人地兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元，别有兼法，見諸下文。此節以下，所舉干支卦位，俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶隱謎，若從實推詳，不啻說要，非楊公言外之眞旨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081352849948707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解註云：輔星，天元宮之最親者，其言微乎玅乎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使人不易測識耳。楊公又云：山中有此是眞龍，明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明指我在水中，又不在天元之水中，正在天元最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親最近之水中。然取于六八者，非也。所云一同到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，一宫之水全到也。細玩其子，癸午、丁卯、乙酉辛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼已在言外矣。同到，卽巳丙亥、壬申、庚寅、甲、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、癸丑、乙辰、辛戌之同到。一同到，則卦爻雜亂，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽差錯，吉中有㐫，不成美器矣。差錯之所，雜亂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081136054779942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方，須挨輔星以補之，是輔星雖非當令之星，亦能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先時補救，化㐫而爲吉者也。所云取得輔星，卽此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂歟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未地元龍，乾坤艮巽夫婦宗。甲庚壬丙爲正向，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉取貪狼護正龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此取四季之支爲地元龍者，亦謂此四支中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有地元龍者存也。此四支原在乾坤良、巽卦内，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦宗。此元氣局逼隘，不能兼他元爲五吉，止取貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狼一星眞脉入穴，護衛正龍根本，則卦氣未値，其根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081694396022818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不搖；卦氣已過，源長流遠，斯爲作家妙用。貪狼卽在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚壬丙之中，故但于此取正向，乘正脉，與天人兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元廣收五吉者有殊，不言輔星、輔弼已在其中故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公著書，泛論錯舉之中，其金針玉線，一絲不漏，葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。地元卽下元逼隘，非形局之逼隘，氣運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之逼隘，故不曰五吉，而曰護正龍，卽八九一之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。然在此時不曰五吉者，何也？謂下元未蓋令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星弗得弗用；上元將交貪又弗得弗用。若兼巨武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181062182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而爲五吉，則吉㐫參半，非但不能爲福，適足致禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂㐫多者，凶勝吉也，豈非與天人兩元取五吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者有殊？作家不可不辨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥人元來，乙辛丁癸水來催。更取貪狼成五吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅坤申艮御門開。巳丙宜向天門上，亥壬向得巽風吹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此四孟之支，亦屬四隅卦，此四卦中有人元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍者存也。天元之後，卽應接人元。楊公因三才三正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之序，顚倒錯列，亦隱秘其天機，使人不易測識耳。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元龍格，亦必兼貪狼而後先榮後凋，若不兼貪狼，慮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548681780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其發遲而驟歇矣。用乙辛、丁癸水催之者，謂此四水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有貪狼也。此宫廣大兼容，故旁及坤艮，亦所不礙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰御門開。若是巳丙壬亥相兼，則犯陰陽差錯之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍矣。法宜去丙就已，去壬就亥，以淸乾巽之氣。此則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專爲人元辨卦而言，處處欲要歸一路。葢一路者，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時直達之機；兼取者，先時補救之道。不直達則取勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無先鋒，不補救則善後無良䇿，二者不可偏廢也。總","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀三節文義，子午卯酉配乙辛丁癸，辰戌丑未配乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮、巽，爲夫婦同宗，而寅申己亥獨不配甲庚壬丙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181111334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲夫婦，則其本意不以甲庚、壬、丙屬寅申、己亥可知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。此正合天玉大五行作用，而非十二支配十二干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲一路之俗說也。故不曰寅申坤艮，而曰寅坤申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非以寅爲坤，以申爲艮也。已屬巽而反曰天門，亥屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾而反曰巽風，顚倒裝成，其託意微而且幻類如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至其立言本旨，不過隱然說出陰陽交五之象，然篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中皆錯舉名目，不肯分明。至後節主客東西方露出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端倪，而終不顯言。先賢之毖愼如此，使我有浪泄天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機之懼矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080212548714548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解人元自有人元合運之山水，自有人元合運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之星辰，體用俱合。人元僅有三吉四吉，此云五吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，何也？謂當時直達之星辰巳得，再取貪狼一星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合成五吉，以補悠遠用法之至要者也。乙辛、丁癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水來催者，非謂此四水盡屬人元，又非謂有此四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水卽是貪狼，正謂在是元，用是山，收是水，或丁或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙、或癸或辛，有得貪狼者在耳。御門開，卽兼通出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之意。葢申與庚，巳與丙，亥與壬，俱屬貼鄰，易犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差錯之宫。或己出於丙，告我向之以天門，亥或雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181144102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于壬，又令吹之以巽風。楊公敎人補救直達，深切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"著明，至矣盡矣。輔亦可兼，弼亦可兼，諸星亦可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼，貴在各乘其時耳。先將當元之令星用得安妥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再將先時補救之䇿，或兼貪，或兼輔，多兼，則元運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不一，吉㐫參半。註云：欲取天元，而非純乎天元，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取地元，又非純乎地元，葢謂此也。總觀三節文義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼法俱要隨時酌量，宜兼貪則兼貪，宜兼輔則兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔，全在作者隨時兼取，隨地變通耳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼原是發來遲，坐向穴中人未知。立宅安墳過兩紀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080300733874211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方生貴子好男兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：貪狼諸卦之統領，得氣先而施力遠，何云發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遲？此言人地兩元兼收之脉，不當正卦傍他涵蓄，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力不專，是以遲也。兩紀，約畧之辭。生貴子，正見誕育","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢才，以昌世業，隱含悠久之義，非若他宫一卦乘時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"催官暫發之比。若夫應之遲速，是不一端，烏可執此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲典要也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上數節言人地兼貪，最易發福，此云發遲者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？謂貪狼雖非人地兩元主運之星，却能補偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080824321441843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救弊，先榮後凋，故曰遲也。坐向，言坐山向首之排","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍也。坐山向首之排龍，或排貪狼到山，或排到向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首，或排到水口三叉奇峯貴砂，定主産賢才，昌世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"業，發福無休無歇也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立宅安墳要合龍，不須擬對好奇峯。主人有禮客尊重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客在西兮主在東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：山龍眞結，必對尊星而後出脉，或迴龍顧祖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或枝幹相朝，先有主峯，乃始結穴，故必以朝山爲重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非重朝山，正重本身出脉眞僞也。平洋旣無來落，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080300733906979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以水城論結穴，水自水，山自山，雖有奇峯，竝非一家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉，向之無益，故只從立穴處消詳堂局，收五吉之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，謂之合龍，而不以朝山爲正案也。未二句，乃一篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之大旨，精微玄渺之譚，所謂主客，又不止於論向，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指龍爲主人，向爲賓客也。主客猶云夫婦，實指陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之對待，山水之交媾，一剛一柔，一牝一牡，玄竅相通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆在於此。言有此主便有此客，有此客便有此主。主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客雖云二物，實一氣連貫，如影隨形，如谷啓響交結。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根原一息不離，非謂旣有此主，乃更求賢賓以對之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080824321474611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。東西葢舉一方而言，亦可云主在西兮客在東，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可云主在北兮客在南，主在南兮客在北，八卦四隅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無不皆然，所謂陰陽顚倒顚也。自天下軍州至此，統","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論平洋龍法，其中卦位干支秘訣，總不出此二語，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于結尾發之，以包舉通篇之義，學者所當潛思而曲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體之者也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：寶照發明平洋龍格，開章直喝：天下軍州總","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐空，何須撑著後頭龍。大聲疾呼，朗吟高唱。此爲楊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公撰著此書，通篇眼目，振綱挈領之處，不可泛泛讀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347080300733939747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過。葢平洋龍格，舉世所以茫然者，只因俗師聾瞽，將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍溷入，無從剖辨，觸處成迷也。平洋之作法旣迷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并山龍之眞格亦謬，失其一并害其二矣。楊公苦心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喝此二語，醒人千古大夢，使知平洋二宅，不論坐後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來脉，凡坐空之處反有眞龍，坐實之處反無眞龍，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍之胎息孕育，截然相反。欲學者從此一關打得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透徹，更不將剝换過峽、高低起伏、馬跡、蛛絲、草蛇灰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"線等字，纒擾胸中，只在陰陽大交會處悟出眞機，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后八卦九星干支方位，以次而陳，絲絲入扣，平龍消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081601773207561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息，始無𦊱漏之虞。平龍旣無𦊱漏，而山龍亦更無𦊱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏矣。倘不明此義，只將後龍來脉膠葛糾纒，則造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞精，何從窺見？雖授之以八卦九星之奥，亦無所施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。窮年皓首，空自芒芒，高山平洋，總歸魔境。我于是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"益嘆楊公度人心切也。後篇所以覆舉二語，重言以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申明之，意深切矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此篇前十二句爲一章，言深山支龍之穴中三十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"句爲一章，言幹龍脫殺出洋之穴，此二章皆屬山龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後四十六句分七節爲一章，言平洋水龍之穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377340928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解山龍看主山朝案，以辨龍體之眞僞；平洋對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三叉，察血脉以認來龍之得失。山洋一定不易之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法也。要合龍者，觀九曜之合不合也。奇峯者，尖秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挺拔之峯也。合元微則對之，不合則不必對之。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云主東客西，卽陽水隂山顚倒顚之義。主人有禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，龍眞氣旺也。龍果眞，氣果旺，前後左右輔從，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加之美名。如龍微氣衰，雖有奇峯貴砂，即改爲惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，所以本主興隆，殺曜變爲文曜；龍身微賤，牙刀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化作屠刀，卽此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已上數節，都屬半含半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081457845829683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐，但吞吐之間，有深意存焉，讀者當細心參考，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所得也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下軍州總住空，何須撑著後來龍。時人不識玄機訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只道後頭少撑龍。大凡軍州住空龍，便與平洋墓宅同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"州縣人家住空龍，千軍萬馬悉能容。分明見者猶疑慮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍不空時非活龍。敎君看取州縣塲，盡是空龍，撥擺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蹤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫嫌遠來無後龍。龍若空時氣不空，兩水界龍連生窟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴得水兮何畏風。但看古來卿相地，平洋一穴勝千峯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377373696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：天下軍州二語，前篇已經唤醒楊公之意，猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐後人見不眞，信不篤，故反覆咏嘆，層層洗發，窮追","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到底，罄其所以然之故。又恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874258325540/1-fd42ece065b166bf.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Cof4nPB7cynyGF7TY2svXPkDzxo%3D","uri":"read/HY2520/2/ref/1kr13v34951kv/1-fd42ece065b166bf.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠂤旡木","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690874258325540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說軍州大勢，尙疑人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家墓宅或有不然，故指實而言。軍州如是，墓宅亦無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不如是，只勸世人揀擇空龍，切勿取實龍作撑也。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以然者，何也？山龍只論脉來，平洋只論氣結。空則水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活而氣來融結，實則障蔽而生氣阻塞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉眼但見漭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漭平田，毫無遮掩，疑爲坐下風吹散氣之地，不知水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神界抱，陽氣冲和，平洋之穴，無水則四面皆風，有水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081457845862451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則八風頓息，所謂氣乘風則散，界水則止。古人之言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正爲平洋而發也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
