{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解楊公恐人不信空龍之說，特引州縣城池爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"証。然州縣城池未必盡屬後空，人家墓宅，亦非以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐空爲是，坐實爲非，只要坐空得坐空之五行，坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實得坐實之五行，方合龍空氣不空，龍實氣不實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙用。中言得水，承上文龍空氣不空，龍實氣不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實而申言之也。此謂得者，非以左右有水謂得，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非以前後有水謂得，以所有之水，得挨星生旺謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377406464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉四山龍，坐對乾坤艮巽宫，莫依八卦陰陽取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽差錯敗無窮。百二十家渺無訣，此訣玄機大祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍須要望龍穴，後若空時必有功。帝座帝車竝帝位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝宮帝殿後當空。萬代侯王皆禁斷，予今隱出在江東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽若能得遇此，蚯蚓逢之便化龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此明八卦之理，卽前子午卯酉屬坎離震兌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四卦，乾坤艮、巽又四卦之義也。所謂坐對，非指山向，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢四正卦與四隅卦兩兩相對，故云然也。八卦隂陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081457845895219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，指八卦五行。以乾卦領震、坎、艮三男而屬陽，坤卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"領巽、離、兌三女而屬陰，此先天之體，非後天之用。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之論陰陽，則差錯而敗不勝言矣。譚陰陽者百二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家，皆此是彼非，渺無眞訣。惟有玄空大卦，乃陰陽五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行大祖宗，聖聖相傳，非人勿示也。識得此訣，雖帝王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地，瞭若指掌，特禁秘而不敢言耳。楊公自言旣得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至道不敢炫耀於世，故披褐懷玉，抱道無言。然天寶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖秘惜，而救世之心未嘗少懈。曾于天玉經、江東一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦诸篇，隱出其旨。世之好陰陽者，有緣會遇，信而行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081694396317730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，頃刻有魚龍變化之徵也。或云：楊公得道之後，韜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光晦跡，背其鄕井，隱於江東，俟考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解。子午卯酉，指地之四正而言，乾坤艮巽，指空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之四維而言，非必拘定要坐對乾坤之位，只要玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空坐對，二四六八，便是陰陽二宅。若能合此玄機，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自有魚龍之變化。下文辰戌丑未，甲庚壬丙，卽此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意也。地氣南北不同，山洋逈異，卽性之剛柔，氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之老嫩，亦隨處而各别者也，切不可拘泥，有誤天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地生成之妙也。地有相去數郡，高卑無二者，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181176870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相去數里，厚薄逈異者，亦有相去數步而老嫩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸絶者，總要隨地取裁，不可執一。卽坐水向水，後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空後實，亦要各得其宜爲妥，切不可拘泥後空爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是，後實爲非，亦不可拘拘後高爲是，後空爲非，總","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要隨地適宜，髙低各得爲是。所謂泥於古者，必不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能愈今疾；拘於方者，決不能治遠人。卽此之謂歟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉四山龍，支兼干出最豪雄。辛丁癸單脉乙行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半吉之時又半凶，坐向乾坤艮巽位，兼輔而成五吉龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒋氏曰：此皆楊公隱謎，舉四正爲例。若行龍在子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377472000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉，四支長流不雜，雖兼帶□位，總不出本卦之內，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其脉淸純，故云最豪雄也。若乙辛丁癸，雖屬單行，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"免少偏，卽犯他卦，所以吉凶参半也。言子午卯酉，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽不外是矣；言乙辛丁癸，而甲庚壬丙不外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是矣。辨龍旣淸，乃於諸卦位□，隨便立向，則又以方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓爲規矩，而未嘗執一者也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此四卦重支之卦，支兼干出，卽子癸午丁、卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉辛。若乙辛丁癸而無子午卯酉兼出者，卽謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之單行脉也。單行之脉，稍有一偏，卽出他卦。行龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181209638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出卦，恐生旺不一，吉㐫無定。所云坐向乾坤者，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必拘定坐向乾坤之位，只要天元取輔，人地兼貪，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今收五吉之氣也。單行之脉，雖易出卦，有心者倘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此種來龍來脉，龍穴眞的者，切莫棄而不取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要用得五吉，合得三星，其吉更勝干一卦淸純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未四山□，甲庚壬丙葬墳多。若依此理無差謬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸貴聲名天下無。爲官自有起身路，見孫曰屋出登科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦不是眞妙訣，時師休把口中歌。敗絶只因用卦差，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358045696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何見依卦出高官。陰山陽水皆眞吉，下後見孫禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若朝來須得水，莫貪遠秀好峯巒。審龍若依圖訣葬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官職榮華立可觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此指四隅龍脉而言，而舉辰戌丑未爲隱謎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。謂此等行龍，而取甲庚壬丙向者甚衆，必須龍法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純全，向法合吉，毫無差謬，而後清貴之名卓于天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。起身路正指來龍之路。八卦本是眞訣，而說用則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福顚倒，故云非妙訣。後章八卦只有一卦通，乃始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微露消息矣。收水之法，向云陽用陰朝，陰用陽應，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181242406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦理至當不易之言，而竟有陰山陽水、陽山陰水，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見災禍者，則辨之不真，陽非陽而陰非陰也。得水二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字，世人開口混說，然非果識天機秘旨，收入女竅之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，雖三陽六建，齊會明堂，虎抱龍迴，消滴不漏，總未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂之得。若知得水眞訣，卽陰陽八卦之理示諸斯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎，莫貪遠秀好峯，卽上篇己發之義，致其叮寕之意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云爾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解甲庚壬丙是隨時變易之甲庚壬丙，非四維","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八干不易之甲庚壬丙，讀者切莫誤認。此理云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377504768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，是山上水裏陰陽相配之理也。山上水裏果能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交之以陽，配之以陰，淸貴聲名，自然流傳天下。八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦九星，本是眞訣，而此獨非者，何也？申言板格之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非也。在地爲八卦九宫，在天卽是北斗九星，隨氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流行，隨時變易，往來無定者也。拘拘於呆法，變易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者反以爲不易，無定者執以爲有定。所謂陽者非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，陰者非陰，故謂之不眞。所謂得水者，非諸家五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之所謂得，又非上元必須離水，下元必須坎水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所謂得也。此所謂得者，是玄空之得謂得也。夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081928492728346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，是四維八干不易之定位，甲庚壬丙是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周流六虛，隨時而在之甲庚壬丙，一空一實，必須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揣摩而得。有形之質，靜而不移，無形之氣，動而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息，一動一靜，一陰一陽，相爲表裏，一往一來，三山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一水，兩相配合，官職榮華，自能立見矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄機妙訣有因由，向指山峯細細求。起造安墳依此訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能令發福出公侯。真向支山尋祖脉，干神下穴永無憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥騎龍走，乙辛丁癸水交流。若有此山并此水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白屋科名發不休。昔日孫鍾阡此穴，從此聲名表萬秋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081062377537536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：通篇皆言平洋，此章乃插入山峯者，何也？葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦九星，乃陰陽之大總持，故凡有山之水，可以不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論山，而有水之山，不能不論水。若遇山水相兼之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未可但從山龍而論，還須細細尋求，亦必合此玄空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大卦之訣，而后墓宅產公侯也。祖脉必要支山，葢從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四正而論，下穴立向，則不拘干支矣。此祖脉乃玄空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之祖脉，非山龍之來脉也。讀者切勿錯認。寅申己亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁癸，俱屬易犯差錯之龍，故曰騎龍走水交流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文有殊，義無別。此山此水而科名不歇者，不犯差錯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081928492793882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。孫鍾墓在富陽天子崗，本山龍而收富春江長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流之水，故引爲證","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上四句言體用兼到之妙，中二句承上文而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言祖脉。此祖脉非太祖少祖山龍之來脉，又非干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支公孫子母之祖脉。此祖脉乃玄空之祖脉，所謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心是也。數語當細細察之。如乙辛、丁癸，寅申己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，卽上文所謂甲庚壬丙，辰戌丑未之意。時師都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂此山此水易犯差錯之龍，皆棄之不取。不知此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山此水亦有發福者，特引孫鍾墓爲證。經云：八方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358111232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位位有眞龍，爻象干支總一同。三謂此也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍須看坐正穴，後若空時必有功。州縣官衙爲格局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必然淸顯立威雄。范蠡蕭何韓信祖，乙辛丁癸足財豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥壬聳龍興祖格，巳内旺相一般同。寅申己亥等五吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁癸四位通。紫緋畫錦何榮顯，三牲五鼎受王封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍回朝祖玄字水，科名榜眼及神童。後空巳見前篇訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴要窩非脉到宫。試看則而及臺閤。那個靠著後來龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂楫水朝爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，羅城擁衞穴居中。依圖取内無差誤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是王侯卽相公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081439181275174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：後空之旨，屢見篇中，而此章又反覆不已者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢後空不但無來脉而巳，并重坐下有水，乃謂之活","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍擺撥而成眞空有氣也。故首句云坐正穴，實指穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後有水，取爲正坐也。古賢舊蹟，往往如此。遍地鉗所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂杜甫、盧仝、李白祖，此又引范蠡、蕭何、韓信總合此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格。下列諸干支，言不論是何卦位，只要合得五吉收","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸坐後發福如許爾。故下文卽接囘龍朝祖玄字水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分明指出前朝曲水抱向穴後，乃囘龍顧祖之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神童黃甲，必可劵矣。篇中又自言後空之訣，已見前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358144000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇。然恐人誤認，只取坐後無來脉，便云有氣，不知穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後必須水抱成窩鉗之形，而後謂之到宮。若但云空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳，非坐水之空，空何貴焉？砂揖水朝，羅城擁衞，皆就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水神而論，穴正居中，指坐穴也。此節直說出王侯將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相大地局法，非泛論也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上節言山龍干神坐實之法，此節言平洋五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉坐空之奥。一山一水，一空一實，申言坐空坐實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用法之不同也。然後空之說，前已詳言，此又重言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，何也？恐人誤認，不察水之幹枝向背也。穴後之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081928492875802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，必要枝流拱向，得神抱繞有情，向背之以五吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽謂正穴，又謂到宫。所云巳丙亥壬，總言不論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是何卦位，是何干支，只要合得五吉，毫無差謬。神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童黃甲，卿相公侯，有得之若操劵者矣。楊公恐人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不信，特引蕭、韓祖墓爲證。坐正穴者，卽不偏不倚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不上不下，不浮不沉之謂也。後空非以穴後有氷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂空，用法水弗得，卽謂空。如穴後有水而金龍到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭，此謂龍空氣不空，所謂脉到宫者，卽此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機妙訣本不同，八卦只有一卦通。乾坤艮巽𨇠何位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358193152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁癸落何宫，甲庚壬丙來何地，星辰流轉要相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫把天罡稱妙訣，錯將八卦作先宗。乾坤艮巽出官貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁癸田庄位，甲庚壬丙最爲榮。下後兒孫出神童，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未審何山消此水，合得天心造化工","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏日：一部寶照經，不下數干，言皆半含半吐，至此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然漏泄。葢陰陽大掛，不過八卦之理，而篇中乃云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦不是眞妙訣者，正爲不得眞傳，不明用卦之法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。而其所以不明用卦之法者，皆因泛言八卦，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知八卦之中，止有一卦可用故也。大五行秘訣，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081928492908570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過能用此一卦，卽從卦流此一轉九星，便知乾坤艮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽諸卦落在何宫，二十四干支落在何宮，而或吉或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，指掌瞭然矣。俗師不得此訣，妄立五行，有從四墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上起天罡，以爲放水出煞之用，如何合得八卦之理？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫收得山來，乃出得煞去，不知一卦作用，山旣無從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收，一卦不收，諸卦干支，又何從流轉九星，求純棄駁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而消水出煞乎？今人但知二十四山處處可出，官貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處處可旺，田庄，處處可出神童，而不知二十四位水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路交馳，果下何卦，收何山，乃消得此水，出得煞去。去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358275072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣不能收山出煞，則其談八卦，論干支，皆胡言妄說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而己。何以契合天心，而造化在手也？天心卽天運，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善人合天之家，不能遇也。大五行所謂一卦，卽指天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心正運之一卦也。篇中露此二字，其間玄妙，難以名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言。楊公雖指出天心一卦之端，而其下卦起星之訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究竟未嘗顯言，則天機秘密，須待口傳，不敢筆之于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：篇中八卦干支，縱橫錯舉，原非實義。細玩此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節何位、何宫、何地等句，卽知經文皆屬活句，非死句","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081601773469705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。我師于前篇註中，切戒學者毋得執定方位意在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爾，凡讀楊公書者，當知此意，非獨寶照而已，天玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青曩無不皆然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解一卦者，一元一卦，卽天心正運之一卦也。能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用此一卦，則知乾坤艮巽落在何宫，二十四干支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨇠在何地，或陰或陽，或順或逆，或左或右，指掌瞭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然矣。不識此卦，誤認五行八長生、四墓庫，左旋右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉，以爲放水出殺之用，不亦謬乎！知此一卦，卽知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收得山來，出得殺去。不知此一卦，則談八卦，論干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081988358307840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支，皆糊言妄語而己，豈能契合天心，挽囘造化哉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星一訣非眞術，城門一訣最爲良。識得五星城門訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立宅安墳定吉昌。堪笑庸愚多慕此，妄將卦例定陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不向龍身觀出脉，又從砂水斷災祥。筠松寶照眞秘訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父子雖親不肯說。若人得遇是前緣，天下橫行陸地仙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：前章既言一卦下穴、收山出煞之義，此章又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直指城門一訣。楊公此論，眞可謂披肝露膽矣。葢五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星之用，其要訣俱在城門，識得城門，而后五吉有用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于此作二宅無不興隆者矣。城門一訣，與龍身出脉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206763810825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正是一家骨肉精神貫通。能識城門，乃能觀出脉，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀出脉，便能識城門，故笑世人不識此秘，而妄談卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例，從沙水上亂說災祥也。此以下皆楊公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874191085622/1-e4a21c2c16a2935f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YkJiW3duJddkNbLvzGlQ5R93rqs%3D","uri":"read/HY0829/26/ref/1kom2wz558qbj/1-e4a21c2c16a2935f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"金𡝤","variants":"鏤","charPicId":"7456690874191085622"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精抉髓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之言，得此便是陸地神仙，父子不傳，夫亦師傳之禁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒如是，豈敢違哉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解察血脉，認來龍，對三叉細認踪。種種要訣，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重在城門。識得城門，卽識龍來何脉矣。城門卽水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交會處，關繫禍福之所，令星緊要之處，須得五吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三星補救直達，斯爲盡善。城門得城門之用法再。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926400034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合兼貪兼輔之妙，兩美相合，立宅安墳，造化自在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌握矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人只愛週迴好，不知水亂山顚倒。時師但云講八卦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却把陰陽分兩下。陰山只用陽水朝，陰水只用陽山收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗夫不識天機妙，自把山龍錯顛倒，胡行亂作害世人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福未到時禍先到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：道德不云乎，常無欲以觀其妙，常有欲以觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其竅。此正丹家所謂玄關一竅，大道無多，只爭那些","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，故曰不離這個。人身有此一竅，天地亦有此一竅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206763876361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理家須識此陰陽之竅。今人只愛週迴好，而不知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"那些子，些子合得天機，週迴不好亦好；些子不合天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機，過迴雖好，皆無用矣。陰山陽山，陰水陽水，皆現成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名色，處處是死的，惟有那些子是活的。些子一變，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是陰，陽不是陽，陰可作陽，陽可作陰，故曰：識得五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行顚倒顚，便是大羅仙。世人不諳天機，誤將山龍來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉，牽合平洋理氣，執定板格陰陽，反成差錯，乃眞顚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒也。本欲造福，反以賈禍，楊公所爲惻然于中，而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是書也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081622803726370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：週迴，言前後左右，前後左右，龍穴砂水好不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好，人人知之。如上山下水，顚倒錯用，時師從何窺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見？且執定板法，如山從右轉者，水必宜左轉；山從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋者，水必宜右到。以山㟠尋龍尋脉之法，混入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平平洋理氣，禍之先到，不亦宜乎？註云：那些子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三字，指挨星生旺而言。城門得生旺，雖週迴不好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦吉；如城門不得生旺，週廻雖好，皆無用矣。隨氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變遷，卽是那些子；氣化流行，物換星移，亦是那些","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子。所謂關竅者，卽此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206763941897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽若無陰定不成，陰若無陽定不生。陽水陰山相配合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫天府早登名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節并下節尤爲全經傾囊倒篋之言，而泛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泛讀過，則不覺其妙。葢舉平洋龍法穴法、收山出煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦干支之理，一以貫之矣。孤陽不生，獨陰不育，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖通論，而大五行秘訣，只此便了。學者須在山水配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合上著眼，所謂配合，自然配合，非尋一箇陽以配陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋一個陰以配陽也。水卽是，陽是陰，陰卽是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山卽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卽是水，故只云陽水陰山，而不更言陰水陽山。知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082091621810216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此者，可與讀寶照經矣。知此者，亦不必更觀寶照經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解陰陽，卽來者爲陽，往者爲陰之陰陽也。陰山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水者，當用將來之氣挨入水中，已往之氣裝在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上，卽爲陽水陰山。此陰陽是氣運消長之陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非干支卦爻之陰陽，又非左到右到之陰陽，又非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上元必須離水，下元必須坎水之陰陽，又非以來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲陽，去水爲陰之陰陽也。參透此關，方知生成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配合之妙理矣。水裏排龍，水裏得陽，山上得陰；山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081973665529866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上排龍，山上得陽，水裏得陰，此謂之陽水陰山，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水陽山也。上文所謂陽山陽水者，此也；所謂山與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水相對者，此也。所謂江南江北，主客東西，亦卽此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。孤陽不生，獨陰不長，此天地生成至當不易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之理也。配合卽陽水陰山，隂山陽水，交互相生，來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往皆春，此眞配合也。荀能如此，自有天府登名之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都天大卦總陰陽，翫水觀山有主張。能知山情與水意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配合，方可論陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926432802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：急接上文。都天大卦，豈有他哉？總不通陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而己。眞陰真陽，只在山水上看，而翫山觀水須胸中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别自有主張，此主張非泛泛主張，乃乾坤眞消息，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂天心是也。山情水之四字，全經之竅妙。今人孰不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰山水有情意，而不知世人所謂情意，非眞情意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識此情意，則是陰陽，便成配合，靑囊萬卷，盡在箇中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於戲至矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：主張，卽天心正運之主張。山情水意，是山水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各得其宜之情意。所言配合，非尋一個陽以配陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347081973665595402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋一個陰以配陽也，要山上排龍，水裏排龍，一九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二八、三七四六，玄空會合也。或一六二七、三八四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九，山上水裏，彼此生生，動靜得宜，雌雄配合。此配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合卽是山情水意元空之配合。知此，則靑囊天玉之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機盡矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都天寶照無人得，逢山踏路尋龍脉。前頭走到五里山，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇著賓主相交按。欲求富貴頃時來，記取筠松眞妙訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：上文說到山情水意，都天大卦之理盡矣。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節又贊嘆而言，此都天寶照不輕傳世，若有人能得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926465570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此觀山翫水，一到山情水意賓主相交之處，用楊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公訣法扞之，頃刻之間，造化在手。葢一片熱腸，深望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之信從，而發此嘆也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上文所言情意，是山上水裏用法得宜，動静","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生生之情意；此言賓主，是相朝相顧，氣止水交，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賓相得之賓主。體用咸明，再參古今名墓，再考其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離合，正其是非，精益求精，斯可窮其變矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有三奇地六儀，天有九星地九宫。十二地支天干十，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干屬陽兮支屬陰。時師專論這般訣，誤盡閻浮世上人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206763974665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽動靜如明得，配合生生妙處尋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：前簡贊嘆己足，終篇又引奇門以比論者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇門主地，從雒書來，與地理大卦同出一原，而時師","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用錯，所以不騐。惟有大五行是奇門眞訣。欲知此訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只在陰陽一動一靜之間，求其配合生生之妙，則在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在有一陰陽，非干是陽而支是陰，如此板格而己。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜卽是山情水意，卽是城門，一訣卽是收山岀煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用一卦法。所謂龍到頭者，此也；所謂龍身出脉者，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；所謂龍空氣不空者，此也。是名眞賓王，是名眞夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082091622006824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦，是名眞雌雄。終篇又提出此二字，與上篇第三章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜中閒求一語，首尾相應，楊公之旨，抑亦微之顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：中篇一十三節，共一百四十六句，皆申明上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇第三章以下未盡之義，以終平洋龍穴之變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解上數句，言奇門之法，世人用差，所以不騐。未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二句論陰陽動靜配合生生之妙。陰陽非以山爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰，水爲陽，又非以干爲陽、支爲陰，又非以四卦屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，四卦屬陰，又非以左水到右爲陽，右水到左爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206764007433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰也。動靜亦非以形動爲動，形靜爲靜也。此所謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜者，即天主動，動以靜而生；地主靜，静以動而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成。如明得天地陰陽動靜生成之奥，再細細尋其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生生配合之妙，玄空之髓，可造乎其極矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜卽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，凡有形者皆靜，爲方爲隅，形象之謂也。動者，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，曰空、曰氣，曰健，無形之謂也。動者，運行于上，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一息之停，萬物生生化化，成形成象，何莫不由天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之動而始也。成形成象，卽是靜，卽是動，以靜而生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜以動而成也。地惟靜，其所以生萬物卽是動，動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082091622072360"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者皆天始之也。天不得地，則無所以生，地不得天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則無所以成。乾統坤，地承天，惟動故能統，惟靜故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能承也。配合生生，是言山上排龍，水裏排龍，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜，山上水裏，有彼此生生來往皆春之情意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：上中二篇，歴敘山龍平洋正變之㫖，自始至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終，有本有未，文雖斷續，而義則相蒙。下篇所言，不過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇餘義，而錯雜言之，無有條貫。每章各論一事，文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無承接，義無照應，淺者極淺，深者極深，學者分别觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082651179679753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之可也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋得眞龍龍虎飛，水城屈曲抱身歸。前朝旗鼓馬相應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下後離鄕著紫衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節專指山龍而言。眞龍之穴，龍虎分飛，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其病也。眞龍行急，龍虎之相隨亦急，急則兩砂之未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘勢逆囘，有似分飛，昔人指爲曜氣，正眞龍靈氣發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露之象也。然情旣向外，則人事亦應之，主子孫他方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發達，謂之離鄕砂也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節言眞龍氣勢行急之象，恐人誤認爲擢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082870134964258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，故特指之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙字水纒在穴前，下砂收鎖穴天然。當中九曲來朝穴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悠揚潴蓄斗量錢。兩畔朝歸穴後歇，定然龍在水中蟠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有聲爲數錢水，催官上馬御階前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：自此以下八節，皆平洋水局形體吉凶之辨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節言曲水纒身之格，歇在穴後，正前篇所謂後龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空坐正穴也。數錢水，假借爲義，俗而巧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此節專言平洋砂形水法之至美者也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安墳最要看中陽，寛抱明堂水聚囊。出來結成玄字樣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082651179745289"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝來鸞鳳舞呈祥。外陽起眼人皆見，乙字彎身玉帶長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有内陽坐穴法，神機出處覓仙方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此言堂氣形局之美。至于內陽坐穴法正前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇所謂來龍正坐及城門一卦之訣也，非神機仙術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥足以語此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解中陽、外陽、内陽卽内堂、外堂、玉帶、乙字等語，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論形局砂水之至美者也。更有坐穴法句，總承","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文龍空氣不空，城門一卦之得與弗得而申言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。不拘內堂、外堂，水法，總以止蓄團聚爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082870135095330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水法團聚，止蓄週迴，自然相向有情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水直朝來最不祥，一條直是一條鎗，兩條名爲插脇水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三條云是三刑傷。四水射來爲四殺，八水名爲八殺殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直來反去拖刀殺，徒流客死少年亡。時師只說下砂逆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍來極速年堪當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892787875879/1-1adf062f11938f4c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hTj9Ng48cpt2SDluH77b29kVAKY%3D","uri":"read/NA03149/9/ref/1kob8j5yjpkqa/1-1adf062f11938f4c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土𡊄","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892787875879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圳路街如此様，亟宜遷改免災殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節極言直來凶格，葢水神最忌木火，以其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有殺氣，無元氣也。縱屬來朝，亦有損無益，況諸路交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馳，漏風沖泄乎？旺元猶可，衰運無噍類矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節專言直水之凶，沖射者更㐫，路街田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892787875879/1-1adf062f11938f4c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hTj9Ng48cpt2SDluH77b29kVAKY%3D","uri":"read/NA03149/9/ref/1kob8j5yjpkqa/1-1adf062f11938f4c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土𡊄","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892787875879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082651179843593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝射者亦忌，有則攺之，以免災殃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前水來朝又擺頭，淫邪凶惡不知羞。乾流自是名繩索，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自縊因公敗可憂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此曲水㐫格。水神雖以曲爲吉，然曲處須節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節整齊，乃合星格。若擺頭斜去，及如繩索樣，或大或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小，或疎或密，或正或欹，皆似吉而㐫，縱然發福，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：穴前水形似曲非曲，似直非直者，謂之擺頭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似是而非，最易誤認，故特指之。水形如此，不相左","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926547490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右，前後二宅均忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊水反長房死，右邊水射小兒亡。水直若然當面射，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中子離鄕死道傍。東西南北水射腰，房房橫死絶根苗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪淫男女風聲惡，曲背駞腰家寂寥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊水反長房死，離鄉忤逆皆因此，右邊水反小兒傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風吹婦女隨人走，當面水反中男當，斷定二房有損傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右中反房房絕，切忌墳塋遭此劫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：以上數節，雖義淺而辭鄙，然其應甚速，以其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切于用也，故存之。惟公位之分，不可盡拘耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082206764072969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：天玉靑囊、都天寶照，或言體，或言用，或兼體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用而言，千言萬語，不外趨避兩字。此兩節專指砂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形水法衝射反跳而言，如諸般凶山惡水，卽合用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，切不可因其合用而取之也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一水裏頭名斷城，下之雖發未爲榮。兒孫久後房房絕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水到砂收反主興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：平洋穴取近水，三方皆可逼窄，唯穴前明堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須寬容不迫，展舒穴氣。若一水裹頭，穴無餘氣，雖環","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抱亦不發。若面前另有一枝水到，則又以接水呈秀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926596642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其逼窄之氣有所發洩，反不爲㐫爾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：形雖環抱，狹而帶淺，左右前後，毫無濶狹生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動之意，名曰斷城，又名裹頭。裏頭之水，穴前陽氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不舒，最易敗絕，似吉非吉，故特辨之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茶槽之水實堪憂，莫作蔭龍一例求。穴前太偪割唇腳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不見榮兮反見愁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：穴前池塘，水聚天心，名蔭龍水，本爲吉周。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"硬直深坑，形似茶糟，旣非佳格，或明堂寛曠，猶末見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，更加急葬，穴氣太偪，則有凶無吉矣。同一穴前池","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082469482627081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，形局軟硬，立穴緩急，其應不同，不可不深辨也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：直硬深坑，毫無動意，謂之茶糟；止蓄團聚，照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴有情，謂之應龍。茶槽宜遠，遠則不割，應龍宜近，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近則得神，切不可誤認而遠近錯用也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武擺頭有多般，未可慳然執一端。或斜或側或正出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須慿直節對堂安。擺頭直出是分龍，須取何家龍脉蹤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大山出脉分三訣，未許專將一路窮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：玄武水來木合後空，活龍之格，宜爲正坐之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴矣。然亦須詳其來法，以辨純雜，定吉㐫，未可執一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082381926629410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。葢水有偏出正出不同，惟直節對堂安，乃是眞玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武水。若擺頭曲來，而又直出前去，一曲一直之間，龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉不一，是謂分龍，不必分兩道而後謂之分龍也。須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察其曲來是何脉，直去是何脉，細細推詳，而后可定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其何家蹤跡，以便下卦。若是水大，則不止一宫之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正坐是一脉，偏左又是一脉，偏右又是一脉，故云分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三訣也。論坐後之脉，精詳曲當，搜剔無遺，乃至于此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂明察秋毫者耶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：擺頭言水似曲非曲之狀。玄武指穴後，穴後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082469482692617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之水，或曲或直，或向或背，情狀不一，難於盡舉，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要與穴前一般排算，故曰對堂安也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家家墳宅後高縣，太陽不照太陰偏。必主其家多寂寞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男孤女寡實堪憐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此卽後空之義。因世人都喜後高，故復叮嚀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此。人但知後高爲有坐托，不知其掩蔽陽光，而偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照陰氣，生機斬絕，人口伶仃，故有孤寡之應也，可不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒與！予觀人家穴後有挑築雨三重照山，以補後托，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未有不大損人丁，甚至敗絕無後者，利害攸關，特爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082721983758370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指出。此節單言平洋格法，若是山龍之穴，又以後高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲太陽正照而吉，後空爲太陽失䧟而凶，讀者莫錯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：以上九節，首節言山龍，後八節言平洋，皆形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：要在未立向以前，必先按其山向，排其五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當空則空，當實則實，所謂龍空氣不空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍實氣不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實，卽此意也。髙一寸爲山，低一寸爲水，髙者當作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山用，低者宜作水論。倘上山下水，顚倒悮用，則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532416550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寡天之患矣。大凡山龍平崗及墩泡高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866180571177/1-548626e8ce124cff.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=phriLUXzQHPyeXDYOm3WvYpEx%2BM%3D","uri":"read/HY0680/12/ref/1kohmq2de599j/1-548626e8ce124cff.webp","fontType":1,"components":"垖十","variants":"埠","charPicId":"7456690866180571177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣爲主者，穴後宜高；水龍平洋及一切湖蕩圲邊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡以水氣爲主者，穴後宜空。切不可拘定後空爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是，後高爲非，只要後空得後空之用法，後高得後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高之用法，總要隨地適宜，高低各得，不必拘拘於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後空後實也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
