{"lines":[{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪、武輔弼巨門龍，方可登山細認蹤。水去山朝皆有地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不離五吉在其中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節及下文九星，皆指形局而言，葢見其星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083155058229282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體合吉，方登山而定其方位。若形局方位皆吉，卽水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去亦吉。今人動云第一莫下去水地，謬矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此節專辨峯巒形局五星、九星正體、變體、形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"像之吉㐫，山形氣勢、星體巒頭旣吉，方登山細說，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃尋龍之要訣，便而捷，且省登山涉水之勞矣。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云五吉，是兼貪、兼輔之五吉，謂形局都合。再查水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之去處，果合補救出殺之妙用，則來亦吉，去亦吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破祿廉文凶惡龍，世人墳宅莫相逢。若然誤作陰陽宅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532465702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有奇峯到底凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此二節專言平洋九星水法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解此四龍形象之最惡者，山龍平洋俱忌，倘然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悞作，縱有奇峯，不能爲福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水法九星曲者爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，直者爲木，方正者爲土，環抱者爲金，直而尖者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲火。總而言之，抱繞止蓄向穴有情者爲吉，反背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無情者爲凶。如破軍、祿存、廉貞、文曲諸般星體，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論山龍、平洋二宅，均忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本山來龍立本向。返吟伏吟禍難當，自縊離鄉蛇虎害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082721983873058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作賊充軍上法塲，明得三星五吉向，轉禍爲祥大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：本山本向，非子龍子向，丑龍丑向倒騎龍之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。蓋指八卦納甲而言。山龍有納甲本卦向法皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"净陰惟陽。其在平洋向法，反不拘淨陰淨陽，而以本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦納甲干支位位作返吟、伏吟，凶不可當。三星與五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉不同。三星言龍體，五吉言卦氣，消詳龍體、卦氣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，卽有天然向法，可不犯本宫，而災變爲祥矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：本山本向者，本元之旺氣到山也。本元之旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣到山，卽是反吟、伏吟。三星謂金、水、土三星，五吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083002263896115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂天元取輔、人地兼貪之五吉。果得三星五吉，卽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能轉禍爲祥矣。細按前後兩個向字，反吟、伏吟由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向而起，五吉亦由向而起。由此觀之，地之吉㐫，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權在向也明矣，其權在五吉也更明矣。苟曉五吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三星之妙理，山水分用之要訣，方知在山謂本山，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在水卽爲十道用得爲三吉用失，卽是反吟；在水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂三吉在山，便是本山敷語，當細細揣之，自得五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉三星補救直達之妙用矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍眞穴正誤立向，陰陽差錯悔吝生，幾爲奔走赴朝廷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082224493281315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巉到朝廷帝怒形。緣師不曉龍何向，墳頭下了剝官星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此言龍穴雖眞而誤立本宫之向，陰陽不和，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于剝官也。蓋地理雖以龍穴爲重，發與不發，專由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴而立向坐宫，又穴中迎神引氣之主宰，此處不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸潔，如玉之瑕，不成美器矣。致廣大而盡精微，又何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不詳審也耶？此所謂向，非以山向五行起長生爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消納也，亦非小玄空生出尅出、生入尅入之說，學者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愼之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：以上四節皆言平洋理氣之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083002263994419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：龍旣眞，穴旣的，誤立本宫陰陽差錯之向，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有剝官之患。此剝官卽上節所言本山本向反吟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟之故也，非俗註所謂壬向之剝官，又非流破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺之剝官。所謂剝官者，正是上山下水顚側□","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用，官星受剋之剝官也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍過氣尋三節，父母宗枝要分别。孟山須要孟山連，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仲山須要仲山接。干奇支耦細推詳，節節照定何脉良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是陽差與陰錯，縱吉星辰發不長。一節吉龍一代發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢雜亂便參商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082224493379619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此等卦理，中上二篇論之已詳，反覆叮嚀，致","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其深切之意。又指明發福世代久暫之應，全在龍脉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節數長短，故父母宗支要分别也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：三節，卽格龍三節不亂之意。父母宗枝，是來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍來脉過峽起頂之宗枝，分别過峽起頂屬何卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之宗枝，則知來龍來脉之合不合矣。孟山、仲山，卽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子字出脉、子字尋之意。看堆何干，來脉何干，入首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細細從來龍來脉上看到立穴處，干與支、體與用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一絲不亂，方謂之良。如有一毫差錯，則吉中有㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083002264027187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不成美器矣，可不加意細察乎？是節辨純雜，定吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，看節數，定久暫，乃方位理氣之最要者也，故又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叮咛之耳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先識龍脉認祖宗，峯腰鶴膝是眞蹤。要知吉地行龍止，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩水相交夾一龍。夫婦同行脉路明，須認劉耶别處尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋大水收小水，不用砂闗發福久。水口石似人物形，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定出擎天調鼎臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此節兼論山龍平洋，言山龍眞脉，則取峰腰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴膝爲過峽，而平洋則不然，只取兩水相交爲來龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082224493412387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行脉，不在過峽上看脉也。但須脉上推求，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識干支純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，夫婦配合之理。如此宫不合，又當别求一宫，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牽强誤下，故云劉郞别處尋。且山龍取砂爲關，而平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洋不用砂關，只要大水行龍，收入，小水結穴。有此小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，引動龍神，于流萬派，其精液皆注歸小水，以蔭穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。此平洋下穴秘旨一語，道破混沌之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890699882507/1-0c86c8ab77e57e9a.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JLH6IaSGNUSHG9uuZpvWc2CkNyY%3D","uri":"read/HY6793/4/ref/1kxjllhfu5wza/1-0c86c8ab77e57e9a.webp","fontType":1,"components":"山白万攵","variants":"𡽄","charPicId":"7456690890699882507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑿矣。觀此，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則知所謂兩水相交，非謂左右兩水會穴前，而龍從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中出，謂之行龍也，正謂大水與小水相交之處，乃眞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之行，眞穴之正也。旣有此小水，收盡源頭，又何用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532498470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水之爲我用與否？豈砂之攔阻能强之者耶？人且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可强，而況于水？若水口捍門，此山龍大地雄峙一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方之勢，葢將山比擬，楊公秘愼之旨，互文隱意，雖若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竝陳，大旨偏重平洋，而以山龍相映發，以辨其不同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"途爾，貴學者言外㑹心。若不知剖析，而視爲一合之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說，將雜亂而無緒矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：束細者爲蜂腰，收而畧放者爲鶴膝，此皆象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形也。衆水去處爲水口，又爲去口。丙有眞結水旦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必有大石當衆水之衞，闗攔水口，其石如琴劍、印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083426530377763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尺、龜蛇、牛馬之形者，定出擎天調鼎之臣。如蘇郡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之范墳，水中有靈石，俗呼曰魁星石，又宜與忠烈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盧公之祖墳，水口有大石一塊，廣濶數丈，形方如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，正當衆水之口。忠烈亦是明季一代之人物，正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是擎天之應騐也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍若直來，不帶關支兼干出是福山，立得吉向無差誤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"催祿催官指日間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒋氏曰：此亦上下二篇所已詳，葢以四正爲例，而其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘自在言外，非位位取地支也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532531238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：此節言山水二龍，形雖帶直，只要不帶欹斜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反跳僵直死硬，種種關殺，用得安妥，亦能發福，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可因其形直而棄之也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽脉過門，節節同行不混淆。向對甲庚壬丙水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫列王更分茅。仲山過脉不帶關，三節山水同到前，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷定三代出官貴，古人凖騐無虛言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：此則單言四隅龍格，反取干神，竝不言及辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌丑未，則其非專重地支可知矣。脉是内氣，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"向對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之水是外氣，兩不相妨也。楊公辨龍審卦之妙，已見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083426530410531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說重地支，而本旨實非重地支。世人被他瞒過多矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知一隻眼逗漏于此節，學智其毋忽哉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：上節言直來不帶關殺則易，此節言屈曲而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求其不雜則難。果能去來屈曲，節節整齊，夫婦同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，不偏不倚，一絲不亂，更兼山水純一，體用一氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自有列土分茅之貴矣。過脉節數等語，總言世代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久暫之應騐也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發龍多向支神取，若是干神又不同。支若載干爲夫婦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干若帶支是鬼龍。子癸爲吉壬子凶，三字眞假在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532564006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽天然穴，水來當面是眞龍。要識眞龍結眞穴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只在龍脉兩三節。三節不亂是眞龍。有穴定然奇妙絕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千金難買此玄文，福祿遇者毋輕洩。依圖立向不差分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮華富貴無休歇。時師不明勉強扞，雖發不久卽敗絕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣氏曰：發龍多取支神，此乃用支之卦也。干神不曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無取，而乃曰若是干神又不同，明明有用干之時，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特與用支者不同爾。于帶支爲鬼龍，只就子癸、壬子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一宫爲例，其眞其假，三字之中，逈然差別。何以乾坤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽獨名天然穴，葢直以乾坤艮巽爲龍，不更轉尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083426530476067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名相，故曰天然。若他龍，則干支卦位非一名矣。水來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當面是真龍，此語石破天驚，鬼當夜哭。葢乾坤艮巽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之穴，又與取支惡干者不同。觀此，則寶照之訣，實非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"單重支神，洞然明白矣。至於格龍之法，止要兩三節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不差錯，則卦氣已全，不必更多求于四五節之外，恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人拘泥太過，陽貴好龍，當面錯過，所以發此非楊公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷就之說也。但此兩三節定要淸純，若到頭節數畧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有勉強，不能無誤，又戒作者須其難其愼也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解：四正之龍，支神爲主，四隅之龍，干神爲主，正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083002264207411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與維，干與支，妙在用支之卦則用支，用干之卦則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用干，在用支之時則用支，在用干之時則用干，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在各得其用耳。惟乾坤艮巽，又與用干用支者有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異，只求水來當面便是眞龍，是非專重地支可知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。自三節不亂以下，皆格能之法也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一個星辰一節龍，龍來長短定枯榮。孟仲季山無雜亂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數產人龍上九重。節數多時富貴久，一代風光一節龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將氏曰：此亦論平洋龍神節數，以定世代近遠之應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總在行度之純雜上斷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083712627998735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姜氏曰：以上六節，皆言平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"洋大五行之法葢中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇所已明而反覆互見者也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直解水法：一曲一折，便爲一節。凡曲動處，水之情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形，總以相向抱穴有情者爲佳。如龍來長短，正謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈曲而愈妙也。曲多則易于夾雜，如果曲曲折折，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或孟或仲，均歸一路者，大貴之地也。世代久暫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應，都在曲折純雜向背上占騐也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理辨正卷之四終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083514673692707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"地理辨正卷之五","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690473001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"杜陵蔣平階大鴻氏著。門人臨安于鴻儀、會稽姜垚較正，錫山無心道人重校。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平砂玉尺辨僞總論","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690489385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理多僞書，平砂玉尺者，僞之尤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690505769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：是書也，以世目視之，儼然經也，子獨辨其僞，何居？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690522153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：惟世皆以爲經也，余用是不能無辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690538537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之術家，守之爲金科玉律，如蕭何之定漢法。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690554921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟出乎此，不得爲地理之正道，術士非","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690571305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532629542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此不克行，主家非此不敢信。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690571305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父以敎其子，師以傳其弟，果能識此，卽可以自號于人曰堪與家延之上坐，操人身家禍福之栖而不讓，拜人酒食金帛之賜而無慚。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690587689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以當世江湖之客，寳此書爲衣食之利器，譬農之耒耜，工之斧斤，其干謀生之策，可操劵而得也，有朝開卷而成誦，暮挾南車以行術者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690604073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知其足以禍世如是之酷哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690620457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知其禍世而不辨，余其無人心者哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690636841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：是書之來也遠矣，子又安知其爲僞也？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690653225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃從而辨之，曰：我亦辨之以理而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690669609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：此亦一理也，彼亦一理也，安知子","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690685993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083844861870114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之理是而彼之理非歟？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690685993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：余邀惠于先之賢哲，而授余以黃石靑烏楊公幕講之秘要，竊自謂于地理之道得之眞而見之確矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690702377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故于古今以來所謂地理之書，無所不畢覽。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690718761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡書之合于秘要者爲眞，不合秘要者爲僞，而此書不合之尤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690735145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既得先賢之秘要，又嘗近自三吳、兩浙，遠之齊魯、豫章、八閩之墟，縱觀近代名家墓宅，以及先世帝王聖賢陵墓古蹟，考其離合，正其是非。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690751529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡理之取驗者爲眞，無所取驗者爲僞，而此書不驗之尤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690767913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故敢斷其僞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690784297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以黄石、靑鳥楊公幕講斷之，以名庠己直降","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690800681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083163082031154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家墓宅先世古蹟斷之，非余敢以私見臆斷之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690800681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：然則秉忠之譔，伯溫之註，非與？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690817065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：此其所以爲僞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690833449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地理者，裁成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以經邦定國，禍福斯民者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690849833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三代以上，明君哲相，無不知之。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690866217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世道下衰，其說隱秘，而寄之乎山澤之癯，逃名避世之士，智者得之，嘗以輔翼興王，扶持景運，而其說之至者，不敢顯然以告世也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690882601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文成公之事明太祖，其最著者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690898985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其沒也，盡舉生平所用天文地理、數學之書，進之内府，從無片言隻字存于家而敎其子孫，況肯著書立說以傳當世？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690915369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083514673856547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即故几世本之稱靑田者，皆僞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690931753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"均之佐命之英，知靑田則知秉忠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690948137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：何是書之文辭井井乎若有可觀者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690964521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：其辭近是，𮏊理則非。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690980905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢亦世之通人而不知地理者，以意爲之，而傅會其說，託之乎二公者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532690997289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余特指共謬而一一辨之，將以救天下之溺于其說者。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691013673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨順水行龍山龍之脉與平壤龍脉，皆因水以驗其脉之動靜，而皆不卽水以限其脉之去來。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691030057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今先言山龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691046441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫山剛質也；水柔質也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691062825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之孔竅而水出焉，故兩山之間，必有三水。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691079209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691095593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083163082063922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窪下之處，卽水流行之道，水隨山而行，非山隨水而行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691095593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之高者，脉所從起，山之卑者，脉所從止。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691111977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山自高而卑，故水亦從之。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691128361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自高而卑，此一定之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691144745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往往大溪大澗之傍，小幹龍所憩焉；大江大河之側，大幹龍所休焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691161129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢來山之衆支聚乎此，故來水之衆泒亦聚乎此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691177513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然據水之順逆，論脉之行止，但可就其大槩而言爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691193897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若必謂水于此界，脉卽于此斷，水向左流，脉必不向右行，則不可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691210281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫龍脉之起伏轉摺，千變而不窮，有從小江小湖崩洪而過者矣；有從大江大河越數十百里，不知共","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691226665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084065935228962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"踪跡端","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691226665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866330763300/1-b0f0be986a8aa7aa.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2Fh8ZorQLF%2FMoNrqgkCKb%2BQSnC2I%3D","uri":"read/NA06797/3/ref/1koeg0bhrqlu4/1-b0f0be986a8aa7aa.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亻日儿","variants":"倪","charPicId":"7456690866330763300"},"logicSentenceId":"7679107532691226665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而過者矣；有收本身元辰小水，逆行數里而結者矣；有向大幹水逆奔數百里而結者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691226665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之眞者，水愈斷而其過脉愈竒，勢愈逆而其骨力愈壯，豈二水之橫流，可遏之使斷，牽之使前乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691243049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今玉尺云：順水直衝而逆囘結穴，方知體叚之眞；若逆水直衝而合襟在後，斷是虛花之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691259433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水趨歸東北，而坤申之氣施生；羣流來向震辰，而乾亥之龍毓秀。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691275817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲卯成胎，不食酉辛之氣；午丁生意，豈乘坎癸之靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691292201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據此而言，是天下必無逆水之龍也，豈其然哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691308585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：子所言者，山龍也，玉尺所言平辨王直解","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691324969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083163082096690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壤也，故其言曰：乾源曠野鋪氊，細認交襟；極隴平坡月角，詳看住結。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691324969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍有脉可據，故有逆水之穴；平壤無脉可尋，止就流神之去來，認氣之行止，豈與山之過峽超伏同年而語乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691341353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于生平專分山水二龍，以正告天下，何又執此論也？","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691357737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解之曰：平壤固純以流神辨氣，與山之脉峽不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691374121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至以水之來去爲氣之行止，則我不取。","logicSentenceId":"7679107532691390505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我，以爲酉辛水到，則甲卯之胎愈眞，癸坎流來，則午丁之靈益。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851637302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤中生氣，衆水必無東北之趨；乾亥成龍，羣流必無","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851653686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY2662/7461917585764778019/1-1742059725918.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HRfAotVMCSKBCJBjEsSdfoXwQEQ%3D","uri":"read/HY2672/8/ref/1kxjk5jpizfp2/1-1742059725918.webp","fontType":4,"components":"","variants":"巽","charPicId":"7482085016013586467"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878851653686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰之向。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851653686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此而言，玉尺不但干山龍特行特結之妙，","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851670070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083712628228111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"芒然未知，且于平壤雌雄交媾之機，大相背謬。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851670070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至其統論三大幹龍，而以爲北幹乃崑崙之丑艮出脉，而龍皆坤申。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851686454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南幹乃崑崙之巽辰出脉，而龍皆乾亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851702838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中條乃崑崙之寅甲卯乙出脉，而龍皆庚酉辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851719222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註者遂實其辭曰：北幹無離巽艮震穴，中幹無震巽艮穴，建康止有南離，臨安止有坤兌，八閩止有坤申。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851735606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"固哉玉尺之言龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851751990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫舉天下之大勢，大扺自","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851768374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878044880937/1-e2427f7d81db1f85.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Cp8XZSTx5Zx6cHr9qtopIEBo%2FmM%3D","uri":"read/CADAL02020202/2/ref/1l8gsn8vunk8j/1-e2427f7d81db1f85.webp","fontType":1,"components":"合儿","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690878044880937"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878851768374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之震、自乾之巽、自坤之艮者，地勢之從高而下然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851768374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于龍之剝换傳變，豈拘二方眞脉，性喜逆行，大地每多朝祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851784758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若執此書順水直衝之","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851801142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083314177769526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說，遇上格大地，反以爲不合理氣而棄之，而專取傾瀉奔流蕩然無氣之地，誤認爲眞結而葬之，其詒害于人，鳥有限量。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851801142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余故不得已而可","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851817526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879785402409/1-7dba4d5cf12ecd91.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eJ5xSj1fmivRsMgm9HlsM5ijFZs%3D","uri":"read/NA06806/25/ref/1kob8rjv8u3ad/1-7dba4d5cf12ecd91.webp","fontType":1,"components":"口𡨴","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690879785402409"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878851817526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反覆以辨之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851817526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨貴陰賤陽易曰：立天之道，曰陰與陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851833910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟此二氣，體無不具，用無不包，是二者不可偏廢，故曰孤陽不生，獨陰不長，是二者未嘗相離，故曰陽根于陰，陰根十陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851850294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舍陽而言陰者，非陰也；舍陰而言陽者，非陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851866678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人作易，必扶陽抑陰者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851883062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：道一而已，故曰乾，分而爲一，而名之曰坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851899446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以兩","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851915830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083637000667162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儀之對待者言，日陰陽，以一元之渾然者言，惟陽而已，言陽而陰在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851915830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而就人事言，則陽爲君子，陰爲小人，內君子外小人爲泰，内小人外君子爲否。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851932214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此言之，陽與陰不可分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851948598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟其分之，則貴陽賤陰，如聖人之作易可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851964982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴陰賤陽，是背乎聖人作易之旨，而亂天地之正道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851981366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺乃以艮、巽震、兌四卦爲陰之旺相而貴之，以乾坤坎離四卦爲陽之孤虚而賤之，卽以納甲八千十三支，丙納于艮，辛納于巽，庚納干震，而亥卯未從。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878851997750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之丁納于兌，而己酉丑從之，十者皆謂之陰而貴；以甲","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852014134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084065935327266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納乾，以乙納坤，以癸納坎，而子申辰從之；以壬納離，而午寅戍從之，十者皆謂之陽而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852014134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于是當世之言地理者，不論地之眞僞若何，凡見陰龍陰水陰向，則槩謂之吉，而見陽龍陽水陽向，則槩謂之凶，此乖謬之甚者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852030518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫吉凶之理，莫著于易，易六十四卦，各有其吉，各有其凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852046902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦，六十四卦之父母也，豈有四卦純吉，四卦純凶之理？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852063286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八千十二支亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852079670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾謂論地正論其是地非地，不當論共屬何卦體，屬何于支。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852096054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若果龍眞穴的，水神環抱，坐向得宜，雖陽亦吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852112438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若龍非眞來穴非眞結，砂飛水","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852128822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082877793763364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背，坐向偏斜，雖陰亦凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852128822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又拘所謂三吉六秀，而以爲出于天星。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852145206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考之天官家言，紫微垣在中國之壬亥方，而太微垣在丙午方，天市垣在寅艮方，且周天二十八宿分布十二宫，皆能爲福，皆能爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852161590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之二十四千支，上應列宿，亦猶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852177974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以在此爲吉，在彼爲凶？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852194358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此與天星之理全乎不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852210742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至謂乾坤爲老亢，辰戍爲魁，","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852227126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883347726348/1-a0bd36757bbf58eb.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VFksKaJUt9G391rXMyoXLoK7k%2Fg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoorvgv/1-a0bd36757bbf58eb.webp","fontType":1,"components":"皿止","variants":"罡","charPicId":"7456690883347726348"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878852227126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未爲暗金殺，種種悖理。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852227126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫乾坤乃諸卦之父母，六子皆其所産，何得爲凶？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852243510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老嫩之辨在于龍，龍之出身嫰，卽乾坤亦嫰也；龍之出身老，卽巽辛兑丁亦老也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852259894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗之戴匡爲魁，","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852276278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083637000716314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗柄所指爲天，正此樞斡四時，斟酌元氣，造化之大柄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852276278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理數家以爲天罡所指，衆煞潛形，何吉如之，而反以爲凶耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852292662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行皆天地之經䌍，何獨忌四金？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852309046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且庚酉辛金之最堅剛者也，旣不害其爲吉，而獨忌四隅之暗金甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852325430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無謂矣！","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852341814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸如此類，管郭楊賴，從無明文，不知妄作，流毒天下，始作俑者其無後乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852358198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我不禁臨文而三歎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852374582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨龍五行所屬，盈天地間，止有八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852390966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之位曰：乾坤定位，山","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852407350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879861145663/1-8991456c593500e8.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WIE5b2vAnTxbYuA7WrJV6%2FZvKS4%3D","uri":"read/NA02892/5/ref/1kvhkf64hmn92/1-8991456c593500e8.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵罒𦍒","variants":"澤","charPicId":"7456690879861145663"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878852407350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通氣，風雷相薄，水火不相射。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852407350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦總之陰陽而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852423734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山陽澤陰，","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852440118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084011912658996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷陽風陰，火陽水陰，皆兩儀對待之象，對待之中，化機出焉，所謂立牝之門，是爲天地根，一陰一陽之謂道。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852440118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦者，天地之體，五行者，天地之用。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852456502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當其爲體之時，未可以用言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852472886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故坎雖爲水，此先天之水，不可以有形之水言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852489270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離雖爲火，此先天之火，不可以有形之火言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852505654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故艮爲山而不可以土言也；兌爲澤而不可以金言也；震巽爲風雷，而不可以木言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852522038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以八卦屬五行，而論龍之所屬者皆非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852538422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論後天方位八卦，而以坎位北而爲水，以離位南而爲火，以震位東而爲木，以兌位西而","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852554806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083314177802294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲金，似矣，四隅皆土也，又何以巽木、乾金不隨四季而隨春秋耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852554806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此八卦五行之三謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852571190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及論二十四龍，則又造爲三合之說，復傅","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852587574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"音輔，俗作附，非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會之以雙山，更屬支離牽强，而全無憑據。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852587574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫旣以東南西北爲四正五行，則巳丙丁皆從離而爲火，亥壬癸皆從坎而爲水，寅甲乙皆從震而爲木，申庚辛皆從兌而爲金，辰戍丑未皆從四隅而爲土，猶之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852603958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今又以子合辰申而爲水，并其鄰之坤壬乙亦化爲水；以午合寅戍而爲火，并其鄰之艮丙辛亦化爲火；以卯合亥未而爲木，并其鄰之乾甲丁亦","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852620342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347082732532695078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化爲木；以酉合己丑而爲金，并其鄰之巽庚癸亦化爲金，論八卦則卦爻錯亂，論四令則方位顚倒，此三合、雙山之再謬也，所謂多岐亡羊，朝令夕改，自相矛盾，不特悖于理義，而亦不通于辭說者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852620342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以龍脉之左旋右旋而分五行之陰陽，曰：亥龍自甲卯、乙丑、艮寅、壬子、癸方來者爲陽木龍；亥龍自未、坤申、庚酉、辛戍、乾方來者爲陰木龍，其餘無不皆然，謬之謬者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852636726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以龍之所屬而起長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨官、帝旺、衰病、死、墓、絕、胎養，又以龍順逆之陰陽分起長生，曰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852653110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木屬甲，長生在亥，旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852653110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083163082162226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，墓于未，陰木屬乙，長生在午，旺于寅，墓于戍，其餘無不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852653110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉世若狂，以爲定理，眞可哀痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852669494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行者，陰陽二氣之精華，散于萬象，周流六虛，盈天地之内，無處不有五行之氣，無物不具五行之體。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852685878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今以龍而言，則直者爲木，圓者爲金，曲者爲水，銳者爲火，方者爲土，又窮五行之變體，而曰貪狼、木、巨門、土、祿存、土、文曲、水、廉貞、火、武曲、金","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852702262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoos83z/1-1759417591058.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gxiypa06x7%2BDlPvv8GMxzDQ5BOc%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoos83z/1-1759417591058.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556640195770302479"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878852702262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍、金、左輔土、右弼金，五行之變盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852702262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此楊、曾諸先覺明曰張膽以告後人者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852718646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫此九星五行者，或爲起祖之星，或爲傳變之星，或爲結穴之星，或爲夾從","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852735030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論城","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083867691417636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔佐之星，或兼二，或兼三，或兼四，甚而五星傳變，則地大不可名言。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852735030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以見五行者變化之物，未有單取一行不變以爲用者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852751414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今不于龍體求五行之變化，而但執方位論五行之名字，是使天地之生機不變不化，取其盡，廢其四矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852767798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又從方位之左右旋，分五行之陰陽，是使一氣之流行，左支右絀，得其半，并未全其三矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852784182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試以物產言之，隨地皆生五材。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852800566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰南方火地無大水，北方水地不火食，西方金地，不產各材，東方木地不產艮金，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852816950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試以禀性言之，盡人皆具五德。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852833334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日：東方之","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852849718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083511234297894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆無義，西方之人皆無仁，北方之人皆無禮，南方之人皆無智，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852849718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且獨不觀四時之流行乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852866102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春氣三嘘，而萬物皆生，不特東南生，而西北無不盡生；秋氣三肅，而萬物皆落，不特西北落，而東南無不盡落。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852882486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是生殺之氣，不可以方隅限也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852898870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又不觀五材之利用乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852915254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棟梁之木，遇斧斤而成材，入冶之金，須","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852931638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894752104484/1-4567a1ca252d1163.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IDdmk9OxrvbDGA3aRIG5jcLyKI0%3D","uri":"read/NA07901/3/ref/1kvp08w75534z/1-4567a1ca252d1163.webp","fontType":1,"components":"火𰍰一コ又","variants":"煆","charPicId":"7456690894752104484"},"logicSentenceId":"7679108878852931638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煉而成器。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852931638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大塊非耒耜不能耕耘，清泉非爨燎不能飮食。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852948022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道家者流，神而明之，故有水火交媾，金木合井之義，以爲大丹作用，卽大易旣濟歸妹之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852964406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：識得五行顛倒顛，便是大羅","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852980790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084065935458338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仙。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852980790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生者何嘗生，相尅者何嘗尅乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878852997174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今玉尺曰：癸王來百兌庚，乃作體全之象；坎水迎歸寅卯，名爲領氣之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853013558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金臨火位，自焚厥屍；木入金鄕，依稀絕命。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853029942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火龍畏見兌庚，遇北辰而自廢；東震愁逢火𪞾，見西兌而傷魂。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853046326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是山川有至美之精英，而以方位廢之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853062710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且五行之論生旺墓，而亦限之以方位，其說起于何人？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853079094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以天運言，則陽升則萬物皆生，陰升則萬物皆死，無此生彼死，此死彼生之分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853095478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以地脉言，有氣則在在皆生，無氣則在任皆死，無此生彼墓，此旺彼衰之界也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853111862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今龍必欲自生趨","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853128246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084065935491106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，自旺朝生，水必來于生旺，去于囚謝，砂之高下亦如之，皆因誤認來龍之五行所屬，于是紛紛不根之論咸。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853128246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從此而起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853144630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有謂龍之生旺墓若不合，别有立向消納之法，或以坐山起五行，或以向上論五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853161014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知山龍平壤，皆有一定之穴，生成之向，豈容拘牽字義，以意推移？","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853177398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝向論五行，固爲乖謬，坐山論五行，亦未爲得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853193782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王尺又兩可其說曰：可合雙山作用，法聯珠之妙，宜從卦例推求，尊納甲之宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853210166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又何其鼠首兩端，從無定見𫆀。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853226550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我願世之學地理者，山龍止看結體之五星，平壤止看水","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853242934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083715006332967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城之五星，此乃五行之眞者。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853242934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟精其義，雖以步武楊賴，亦自不難。","logicSentenceId":"7679108878853259318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于方位五行，不特小立空生尅出入宗廟，洪範","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252805674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872567595044/1-417e26efbd4f6aef.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WFgoNqTsoIdG%2BpdZ2KVMmQzqUNA%3D","uri":"read/HY2743/2/ref/1kr9bbily72us/1-417e26efbd4f6aef.webp","fontType":1,"components":"雔乂","variants":"雙","charPicId":"7456690872567595044"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587252805674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山三合斷不可信，卽正五行八卦五行亦不可拘。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252805674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此關一破，則正見漸開，邪說盡息，地理之道始有入門。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252822058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟乎！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252838442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我安得盡洗世人之肺腸，而曉然吿之以玄空大卦、天云九氣之眞訣，使黄石靑囊之秘，昭昭乎若揭日月而行也哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252854826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨四大水口夫四大水口，有至理存焉，楊公書中未嘗發露，惟希夷","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252871210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083511234363430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先生闔闢水法，倡明八卦之理，而四大水口之義寓于其中，此乃黃石公三字靑囊所固有，楊公特秘而不宣，卽希夷猶引而不發也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252871210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人不知天元八卦之妙用，妄以凡庸淺見測之，遂以爲辰戍丑未爲五行墓庫之方，輒以三合雙山傅會之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252887594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日：乙丙交而趨戍，辛王會而聚辰，斗牛納丁庚之氣，金羊收癸甲之靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252903978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼謬矣！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252920362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合五行起長生墓庫之非，卽龍上五行左旋爲陽，右旋爲陰，而同歸一庫，穿鑿不通之論，前篇皆已辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252936746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨此四大水口，原屬卦氣之妙用，靑囊之正訣，而亦爲此輩。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252953130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084241491984418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjooskr3/1-1759418213691.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3%2FMoTn1ZI7zplMpMSDg7kkYqjtg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjooskr3/1-1759418213691.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556642275171631144"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587252969514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合錯解，以僞亂眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252969514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余毎開卷至此，不勝扼腕，故又特舉而言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587252985898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫圖南先生八大局，皆從洛書八卦中來，一卦有一卦之水口，舉四隅之卦而言，則有四；若兼四正之卦而言，其實有八。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253002282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然括其要旨，卽一水口，而諸卦之理已。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253018666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其學者苟明乎此，山河大地，布滿黃金矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253035050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特以天心所秘，非人勿傳，故不敢筆之于書，聊因俗本，微露一端，任有夙慧者，死心自悟。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253051434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以爲陽艮龍，丙火交于乙，墓于戍；陰亥龍，乙木交于丙，亦墓于戍，以爲天根月窟，雌雄交媾，玄竅相通，種種癡人說夢，總因悞認諸家五","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253067818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083715006414887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，不知卦氣之理，以訛傳訛，盲修","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253067818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879923798057/1-4a29869e1e6d438f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Xc3J7fnhlBvKLWGWNVwt7pOgjP8%3D","uri":"read/HY1522/7/ref/1kw80rqoksc2q/1-4a29869e1e6d438f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"目㝉𠮷","variants":"瞎","charPicId":"7456690879923798057"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587253067818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煉。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253067818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾徧觀古來帝王陵寢，以及公卿名墓，何嘗有合此四語者？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253084202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用此四語，擇得合格之地，總與地理眞機無涉，其爲敗絕，亦猶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253100586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂勞而無功，聞余言者，不識能惕然有動干中否？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253116970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨陰陽交媾，天地之道，不過一陰陽交媾而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253133354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地有一大交媾，萬物各有三交媾，變變化化，施之無窮，論其微妙，莫可端倪，而實有其端俔，故曰：立牝之門，是爲天地根。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253149738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253166122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083593522380838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253166122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若確見雌雄交媾之處，則千卷靑囊，皆可付之祖龍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253182506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯理甚秘，而實在眼前，若一指明，觸目可覩，然断不從五行生旺墓上討消息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253198890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺乃曰：有乙辛丁癸之婦，配甲庚、丙壬之夫，又曰：陰遇陽而非其類，號曰陽差；陽見陰而非其耦，名曰陰錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253215274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍取必于乙丙之墓戍，辛壬之墓辰，丁庚之墓丑，癸甲之墓未，此眞三家村學究之見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253231658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陰陽之交媾，自然而然，不由勉强，亦活潑潑。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253248042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地不拘一方，豈可以方位板格、死煞排算乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253264426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽以天地之交媾者言，天氣二降，地氣三升，而雨澤斯沛矣，子能","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253280810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084241492017186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"預定天地之交于何方，合于何曰乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253280810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更以男女之交媾者言，陽精外施，陰血内抱，而胎元斯孕矣，子能預擬胎孕之何法而成，何時而結乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253297194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知天地男女之不可以矯揉造作，則知地理之所謂天根月窟，亦猶是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253313578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此惟楊公都天寶照，言之鑿鑿，不啻金針暗度。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253329962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余因辨玉尺之謬，而偶泄于此，具神識者，精思而𡨋悟之，或有鬼神之告也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253346346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨砂水吉凶今之地理家，分龍穴、砂水爲四事，或云龍雖好，穴不好，","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253362730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083637000765466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或云龍穴雖好，砂水不好，何異癡人說夢。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253362730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古之眞知地理者，只有尋龍定穴之法，無尋砂尋水之法，正以雖有四者之名，而其實一而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253379114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴者，龍之所結，水者龍之所源，砂者龍之所衞，故有是龍則有是穴，有是之則有是砂水。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253395498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未有龍穴不眞而砂水合格者也，亦未有龍眞穴的而砂水不稱者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253411882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺反曰：龍穴之善惡從水，猶女人之貴賤從夫，穴雖凶而水吉，尙集諸祥，是以本爲未，以未爲本，顚倒甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253428266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且其所謂吉凶者，只取四生三合、雙山五行，論去來之吉凶，而以來從生旺，去從墓絕","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253444650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083593522413606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者爲吉，反此者爲凶，旣屬可笑；又以砂水之在淨陰方位者爲吉，在淨陽方位者爲凶，尤爲拘泥。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253444650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫水之吉二，只辨天元衰旺之氣；砂者借賓伴主，只要朝拱環抱，其形尖員平正，秀麗端莊，皆爲吉曜；若斜飛反去，破碎醜拙，則爲凶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253461034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
