{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或題之曰文筆，曰誥輔，曰御屏，曰玉几，曰龍樓，曰鳳閣，曰仙橋，曰旗幟，曰堆甲屯兵，曰烟花粉黛。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253477418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸般名色，皆以象取之類應之，而不可拘執。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253493802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦須所穴者果是眞龍，胎息，精靈翕聚，而后一望臚列，皆其珍膳。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253510186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如一山數塜，同見貫砂，而一塜獨發，其餘皆杏貴，","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253526570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083844862132258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非貴之與賤，在龍穴而不關于砂乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253526570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况四神八國，並起星峯，皆堪獻秀，何必淨陰之位則吉，淨陽之位則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253542954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴無貴陰賤陽之分，砂水又豈有貴陰賤陽之分耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253559338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其云：文筆在坤申爲詞訟，旌旗見子午爲刦賊高峯出南離，恐驚囘祿；印星當日馬，必遭瞽疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253575722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾戍爲鼓盆之殺，坤流爲寡宿之星。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253592106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅甲水瘋疾纒身，乙辰水投河自縊。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253608490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：未離胎而夭折，多因冲破茄神，纔出世而身亡，葢爲擊傷生炁，四敗傷生，雖有子而母明父暗；旺神投浴，恐居官而淫亂可羞。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253624874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸如此類，不可枚舉，立辭愈巧，其","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253641258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084225696268324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愈虛，二謬百謬，難以悉辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253641258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總其大旨，日廢五行衰旺之說，被陰陽貴賤之名，可以論龍穴，卽可以論砂水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253657642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我于是書，取其四語曰：本主興隆，殺曜變爲文曜；龍身微賤，牙刀化作屠刀。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253674026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此則沙中之金，石中之玉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253690410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釆葑采菲，無以下體，故特舉而存之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253706794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨八煞黃泉祿馬水法。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253723178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水法中有祿上御街，馬上御街，其說鄙俚不經，而最能使俗人艶慕。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253739562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有黃泉八煞二種禁忌，使大望而畏之，若探湯焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253755946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我以爲其說皆妄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253772330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫祿馬貴人起例兄于","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253788714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083593522479142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六王，在易課中已屬借用，與地理祿命皆無于涉。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253788714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人學術無本，一見千支，便加祿馬，推命家用之，地理家亦用之，東邠西借，以張之子孫，繼李之宗祖，血脉不通，鬼神不享。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253805098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此在楊會以前，從不見于經傳，後之俗子妄加添設，不辨自明。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253821482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地理之正傳，止以星體爲巒頭，卦爻爲理氣，舍此二者，一切說立說妙，且無所用之，況其鄙俗之甚者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253837866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所稱馬貴者，亦有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253854250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰貴人，曰天馬，此皆取星峯而爲名，不在方位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253870634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之御街，亦以形論，非以方言。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253887018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于入煞黃泉，尤無根據，全然揑造，更與借","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253903402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084241492115490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用者不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253903402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天地一元之氣，周流六虛，八卦方位，先天後天，互爲根源，環相交合，相濟爲用，得其氣運則皆生，違其氣運則皆死，但當推求卦氣之興衰，以爲趨避耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253919786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從無此卦忌見彼卦，此父忌見彼爻之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253936170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若失氣運，則巽見辛，艮見丙，兌見丁，坤見乙，坎見癸，離見壬，震見庚，乾見甲，本宮納甲正配，尙足以興妖發禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253952554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得氣運，雖坎龍、坤兔、震猴、巽雞、乾馬、兌蛇、艮虎、離猪，而卦氣無傷，諸祥自致。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253968938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我謂推求理氣者，須知有氣運隨時之眞殺，實無卦爻配合之煞曜。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587253985322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今眞煞之刻期刻應，剝膚切骨","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254001706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083637000798234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，不知避，而拘拘忌八矅之假殺，亦可悲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254001706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃泉，即國大水口而强","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254018090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890720313407/1-872aecb614b0051b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AA7i9azdX%2BC7eZb65tQZ8CHPqKU%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/5/ref/1koeh5zj3mtyd/1-872aecb614b0051b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土人𭥴","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890720313407"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254018090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名色者也，故又曰：四箇黃泉能殺人，辰戍丑未爲破軍，四箇黃泉能救人，辰戍丑未爲巨門，故又文飾其名曰救貧黃泉。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254018090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫旣重九星，大立空水法，則不當又論黃泉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254034474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何其自相矛盾，一至于此？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254050858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或亦高人心知其誣，而患無以解世人之惑，故别立名色，巧爲寛譬耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254067242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未可知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254083626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其實則單論三吉水可矣，不必論黃泉。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254100010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254116394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且黃泉所忌，于彼所言淨陰淨陽、三合生旺墓水法，皆不盡合。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254132778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論陰陽，則乙忌巽是矣，而丙則同爲純陰；","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254149162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083593522577446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚丁忌坤，申癸忌艮，辛忌乾是矣，而壬則同爲純陽，何以亦","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254149162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892829835305/1-773c0957869d553b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dIFx60IOKfmRa2CWmnyjt3p%2FxxM%3D","uri":"read/HY1230/1/ref/1koef5yfhdg5n/1-773c0957869d553b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"巳心","variants":"忌","charPicId":"7456690892829835305"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254149162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881505034294/1-2caade7b7bbdfe25.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Ca5PbmACQHQko1m6uD2COyO8Xg4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoosxe7/1-2caade7b7bbdfe25.webp","fontType":1,"components":"止刂","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690881505034294"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254149162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于淨陰净陽自相矛盾也？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254149162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論三合五行，則乙水向見巽，丁木向見坤，辛火向見乾，癸金向見艮，同爲墓絕方","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254165546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892829835305/1-773c0957869d553b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dIFx60IOKfmRa2CWmnyjt3p%2FxxM%3D","uri":"read/HY1230/1/ref/1koef5yfhdg5n/1-773c0957869d553b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"巳心","variants":"忌","charPicId":"7456690892829835305"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254165546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254165546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火向見巽，庚金向見坤，壬水向見乾，甲木向見艮，皆臨官方也，何以亦","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254181930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892829835305/1-773c0957869d553b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dIFx60IOKfmRa2CWmnyjt3p%2FxxM%3D","uri":"read/HY1230/1/ref/1koef5yfhdg5n/1-773c0957869d553b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"巳心","variants":"忌","charPicId":"7456690892829835305"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254181930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此千三合雙山自相矛盾也？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254181930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我卽彼之謬者，而以証其謬中之謬，雖有蘇、張之舌，亦無辭以復我矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254198314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺遂飾其說曰：八殺黄泉，雖云惡曜，若在生方，例難同斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254214698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此眞掩耳盜鈴之術。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254231082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣云惡曜矣，又焉得云生方？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254247466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣云生方矣，又焉得稱","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254263850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084241492230178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254263850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰知惡曜固不眞，而生方亦皆假也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254280234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或者又爲之辭曰：黃泉忌水，去而不","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254296618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892829835305/1-773c0957869d553b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dIFx60IOKfmRa2CWmnyjt3p%2FxxM%3D","uri":"read/HY1230/1/ref/1koef5yfhdg5n/1-773c0957869d553b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"巳心","variants":"忌","charPicId":"7456690892829835305"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587254296618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來；或又曰忌水𬽃而不忌去，總屬支離，茫無一實。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254296618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我謂運氣乘旺，雖黃泉而但見其福；運氣當衰，雖非黃泉而立見其禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254313002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟知其要，不辨自明。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254329386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而我偲偲然論之不置者，以世人迷惑已久，如墮深坑，無力自脫，多方曉譬，庶以云救也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254345770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼，當世亦有見余此心者耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254362154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨分房公位夫葬者，所以安親魄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254378538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親魄安則衆子皆安，親魄不安，","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254394922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083988185415717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則衆子皆不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254394922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之世家巨族，往往累年不葬，甚至遲之又久，終無葬期。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254411306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一則悞于以擇地爲難，再則悞于拘分房之說，一子之家猶可，子孫愈多，爭執愈甚，遂有挾私見以隄防，用權謀以自使者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587254427690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時得一吉地，惑王旁人之言，以爲不利于己而阻之者，阻之不已，竟葬凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416383542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地同歸于盡，亦可哀哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416399926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原其故，皆地理書公位之說爲之禍根，使人滅偷理喪","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416416310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoota1b/1-1759421215634.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uiO1OFRkXudnVE%2F5%2B22OHlsXrWo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjoota1b/1-1759421215634.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556655742884839458"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587416416310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心，無所不極其至也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416416310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知葬地如樹木，根荄得氣，則衆枝皆榮，根荄先撥，則衆枝皆萎，亦有一枝榮，一枝萎者，外物傷殘之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416432694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬親者但論","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416449078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083593522610214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其地之吉凶，斷不可執房分之私見。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416449078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾觀歴來名宗巨室，往往共一祖地，各分均發者甚多，亦有獨發一房，或獨絕一房者，此有天焉，不可以人之智巧爭也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416465462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問曰：然則公位之說全謬與？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416481846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又何以有獨發獨絕者耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416498230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：是固有之，而非世人之所知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416514614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其說在易曰：震爲長男，坎爲中男，艮爲少男，巽爲長女，離爲中女，兌爲少女，孟仲季之分房，由此而起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416530998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然其中有通變之機，非屬此邽，卽應此子，應此女之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416547382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺乃云：胎養生沐屬長子，冠臨壯衰屬仲子，病死墓絕屬季子。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416563766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽就彼之言以折","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416580150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084349927620648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，生則諸子皆生矣，旺則諸子皆旺矣，死絕則諸子皆死絕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416580150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何爲以此屬長，以此屬仲，以此屬季？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416596534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：亦以其漸耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416612918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"折之曰：以爲始于胎養，繼而之旺，旣而死絶，似矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416629302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有四子以往，則又當如何耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416645686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其轉而歸于生旺耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416662070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抑另設何名以應之耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416678454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此不足據之甚者也，世人愼勿惑于其說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416694838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論後，蔣子作五尺辨僞旣成，或問曰：子于是書訛謬辨之則既詳矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416711222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子謂吉凶之理存乎地，而非方位之所得而限","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416727606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084347872116790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416727606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則八千四維、十二支，舉無有吉凶之當論乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416743990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：何爲其然也？","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416760374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我正謂八干四維、十二支皆分屬乎卦氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416776758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫卦氣吉凶之有辨，葢灼灼矣，而特非淨陽浄陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416793142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙山三合生旺墓之云云也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416809526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃若靑囊正理，方位之辨，實有之，其秘者不敢宣泄，姑就玉尺之文以槩舉之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416825910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺所畏者，曰乙辰，曰寅甲，而以靑囊言之，乙之與辰，寅之與甲，相去不啻□□□七，有□□□□□□□□比凶而彼吉者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416842294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所最羡者曰巽巳丙，而以靑囊言之，巽巳之與丙，相去亦不啻千萬里也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416858678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時此吉而彼凶，有時此凶","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416875062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083988185514021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而彼吉者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416875062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所最欲分别而不使之混者，曰丙午、丁，曰乾亥，曰甲卯乙，曰辰巽，曰丑艮寅，而以靑囊言之，午之與丙丁，亥之與乾，卯之與甲乙，巽之與辰丑，寅之與艮，所争不過尺寸之間而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416891446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時而吉，則必與之俱吉，有時而凶，則必與之俱凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416907830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今乃于其當辨而不可不辨者，如黃精之與勾吻，附子之與烏頭，一誤用之，而足以入口傷生者，反置之不辨；于其易辨而可以不辨者，如白梁之與黑秬，異色而皆可以養人；堇之與鴆異類，而皆可以殺人者，屑屑焉悉舉而辨之，彼自以爲智，而乃","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416924214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084604378972170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之大愚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416924214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且生旺死絕之說，靑囊未嘗不重之，故葬書曰：葬者，乘生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416940598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣之所謂生，非三合五行之所謂生；卦氣之所謂旺，非三合五行之所謂旺；卦氣之所謂死絕，非三合五行之所謂死絕。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416956982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且地氣之大生旺不知趨，而區區誤認一干一支之假生旺而求迎之；地氣之大死絕不知避，而區區誤認一干一支之假死絕而思避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416973366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悲夫！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587416989750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂雀以一葉障目，而謂彈者之不我見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417006134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此爲己，適以害己；以此爲人，適以害人而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417022518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故夫玉尺之于地理，猶鄭聲之于雅樂，楊墨之于仁義，二","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417038902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084576856113186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是一非，勢不兩立，實有關于世道之盛衰，天地之氣數。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417038902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竊聞嘉靖以前，其書尙未大顯，至萬歴時，有徐之鏌者，爲之增釋圖局而梓行之，于是江湖行術之徒，莫不手握一編以求食于世，至今曰，而惑于其說者，且徧天下也，悖陰陽之正，干天地之和，與俶擾五行，怠棄三正者，同其禍患。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417055286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有聖人者出，而誅非聖之書，于陰","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417071670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881757691967/1-f32315f2384ef87f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0ufo9pkPzXvppZFPy0sORXOgIT0%3D","uri":"read/HY2142/3/ref/1kpj4vwgn37l1/1-f32315f2384ef87f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"阝目一勿","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690881757691967"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587417071670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一家，必此書爲之首。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417071670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417088054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書不破，世運何由而息水火，生民何由而躋仁壽哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417104438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我拭目望之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417120822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平砂王尺辨僞總括歌會稽姜垚汝臯撰。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417137206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084604379004938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬卷堪輿總失眞，平砂玉尺最堪嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417153590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二劉名姓憑伊冐，豈有當年手澤存。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417169974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開國伯温成佐命，嘗將妙訣定乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417186358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晩年一篋青囊秘，盡作天家石室珍。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417202742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶不容人漏泄，忍將隱禍中","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417219126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894521319436/1-1f7d1e5e38c6cf33.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YzTsa5XGEAZL58zdEAKWPihR7MM%3D","uri":"read/HY0747/2/ref/1kp7y6ea97ghf/1-1f7d1e5e38c6cf33.webp","fontType":1,"components":"日儿","variants":"兒","charPicId":"7456690894521319436"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587417219126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417219126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"片言隻字無畱影，肯借他人齒頰名。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417235510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秉忠亦是元勲列，敢冒嫌疑著此經。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417251894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世上江湖行乞者，只貪膚淺好施行。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417268278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"户誦家傳如至寶，興災釀禍害生民。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417284662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸遇我師垂憫救，苦心辨駁著斯文。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417301046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竊恐愚夫迷不悟，括成俚句好歌今。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417317430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"願君細察歌中意，莫枉宗陽一片心。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417333814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下山山多順水，此是行龍之大體。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417350198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍發足不隨他，","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417366582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084604379054090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定是轉關星特起。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417366582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特起之龍變化多，渡水逆行不計里。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417382966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺開章說順龍，順水直衝爲大旨。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417399350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水來甲卯兌不收，水來丁午坎不取，必要隨流到合襟。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417415734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直瀉直奔名漏髓，全無眞息蔭龍胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417432118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山穴平陽皆失軌。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417448502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君莫聽此胡言，悞向順流探脉理。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417464886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八方位位有眞龍，爻象于支總一同。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417481270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山脉隂陽分兩界，此是天然造化工。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417497654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽脉出身陽到底，陰脉出身陰爲宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417514038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從無僞來并僞落，豈有貴賤分雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417530422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是眞胎成骨相，乾坤辰戍也崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417546806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是空亡無氣小，巽辛亥艮盡招凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417563190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品水評砂原一例，三吉六秀有何功。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417579574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347083988185579557"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君莫聽此胡言，旺相孤虚理不通。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417595958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相生與相尅，此是後天粗","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417612342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879875137575/1-948d16222f702ab4.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yVgeXu9m1Jya1qGSLHv21TPjXuI%3D","uri":"read/HY2107/6/ref/1ktw9jly7mtye/1-948d16222f702ab4.webp","fontType":1,"components":"米厂䒑禺","variants":"糲","charPicId":"7456690879875137575"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587417612342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417612342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山川妙氣本先天生，不須生尅非尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417628726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木行金地反成材，火入水鄕眞配匹，南離爐冶出眞金。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417645110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽妙處全須逆，原說五行顚倒顛。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417661494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庸庸之輩何能識。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417677878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天理氣在卦爻，生旺休因此中出。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417694262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"量山步水總一般，立向收砂非二格。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417710646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安有長生及官旺，全無墓庫與死絕。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417727030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦若旺時路路通，卦若衰時路路塞。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417743414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人識得卦興衰，眼前盡是黃金陌。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417759798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納甲本是卦中立，用他配合皆非的。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417776182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪笑三合及雙山，立空生出并尅出，更有祿馬及赦文。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417792566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084347872215094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池黃泉八曜煞，庸奴只把掌心輪，誤盡天涯聰慧客。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417808950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君莫聽此胡言。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417825334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行更覔","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417841718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OLGcYEdGxH24kFB%2FwFYRCB7VHuE%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7679109587417841718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消息，雌雄交媾大陰陽，月窟天根卦內藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417841718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是乾坤造化本，會時便號法中王。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417858102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公說箇圑團轉，一左一右兩分張。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417874486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明明指出夫和婦，有箇單時便是雙。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417890870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山雙雙起，八卦之中定短長。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417907254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈料庸奴多錯解，千支字上去商量。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417923638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誤起長生分兩局，會同墓庫到其鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417940022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未曾曉得眞交媾，那裏懷胎喚父孃。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417956406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我卽汝言來敎汝，陰陽指氣不指方。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417972790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚内壬是陽位，有時占陰不喚陽；乙辛丁癸是陰位，有時占陽卽喚陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679109587417989174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineI t":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫定卦分元，辨星審運，此非臆造，乃出自然。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273484835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天元九","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273501219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，遞管樞機，千支八卦，統歸皇極，則九星流轉，三八顚","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273501219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒，則陰不是陰，陽不是陽，倒地翻天，故曰對不同在元","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273501219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273501219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然是法造物之所忌，先師之所秘，苟能曉得九星流。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273517603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉之機，則一卦通管三卦，雙起之元關自能畧見二斑。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273533987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣最嫌於雜，故此收山納水，務取清純，而龍氣又病","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273550371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084509793304614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於單，故源泒當求滙合。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273550371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若使八神齊到，氣水兼收，再能","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273566755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼貪兼輔，則上下三元，三星六甲，直達補救之法，亦在","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273566755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273566755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法者，繩墨也，其用則工之巧也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273583139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乘時立穴之法，苟非","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273599523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼顧星源，則龍運未交，先遭衰替，盛時既代，便即凌夷，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273599523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又安能一元而兼得兩元龍力悠遠不替耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273599523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能裁制","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273615907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得宜，天元取輔，人地兼貪，即出而不出之要訣，亦可得","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273615907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273615907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元之後，卽接人元，斯則六甲三分，九星顚倒，八國轉","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273632291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084509793353766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"移，要求諸卦之宗，細","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273632291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw7x8g/1-1759399371226.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mdGGJfl1wNImCQyfu91xPmJA%2B5g%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw7x8g/1-1759399371226.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7556561793444855862"},"logicSentenceId":"7679114898273632291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"統龍之氣，例地翻天，半由乎此，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273632291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何位何宮，亦由乎此。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273632291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼即一白五行屬水，先天爲乾，後天爲坎，數爲萬數","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273648675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之始，卦爲諸卦之首，運値上元，氣通八卦，星氣和平，施","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273648675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力悠遠，故此楊公有脉取更取之語。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273648675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則兼貪己屬出","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273665059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，知此，方知出而不出之妙用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273665059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道德經云：天得一","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273681443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以淸，地得一以寕，神得一以靈，糓得一以盈，萬物得","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273681443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以龍，侯王得一以正。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273681443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，一之爲用大矣哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273697827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五星者，即水火金木之五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273714211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質行於地，而氣行於","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273730595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084509793435686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天，故天有五星，地有五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273730595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有九星，地有九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273746979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫九星","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273763363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，即北斗中貪、巨是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273763363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九宮者，卽坎、坤、震、巽、乾兑、離長","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273779747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與中央也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273779747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在地之九宮，有此闢彼闔，此一彼二，陰陽奇","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273796131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耦之殊，此二彼二者，以顯天心之所在也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273796131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一交會，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273878051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084955589115919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍眞穴的，羣山四聚，發祖之山，過度之山，莫不統會，或","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273878051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作應照，或作闗闌，或作朝案，骨肉一氣，情意親切。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273878051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二交喜，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273894435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二水相會，𨚫如湖裏交鵝，山有情，水有意，氣止水交，形","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273894435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止氣蓄之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273894435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三交泰，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273910819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四面情形，邞與主山相稱，不至主弱而賓強，體得而用","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273910819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失，砂水無欺壓牽動之虞，有澄淨安帖之趣。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273910819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四交媾，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273927203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084955589148687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道其形曰交媾，言其情曰雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273927203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交媾者，是言山水有雌","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273943587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雄交媾之眞情也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273943587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五相見。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273959971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云相見者，卽是一山不論一山之陰陽，而論與此山","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273976355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相見之陰陽；一水不論一水之陰陽，而論與此水相見","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273976355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之陰陽者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273976355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相見有兩說：二說是體，一說是用。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898273992739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體之相見，卽是山水情形，有賓主相迎相見之情狀，此","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274009123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義易知。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274009123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟用之相見，如山上排龍，山上所得星辰，要與","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274025507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水裏所得星辰陰陽相見；水裏排龍，水裏所得星辰，又","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274025507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085453142540324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要與山上所得星辰往來相見。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274025507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相見者，即是陰陽動靜，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274041891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配合生生之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274041891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲和","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274058275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲和，是言體得其體，用得其用，有陰陽動靜配合生生","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274058275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274058275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此两節皆是點穴定向之元微。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274074659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲和相見，指體用之","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274091043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡善者而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274091043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右四交及冲和相見，言體言用，乃隨身之至寶，興廢","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274107427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之攸闗，須口傳心授。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274107427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如昧此理，幸勿妄爲，自取禍害。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274123811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084509793517606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁人孝子，宜究心焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274140195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274156579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885451857983/1-7c46015216ed8d8a.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rMb%2BBYvXiHJTG8Tj2Tovqquw%2B%2BQ%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzw9og0/1-7c46015216ed8d8a.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丌又","variants":"𢗏","charPicId":"7456690885451857983"},"logicSentenceId":"7679114898274156579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會交喜者，山與水交，水與","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274156579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山交；交㤗者，指山水相交，有悠悠自然之𧼈。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274156579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍脉有","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274172963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一力專注入穴之勢；八首有一口吸到我腹之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274172963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274189347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星有統攝周圍之勢，砂水有趨承眷愁之勢，而水之","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274189347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與砂，更有紓迴關截之勢，如君臣交來之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274189347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交媾，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274205731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指陰陽配合而言，青囊所云相見，指人方而言，非謂","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274205731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一山一水而言也，即一六二七、三八四九，陽水陰山，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274205731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水陽山，元空會合之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274205731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八極神樞：","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274222115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085590472425499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰淸真。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274222115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清者，是言來龍來脉、來水千支方位之不以","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274238499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274238499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂之淸。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274254883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞者，眞也，眞而再兼不雜，方爲淸眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274271267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274287651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亥王乙辰之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274287651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸者，子癸午丁、乾亥坤由之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274304035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二日專一，言千支有干支之專一，情性有情性之專。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274320419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴情砂水朝案及情性干支，都以專一者爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274336803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專者，專","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274353187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274353187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍脉專於此，砂水專於此，四面拱向之情亦專","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274369571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此，故曰專一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274369571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日深蓄，深蓄則氣厚，淺露則氣薄，穴貴窩藏，忌突露；","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274385955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴貴和平，忌偏斜欹側。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274385955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084835384721435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰端平。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274402339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端平，言不欹不側，端方平正。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274418723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主山有尊嚴之","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274435107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢，砂水有朝拱之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274435107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平者，無偏無側之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274451491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山不論大","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274467875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小，只要端方周正，定出正人高士、忠臣孝子；大忌侧體","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274467875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顧人，定出奸邪之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274467875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰翕聚，形止氣蓄，方是翕聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274484259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翕者，合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274500643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚者，藏也，蓄","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274517027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，謂山水精靈，都翕聚於此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274517027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六日環衞，言穴氣須固也，四面照顧有情，謂之環衞。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274533411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七日中和，言不偏不倚，不欹不則，不上不下，不沉不浮，","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274549795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水兼得，都謂之中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274549795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中和云者，陽水陰山，彼此生生","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274566179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084955589246991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274566179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青囊經云：相見而得其中和之氣者，福祿永貞；","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274582563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相見而不得其中和之氣者，便是禍咎之根者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274582563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰明淨，言立穴無碍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274598947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我不碍人，人不碍我，自然明。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274615331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凈再水光照穴有情處，須得方圓明淨，形如鏡者，此謂","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274631715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之眞明凈也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274631715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此黃輿建極之神符，靑囊傳心之奥旨。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274648099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無極大士衍","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274664483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此靈符，遠溯管、郭，中及楊、曾，近稽劉、賴，無能出此範","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274664483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圍。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274664483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能神而明之，變而通之，誠濟世之津梁，救貧之","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274680867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金丹，寶之寶之，勿示匪人，恐招造物之忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274680867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084908084559913"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心眼指要卷之一終","logicSentenceId":"7679114898274697251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳日：數往者順，知來者逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055664155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法葢以中五爲皇極，中五","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055680539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以前爲往，往者順，一、二、三、四是也；中五以後爲來，來者","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055680539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆，九、八、七、六是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055680539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：是故易逆數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055696923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢自河圖、易出，","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055713307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書對待縱横，自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055713307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨒾數云者，將往來生成之","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055729691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數皆八中宮逆數其所以逆数之故，","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055729691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余不揣固陋，特繪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084953299042342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖、易出洛書於右，以博精乎易理者一笑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055729691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0504/8/ref/1llldz7i565ux/1-7347084953299042342_87252_10051758.webp~tplv-ceu0di {"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵法有八陣，醫方亦有八陣，地理有傳","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心入易，一而八之，所以通變化；八而一","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，所以辨天心。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵法之八陣，係國家之","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055778843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安危；醫方之八陣，司性命之存亡；地理","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055778843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之八易，順天氣之流行，闗子孫之興替。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055778843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當細心參考，靑囊天玉之機，自能","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055795227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畧見一斑矣","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055795227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055811611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖南先生八大局，卽是地理之八陣，特以天心所秘，故","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不敢筆之干書，聊因俗本，畧露一端，貴學者細心自悟，","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085668905943040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必有所得也","logicSentenceId":"7679109853055827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227700275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理氣一法，原本洛書，九氣，上應北斗，主宰天地化育之","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227700275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道，運斡四時，流通八國，正是理氣之宗祖，用法之眞詮。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227700275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得其訣，用之究盈虛，考消息，測盛衰，辨得失，如鏡臨","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227716659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物，一毫不爽者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227716659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不得其訣，徒以洛書之坎一坤一","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227733043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呆方位，辨吉凶，定盛衰者，何異乎刻舟求劍耶","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227733043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227782195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大元空，妙無窮，排六甲，運九龍，來何地，落何宮，顚顚倒，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227782195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085687868358667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順逆從坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227782195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬乙是巨門，巽辰亥武曲名，艮雨辛是破軍","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227798579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲癸申，貪狼行。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227798579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心動九宮，更是巨門非巨門，非巨門","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227814963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是巨門。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227814963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙雙起，無定名，通變化，都是春","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227831347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227880499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪天道，輿地道。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227880499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿之道，卽天地之道。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227896883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天主降，地主升，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227913267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天主動，地主靜。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227913267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天依形，地附氣，理寓於氣，氣囿於形。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227929651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227946035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形家擇地，必使所取之地足以承天，天不我隔，必使所","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227946035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承之山足以納氣，氣不我去。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227946035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地合其德，體用合其宜，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227962419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖讀靑囊萬卷，無外乎此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227962419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子云：位者安其所，育者","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227978803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085687868391435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遂其生。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227978803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能安其所，遂其生，卽是體得其體，用得其用","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227995187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061227995187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無奈世人不知堪輿爲何物，只從水之左來右到立。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228011571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向消納此，猶指天而射魚，焉能得中耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228027955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天爲氣之始，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228044339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故氣機初動，而萬物悉資之以爲始也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228044339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一始則無所不","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228060723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始，而生而成，總此一元直貫，故曰統天。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228060723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如曉元空之精","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228077107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髓，則天道始終迭運，消長之機，都在掌握中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228077107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228093491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也，萬物之始，氣始之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228093491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，形始之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228109875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物資坤以","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228126259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，然非坤之自爲也，乃順承乎天氣之始耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228126259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故此收山","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228142643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納水，須承天氣，方謂之承生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228142643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之道，可一言而","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228159027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347084953299189798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228159027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲物不或，則其生物不測。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228175411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以一誠運於上，地以","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228191795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一誠運於下，故生物不測。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228191795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠爲物之體，物爲誠之用，體","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228208179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用各得，方是物物。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228208179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一鬼神，卽是物物一太極。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228224563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地不","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228240947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，萬物不生。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228240947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地合而萬物生，天地交而萬物通，得體","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228257331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得用，卽是交合。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228257331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至不息者天也，至不動者地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228273715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一動一","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228290099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜，萬物生生化化之氣機。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228290099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以氣煦，地以形嫗，天圓","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228306483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地方，圓者一而圍三，三各一奇，故參天而爲三。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228306483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方者一","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228322867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而圍四，四合二偶，故兩地而爲二。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228322867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬數皆由此而起。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228339251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228355635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085590472589339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之間，本三氣之流行，而有動靜之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228388403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其流行之","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228404787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，統體而言，謂之天，無所不包。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228404787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其動靜分之而言，則","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228421171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰陽剛柔之别。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228421171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其氣而言，則陽爲剛，陰爲柔；以其","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228437555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質而言，則陰爲剛而陽爲柔矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228437555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
