{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228486707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬者，藏也，乘者，接也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228503091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬乘生氣，卽乘天地陰陽，化生萬","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228519475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228519475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然天有天之生氣，地有地之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228535859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天者，氣也，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228552243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用也；地者，形也，體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228552243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體有山水之分，用有得失之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228568627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228585011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此生彼死之異，用有此往彼來消長之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228585011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體以活潑","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228601395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085935990800436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈動者爲生，僵直粗頑者□死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228601395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要求龍體之生死全在。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228617779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎形氣神三心上着眼，方得察神氣，看色澤，挨生棄死","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228634163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去，皆就面之要訣，用之生死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228634163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以來者爲生，往者爲死，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228650547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與時合者爲生，與時背者爲死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228650547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要得用之生死，當在盈","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228666931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛消息上揣摹，自得察血脉，認金龍，葬乘生氣之元機","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228666931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228666931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書所論乘生氣三字，百二十家，千言萬語，非從形","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228683315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"跡上著眼，卽從二十四千丈上迷心妄想，顚倒播弄出","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228683315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許多名色，未曾道著。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228683315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之生氣，如天之生氣，卽是化生","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228699699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228699699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣葢以當元言爲旺，將來者爲生，方過","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228716083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085935990898740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者爲衰，過去已久者謂之死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228716083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍平洋，山水分用，總是","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228732467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一殺，又云：水以向納龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228732467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以山收方得山水分用乘生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之元機，生氣卽是化生萬物之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228732467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍氷龍陰陽二","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228748851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅，苟能承得天地生生之氣，自能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228748851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若背此生氣，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228765235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便衰退，理所必然。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228765235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此生氣是元空無形之生氣，非挨左","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228781619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨右有形可見之生氣，又非長生官旺之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228781619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者宜","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228798003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228798003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其陽者生，得其陰者死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228814387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順天之氣則生，違天之","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228830771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣則死，此卽葬乘生氣之元機。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228830771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫𭟄頭有形有跡，向背","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228847155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生死，有形可見，體認無難。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228847155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形者，神也氣也，變化不測，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228863539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085687868489739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽不一，吉凶無定，若非傳心傳眼者，可與共談斯道","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228863539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也耶","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228863539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228879923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉認來龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228896307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228912691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點穴之難，難於詔氣；認氣之難，難於說脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228912691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫脉之形象，","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228929075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細而軟，和而緩，動而微，如人身之脉三般，有呼吸浮沉","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228929075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之動氣者爲生，直硬粗顽者爲死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228929075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉之曲直橫斜，卽是","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228945459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉之變化生死；忽隱忽現，若斷若續，亦是脉之變化生","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228945459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228945459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能識得氣脉變化生死之真情，由氣脉再察氣色","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228961843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之榮枯，穴情之隱顯偏正，任爾奇奇怪怪之穴自無遺。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228961843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085590472720411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228978227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之道，不離乎形氣精神，所謂有神卽生，無神","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228994611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽死者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061228994611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉之形象，葢有數種，有一種，可一望而","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229010995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知；有一種初看似無，細看實有者。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229010995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或從本身看者，或從","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229027379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對面看者，或有從傍看者，細看方能觀脉之有無也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229027379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229043763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，穴之有無眞假，都在此來龍來脉上討消息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229043763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必須","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229060147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細察爲安","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229060147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之道，惟生氣最爲難認。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229109299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢生氣之外，上下左右皆","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229125683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是死氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229125683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詔氣者，須於百死之中認其一生，一生之外，識","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229142067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085838410317862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其百死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229142067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫煞就和，挨生棄死於毫釐尺寸之間。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229158451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再辨來","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229174835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍來脉，是何方位，是何干支，山與水一一辨淸，再兼用","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229174835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，因地置宜，隨時兼取，斯爲得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229174835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詔生死爲堪輿家","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229191219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一件要事，宜細察之","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229191219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229207603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審理氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229223987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天即理也，理爲天之體，氣爲天之用。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229240371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理氣云者，是分理","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229256755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元九運運行遷謝、盈虛消長之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229256755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫三元九運盈","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229273139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚消長之氣，無形可見，無跡可尋者也，讀者從何可理？","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229273139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能理得三元九運運行遷謝之氣，孰往孰來，誰消誰","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229289523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085668906139648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長，必使來者長者而趨之，往者消者而避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229289523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則看","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229305907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍，乘生氣，察血脉，認來龍之元機，曰能了了矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229305907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229322291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地陰陽之化生，實生民性命之根源，首把握補救之妙","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229322291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用者，誠我道代天之大權。","logicSentenceId":"7679111061229322291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使我於此而見理不眞，眼法","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347378202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不到，一舉一動，賊害有不可勝言者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347378202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天道貴信，地","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347394586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道貴眞，不信不眞，萬物不生。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347394586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動者，天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347410970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變者，物從而變","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347427354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化，則有不知其所以然而然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347427354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼以形言，體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347443738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347460122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理三言，用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347460122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者天之體，易者天之用，物之千變萬化，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347476506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此氣，非有綢繆而能如是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347476506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有時以生，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347492890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347492890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085668906172416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺生殺卽陰陽消長之道，用法當趨其生，避共殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347492890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347509274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生萬物，以陰成萬物，生者，仁也，成者，義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347509274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故理氣者","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347525658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當趨其生，避其成也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347525658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347542042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347558426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山有山之陰陽，水有水之陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347574810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之陰陽，葢以開面者","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347591194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陽，收束者爲陰，曲動活潑者爲陽，僵直粗頑者爲陰，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347591194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以向穴者爲陽，背穴者爲陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347591194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之陰陽，葢以特潤","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347607578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特大者爲陽，狹小直硬者爲陰，屈曲活動者爲陽，破碎","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347607578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏斜者爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347607578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有情顧穴者爲陽，無情向穴者爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347623962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千支","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347640346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085676166348863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有王支之陰陽，卦爻有卦爻之陰陽，卦爻之陰陽，葢以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347640346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇者爲陽，耦者爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347640346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王支之陰陽，則又以甲𢈔壬丙爲","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347656730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，乙辛丁癸爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347656730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支之陰陽，以辰戌丑未爲陰，寅申己","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347673114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347673114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若顚倒無定之陰陽，則又以來何地，落何宮，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347689498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時而在者分陰陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347689498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍須要干支淸純，水龍亦","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347705882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要干支不雜，如來龍來脉有錯雜之病，須求水法純一","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347705882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以補之；或山水都帶夾雜之病，須用五吉以救之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347705882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347722266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心眼之至要者也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347722266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347738650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨順逆","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347755034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085838410416166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與時合者爲順，又名正神；與時背者爲逆，又名零神。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347771418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347787802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則生旺，逆則衰死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347787802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此順逆是氣運消長之順逆，非千支","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347804186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顛倒之順逆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347804186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂順天者","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347820570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昌，此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬，乘生氣者，亦卽","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347820570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347820570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然有山水之分用，讀者宜察","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347836954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星八卦，本無有吉，合時則吉；本無有凶，背時則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347886106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347902490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，推算何星，旺於何時何卦，吉於何運也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347902490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三吉者，有一","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347918874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦卽有三卦，有一吉即有三吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347918874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此三吉吉凶無着，隨","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347935258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用而轉移者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347935258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085838410448934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨落脉","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347951642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡結地主山，必成星體，星體之上，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347968026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必起六府小頂小","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347968026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂下開陽開面，中間微微起脊而落者，謂之脉綱，軟而","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347968026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活動者，亦謂之脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347968026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行乎脉之内者，爲氣生動。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915347984410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無脊者，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348000794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲氣，忽伏忽起，有暈有輪者，亦爲氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348000794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹小而微有脊者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348017178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方謂之脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348017178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收而束細，如絲如帶，此謂之線脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348033562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不知葬","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348049946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，但知葬脉，其不犯剛飽硬直者鮮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348049946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人身之脉，以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348066330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣而行，山龍之脉以水而運，氣藏于內，水界於外，真龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348066330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉折而來者，自有曲折之水相應。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348066330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此方知水爲領氣","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348082714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968198666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，下文所謂囚水騐氣者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348082714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉之爲狀，小也、細","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348099098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，微也，其狀如絲如帶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348099098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微者似有似無則糢糊難見，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348115482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細小則顯明而易見，故細小比之於微稍爲較大也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348115482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348131866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趕裹稜弦向背之情","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348148250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趕裏者，是言四面環抱，有情之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348164634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稜弦者，是言開面","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348181018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開口、開肩開手，有層有級，有稜有角，外背内面，拱向有","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348181018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348181018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之有無，穴之眞假，都在稜弦趕裏、向背上","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348197402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"討消息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348197402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠看近看，前看後看，内看外看，細看諸山","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348213786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形勢之所歸，精神之所聚，眞氣之所鍾，冉察穴情之眞","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348213786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968231434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假，士色之榮枯，神氣之有無生死，此亦看地之最要者","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348213786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348213786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如看地，若不辨氣之生死，土色之榮枯，猶看死尸一","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348230170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"般，死尸猶是人也，惟無氣耳","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348230170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348246554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑元朱白証佐之情","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348262938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑元朱白，卽前後左右之別名。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348279322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"証佐者，卽是向證穴證","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348295706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼、禽曜、朝案之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348295706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情也者，拱向有情之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348312090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後左","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348328474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右果有眞情朝拱，則內氣自眞，內氣眞，再察其神氣，果","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348328474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有精光融聚之致，神完氣足之象，自能一葬便興殳發","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348328474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348328474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如神不充，氣不足，精神渙散，氣召乾枯者，雖有萬","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348344858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085274305904680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水干山，徒無益也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348344858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348361242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察生動","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348377626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，藏著於内，無形可見，何以知其生氣而求之？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348394010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抑知","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348410394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣止聚之處，其上必有動氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348410394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動氣者何？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348426778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽是起伏行","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348443162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止，生動活潑，有呼吸浮沉之情狀者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348443162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：動則生，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348459546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348459546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山以曲動開面開口，并有精光融聚秀嫩","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348475930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋潤之色者爲生，粗頑硬直者爲死；水以屈曲活動，旋","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348475930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉抱穴有情者爲生，斜飛反跳，形如木火者爲死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348475930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348492314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍尋穴，爲巒頭第一件要事。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348492314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如含龍穴而求砂水，必爲","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348508698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086183928856576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花假者所誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348508698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之形家，多中此病。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348525082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽論三元，講水法者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348541466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只求洛書之呆方位，某水合，某水不合，并不論腳下有","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348541466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣無氣，并不論用法之得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348541466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦堪輿家之通病，讀者","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348557850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當細細推求，對脉來情，水來當面，前輩未常不言及氣","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348557850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348557850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之生，皆資天之氣以爲始也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348574234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬埤承此","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348590618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，卽承天之生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348590618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天至動至陽之物，其靜也陰，所以","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348607002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生物，卽是陰，卽是靜。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348607002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地至靜至陰之物，其動也陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348623386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇地","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348639770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故貴乎動。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348639770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦葬乘生氣之一法也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348656154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348672538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看行止","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348688922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085770509041700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣不自行，有水以引之；氣不自止，有水以止之；氣不自","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348705306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚，有砂水交會以聚之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348705306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形止氣蓄，水交砂衞，再有精光","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348721690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"融聚之致，方是眞止，方是眞聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348721690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再察其四面拱向之情，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348738074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再察其穴情之眞假，元辰之真的。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348738074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則眞穴眞情俱","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348754458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可辨認。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348754458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能辨得穴情之眞的，是眞是假，到眼自然雪","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348770842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亮。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348770842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有行卽有止。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348787226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行者，動也，止者，靜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348803610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍如是，水","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348819994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348819994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子日：水性止，能止衆止，故水貴乎止蓄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348836378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五歌云：山有山之止，水有水之止。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348852762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是止形皆可穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348869146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348885530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348885530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968264202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因形求氣，因氣求神","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348901914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348918298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣由形辨，舍形何由以辨氣之生死？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348934682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣因理之，舍理何","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348951066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由以見氣之興衰？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348951066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故形有眞僞，氣可辨也；氣有生死，神","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348967450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348967450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有氣方言體，有體而無神氣者，卽用得合","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348983834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，斷不能爲福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915348983834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有形自有氣，有氣自有形。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915349000218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣依","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653562394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於形，形又依乎氣，形氣兩兼，有是氣，必有是神耳","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653562394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653578778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體用各得","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653595162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理之道，形勢爲體，理氣爲用，故萬物必先有體而後","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653611546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有用，所謂體立而後用行者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653611546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且萬物生生之始，未","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653627930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968329738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有形先有氣，未有氣先有理。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653627930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如舍體而求用，則用無所","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653644314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"施；舍用而求體，體無興廢。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653644314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之察乎氣，審乎勢，相乎情，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653660698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度乎理，觀乎神，合乎時，體用各得其宜，方得體立用行","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653660698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之精微","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653660698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653677082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地有吉氣，土隨而起","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653693466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653709850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有土自有氣，有氣自有土，此乃陰陽自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653726234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653742618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專辨吉土，卽辨氣土、暈土、骨土、五色土之類，非辨泛泛","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653742618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653742618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉土自有眞氣，有眞氣自有吉土，氣與土相","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653759002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連，未聞有土而無氣者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653759002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡到形止氣蓄之處，自有眞","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653775386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085612173852709"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣結聚於其間，眞氣結聚，自然高於兩傍，兩傍自有低","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653775386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田低地爲界，貼身有界，中間自然高起，故曰土隨而起。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653775386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此所云起者，是言吉土之起，非言几土之起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653791770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑿穴求","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653808154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，宜細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653808154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍平岡之起伏，有墩有泡，有脊，有","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653824538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背有面，有凹有凸，其髙低易見，平洋高一寸，低一寸，實","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653824538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬難看，更宜細察。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653824538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍活動，到頭脫盡，自有吉土，或","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653840922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開鉗口，或到頭有大小入字分開，頑氣卸於兩傍，亦有","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653840922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞土穴形，故取窩鉗爲上也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653840922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653857306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢來之止","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653873690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085274306002984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢來，是言山形氣勢，從高而下，有頓有趺，有起有伏，旋。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653890074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繞曲動及前後左右諸山，都有拱向之眞情形，止是言","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山形水勢，到結穴處，自有止蓄之情形，主山自有統攝","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周圍之勢，砂水自有主賓相朝相顧之情，或起頂腰落，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或開面中曲，有優游自然之情狀者，方是眞來，方是眞","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：來是言穴後來龍來脉之形勢，止是言穴情砂","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653922842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之止不止也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653922842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形者，氣之宅也；氣者，形之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653939226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神者，形","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653955610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之精神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653955610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形以氣爲生，氣以神爲活。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653971994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如舍神氣而求","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653988378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形者，眼法之眞詮，何曾夢見耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915653988378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085274306068520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深得宜","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654004762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地氣高厚，士色明亮，左右界水貼切而兼深蓄者宜深；","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如界割不甚淸楚，再兼地氣平薄者宜淺。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當開鑿金井","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654037530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，必須視其土𮎛何如，方可定其深淺。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654037530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此自無過","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654053914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺過深之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654053914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如土色堅細滋潤而有光彩者宜深，深","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654070298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不可過深。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654070298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過深曰久，自有潮濕之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654086682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過淺藏棺於粗","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654103066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬆浮土之中，則乾枯虫蟻之患，勢所不免。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654103066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須藏棺于恰","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654119450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好處爲妥。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654119450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"除去浮土，開見吉土，深有二三尺或一二尺","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654135834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不等，將棺藏于吉土之内，不浮不沉，不深不淺，斯爲得","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654135834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085274306101288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654135834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654152218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫藏棺于吉上之中，自然乾暖，自無潮濕虫蟻之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654168602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棺槨自能悠久，子孫自能昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654184986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且擇地非爲子孫計，木","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654201370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲祖宗，欲免潮濕風水虫蟻之患耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654201370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：深淺得宜，地","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654217754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654217754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠哉是言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654234138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋培土安墳，不過避潮濕，以及","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654250522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水浸棺槨，水浸棺槨，退財傷丁，勢所不免，卽用得合法，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654250522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不能爲福，故以培土爲先也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654250522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654266906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽有龍有氣，并有吉","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654283290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，深可一二尺不等。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654283290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如氣蒲者，開見黄土，卽止，將棺","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654299674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安於黃土之上，極低之處，培土三二尺，然後放棺。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654299674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深則","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654316058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐有潮濕之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654316058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棺之外，宜用石灰與好士打結，以避客","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654332442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086340179148840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654332442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽羅城攔士，亦要内高外低，使水易去，切不可","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内低外高，使水蓄于穴中。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每見今之攔土，用磚石高砌，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654365210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有四五尺者，有七八尺者，高於塚墩，徒取石之好看，不","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654365210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顧水之去不去，此謂之欄水，非攔土也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915654365210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657756698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紹興、杭州及","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657773082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘉、湖諸郡山龍安葬墳墓，金井深者不過尺許，此亦因","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657773082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地置宜之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657773082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"培土安墳，皆因地氣卑薄，恐有水浸棺","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657789466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"槨，故此培高二三尺，以受淸陽之氣，此卽古之架法。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657789466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657805850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而淸陽之氣，亦要所用之地，有氣有土，方能承接天之","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657805850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657805850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否則士雖培高，三年五載之後，虫蟻潮濕之患，勢","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657822234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086293349728267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所不免。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657822234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫有氣有土，此地自暖，暖則地氣上升，稍有潮","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657838618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濕，曰久自乾。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657838618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣無土則寒，寒則地氣不能上升，潮濕","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657855002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自來。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657855002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦陽升陰降自然之理也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657871386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657887770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土高水深","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657904154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657920538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣厚則土厚，土厚則氣厚，氣厚則左右界水及内堂止","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657920538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓄之水自深，乃山水陰陽自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657920538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下文所云鬱草","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657936922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茂樹，果得龍氣活動，水深王厚，草木自然榮茂，此亦生","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657936922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之使然耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657936922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地氣衰薄，士色乾枯，草木定多衰落之色，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657953306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有諸内，形諸外，此亦衰死之氣使然耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657953306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之磽者，雖","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657969690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968362506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有善種，不能生物。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657969690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：土敝則草木不長，種植尙求吉","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657986074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王，何况安墳，關繫子孫休咎乎","logicSentenceId":"7679111915657986074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658002458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細察氣色","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658018842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣卽生動活潑之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658035226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善察氣色者，看其形之動靜，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658051610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可下其氣之興衰；察其氣色之榮枯，卽可知其氣之生","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658051610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658051610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動氣是由生氣而動者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658067994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色者，氣之華也，色澤榮枯，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658084378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦由氣之生死而使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658084378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此則土色草木均宜細察。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658100762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妥。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658117146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：色澤鮮靈則氣旺，色澤枯老則氣死，卽草木","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658133530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土色亦當如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658133530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀山有坐眠、立三體，并有喜怒之形","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658149914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085279968395274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658149914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如破碎巉巖，粗頑硬直，石性雜亂，土色乾枯，草木稀","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658166298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少，種種都是怒形。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658166298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山背山腳毎多如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658182682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如峯巒挺拔，秀","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658199066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗尊嚴，開面向穴，屈曲活動，并有滋潤之色者，卽草木","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658199066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有鬱鬱葱葱之象，種種都是。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658199066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之喜氣，必多結作。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658215450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658231834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦尋龍尋穴之持徑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658231834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地之生死，全在乎神氣有無","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658248218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658248218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然氣之有無易見，神之生死難看。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658264602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡非神字","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658280986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以主宰氣脉，保合太和，流行上下，仰承天氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658280986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華元化曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658297370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神者，氣血之先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658297370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣血之先，非神而何？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658313754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則氣依於神，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658330138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神又依乎氣者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658330138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍之幹枝，猶木之幹枝，老本爲幹，嫩枝爲枝。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658362906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡老","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658379290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹行龍，情性堅剛，士老石粗，結穴最少，猶水之開花結","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658379290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸，多結于嫩枝，少結于老幹。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658379290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫枝龍卽是幹龍，分下傍","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658395674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"椹、僭麻之類，并有幹中幹、枝中枝、枝中幹、幹中枝之别。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658395674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此云土貴有枝者，是言正幹行龍，愈分而愈妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658412058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣識","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658428442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其分，再識其止，枝龍止蓄之處，卽是眞氣，眞穴所鍾之","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658428442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，眞穴所鍾水必聚于此，此亦山水陰陽自然之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658428442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝者，分也，不分則粗䅡之氣不能脫盡，故以分爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658444826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086340179312680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫卸愈多，頑氣愈盡，龍力愈壯，土色愈美，卽水龍亦貴","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658461210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有枝。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658461210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝者，分浜分枝之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658477594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝浜愈多，龍愈生動，士色","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658493978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈佳，氣愈活潑，所謂分盡之分者此也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658493978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658510362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨神氣色澤","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658526746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書言龍言氣，言之詳且盡矣，未曾道及神氣色澤。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658559514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，裏也，神色者，氣之表也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915658559514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"表在外而易見，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812945946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣在内而","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812945946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難知。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812945946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今因神色易見，卽以易見之神色而推測難見之","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812962330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，卽以神色之榮枯，以卜氣之有無生死。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812962330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人所謂因","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812978714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形求氣，因氣求神者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812978714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此猶醫家望間問切之法，病","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812995098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086636917735443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之生死安危久暫，都以神色辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915812995098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇地者亦當細參神","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813011482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣爲要。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813011482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣色澤，物物有之，卽骨董字畫，亦以神氣色","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813027866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤辨眞假也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813027866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宋元名人筆墨，自有名人之神氣；卽本","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813044250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝南田之花卉，用筆用墨，另有一般神氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813044250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽八大窑之","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813060634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"磁器，精光神色，比凡窑自然各别。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813060634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽漢玉與近時之玉，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813077018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣精彩，亦屬大相懸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813077018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨地之神氣生死，當以此法","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813093402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"參之，地之眞假疑似，可一望而知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813093402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神也者，神完氣足","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813109786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813109786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣充足，自有明亮光彩，滋澗之神色見焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813126170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁財茂盛之家，墳上樹水必茂，土必滋潤，子孫衰落，樹","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813142554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086297212747786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木葉定凋零，士必乾枯。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813142554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并有初葬合法，樹木極盛，合葬","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813158938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失時，樹木頓衰，此亦是所承之氣使然耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813158938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：小地看","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813175322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精神，大地看氣局。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813175322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地雖重氣局，亦不離乎精神耳","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813191706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813208090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考眞假","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813224474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813240858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士色佳美，神氣充足，形止氣蓄，水交砂衞，卽前後左右","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813240858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山來水，處處拱向有情，還要細察立穴定向之得弗","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813240858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813240858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：地無大小，一眞便發。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813257242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：地無吉凶，葬法","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813273626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得則吉，失則凶，故以得穴得用爲最要也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813273626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813290010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨得失，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813306394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830092338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得穴得用，并得補救，是謂之得。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813322778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得用而不得體，得體","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813339162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不得用，均謂之失。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813339162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽體用俱得，位置稍不得其當者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813355546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦謂之失也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813355546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813404698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之外卽是砂，砂之內即是水，水向卽砂向，砂向卽水","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813404698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向，乃砂水陰陽白然之勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813404698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：向背在乎情性，情性","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813421082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向乃爲眞向","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813421082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
