{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍來脉俱已詳辨，惟穴情爲砂水之主宰，不可不察","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813470234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347085971005112354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813470234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴之情形，千變無窮，總不離窩鉗、乳突四種。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813486618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813503002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鉏爲上，乳究次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813503002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然窩鉗不離乎乳突，乳突不離乎窩","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813519386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813519386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩鉗穴後不起突，前無唇簷，便爲空窩；乳突無錯窩，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813535770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則葬口不開，立穴無據，貼身有蟬翼，陰砂，邊有邊無，邊","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813535770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長邊短，都不必拘拘，只要有一臂便結，形如牛角者佳","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813535770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813552154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知龍穴砂水筍縫門合之情","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813568538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813584922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍從左來，穴必結於右，龍從右轉，穴必結於左，此龍體","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813584922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋轉自然之勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813584922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫筍縫門合四字，是龍穴砂水相朝","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813601306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相顧，雌雄相配、主賓相迎之情狀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813601306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能識得筍縫鬥","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813617690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086785098285090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合之竅，任爾左栖右閃，奇形怪穴，俱可辨認矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813617690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則眞","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813634074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之結穴，變化無窮，難於盡舉，只可言其門合之情形","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813634074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813634074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門合卽是山水有賓主相迎相顧之情，道其形日","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813650458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筍縫門合。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813650458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言其情曰雌雄交媾","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813666842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813683226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童斷石過，獨","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813699610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不生草木曰童，草木不生，生氣已絕，俗呼剝皮龍者，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813715994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813715994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷是鑿斷開傷之謂，非跌斷之斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813732378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑿斷開傷，此謂","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813748762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之病龍故忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813748762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石是滿山頑石，無頭無面、無分無界之亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813765146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石山故忌，如螺絲吐肉，老蚌生珠，每每多在石山，須在","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813781530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086636917833747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐肉生珠四字上着想，方不至誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813781530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石山上山葬下，禍不","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813797914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋踵者，總由無矬無平，陰歛剛飽，渾身是煞故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813797914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過即","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813814298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是此山過彼山之過。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813814298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷不卽斷，起不卽起，犖牽連連，無","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813830682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背無面，左右又無護從遮攔風水一派純陰之氣，故日","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813830682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可葬。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813830682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨是乾枯無神之謂，卽無背無面，不分不界，無","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813847066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝無腳，亦謂之獨，非是出洋盡結獨墩孤泡、獨山之獨。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813847066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，卽大山博小山，不開陽面，不抽嫩枝，亦謂之獨。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813863450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813879834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂枯老無發生之機也","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813879834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813896218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收放","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813912602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086620627206181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收者，束也，龍身行度處以束定峽到頭一節以束觀八","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813928986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首所謂束氣者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813928986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋無資脉可憑，全在收處察其","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813945370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真假，証其來源。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813945370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"放者，開也，帳葢之大小，纒護之短長，均","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813961754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此定之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813961754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大收大放，葢帳關峽是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813978138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小收小放，峯腰鶴","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813994522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膝是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915813994522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收放愈多則愈有勢，放愈大則愈張揚，收愈小","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814010906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則龍力愈壯。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814010906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故穴後入首二節之收放，比後龍更爲緊","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814027290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814027290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘平陽平岡，山龍都宜如是","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814043674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分合","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814060058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814076442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴後宜分不宜合，分則頑氣自脫；穴前宜合不宜分，合","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814092826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830125106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則砂水自向，門戸自閉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814092826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有地無地，且看下臂。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814109210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814125594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下砂不轉莫尋龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814125594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此數語豈非尋地之捷徑乎","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814141978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814158362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來情對脉","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814174746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814191130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍有九星正變之象，水龍亦有九星正變之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814191130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814207514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有主山，水龍右城門。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814207514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍有來脉八首，水龍有來源八","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814223898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口，并有兩淚。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814223898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"界水止處，必須界抱有情。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814240282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍入首結穴","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814256666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處，須求眞止之情形；水龍照穴有情處，須求方圓眀凈，","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814256666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方爲真水。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814256666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五歌云：對脉論來情者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814273050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水來當面者，此","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814289434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814289434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086785098383394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍一線，平洋一片","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814305818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814322202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍一線，平洋一片。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814322202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一線者，言其狹小也，必須細心察","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814338586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看，方得其一線之眞土眞氣，否則夾砂夾石，水濕虫蟻","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814338586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之患難免矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814338586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一片者，言其廣濶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814354970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣濶者須求動處爲","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814371354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814371354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有一兩處來者，有三四處來者，來處雖多，用法須","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814387738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸乎一氣，此亦平洋納水之要訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814387738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如半得半失者，定","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814404122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主房分偏枯，得三失五者，退財傷丁，勢所不免矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111915814404122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087008000393257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之可否固在乎體，貴賤實由平用。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064620570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用法得宜，富而","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064636954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且貴，并能悠久。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064636954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用弗得其當，退財傷丁，子孫下流，無","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064653338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所不至。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064653338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，體與用並重也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064669722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細細推之，用更重於","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064686106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064686106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064735258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有公私，過客、特朝之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064735258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公者，公共之水，無所專於一","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064751642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處者，此謂之公；私者，一穴獨受干支情性，都專于此者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064751642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂之私。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064751642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過，卽此卦過彼卦，此方過彼方之過。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064768026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無瀾無","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064784410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹、無灣無曲、無情於穴者，謂之過客。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064784410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特朝者，對脉處恰","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064800794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086620627271717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有枝水特朝，長短曲動，與來龍相稱者爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064800794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取用之法，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064817178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當用眞水特朝者爲先，次收公過，最爲得法。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064817178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如誤用，恐","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064833562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有元運不一，房分偏枯之患矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064833562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064882714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴中有生物及紫籐茜草之類，亦可猜測而得。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064882714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見有此","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064899098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"籐，斷不可改動；卽不見此籐，但見氣色榮潤，亦不可更","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064899098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，稍動必至傷丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064899098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡直達補救兼收，自多諸吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064915482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064931866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生化，都由山向水口所用之星辰，得弗得以辨吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064931866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064931866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上種種，在識者按其山向、水口、地氣，卽可卜其。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064948250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086620627304485"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有無，卽浮厝棺槨，看其磚石之神色，卽可知其生物之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064964634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064964634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能知此，覆舊易易耳，不但覆舊之易，且不肯亂","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064981018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動人家墳墓矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916064981018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065030170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有情昭穴者爲眞，無情顧穴者爲假。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065030170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如來龍活動，士色","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065046554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堅潤，或兩傍有水界割，其氣自淸，或龍到頭止蓄之虛，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065046554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内堂有點眞水，大旱不涸，恰與來龍來脉相稱，方爲之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065046554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞水。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065046554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞水者，來情對脉，水來當面之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065062938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水色混濁，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065079322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并有奥味，及偏斜反弓，卽易盈易涸等等，都由地氣與","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065079322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086425638207523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不交，故謂之假","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065079322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065194010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因水騐氣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065210394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065226778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者水之母，水者氣之子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065226778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣斯有水，有水斯有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065243162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣無形而難見，水有跡而可求。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065259546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水來則氣來，水止則氣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065275930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止，水抱則氣全，水滙則氣蓄。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065275930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有聚散，而氣因之聚散；","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065292314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087158395535395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有深淺，而氣之厚蒲因之，故因水可以驗氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065292314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若池","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065308698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湖蕩胸，潑面，無攔則氣不聚，無案則勢不可當，卽易盈","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065308698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易涸，急去急來，倏淺倏深者，均非盡善之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065308698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟大水","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065325082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之內，又有小水重重包裹，方見氣之藏而聚；大界水之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065325082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内，更有微茫隱隱分合，方見氣之動而止。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065325082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故眷戀迴環，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065341466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交鎖織結，皆是氣之所在也；穿割牽射，反直斜冲，皆是","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065341466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065341466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如反者使其環抱，直者使其曲折，挽回造化，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065357850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦在人功。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065357850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但本身小水，有情顧穴者，務宜挨親；幹水無","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065374234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意留戀者，不可扳援。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065374234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若山谷之平陽，山多水少，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065390618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見大","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065390618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830157874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水無害，總要自己界合爲先，并宜大小兼收爲妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065390618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065407002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之盈虛消長，上通乎天，下貫乎地，應乎萬物，神氣相","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065407002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"感，體用得宜，生生之道在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065407002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五歌云：直來直去龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065423386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之僵，有灣有動龍之活。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065423386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍如是，山龍亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065439770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂水來","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065456154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當面是眞龍者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065456154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂對脉論來情者，亦卽此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065472538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋以水爲龍者，法宜培土安墳，若地有眞氣，龍眞穴","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065488922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"的，開鑿安墳亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065488922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蕩然無氣者，卽培土亦不能發福，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065505306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非但無益，且有水浸之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065505306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精生氣，氣生神，神完氣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065521690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足，故曰神氣爲巒頭，第一件要事，宜細察之，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065521690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830190642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨地取裁","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065538074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065554458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看地非獨心法變化無窮，卽眼法須要活潑靈動，斷不","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065570842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可拘執。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065570842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如九華、天目、句曲，都是老龍幹氣，尋得龍穴砂","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065587226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，件件合式，大者開族，小者不過丁財而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065587226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蘇、杭、湖、","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065603610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松脫刼龍，稍有一樣，可取鼎甲科名，連綿不絕。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065603610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘呆","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065619994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，覔地更難矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065619994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽脫刼龍亦有老嫩之分，如蘇州之羊","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065636378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山、猫山、鹿山以及獅山等諸山，色澤神氣、土色都帶乾","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065636378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枯，卽是脫刼，亦不結大地。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065636378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如洞庭、七子、天平山，及常熟、","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065652762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虞山、無錫、惠山、江寕、鍾山諸山，神氣色澤，士色滋潤，猶","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065652762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086952996274227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花木一般，節節","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065652762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"開花，枝枝結菓。諸山亦有老嫩背面之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分斷，不可拘拘，故曰隨地取裁","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065652762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065669146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"移步換形","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065685530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065701914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稍移則形象更換，形象換，吉凶不一，勢所必然。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065701914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全在未","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065718298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立穴以前，格定方位，細察星體情形，合吉則用之，不合","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065718298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再移，移到千支方位，山水情形都合爲是，斷不可脫龍","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065718298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫脉也","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065718298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山、平陽、平岡種植，土人必擇物士相宜而後種植。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065767450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065783834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086425638240291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種地黃、山藥、山茹、葡葡、生薑、百合等等，必擇沙土而兼。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065783834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潮濕者如種松及竹，須擇浮土而兼高燥者；如種楊梅、","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065800218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃李花菓，亦擇砂土而稍帶鬆濕者；如種栗，亦擇砂夾","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065800218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士而兼鬆散者。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065800218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦觀其所植，卽知土色乾潮，此亦遠","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065816602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"望之捷法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065816602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之木質堅細者，上必堅細；木質粗鬆者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065832986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士必粗鬆，此亦物產之自然","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065832986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平岡平陽，看法與山龍一般，第一先看神氣士色，第二","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看龍身活撥靈動，第三要看界割淸切，第四要看四","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086601761325067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面照應，𨚫有眞情顧穴；第五要着過峽起伏，第六要看","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂局水氣止蓄團聚；第七要看下砂闗欄，有情有力，第","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八要看八方平順，第九要看穴情眞的；第十要看砂水","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相稱，穴情隱顯偏正，然後再言𪐴穴立向之得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065882138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065898522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，誤人之過自少矣","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065898522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡發地塚上都生樹木，其所由來，亦由用法所得之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065947674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣而生者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065947674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如海寕陳氏祖墳，塜上生檀樹，常州呂狀","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065964058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元祖墳，塚上出椐樹，上虞沈侍郞塚上生松樹，宜興崔","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065964058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086983086276659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氏墳塜上出朴樹。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065964058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上所生樹本等等，必由向首所得","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065980442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣而生。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065980442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家位至極品，族盛丁蕃，富貴不歇。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916065996826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟塚墩","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066013210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上天生樹木，得氣所生，故不可伐。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066013210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伐去傷丁，勢所不免。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066029594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余友姓姜名堅，號實夫，祖墳在江都北門外，塚上生穀","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066045978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樹，大有數尺，姜公因榖樹中空，擇吉砍去。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066045978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道光拾年冬，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066062362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李兄弟四人少丁，都犯血症而死，此乃伐樹之故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066062362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066078746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐人家將墳塚上樹木亂斫，故特誌之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066078746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理有四大承氣法：土承積，木承風，水承氣，石承煞，凡","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066127898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086983086342195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞氣照見，斷不可堆做石工等等。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066127898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石能招煞，故忌水。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066144282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟止能止衆止，龍氣遇水而止墳地，故貴乎得水。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066160666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大居","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066177050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳地有凹，風吹着者，忌種樹木，因木能招風，山地更甚，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066177050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066177050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積者，高也，厚也，堅細而有光彩者謂之積。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066193434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故擇土","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066209818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴堅細而有光彩者也","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066209818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916066226202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時看法：","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211404851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時雨陰，鬆土砂土浮面，爲雨所潤，最爲難看。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211404851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然士雖","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211421235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋潤，必帶潮濕，所謂剥皮者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211421235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天氣嚴寒，雨雪濃霜","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211437619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之後，粗鬆浮士，必定凍酥，不必粗鬆浮士而然，卽氣薄","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211437619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086983086407731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂體潮濕之地，無不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211437619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四季看色之要，有氣有神者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211454003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春初草必先靑綠；無氣無神者，草必遲發而早凋。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211454003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211470387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九十月衰草如老年頭髪一般，軟而色淡，枯而無神者，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211470387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定然無氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211470387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看者地土粗鬆，多生粗根根深之草木，如夏","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211486771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋多生蕨草、葛根之類，石多土少，定出拳曲之木。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211486771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211503155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理之必然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211503155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天池攷騐：","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211519539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頂上有池水，謂之天漢，又名天池。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211519539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下有眞結，上必有","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211535923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天漢，不拘山之大小。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211535923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍起頂，將近結穴處，頂上定有","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211552307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086983086440499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水，此亦陰陽自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211552307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘇州范墳上有池三個，宜","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211568691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興龍池上亦有池三個。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211568691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江陰香山，山雖低小，頂上有池","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211585075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七個。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211585075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揚州甘泉山，頂亦有池，其味甚甘，故名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211601459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江寕保","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211617843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山、鍾山頂上都有池。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211617843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鍾山下有明太祖孝陵在焉，保山","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211634227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下有方氏祖地在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211634227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水是天地精靈之氣所結，最爲","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211650611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊貴","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211650611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211699763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"探土有山地、平洋之别。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211716147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山地看准龍脉八首，有穴情疑","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211732531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似者，必探其土色可否，然後點穴，方不至誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211732531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土必變色，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211748915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086830183137320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四色五色，堅潤爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211748915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋探土，第一要開下四五寸，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211765299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見吉土爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211765299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次要左右近界，兩傍黃土要深，深則方見。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211781683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉士之起處爲是，如龜春、牛背之形，及開下二尺、二尺","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211798067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見黃土者，卽有潮濕之患","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211798067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211830835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太平曰久山地非舊時眞面目者居多，不可不加意細","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211847219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211847219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張氏祖墳賣爲李氏安阡，不數年，李氏墳又改爲别","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211863603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姓，更換一姓，堆做一回，故曰非舊時眞面日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211863603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳塋毎","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211879987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每逢着熟地，都由心眼粗踈之故，輕易動人，朽棺腐骨，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211879987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086830183170088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并有遮攔别姓墳墓之向道，以至敗絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211879987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井有不顧人之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211896371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可否，因有小利可圖而不顧人者，種種弊端，罪不容誅，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211896371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲將來者戒。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211896371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余於道光丁亥年冬，不遊吳門，見西跨塘","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211912755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之西有吳氏墳墓，乙酉年八月，新阡葬時，動無主枯骨","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211912755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無數，地師卽於是年死絶，吳氏不及二年亦絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211912755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此動人","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211929139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枯骨之報也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211929139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡擇地安葬，必先積德，地有吉凶，德有","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211945523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚薄，德薄者葬凶，德厚者葬吉，此乃天地陰陽自然之","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211945523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211945523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無德者欲葬吉地，本屬妄想，還要動人枯骨，碍人","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211961907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風水，天降災殃，非絶而何？","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211961907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如常熟、虞山、無錫、惠山、常州、","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211978291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087086710915083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茶山、蘇州七子墳墓，重而又重，疊而又疊，猶如閶門支","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211978291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墨一般，開鑿金井，難免不熟，稍見磚灰等信，理當讓一","logicSentenceId":"7679111916211978291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棺兩棺地步","logicSentenceId":"76791 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212158515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新做墳墓，只要顧山向水口，立穴定向，用法之得弗得。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212158515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212174899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老墳上附葬有塚，自有八方，先要看在何方何位，流","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212191283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年空利否。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212191283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽合葬亦要推算得失，與初葬更要小心。","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212207667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212224051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也？","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212224051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初葬是初葬之時，合葬是合葬之時，陰陽顚倒，竟有","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212240435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大相懸絕者，可不加意細察乎","logicSentenceId":"7679111916212240435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"太平孫竹田氏著。錫山無心道人纂，門人桐鄕陳椰愚、長洲柯遠峰、金匱錢荆山、子雲谷、孫其焕同較。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一、堪輿之學，本是性理之一端，非深明經史者，不足以知此。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946833443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無奈世人安于固陋，不甚推求，有視爲奇術，甘心受欺者，有不擇吉凶，聽之天命者，更有漫然不信，謂無此理者，種種塵勞，同歸愚劣，可勝歎哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946849827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今此書返本窮","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946866211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源，言極醒豁，欲干天下仁人孝子，劈破疑國，浩浩蕩蕩，灑灑落落，相與養生送死于光天化日之下，不堪爲操","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946866211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946948131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一、葬埋之事，所以安死者，非爲福生人。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946964515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死者旣安，則生者自福，不必更生妄想于其間也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946980899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之術家，胸無實學，專以禍福動人，爲一時取利之計，主家惑之，有以親骸爲邀福之具，遷移不已者，有視爲畏途停棺，累世不葬者；更有蠢爾無知，因貧病無聊，以親骸爲禍椒，燒毀抛棄者，此非禍福之說有以致之哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679115052946997283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神有知，能不陰奪其魄也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947013667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今此書伹明葬理，理明則疑釋，疑釋則吉凶判然，洞若觀火，自然頭頭是道，而無風蟻泉石之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947030051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830321714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼不務窮理，而惟禍福計者，不必觀此","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947046435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947062819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"实葬之制，葢始于中古，河洛出，八卦畫，仰以觀于天，僪以察于地，于是乎識山川之情，更徵之以人事，而得其義。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947079203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其義云何？","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947095587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：尋得一點生氣而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947111971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣所聚，内藴牆華，其土綱密膩如團粉，教之者安，得之者昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947128355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則生氣固可識乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947144739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰可。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947161123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣本于天，質成于地。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947177507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有陰陽，地有剛柔，惟柔故生，惟剛故殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947193891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山體剛，剛中取其柔以爲生之機，猶之一陽動于坎中，而萬物始生，此生氣之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947210275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故觀此圖而知象，觀是書而知點穴之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947226659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩、鉗乳突","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947243043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086318830354482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947243043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢粘倚撞點穴之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947259427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有法中之法，名曰理氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947275811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫立向消納，承氣收水，莫善乎理氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947292195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理氣者，卽大元空五行分理三元九運運行遷謝之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947308579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能如是，巒頭理氣，無所不當矣","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947324963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947341347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩者，太陽之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947357731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生陰中，外剛内柔，宛然藏書，旁有範圍，前有氣口，眞氣內注，穴宜深取。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947374115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然有陽必有陰，有眞必有假，辨之既清，方知取含","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947390499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947406883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩形圓整，輪弦明白，中有肉地，肥嫩","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947423267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腳，相開如糞箕樣者，曰開口窩。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947505187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩中肉地，又有出氣、進氣之不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947521571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其内地微弦，向內收入，如人之呼者，日進氣窩向外吐出，如人之嘘耆","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947537955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY2499/7460068055994990619/1-1738828307335.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BoiyB%2By9W3JuqBAMJZtRV2m6i9k%3D","uri":"read/HY3994/19/ref/1kuujt02c3egw/1-1738828307335.webp","fontType":1,"components":"曰","variants":"","charPicId":"7468207229952540684"},"logicSentenceId":"7679115052947537955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出氣窩。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947537955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出氣宜穴上弦，出氣宜穴下弦","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947554339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十數穴者，可盡其量而阡之。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947603491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若窩大","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947619875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而深濶，其中肉地或不能滿，則窩上","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947619875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347086425638338595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必有三脉，微起如額，或自邊自角，注八窩内，拖出嫩肉，則𦂳接而阡之。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947636259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見肉地，沿邉吐出肥厚者，則氣己下注，穴宜阡出。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947652643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩大而有肉，吐出復起，瑰突成穴者，尤則。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947669027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍氣旺極之所結也","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947685411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947701795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山勢上聚吐出平坡，窩弦一邊邊勾轉。作案内有肉地明白者，曰遙窩、橫龍窩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貼有勾窩亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947718179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087199650725923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍來成窩作穴，而中無肉地，則氣必化于弦上，平坦肥嫩，下陰上陽，穴阡弦上。","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947734563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以肥嫩爲要，稍帶枯老，卽是空窩，阡之必絶","logicSentenceId":"7679115052947750947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087852523520037"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大乳要渾厚肥嫩，有收拾，不懶，攤斜","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372416015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門下粘穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372514319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有兩乳三乳並出者，俱乳肥嫩，則俱可下。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372530703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有數乳齊出，俱直","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372547087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087852523585573"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢者，頂門之穴法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372579855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山勢簇擁，俱從頂上盤旋，靑陽之氣，上聚下散，山腳壁立，一片純陰，全無氣下，則穴成顚頂。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372596239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出陽之龍，頓起星峯，仰而不俯，則氣不下注，亦成高穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372612623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴仰多窩形，以太陽之比，而上居至高之位，此淸陽上升之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372629007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一片平坦，肥厚恬靜，而無窩靨之形者，則陽土之氣化而上升，故其山勢亦成上聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372645391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡上聚之穴，陽氣充足，不犯陰殺，明堂遠照，從砂遠護，不怕風吹，不畏孤露，法宜用蓋。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372661775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外觀其形，肉察其暈，佐以吞吐，量其淺深，此用蓋之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372678159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平面之突，形如仰孟，陽泛于","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372694543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087101873160218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上，亦宜用葢。","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372694543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗人不識穴形，以爲孤露破突作粘，地靈受傷，葬凶之禍不免矣","logicSentenceId":"7679115805372710927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087852523651109"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粘者，粘也，陰中取陽之穴法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431229440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山勢俯下，後有駝背，前有凹胷，開顔下照，上陰下陽，上散下聚，氣出干足，則成乳形。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431245824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以少陰之氣而成穴于至卑之處，此陰降而爲陽生之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431262208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故其乳形必如花之初蕋，如木之始芽，生意已露，方能成穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431278592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若降而不化，如蛇頭鼠尾，腫腳筲箕，懶垣偏斜，淋頭場腳，總不脫乎。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431294976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純云之本相，犯之絶人。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431311360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陰卽殺也，乳而曰粘，卽所云脫殺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431327744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰降而有陽之可扶，則爲脫殺，卽脫根而粘。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431344128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陰降而無陽，漫向山腳盡𧆧，指爲龍盡殺脫，阡化粘穴，此庸術之誤人，而荒塜之","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431360512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087101873192986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以纍纍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431360512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山半亦有高乳，多是閃出，亦作粘論。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431376896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天葩凡乳形多出于木，木星出乳，形如花瓣，故名天。","logicSentenceId":"7679116287431393280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫水有得失，必宜詳辨，然後再看其去來形局。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729773583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去多則","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729789967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來多，去少則來少，能消一分之去口，必能納一分之來","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729789967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347088883428917275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情；能消十分之去口，必能納十分之來情，理勢之所必","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729789967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729789967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奈何拘拘于水口不容舟之說，一見去口寬大，","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729806351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節欲阻塞，孰知去口一阻，則來水不能利導，必然分流","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729806351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而假道於他方矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729806351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小阻小退，則大阻大退，勢所必然。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729822735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729839119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口只要屈曲交互，望之似不通舟迢遞，悠長織合，疊","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729839119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲闗鎖者，悉爲上吉，而水路之大小勿計也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729839119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有潴滙","l {"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"認水口者，須認得失，方可神明其際矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729904655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此所謂得水","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729921039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非諸家五行所謂得，是大元空五行之所謂得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729921039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水謂之纒元武者，一在入口朝堂之後，又復繞抱穴","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729953807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後，過巧獻奇，有情照穴者而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729953807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此取顧我欲留之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729970191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一在水順行之際，忽然逆抱，兠收有情，顧穴者，更有變","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729986575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戀不舍之情狀者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497729986575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用法苟能天元取輔，人地兼貪，","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730002959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087485782032394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方謂盡善。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730002959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍點穴，須合元機。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730019343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽龍法，眠倒平鋪，有不統觀全形全勢，凡遇一鈎一","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730035727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"搭之所，似平面面有情，處處可穴，孰知並非眞氣所注？","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730035727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故必得統觀全局，追踪尋脉，方曉一切鈎搭，悉屬隨從","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730052111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之翼衞，狂送之枝腳。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730052111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此眞眞假假，是是非非，苟能瞭","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730068495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然心目，洞若觀火，便可察氣脉，審力量，辨貴賤，較輕重，","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730068495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"判吉凶眞易如反掌。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730068495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云元機者，帥上文得失之元機","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730084879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730084879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347087993876021282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作用貴得師傳，","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730101263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相地全憑形勢，形勢妙在理氣，理氣貴乎點穴，點穴全","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730101263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賴山向，山向是理氣之主宰，可不加意乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679106497730101263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于立穴之","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616191540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，更有","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616191540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
