{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者勉乎哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616257076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347088571267858471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水法眞機，須在遍證名地。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616273460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水夾龍行，龍隨水轉，因水勢之南北東西，察龍勢之分","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616289844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合行止，不論大幹小枝，有結聚，必有界落，教砂之胎伏，","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616289844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"護從之迎送，橈棹之開帳，旋驛之停頓，關峽之轉折，凹","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616289844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凸之施受。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616289844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣而水交砂會，形止氣蓄，或兠洪藏蓄，或內","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616306228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外砂水，逆潔順抱，而明腤分含之情形出焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616306228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因而觀之，","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616322612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右旋左旋，是尾是腹，察脉之直來橫來，單行雙行，審勢","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616322612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之偏側敵斜，腰受耳受，相穴之有憑有據，應吐應吞。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616322612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之左到右到，看城門之在前在後，何干何支，然後立","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347088571267924007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴官乘龍之生氣，細察水之得失，對三义，細認踪，察血","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉，認來龍，納三吉，避四凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616338996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明此則知龍有龍之生旺，水","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616355380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有水之生旺，向有向之生旺，坐有坐之生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616355380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是龍要","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616371764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合向，向合水，水合三吉位，雖變通之在我，悉循乎造化","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616371764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之自然。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616371764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之，體之靜者，當於生動處求之，用之變者，當","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616388148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於盈虚消息中得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616388148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其大畧也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616404532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術家不得其傳，胡行","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂作，無所不至，甚且開鑿填塞，強彼就我，遂致縱橫奇","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正之格局，皆成吉凶莫測之陷芽。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616420916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此不學無術之病也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616437300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旨哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616453684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公之言曰：陰陽動靜如明得，配合生生妙處尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616470068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347088883429015579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當細心考究其元微，以揮其要。","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616486452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次察水裹龍神之","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616502836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得弗得，以神其","logicSentenceId":"7679107249616502836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用，然後遍證名地，勢如破竹，迎刃而解矣。","logicSente {"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下得吉向，福蔭必宏。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503599668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即四","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503616052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一亦謂之逆纒","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503616052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水要兜收。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503616052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前格論砂水逆纒，此格辨砂水兠收，然水纒即是砂纒，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503632436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂纒便是水兠，何用區分？","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503632436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知逆纒之取用，在于水神","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503648820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兠收止蓄之處裁之，始不致悞。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503648820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八口須求屈曲來朝，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503665204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347090949077532707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝堂之水，須轉折入口爲佳，故曰九曲八明堂，卽轉折","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503665204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503665204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢有轉折，則不衝射，而氣與水有相迎相接之","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503681588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503681588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來要之元，去要屈曲，如當面特朝，須要短瀾。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503697972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍水既","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503714356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，再察水裏龍神得失，以爲棄取耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503714356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張潮食水","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503730740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食水者，收入元竅之中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503730740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如沿江近海之處，六時潮來，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503747124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六時潮茫，來口即是去口，去口即是來口，氣機鼓動，運","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503747124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不息，與遊魂之來往無定者有異。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787503747124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潮水之地，往來一","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783143439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定，潮來爲客，潮落爲主，控制山川，打動龍神，全憑理氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783143439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347090460109897779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上水果，天機消繡，體用不可偏廢，非獨潮水加是，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783159823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍平洋皆宜如是，方是體得其體，用得其用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783159823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倚水立穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783176207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣爲水之母，水爲氣之子，氣行則水行，水來則氣來，故","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783176207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日水爽龍行，能隨水轉。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783176207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂氣行地中，無形可見，故必","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783192591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醜水之來去順逆，以爲龍之行止者，理之常也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783192591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然又必","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783208975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相地之形勢，又必相形勢之轉變，又必相傳變之順逆，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783208975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爲行止，而不沾沾以水之來去順逆爲行止者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783208975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783225359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有水自北來，龍自南來，水自西來，龍自東夫，曾爲逆","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783225359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347090949077598243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之局，可見龍之變化難量，水之行度無方，錯綜交互，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783225359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神鬼莫測，學者更可從此而益窮其微妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783225359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴貴專結，","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783241743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專結者，不待會局而成者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783241743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行龍至此，如脫頴而出，猶","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783258127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帷珠碩菓，獨顯精華，源氣所鍾，力量實與","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783258127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而等也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783258127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特其四應類多，與會局之脫缷成團者","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783274511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稍覺有異耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783274511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漾蕩偷祜，須求眞","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783290895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鄉澤國之區，大漾大澤之敷，每有蘆葦叢生，砂洲錯","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783290895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347090460110012467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處，令人眩目惑心，無從捉摸，儘有奇踪妙結","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783290895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漾蕩閃結，宜藏","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783323663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鄉之處。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783323663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇大河大漾，浩瀚彌漫，洪流奔逐，此中亦","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正有眞龍棲泊，特以水势張大，往往明落，避其飄刼，如","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊岸浮牌之類，大率依傍圩岸，取其隈藏，必以一二陰","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂蔽穴爲関","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690888871641129/1-24735195ce5f5685.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1dACKNe%2FyyoqTBvKKWl%2BYS4RUKc%3D","uri":"read/NA11436/9/ref/1kqq5i1g6pije/1-24735195ce5f5685.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌䦨","variants":"攔","charPicId":"7456690888871641129"},"logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲証佐者，結穴方眞，合得上乘，亦至穩","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347090842349469736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至妥而裕後昆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679107787783340047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

73322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但天道深微，傳非其人，亳釐","logicSentenceId":"7679072435416989706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千里，適足自誤誤人爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435416989706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於是薫沐敬受，而微言妙義，不","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417006090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"克驟通。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417006090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小憤則昏旦失經，□疑則寒暑易序。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417022474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比其曉悟，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417038858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星歲十週，又復遍考遺踪，騐其得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417038858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢□掌者二十年，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091927256268851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胼胝者數千里，乃得內無惑思，外無疑製，故願廣志殷，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗持奥義以贈後人。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而見淺見深，多方岐誤，或始信而","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417071626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終疑，或得半而自足，或以僞而亂眞，欲求通曉，良爲不","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417071626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417071626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883333898252/1-0e0e2c6fa11b8ec1.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nOeYlsHxlynPWc0HeK7A6q0VzFU%3D","uri":"read/HY1314/2/ref/1krfe28396wpv/1-0e0e2c6fa11b8ec1.webp","fontType":1,"components":"雁日","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690883333898252"},"logicSentenceId":"7679072435417088010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417088010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417088010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉之歲，僣我周生翺翔入越，越之彦土，觴子於宛","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417104394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"委之山。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417104394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟時同遊者多人，呂子相烈求卜一邱，奉藏母","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417120778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翣，并於宛委南麓，爲是馬鬛之封。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417120778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而呂子之再從叔師","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417137162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濓，及弟洪烈，先與予詩酒倡和，得意忘形，縞帶紵衣，願","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417137162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言古處。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417137162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂氏諸子之定交於子，匪朝伊夕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417153546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫於越諸","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417169930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091488788037667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山，祖于金庭、天姥，委于四明，若耶霄客之所都居，羽人","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417169930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所遊衍，願隨同好之士，披衣嵐岫，坐嘯巖阿。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417169930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以故酉","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417186314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌之後，歲必適越。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417186314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三浙以東，虞江以西，足跡幾遍。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417202698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂子","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417219082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同遊日久，山川之變，能心目洞然。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417219082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又欲周知昔人裁制","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417235466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，而進問於子。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417235466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子遵奉師訓，敬授以玉凾秘義，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417251850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而總","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417251850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其要爲天元歌五篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417251850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂氏世族，代產聞人，挺滋後昆，詎","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417268234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慚先哲，是能曲暢斯歌，不晦雲陽之㫖，使有覺之類，咸","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417268234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識愼終，則太始之餘巧，未必非利濟之全能也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417268234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以是窮","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417284618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"探道奥，夫豈遠乎！","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417284618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091927256367155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順治己亥，日月會於云","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417301002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894860025892/1-8a78063879db3706.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IJLaAbRHg73nCMsrCipaG4RaVgE%3D","uri":"read/HY2189/17/ref/1kwpi28k1mwp5/1-8a78063879db3706.webp","fontType":1,"components":"木口方","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894860025892"},"logicSentenceId":"7679072435417301002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之次，中陽大鴻氏題於㑹稽","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417301002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之樵風","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417301002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涇。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417301002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091488788086819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元空秘旨","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417317386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目講禪師著，無心道人解。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417317386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元空者，倒地翻天，隨時變易之元機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417333770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目講深得其","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417350154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奥，作此秘旨，闐發靑囊天玉之至理，九星雙起之元","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417350154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闗，辯吉㐫，定盛衰，發皆中節，靈如桴鼓，眞理氣之全","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417350154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"針也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417350154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知變易，但知不易。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417366538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星八卦皆空，不識三般，那識兩","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417382922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"片。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417382922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡屬五行盡䥘，顚之倒之，輔禍福於指掌之間，左挨","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417399306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右挨，辯吉㐫於亳芒之際。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417399306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一天星斗運用正在中央；九","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417415690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091718241681418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支旋轉，由乎北極。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417415690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言元空大卦，陰陽五行，縱橫顚倒，變化不測，毫釐","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417432074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千里，甚屬元微。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417432074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目講恐讀者無所適從，又將衆星旋","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417448458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉之機以示之，謂衆星之所以旋轉也，其機在平北","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417448458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極；陰陽之所以顚倒也，其樞在乎三般。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417448458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者當细细","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417464842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揣之，則縱横顛倒之機，隨時變易之理，自可得而知","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417464842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417464842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦相逢於道路，却嫌阻隔不通情；見孫盡在於門庭，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417481226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶恐兇頑非孝義。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417481226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091189981724724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相逢者，卽山上水裏，陰陽相見，配合生生之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417497610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417513994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見而得其所，自有福祿之蔭；相見而不得共所，便是","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417513994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍咎之根。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417513994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用法卽得是方，或逢形勢反背，水法傾流，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417530378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似是而非，定有阻隔兇頑之更變矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417530378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節及下文，總言山上水裏挨星得失之元徵。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417546762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417563146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奥妙，全在說卦以推氣，用卦以明理，縏詞以辯吉㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417563146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因形察氣，因氣求形，以推休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417563146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦爻雜亂，異姓同居，吉㐫相併，螟蛉爲嗣，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417579530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出卦則卦氣雜亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417579530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜亂即龍神交戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417595914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交戰雜亂，自有","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417612298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091927256514611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417612298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雑亂指干支方位而言；相併指挨星反伏而","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417628682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417628682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂用得卽是相見，用失便謂反吟。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417645066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山風値而泉石膏盲，午酉逢而江湖花柳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417661450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星連奎壁，啟","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417677834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八代之文章；胃入斗牛，積千箱之玉帛。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417677834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雞交鼠而傾瀉，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417694218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必犯徒流；雷岀地而相冲，定遭桎梏。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417694218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮爲山，止也，陽在上則止；巽爲風，入也，陰在下則伏。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417710602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止者，不事王侯，高尙之土也；伏者，山林隠逸，不求聞","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417726986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"達于諸侯者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417726986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止伏相投，自有泉石之癖。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417743370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲火，爲","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417759754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目爲心，性喜流動；兌爲金，爲少女，爲妾，性愛□□。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417759754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417776138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091189981757492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗也，一陰附於陽則喜；兌，說也，少陰出于陽則說。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417776138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417792522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌相逢，故有江湖花柳之應也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417792522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星應日，司，文章翰墨","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417808906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之神；躧于奎璧，定卜文才傑出。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417808906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胃爲土，主倉廩五穀","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417825290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之府；𨇠于牛斗，定致千箱之積。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417825290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兑如□坎，或傾渇奔","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417841674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流；一遇歲君，徒流不免。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417841674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震若交坤，或相冲相射，年逢","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417858058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三碧，桎梏難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417858058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火若尅金兼化木，數經回祿之災；土能制水復生金，定","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417874442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主田庄之富。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417874442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木見火而生聰明奇士；火見土而出愚鈍","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417890826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顽夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417890826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無室家之相依，奔走于東西道路；鮮姻緣之作合，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417907210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091927256563763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寄食于南北人家。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417907210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節專言生尅制化之理，妙在山水峯巒，五星九星","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417923594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正變之象，辨别淸楚，再辨元空。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417923594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時變易之機，往來","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417939978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退之理，認得分明，當補者補，當瀉者瀉，制化得宜，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417939978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自能得心應手；稍有偏勝，定見榮枯，理之必然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417939978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如火金相剝，當扶水以尅之，或培土以泄之，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417956362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃是扶","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417956362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金壯水之至理。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417956362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若反以木助火，火藉風而愈熾，木生","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417972746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火而愈旺，回祿難逃，土尅水則水自涸，得金曜重重，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417972746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洩土壯水，自有田庄之富。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417972746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂强者宜洩，弱者宜扶，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417989130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091841424031779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽同此意。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435417989130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火由木出，母子相得，木火通明，定多聰俊；","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418005514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土本火生，太過則火炎土燥，自産顽愚。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418005514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男以女爲室，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418021898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女以男爲家，無家無室，是言孤陰孤陽，無所依靠，故","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418021898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言奔走寄食于東西南北也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418021898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女多情，無媒妁而爲私合；陰陽相見，遇𡨚讐則反無","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418038282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418038282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟正配而一交，有夢蘭之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418054666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得于神之雙至，多折桂","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418071050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之英。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418071050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多情，言山形水勢相得之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418087434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"媒妁，謂立穴定向之得","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418103818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418103818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如立穴定向，少有差錯，猶男女不用媒妁，便爲私","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418120202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092274955714587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418120202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽雖得相見，遇反伏冲尅，上山下水，顛倒誤用，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418136586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反恩爲讐，定見災殃雙至，卽干支品配得宜，山上水","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418136586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裏排來都吉之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418136586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽靑囊所謂四神第一者是","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418152970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418152970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰神滿地成羣，紅粉塲中快活；火曜聯珠相遇，靑雲路","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418169354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上逍遙。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418169354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非類相從，家多淫亂；姻親相合，世出賢良。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418185738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四七九二爲陰神諸星，重疊于水口三叉，或値門方","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418202122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首，男女貪淫，火曜卽尖秀挺拔之峯，排立于主山","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418202122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝案用又得一六連珠之妙，自能早登科第，得志于","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418202122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091841424064547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418202122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云相從相合者，總言山上水裏之元空，及","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418218506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方位干支淸純錯雜之應騐耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435418218506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"負棟人南離，竚見㕔堂再焕；驅車朝北闕，時聞丹詔頻","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802472499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802472499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全無生氣，入門糧蹇一宿；會有旺神到穴，富積千箱。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802488883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"負者，排也，挨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802505267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨排。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802521651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震木加干離火，出乎震者，復相","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802538035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見乎離，故有廳堂之再煥。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802538035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾金排於坎水，成乎地者。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802554419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又生乎天，天地生生不息，定主丹詔頻來，無生氣，有","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802570803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802570803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總言宜生不宜尅，宜旺不宜衰，此亦趨旺避衰","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802587187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之最要者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802587187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092274955747355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅而有相濟之功，先天之乾坤大定；相生而有相","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802603571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之害，後天之金水交併。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802603571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言河圖洛書，先天後天，陰陽變易之機，五行顛倒","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802619955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，顛倒變易，相尅相生，乃陰陽五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802619955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且先天主體，後天主用，爲體者不可以用言，爲用者","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802636339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以體言，所謂先後八卦，體用咸明者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802636339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木傷土而金位重重，禍須有救；火制金而水神","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802652723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦能禳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802652723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土涸水而木旺無妨，金伐木而火熒無忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802669107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節申言生尅制化得宜之妙，必須衫氣，兼看五得","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802685491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092124409561088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制化之精微。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802685491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如形合而氣不合，或氣合而形不合，稍","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802701875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有偏勝，制化雖得，亦見榮枯，理勢之必然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802701875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神旺而制神衰，乃入室以操戈；吉神衰而㐫神旺，直","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802718259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開門而揖盜。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802718259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我者謂之忌神，制神卽制尅我之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802734643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者，强也，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802751027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰者，弱也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802751027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制尅無權，定見操戈之患；吉不敵㐫，自有","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802767411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楫盜之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802767411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之一貴當權，諸㐫咸服；衆㐫尅主，獨力","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802783795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難支，此亦扶生制尅之一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802783795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重尅入，立見死亡；位位生來，連添喜氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802800179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不剋我而尅","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802816563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092169292808230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我，同類多𩹌寡孤獨之人；不生我而生我，家人出俊秀","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802816563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802816563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生則不尅，尅則不生，陰陽五行，自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802832947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云位","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802849331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位重重，指門方小口而言，門方水口，有生入尅入之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802849331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利害；同類家人，指干支卦爻而言，干支卦爻有正尅","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802849331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傍尅之吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802849331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生一尅，一正一傍，應騐各殊。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802865715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者當","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802882099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察五行之情性，山水之形勢，去來得失之間，趨生避","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802882099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死，迎旺去衰，自無死傷孤寡之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802882099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲父所尅，男不招兒；爲母所傷，女難得嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802898483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後人不尙，因","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802914867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092124409626624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生方之反背無情；賢嗣承宗，緣生位之端方朝揖禮。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802914867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木受金尅，長子難招；水被土傷，次無子嗣，皆指元空","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802931251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而言，非指方位。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802931251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云朝揖反背，葢言山水之情形。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802947635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802964019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方旺方，是言挨星之得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802964019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生方果有眞情相向，并有","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802980403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝揖情形，兒孫定多賢良，定多孝友，此即因形察氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802980403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因氣求形之一法。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802980403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總之兼形兼氣，兼理而推休咎，方","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802996787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能三毫不爽耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435802996787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅彼而竟遭其辱，爲財帛以喪身，我生之而反受其","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803013171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殃，因產難而致死。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803013171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092169292939302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之大過，反主死傷；尅之太急，反遭其辱，均由形氣","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803029555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘戾之故，所謂過猶不及者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803029555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹多水而膨脹，足見金而蹣跚。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803045939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽宮水路纒乾，主有弔","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803062323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樑之厄；兌位明堂破震，定生吐血之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803062323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風行地而硬直","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803078707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難當，室有欺姑之婦；火燒天而張牙相鬬，家生駡父之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803078707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803078707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲腹爲土，土衰不能制水，自有膨服之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803095091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震爲足，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803111475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲木爲肝，肝主血，受乾、兌金尅，則木壞肝傷，主足跛","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803111475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐血之症。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803111475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽爲長女，坤爲老母，風行地，則坤母受制","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803127859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092124409692160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於巽女，更兼形勢破直無情，故有欺姑之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803127859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾爲天，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803144243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲父爲金，幹金受尅，干離火更有張牙不遜之勢，必","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803144243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生不孝之兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803144243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種不法，大闗風化，全在立穴定向之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803160627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"際，斟酌得宜，苟能挽逆爲順，實大有功於名教也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803160627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節總言相尅之利害，腹脹吐血，欺姑罵父，此皆形","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803177011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣相尅之應騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803177011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者當細心參考，務宜兼形兼氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803193395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方得九星八卦之精微。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803193395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩局相關，必生攣子；孤龍單結，定有獨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803209779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩局指承氣收水而言，孤單指地氣形勢而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803226163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803242547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092169293070374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專言龍水濶狭厚薄之應。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803258931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宮高塞而耳聾，離位陽殘而目瞎。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803275315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌缺陷而唇亡齒","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803291699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，艮破碎而筋枯臂折。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803291699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山地被風吹，還生風疾；雷風因","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803308083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金死，定被刀兵。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803308083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎耳離目，艮手震足，總兼形兼氣而占騐休咎者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803324467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘旨所言卦理，是元空變易之卦理，非南離北坎之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803340851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803340851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者切勿誤會。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803357235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如坎方高塞，定主耳聾；離位","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803373619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷殘，必多目疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803373619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌取象于口缺陷，自有唇亡齒缺之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803390003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂；艮取象于身破碎，自有臂折筋枯之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803390003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮坤爲土，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803406387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091841424195619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被巽風吹刼，風疾難逃；震巽爲木，遭乾兌金傷，刀兵","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803406387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必至。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803406387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種均由，縱橫顛倒，相冲相射，形氣之所應也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803422771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家有少亡，只爲冲殘子息卦；庭無耆老，都應攻破父母","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803439155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803439155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤爲父母，六卦爲子息，此是八卦之父母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803455539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803471923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自爲母，三爻爲子息，此一卦之父母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803471923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如元空之父","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803488307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母子息，則又以變易干支者爲父母，以何位何宮，倒","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803488307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地翻天者爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803488307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云冲殘攻破，總言生氣受尅之","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803504691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803504691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092274955993115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏道在坎宮，遺精泄血；破軍居巽位，顚病風狂。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803521075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開口筆","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803537459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"插於離方，必落孫山之外；離鄉砂飛於艮位，定亡驛路","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803537459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之中。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803537459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏道者，是水分兩處，非分浜分枝之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803553843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎爲水，爲","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803570227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肾，主精血。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803570227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是方，適逢傾瀉奔流，便是腎氣不固，自有","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803586611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遺精泄血之病。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803586611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘顛病風狂，總是因形察氣之法","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803602995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803602995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水多情，貪花戀酒；木金相反，背義亡恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803619379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震庚會局，文","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803635763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臣面兼武將之懽；丁丙朝乾，貴客而有耆耄之寿；天□","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803635763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091842036580386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而坤，富堪敵國。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803635763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離壬會子，癸喜產多男；","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803652147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水多情，木金相反，是言元空之金木，非東木西金。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803652147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之方位。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803668531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震爲天祿，庚號武爵，元空會合，文武全才。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803684915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803701299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲南極，丙爲太微，果有眞情朝拱，自能貴而多壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803701299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803717683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲天市，本主財祿，又得火土相扶，定然富敵王公。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803717683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803734067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸，會成旣濟，主有多男之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803734067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然必體得其體，用","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803750451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其用，方有是徵。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803750451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘拘千呆法者，百無一得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803766835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四生有合，人文旺；四旺無冲田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803783219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" enceId":"7679072435803881523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸爲元龍，壬號紫氣，昌","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803897907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛各有攸司。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803897907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨文曲，丁近傷官，人財因之耗乏。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803914291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有合無冲者，卽彼此生生，無冲射反伏之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803930675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東木","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803947059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西金，南離北坎者，是言四生四旺，各得其宜之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803947059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"健動止靜，謂干支卦爻，淸純者爲靜爲止，錯雜者爲","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803963443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爲健。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803963443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如論山水，則又以形動者爲動，形靜者爲靜，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803979827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂行乎其所不得不行，止乎其所不得不止，氣勢","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803979827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347091841424261155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩兼，方是眞動眞止。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803979827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王謝陶朱，總言砂水峯巒，體用","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803996211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼得之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435803996211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙庚辛，不拘來山去水，方位干支，須","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804012595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸一路。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804012595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙雜己，丁入未，不知挨星妙用，而又出卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804028979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自有偏枯耗散之病矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804028979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見祿存，瘟㾮必發；遇文曲，蕩子無歸；値廉貞而火災頻","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804045363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見；逢破軍，身體多虧。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804045363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓非吉，陽土陰土貴剪裁；四生","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804061747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非㐫，卦内卦外由我取。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804061747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知禍福因由，妙在天心橐籥。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804078131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節專辯諸星之應騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679072435804094515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星應騐各殊，必須測氣象，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332380718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯九星，察形勢，看遠近，再推五行生尅制化之理吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332380718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092560159997978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫消長之機，而言得言失，言禍言福，自能百不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332397102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰土陽土者，卽借庫自庫之謂也；卦内卦外者，卽得","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332413486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332413486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者須從天心顚倒之間，裁取得失，自無","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332429870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不當耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332429870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊萬卷，總不出體用二字。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332446254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體有山水之分，用有得","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332462638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失之辯，體有移步之不同，用有隨時之更變。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332462638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用必依","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332479022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形而顯休咎，禮必因氣而見吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332479022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之體無用不□，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332495406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用無體不驗，必須形氣兩兼，黙參九星生尅之理，□","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332495406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推休咎，方得體用之精微。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332495406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此秘言言體言用，條分縷","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332511790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092124409823232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晰，發精詳，無微不入。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332511790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非深得靑囊之奥、河洛之理","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332528174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，焉能道其隻字耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332528174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道光癸未四月旣望，二","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332544558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"泉山右無心道人註於廣陵山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氏樸園水木淸華之閣，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332544558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門人柯學熙較訂。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332544558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姑蘇□門外梅涇橋西石","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332560942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屑衡口吳學圃刊刻。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332560942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□訂","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332577326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092560160063514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092667198685224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"保墓良規。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332593710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古卿大夫爲石槨，三年不成，孔子聞之，尙有速朽之嘆。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332610094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人稍有資財，亦爲石槨，砌石工，竟有四五年而不成","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332626478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332626478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此造作，傷龍脉，泄地氣，其弊不可勝言。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332642862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人擇地，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332659246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必取有氣之地，足以承天，俾陽和之氣下浹於地，天地","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332659246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣交接，自無潮濕之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332659246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃不思使其交按，反用石板","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332675630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舖塞，使天地之氣隔絶，日久月長，水蓄棺槨，勢所必然，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332675630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其弊一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332675630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方當盛時，墳丁有意損傷，年脩年塌，藉爲利","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332692014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332692014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其衰也，工程坍壞，墳丁竊取，爲坑爲厠，無所不至。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332708398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092560160161818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宗經紀在前，今目反爲下人遭切，其弊二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332724782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚至不","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332741166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肖子孫，乃曰：某可以變錢，某可以易米，當其造作之時，","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332741166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟恐他人毁壞，工作堅固，不料子孫親自拆毁，陷於不","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332741166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝，其弊三也。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332741166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種弊端，都由磚石之所招耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332757550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僕思彼之。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332773934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚葬，不過欲其悠久不替，以盡爲子之道，然非大忠大","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332790318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝、大有功德於天下者，焉能冥冥呵護耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332790318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今爲世之有","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332806702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力者計，將此石工之費，買田數十百項，設立義庄，使死","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332806702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生貧苦，長享其利。","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332806702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，不特墳丁無所施其詭技，不肖","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332823086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無所舊其妄想，俾世世子孫承天之庥，永□無彊，非萬","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332823086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092667198734376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全之策哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679072999332823086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092530200150067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天淸地濁成兩儀，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156513846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽互根氣來在。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156513846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山川土石象中氣，日月星辰氣中象，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156530230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二氣相抱不相離。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156530230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濁陰本是淸陽相，惟有人爲萬物靈，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156546614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品配乾坤號有兩。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156546614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人自具一天地，卓立三才不相讓。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156562998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元陽本是天中來，形從大地產根荄。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156579382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至人父天而母地，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156595766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092891199799346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是生成妙化裁。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156595766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
