{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元降在地元中，猶如父母搆成胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156612150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月嬰胎非父職，三年乳哺母之懷。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156628534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生本天而親地，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156644918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地靈原是天靈栽","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156644918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陰陽一氣，天地一醴，而人與天地合體，地受天氣而生，人推原地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣蔭人","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156644918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之本。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156644918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太初無形之氣，始於一陽，此氣浩蕩無邊，包含萬象。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156661302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言三象，而萬象咸在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156677686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混沌是淸濁未分之謂。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156694070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸氣升，濁氣降，兩儀由此分，陰陽由此運，四時中此","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156710454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156710454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之所以胚胎，卽是萬物之大初，卽是萬物之","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156726838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156726838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地不得天則無所以成，天不得地則無所以","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156743222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092667198799912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156743222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地陰陽無一息之離，乃萬物生生化化之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156759606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且山川草木，在地之有象者也，而春榮秋落，升騰熱","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156775990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏，卽是象中之氣；日月星辰，在天之有氣者也，而斗","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156775990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉星移，弦□晦朔，乃是氣中之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156775990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜與動，陰與陽，形","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156792374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與氣，上下相須，而生生不息者，乃天地萬物生化自","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156792374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156792374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其妙難以明言，故將父母嬰貽之意以發","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156808758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明之，亦猶大易男女媾精，萬物化生之義云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156808758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時衣食居厦屋，萬寶地陷名天祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156825142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由來宅相福生人，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156841526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝室皇居壯京國。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156841526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死時理骨歸於土。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156857910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反本還原義反覆。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156874294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092872023261221"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還從地氣吸天光，變化蒸噓露金玉。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156890678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陰陽二宅，皆天氣陽精反本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化生之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順天之氣則生，違天之氣則死，乃萬物生化自然之。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156907062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156923446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之生也，一呼一吸，卽與天地之氣，息息相","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156939830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通，非但生者得此以生，卽化者亦得此以化。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156939830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反本還","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原，端頼有形之質，足以承天，無形之氣，足以生質，質","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，氣生質，天地合其德，體用合其宜，上行下效，陰","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽往來，變化蒸噓，子孫之休咎從此出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煉□仙客解冲虛，凡骨猶能化百族。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156972598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉成龍鳳衆靈奇，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156988982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092667198865448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶作蟲蟻諸惡毒，精魂□樂人不知。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153156988982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但見子孫生禍福，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖賢仙佛也難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝王将相莫自豪，各有山川來蔭應，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157021750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今來古往不相饒。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157021750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最小千金傭販子，亦沽微潤樂陶淘。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157038134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然無祿並絶世，墓宅不爽争秋亳。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157054518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言品類不齊，皆屬宅墓之應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文所言承生氣者，是承氣運消長之生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157070902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬埋","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157087286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承此生氣，則骸骨與此氣交合，結成諸般靈物。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157087286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若背","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157103670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此生氣而承衰退，則骸骨與衰氣交合，結成諸般惡","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157103670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毒，是所謂氣以成形者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157103670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫此盈虚洧長之氣，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157120054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往來之理，雖聖賢仙佛、將相帝王，猶不能逃其範圍，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157120054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093114152026163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况在中人以下哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157120054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人重此道，遷豳卜洛何焦勞。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157136438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後來名賢朱、蔡辈，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157152822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煌煌書冊議最高，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157152822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴敘上下數千百年，大聖大賢，仰觀俯察，卜洛遷豳，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157152822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以證千古一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157152822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自一行以來，僞法雜出，僞者淺而","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157169206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曉，眞者奥而難明。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157169206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間有知者，又恐天律有禁，不敢","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157185590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕洩，於是大元空一法，從此而軼其說。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157185590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟蔣公得無","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157201974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極眞傳註辨正，作五歌數萬餘言，發明天玉青囊之","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157201974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旨，天心一卦之端，錯綜變易之機，陰陽動曰之理，幾","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157201974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157201974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092540555935796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞭如指掌矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157201974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無奈監儒識見偏，諱言求福云違天，世上惜財薄葬者，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157218358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附會此說以文慳。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157218358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日倫安抛父骨，世代凋零百不全。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157234742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直使子孫貧天絶，不孝莫大豈爲賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157251126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆槨翻棺并腐骨，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157267510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母魂魄更堪憐。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157267510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言後儒失先賢遺意，陷人於大不孝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先儒固有不信地理之說，惟其德可回天，天故祐之，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157283894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人定勝天之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157283894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後人無其德而託其說，竟不擇可","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157300278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否，而愎諫違卜，遂致覆槨翻棺，諸惡畢備。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157300278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫爲子之","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157316662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道，養當盡其敬，葬宜盡其力，親安則子安，子安則親","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157316662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092997739118619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈安矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157316662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不愼哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157333046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不愼哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157349430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世閒萬事半荒唐，惟有陰陽不可當。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157365814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不笑不言三尺土，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157382198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌握禍福急如火。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157382198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"笑人不重祖父墳，只望花開不看根。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157398582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道乳母且相應，繼子外甥如嫡親。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157414966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓宅吉凶較量看，","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157431350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新墳舊墓也相參。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157431350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓宅兩興宜鼎盛，宅墓兩廢斷人烟。","logicSentenceId":"7679081153157447734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅凶墓吉兒孫慶，墓凶宅吉眼前歡。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143545407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖父新阡沾殺氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143561791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高曾福蔭他房去，寒林忽發一枝榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143561791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非新宅必新塋，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143578175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉少凶多福來短，吉多凶少禍來輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143578175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言地有必應之理，見宅新舊參。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合應騐，不可","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143594559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以執一論。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143594559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092540555984948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以僧道乳母、繼子外甥，甚言墳墓之應騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143610943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銅山","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143627327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西崩，靈鐘東應，理有固然，無足怪者。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143627327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然新墓舊墓，陰","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143643711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"基陽基，須當兼看，而新墓尤爲紧要耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143643711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看屍骸寒與暖，歲久骨枯取效緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143660095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡山惡水倘會埋，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143676479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銷盡陰霾氣方轉。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143676479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初喪新骨天靈完，葬乘生氣朝花鮮，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143692863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇嫩山并嫩水，一紀之内锦衣還。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143692863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并將宅氣來相輔，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143709247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卑田院裡出官班。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143709247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言墓氣速應之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專言歳久骨枯之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143725631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽葬吉地，須候陰寒之氣，消盡","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143742015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，方能轉機。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143742015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新骨是一年半載、三月五月之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143758399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092997739184155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再求嫩山嫩水，用法得宜，自能一葬便興，父發子榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143774783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之白星公卿，毎多如是，乃新骨取效之應驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143791167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫說生來命數奇，地元一得天星移。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143807551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是至人造命訣，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143823935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿掌中齊。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143823935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地元者，盈虛消長，化生萬物之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143840319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳地得此生氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143856703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則子孫之生命亦隨之而轉移，此卽生者命從葬者","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143856703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143856703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫說窮通有骨相，螣蛇變作雙龍様，此是仙家換骨方，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143873087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死骨不灰生骨壯，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143873087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言地理，挽回氣數之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092540556050484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此無命無數之說，未免太偏。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143873087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴觀世家大族，祖墓必","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143889471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳，卽傭販小康，墳地亦吉，大以成大，小以成小，古往","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143889471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今來，一毫不爽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143889471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并有一葬便興者，有葬後不數日","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143905855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而卽敗者，敗與興，其權皆在墳地，無關命與相也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143905855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143922239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則世之拘於命而不問地之可否者，固非；卽拘泥求","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143922239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地而不順天理人情之自然者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143922239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勸君大地勿誤求，大形大局少根由。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143938623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有千山并萬水，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143955007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與他穴氣不相投。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143955007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水二龍，都以神氣滿足，情形專一者爲的。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143971391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂根","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143987775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092997739282459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由者，此也；所謂相投者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246143987775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如坐下無氣，精神渙散；","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144004159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土色無神，雖有萬水千山，無益也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144004159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一枝一泡山龍眞，一鈎一曲水龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144020543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉眼只嫌結局小，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144036927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箇中生意滿乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144036927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言地不在乎大小，在乎神氣而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144053311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽二枝一泡，一","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144069695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鈎一曲，果有神氣，何患乎地之小哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144069695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍無神氣，何樂","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144086079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎其地之大哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144086079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉眼拘拘於局之大小，而不察地之","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144102463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生死眞假者，謬矣！","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144102463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謬矣！","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144118847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恨殺時師不識眞，常將假局嫌他人。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144135231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀占靈壇并舊墓，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144151615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093058384625704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壤人心術少安寕。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144151615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知吉地方方有，只在眉頭眼下尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144167999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章戒人勿貪大局，而爲假地所誤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專言有意誤人之弊，明知舊墳，百計謀占，翻動朽棺","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144184383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腐骨，甚至棄之溝壑，將數千百年古琢磨滅，心術如","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144184383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是，非但不能求福，必招奇禍於目前，卽經手用事之","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144184383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，欲免災禍，亦幾希矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144184383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至有不顧地之可否，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144200767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕易遷","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144200767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人祖墓，而從中取利者，甚有明知一葬便凶，因其中","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144200767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有小利可圖而不顧人者，種種弊端，一一指出，爲将","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144200767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來者戒。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144200767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093353252569125"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將生二十慈親喪，幾度拜人求吉葬。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144217151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家破多因買地差，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144233535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰半爲尋師浪。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144233535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸遇眞人無極子，授我玉圅法眼藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144249919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十年冥悟徹元微，萬里探奇走烟瘴。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144266303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得天元造化根，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144282687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化前月下天機放。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144282687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此蔣公自言得師之難，身衰家破，均由不得明師之","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144299071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144299071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸遇真人於逹方之外，從遊多年，北走盛京，南遊","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144315455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"烟瘴，徧覽古今名墓，參互考訂，始窮其變，而後花前","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144315455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月下，隨手拈來，無非天機妙用爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144315455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書不是術家書，河洛⿔龍太極圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144331839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羲文周孔心相契，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144348223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092507886501940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏禹殷箕義不磨。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144348223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管、郭遺文多僞托，曾楊口訣世間無。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144364607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不傳心并傳眼，靑囊萬卷總糢糊。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144380991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天涯倘遇知音客，","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144397375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"留取雲陽醉後歌。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144397375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言我師自敘地學得傳之由，發明作歌之意，而歸重於口傳心授。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理氣一法，原本洛書，卽九州、井田、宗廟、明堂、算學、勾","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144413759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"股及堪輿、醫藥、卜筮之術，皆由此而出。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144413759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故蔣公特舉","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144430143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸大聖人，以證俯察之理，本乎洛書之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144430143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之一終","logicSentenceId":"7679081246144446527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093353252667429"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092507886600244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之二，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977166898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲間蔣大鴻氏撰。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977166898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古吳徐嘉穀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門人","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977183282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"湖州陳陶生，長洲柯遠峰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同較。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977183282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錫山無心道人注。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977199666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱陶康吉","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977216050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元歌二山：","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977216050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍子雲谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔日華山陳處土，演成大極傳當世。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977216050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推原天地未分時，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977232434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只有坎離水火氣，二氣盤互不相離。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977232434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸者爲天濁者地，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977248818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離一交成乾坤，製造大圜如冶鑄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977248818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃輿乃是冶中灰，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977265202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火煎烹積滓翳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977265202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"首章推原渾天化生之始，大地山河成象之初。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生演成太極，推原天地未分，其氣混沌，只有","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977281586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347092507886649396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火二氣，升降虚元，亘古不離，摩盪不已，淸濁乃分。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977281586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸者升而爲天，濁者降而爲地。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977297970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸濁之所以升降，都","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977314354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由坎離水火一息不離，而能如是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977314354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰生天地者","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977330738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣，生萬物者此氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977330738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山情剛燥火所凝，骨骼支撑爲砥柱。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977347122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崑崙高頂九霄中，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977363506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是中天泰帝宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977363506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海外三山幾萬里，總與此山脉絡通。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977379890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽脉東南來震旦，如人正面，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977396274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"向離風，篤生聖哲臨夷夏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逈與肩背不相同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977396274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言中國大幹有三，都從崑崙出脉，在大江之左者","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977412658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093203125796898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲南幹，在黃河之左右者为中幹，順天關東爲北幹。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977412658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三幹都是崑崙山之正面，所產聖賢，逈異肩背。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977429042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977445426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背面內外之别。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977445426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍平岡，不可不察也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977461810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大幹三條分主輔，三條各有帝王龍，帝穴龍神五百里。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977478194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然百里作王公，但有□龍來薮里，亦許功名鑄鼎鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977494578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章槩言中國","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977510962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三條龍脉大勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977510962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論來龍之遠近長短，以辨力量之大小也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977527346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識龍行先識起，龍若起時勢無此。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977543730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山萬仭削芙蓉，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977560114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南嶽七十二峯，峯之最髙者名祝融，與芙蓉，在湖南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千里層巒皆俯視。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977560114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍多生","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977576498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093203125862434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火形，放下羣枝行八際，一枝一葉有龍神。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977576498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍端向","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977592882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央去，只把江南大勢看。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977592882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南龍起頂是黃山，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977609266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在江南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左翼","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977609266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九華開內輔，右翼天目厰東藩，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977609266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在浙江。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍句曲神仙府。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977609266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽茅山，直到金陵，龍虎蟠，是寕江。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言幹龍氣勢雄徤，成星成體者，每多木火，南幹之","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977625650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977625650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言九華天目，是謂江浙諸山，直到金陵，龍","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977642034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蟠虎踞，方是南幹之正結。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977642034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山形一起一龍分，數起數分龍益尊，龍神分去無非穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977658418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正幹偏枝力不均。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977658418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言眞龍起祖分宗枝幹之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093058384756776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章專以山形之起分，辨龍體之貴賤，又辨正幹偏","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977674802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝力量之不齊，此亦看龍之最要者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977674802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍以分為貴，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977691186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分則粗頑之氣脫盡；水以聚爲尊，水聚則氣止，氣止","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977691186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水聚，其情自然環向。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977691186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍平洋大勢然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977707570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡山龍分","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977723954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉分枝，必先起頂，分下旁枝，卽爲偏枝。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977723954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍者，一州","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977740338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一郡，或千里，或數百里，諸山莫高大於此山者，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977740338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹，或早晚有雲霧生其頂者，亦謂之幹。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977740338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍氣老，結","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977756722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴最少，果有眞結，力量最大，偏枝旁脉，力量稍殊。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977756722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977773106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹者，卽數起數分之正脉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977773106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正脉來愈遠，分愈多，麤","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977789490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093058384789544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頑之氣愈盡，此之謂分盡之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977789490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看龍看起復看斷，凡屬眞龍斷復斷，斷時百里失眞踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977805874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穿江渡海情無限。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977822258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根委曲地中行，不是仙人誰著眼。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977838642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言眞龍斷復斷之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上文論龍之起分，此章言龍之跌斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977855026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢龍之分也，必","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977871410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先起而後分；龍之起也，必先伏而後起，眞龍之勢然","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977871410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977871410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章不言伏，而言斷者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977887794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷也者，伏而將盡之","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977904178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977904178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏而將盡，其起必雄健，故伏以斷爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977920562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得斷龍方識結，結穴元徵最難說。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977936946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人求穴近大山，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977953330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263680527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且要案山龍虎夾，豈知大山龍未歇，縱朋窩藏反走泄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977953330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍偏結曠野中，踴躍奔騰不怕風。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977969714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"饒他落在深巖裡，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977986098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也要平坡萬象空。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075977986098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好龍勇猛向前奔，從龍不及過關門。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978002482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬若神駒日千里。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978018866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難將凡馬望其塵，亦似三春抽嫩笋。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978035250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從龍如籜抱其身，一朝雷雨干霄長，節高籜落不相親，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978051634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師只怪無龍虎。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978051634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍眞虎穴中鎻，會得天然龍虎時，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978068018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浪打風吹皆樂土。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978068018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言眞龍結穴變化之奇，而辨時師取用外砂之謬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷者，伏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978084402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡眞龍將到，結穴時，必先伏而再起者爲","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978100786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978100786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若出洋脫劫，伏而起，起而伏，穿江渡河，踪跡端","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978117170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093058384855080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倪，最難著眼。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978117170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之結穴，更屬元微，深山老幹，踴躍奔","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978133554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騰，頓跌起伏之情形，人所易曉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978133554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出洋脫劫，變測不灘，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978149938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將到結穴時，龍之踪跡愈變，龍之機勢愈疾，左右從","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978149938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，似有追從不及之狀。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978149938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗眼毎因左右無砂，棄而不","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978166322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978166322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之眞龍結穴之際，定不孤行，外纒夾護，隠隱相","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978182706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從，或貼身左右有蟬翼陰砂，或有羅星關攔水口，此","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978182706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽爲眞龍眞虎，又爲天然龍虎。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978182706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得此穴，不拘湖蕩","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978199090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圩邊，風吹浪打之所，皆成樂王也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978199090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍神節節顧祖宗，如子戀母遠相從。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978215474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不祖山爲正案，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978231858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679092239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"另求特案配雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978231858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百里眞龍百里案，賓主威嚴眞匹配。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978248242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫言作案便非龍，但是高峯都不賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978264626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言眞龍相朝相顧之情形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋對三义，察血脉以辨龍之得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978281010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍看落脉，辨","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978297394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴情，察神氣，認生死，以定穴之有無，乃尋龍之要訣","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978297394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978297394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云正案雌雄，卽齊眉入懷之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978313778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨穴先須辨落脉，落脉乃是穴消息。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978330162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂上生峯脉頭角，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978346546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨旁開帳脉羽翼。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978346546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粗枝出細好花房，老蚌生珠光滴滴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978362930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也有好龍無脉看，高岡平阜只粗頑，彼處祖宗多脫卸。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978379314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數節之前骨相完。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978395698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263713295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨落脉必先辨開面之大小，然後再辨落脉之眞假。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978412082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不開面而落者，不是貫頂，定是劍脊，此皆山龍之","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978428466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978428466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大開陽面而脉從中出，或從結項開帳旁落。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978444850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一叚陽和之氣者，方是眞落脉、眞結頂，故云辨穴","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978461234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必先辨落脉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978461234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"落脉秀嫩，似有似無，有呼吸浮沉之","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978477618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動氣者，此乃辨有穴無穴之消息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978477618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍凡有落脉，","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978494002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必先起頂，亦有未起頂而先落者，亦有起頂而後落","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978494002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亦有從肩落者，亦有從腰臍偏旁落者，種種不一。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978494002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老蚌生珠等語，是言老幹抽枝出脉處有光彩奪目","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978510386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263746063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之情狀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067075978510386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"另有一種無脉可尋者，必於數節之前脫","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152912430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡方眞，出洋脫劫，每多如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152912430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率眞脉有二種：連脉飛脉精神逈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152928814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連脉眞踪在本山，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152945198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛脉他山復一湧，本山定是結垂頭，他山半作抛珠弄。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152945198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也有飛脉遠數里，起伏愈多龍愈美。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152961582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師只道餘氣長，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152977966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或說羅星水口當。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152977966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈識眞龍饒變化，草蛇灰線最難詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531152994350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"教君到此須求盡，眞龍大盡貴非常。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153010734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近山飛脉不嫌土，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153027118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠山飛脉石中數。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153027118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無眞土盡浮泥，恐是人工難□□。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153043502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章詳辨眞龍出脉變態。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679141391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地形相連者爲連脉飛脉，卽渡水穿田之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153059886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近山飛","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153076270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉，雖不論士，亦要堅細明亮爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153076270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠山飛脉，伏而起，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153092654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起而伏，渡水過河，粗頑之氣已經脫盡，必有眞土，并","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153092654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有石脉石骨者爲最吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153092654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無石脉，又無真土，此地","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153109038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必假。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153109038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云抛珠垂頭，是言飛脉連脉結穴之情狀；草","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153125422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇灰綿，是言龍脉隱微，難於言狀，故將草中蛇、灰中","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153125422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"線以比之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153125422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與君細論石中機，石是山精骨髓滋。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153141806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師只怪石無穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153158190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰道真龍石始奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153158190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞鉗眞窩石内藏，眞龍眞虎石兩旁。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153174574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263778831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得枕棺龍口石，干山王乳灌心香。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153190958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結穴之石此中推，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153207342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行龍之石脉胚胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153207342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不審其中元竅理，滿山頑石豈堪裁。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153223726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試言結穴有二品，石穴土穴貴相凖。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153240110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石穴端的是窩鉗，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153256494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愼莫鑿傷龍骨髓。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153256494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土穴太極暈中抱，内象分明外象隱。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153272878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩蚶土色不須論，太極重輪仔細尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153289262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞土原來石變化，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153305646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同凡土五華文。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153305646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人鑿穴但求土，若逢凡土枉勞神。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153322030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言石土二穴眞機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節專論石穴，石穴多結窩鉗，窩鉗之石，必須入字","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153338414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分開，卽石脉與左右兩砂之石，亦要分淸主客，塊塊","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153338414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679190543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞情向穴者爲的。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153338414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石穴眞結，定有眞土，土眞其色","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153354798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自異，不必拘拘於五色也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153354798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如土色頓異者，卽謂之暈，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153371182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不必拘拘於重輪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153371182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果是眞結，近穴諸石，另有一","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153387566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"般神氣色澤，宜細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153387566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞土開下二三尺，路見，其色","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153403950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自與凡土不同，并有開下數尺，有小石如魚鱗者，有","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153403950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如冰紋者，并有石板一平如鏡者，卽名枕棺石，又爲","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153403950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膝葢石。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153403950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘見此石，斷不可鑿傷，亦不可開動，有洩眞","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153420334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153420334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其下每有靑鸞、白鶴、金鷄玉兎之類，蛇蚪魚蠏之","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153436718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬，一見諸物，斷不能受眞龍之全吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153436718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言土穴，滿","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153453102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679223311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山是石，獨下穴之處無石，又有浮面是石，開下數尺","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153453102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是土者，有來脉是石，𧵑身起石頂，開石鉗而結土穴","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153453102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，種種結處，毎多極暈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153453102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内象言土色重輪之象，外象","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153469486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是左右形局向背之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153469486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真土變化不一，難於盡舉，惟","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153485870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求明亮光潤堅細爲","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153485870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874405011492/1-b1361579eecc4dd2.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1VOKJNWGTPh1XMwiRoBn4%2FcKZ1o%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/2/ref/1lfzvxjooubyn/1-b1361579eecc4dd2.webp","fontType":1,"components":"貝勺","variants":"䝧","charPicId":"7456690874405011492"},"logicSentenceId":"7679068531153485870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153485870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土有五色，以黄爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153502254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑿穴","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153518638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求土者，斷不可拘拘於某龍土必某色之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153518638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫龍氣","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153535022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變化不測，土色亦隨之而變化。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153535022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山山不同，處處各別，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153551406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堅潤而有神氣光彩者，卽靑黑亦眞；粗鬆潮濕乾枯","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153551406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無神者，卽紅黃必假。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153551406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之在乎神氣而己，何必拘。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153567790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679256079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於靑黃赤白之呆法耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153584174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾郡洪稚存太史之祖墓，在","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153600558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北門外數里，地名前橋，開下尺許，土色如墨，光彩射","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153600558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，形方如几，僅容兩棺，其餘皆黃色，後發鼎甲，名垂","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153600558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於後。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153600558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有盛孟巖方伯之祖塋，在郡之東夏墅，土色","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153616942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑如藍靛，質堅如石。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153616942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬後子孫父子兄弟多登科第，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153633326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位皆通顯。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153633326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽靑黑之吉者，可以爲証。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153649710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有土山起石","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂而結穴者；有滿山頑石，石下特起靈巧怪石數塊","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而結穴者；有平陽起石脉兩三節而結穴者；并有圩","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田之中特生石峰五六塊而結穴者；有石形似牛馬","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679288847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，有似巧雲者，有似春笋者，有似日月者，有似連珠","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，怪巧不可勝計，惟據僕所見者誌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153666094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡結穴","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153682478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之石，必要開面監立向穴者爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153682478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竪則石性向上，開","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153698862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面向上，水從石後，必分水分下，必有土而且乾暖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153698862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌橫斜冲射，橫斜冲射，性必向下，水亦隨石而下，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153715246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下必有水。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153715246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽石性在數尺之間，斷不能脫盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153731630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟鬼撑","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153748014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山脚、山背之石，毎多如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153748014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問君下穴有何法，正龍正下是眞訣，時師只說冲腦門，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153764398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每向龍旁尋倚穴，精華走失發不全，左右偏枯房分絶","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153764398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263811599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也有眞龍偏側走，龍是側來穴是正，此是龍身一轉頭，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153764398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結頂垂頭巧相稱。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153764398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言下穴之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍正下爲專向龍旁尋倚穴者，發也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153780782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拘定於偏旁","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153797166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求穴者固非，卽拘泥於正中求穴者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153797166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要穴","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153813550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結於旁則旁，穴結於正則正，立穴得宜，自無偏枯之","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153813550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153813550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫眞龍行走之勢，情狀不一，惟側走偏落者，背","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153829934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面易分。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153829934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如回龍顧祖，枝幹相朝，種種每多側勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153846318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行走","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153862702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之勢雖側，到結穴之際，或轉身出脉，或起頂腰落結。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153862702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂垂頭之勢，却與左右龍虎相稱，此乃傍城假主之","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153879086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263844367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153879086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語君結頂是眞訣，披肝露胆向君說。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153895470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍不起頂非眞龍，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153911854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴不起頂非眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153911854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結頂名爲眞穴星，穴星圓暈產眞金，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153928238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世間萬寶金爲貴，此是眞陽露妙形。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153928238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍大地皆同體，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153944622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇著眞金莫放行。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153944622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有穴星兼四曜，不離金體是眞精。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153961006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言眞穴起頂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍起頂處，卽是眞氣脫胎出脉之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153977390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫胎出脉之","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153993774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右，自有護帶纒送，蟬翼陰砂，如八字様，護衞兩旁，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153993774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方爲眞結頂，又爲真出脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531153993774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等落脉到頭，定結穴星，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154010158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679354383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴星亦要起頂，如穴星不起頂，則眞氣不聚，立穴無","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154010158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據，故曰非眞穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154010158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴星圓暈，是言穴星之形象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154026542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154042926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂結穴者，每多金體，所謂眞陽露妙形者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154042926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
