{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無極天元無别說，只曉眞龍并眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154059310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得眞龍與眞穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154075694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機造化任我奪，不得真龍與眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154075694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我師更有方便法，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154092078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁枝旁脉有來情。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154092078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要穴後生一突，𦂳粘突下作穴星，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154108462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法名爲接氣訣，人丁財祿兩豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154108462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦堪衆子登黃甲，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154124846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君看當令富貴墳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154124846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都接氣非眞結。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154141230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言接氣穴法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來情者，脉線之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154157614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡突必要來情，方爲眞突，用接","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154173998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263877135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣法葬之，自能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154173998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有突□無來情，便是假突。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154190382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154206766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種穴法，最易誤人，故特辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154206766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再者雖有來情，亦要辨","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154223150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸來情之背面生死，而後用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154223150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"接氣二字之奥自得。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154239534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有眞龍向前行，腰澡春上有三停，凑著龍身下一穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154255918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此作騎龍斬氣，名","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154255918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言騎龍斬氣法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騎龍斬關，是看龍尋穴之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154255918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍有起伏頔跌，濶狹縱","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154272302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"放之勢，有開帳起頂、曲動行止之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154272302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡跌者、伏者，收","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154288686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而束細者，此皆龍氣變化，分脉分枝，自然之勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154288686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154305070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人所云峽前峽後可尋龍者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154305070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地都從腰禆落，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154321454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093552679387151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154321454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡過峽束氣之前後，腰間脊上稍有動氣情","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154337838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形，呼吸浮沉之嫩脉，下穴於此，謂之斬氣，又名貼脊。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154337838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞氣將伏未伏之際，左右前後從送，必有欲前不前","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154354222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之勢，欲止不止之情；將起未起之際，必有迎前","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154354222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"送後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之情形。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154354222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下穴於此，謂之騎龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154370606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騎龍之穴，堂局砂水及","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154386990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一切用神，都以左右之迎前送後者爲財身之輔從，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154386990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天然局面者爲的也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154386990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍餘氣本非穴，撞背來時氣未絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154403374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有龍旁一脉垂，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154419758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是號流神皆可發。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154419758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人見發說穴真，豈意龍頷剩明月。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154436142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093275263942671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章言不得眞穴，而得","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154452526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘氣流神，亦能發福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154452526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏側分枝有動氣者，謂之旁脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154468910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流神二宇，以狀動脉","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154485294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情形，似水之流動也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154485294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囑君受穴𦂳中粘，莫嫌湊煞出球簷。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154501678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得龍脫脉眞元散，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154518062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受水乘風禍不淺。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154518062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章申言葬法不宜脫氣，以下直指山穴諸忌格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立穴之法，先看其情形，相其動靜，察其左右，觀其照","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154534446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應，當𦂳則𦂳，富寬則寛，隨地適宜，總以接氣爲佳，斷","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154534446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可脫龍脫脉，山形高低起伏，頓跌曲動，變化不測，","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154534446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有類龍之情狀者，故謂之龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068531154534446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍也者，變化不測之","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152642587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940970979362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152642587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉也者，聚精會神之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152658971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細而軟，動而微，和而","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152675355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緩，如人之六脉一般，有呼吸浮沉之動氣者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152675355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152691739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜得龍得脉爲要，如弗得龍脉，用於偏旁界水之際，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152691739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難免受水乗風之患矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152691739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我有眞人枕中記，說盡葬山諸大忌，一一分明告世人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152708123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣渡羣迷長生意，第一切忌下空窩。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152724507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空窩積水寒氣多，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152740891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬下淤沮骨腐爛，子孫絶滅可奈何，凡有水淋生大咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152740891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左淋長子先不宥，右淋小子少安寧，當背淋來皆莫救。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152757275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡窩穴，必先起乳突，而後開窩，窩中再吐唇毡，此","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152773659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093824629424180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲眞窩。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152773659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有窩上無乳突，下無唇毡，便是空窩，此窩","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152790043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水必多，故以此爲第一忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152790043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴無貼肉若坐空，定有淋漓向穴冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152806427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流割腳猶堪忍，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152822811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若淋頭立見凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152822811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言山穴忌空窩，忌淋頭，平陽忌割脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貼肉，卽球簷之别名。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152839195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐空，非平洋坐水之空。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152855579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂下穴","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152871963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於無貼肉之所，卽爲坐空。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152871963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴無貼肉，自有水淋之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152888347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二切忌下平坦。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152904731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴居平坦眞情散，坐後全無貼體星，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152921115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平坡漭蕩生憂患。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152921115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言穴忌平坦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平坦必須界水淸楚，脉有來情，穴之丁財亦足。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152937499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但得","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152953883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971012130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平曠，毫無起伏，無泡無突，無收無束，又無貼體星辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152953883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又無小水界淸來脉，入首又無動氣，此謂之眞平坦。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152953883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平坦之地，氣散局寛，立穴無據，定有蟲蟻水濕，風吹","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152970267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣散之憂，故以此爲第二忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152970267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三莫下天風刼。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654152986651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山頂上空無穴，高而有穴不爲空。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153003035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無穴天空眞劫煞，八面風搖骨作塵，此是風輪不可說。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153019419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言穴忌天風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頂穴貼身左右，必須陰砂抱繞，石紋拱向，藏風聚","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153035803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，結成窩鉗之形，而有天然局面者爲的。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153035803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽前後左","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153052187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971044898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右之護從，必須面面相向，山山環繞，層巒拱照者爲","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153052187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"的也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153052187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四勢邊有邊無，從山半向半背貼身，又無陰","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153068571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂抱繞，便是天空劫煞，下後災禍立見，骸骨易化爲","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153068571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塵，故以此爲第三忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153068571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山頂上，結穴最少，卽有","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153084955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都是神廟仙壇，多因結穴孤露，而應如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153084955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四莫下龍脇背龍自他行，氣不聚，緃然穴後不空虚，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153101339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牆頭壁下無根蒂。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153101339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言穴忌脇背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背郎背面之背，砂飛水反，亦謂之背。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153117723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡形反者，情","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153134107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不内顧，山背者，氣必他行，故此山龍平洋，凡背俱忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153134107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093824629489716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脇卽左右偏旁，餘氣已盡之處，雖在正面，眞氣不到，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153150491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽有後山，與穴毫無干涉，故曰牆頭壁下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153150491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如貼身","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153166875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"另有小水，界淸來氣，則氣聚内堂，又有一黙眞水，止","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153166875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓄於穴前，則氣止。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153166875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此一止，則無所不止矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153183259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主山朝","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153199643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"案，雖是借用，下之亦能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153199643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若脉無水界，水無止蓄，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153216027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴之災禍，雖不立見，子孫定主伶仃，故以此爲第四","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153216027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153216027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上種種，都非的穴之眞情，似是而非，恐人","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153232411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誤認，故特指之。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153232411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總之真穴少人知，只言怪穴不易窺。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153248795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正穴正情原不怪，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153265179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093824629522484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須將福德合天機。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153265179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此□言眞穴非怪，惟有德者常之。以下皆辦時書。俗□從來之誤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有怪穴，無怪龍，識得眞龍千变無窮之熊，方知怪而","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153281563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不怪之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153281563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正穴正情者，謂龍易識，穴易知，卽端頭","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153297947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正面，人人共識之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153297947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然其用法之得失，全在乎人","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153314331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之福德，方能凑合天機，何况怪而奇者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153314331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恨殺堪輿萬卷經，當年會有滅蛮名。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153330715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假托曾、楊爲正訣，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153347099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不悮蛮夷誤後生。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153347099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言堪輿書之誤人，由來已久，自唐一行造滅蛮經，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153363483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至今不悟，故蔣公特爲指明，以醒當世也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153363483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093203126108194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽兩淨卦中來，陽龍節節是陽胎，陰龍剝換亦如此，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153379867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只取淸純向首排。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153379867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章力辨俗術淨陰淨陽之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淨與不淨，卽出卦不出卦之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153396251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山在山之卦内，水在","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153412635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之卦內，山得山之用法，水得水之用法，此謂之兩","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153412635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淨，又謂之淸純。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153412635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辨龍体之陰陽，則以開陽開面者","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153429019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陽，收束收歛者爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153429019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如論氣運消長之陰陽，則又","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153445403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以長者爲陽，消者爲陰，來者爲陽，往者爲陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153445403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如論","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153461787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支顚倒之陰陽，則又以隨時遇陽者爲陽，隨時轉","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153461787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰者爲陰也，断不是某干屬陽，某干屬隂之呆法可","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153461787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971077666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153461787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是嫩龍終是嫩，乾坤辰戌皆英俊。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153478171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是老龍終是老，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153494555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽辛亥艮未爲寶。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153494555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章力辨俗術以巽辛亥爲嫩，乾坤辰戍爲老之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之老嫩生死是言龍体之形势，活動者爲生，直硬","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153510939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者爲死，秀嫩滋潤者爲生，粗頑乾枯者爲死，断不是","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153510939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左水到右，右水到左，掌上□得長生官旺者爲生死","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153510939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，又不是乾坤辰戌、巽辛亥艮之老嫩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153510939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言老嫩，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153527323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是氣势情形之老嫩，非方位干支之老嫩。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153527323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者莫誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153543707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浪說貴隂而賤陽，天下奇龍阡葬少。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153560091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星只取影中形，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153576475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093824629555252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星変化亦非眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153576475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辨貴陰賤陽之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節申言世俗誤認方位五行而論龍體陰陽貴賤","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153592859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之非，卽拘五星、九星之変体而定貴賤者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153592859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□出後天生與尅，豈解先天大五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153609243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天五行無生尅，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153625627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一陽変化皆太極。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153625627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞木原從水裏生，眞火本是水中出。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153642011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語君休忌尅胎龍，木金水火原非逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153658395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此專辨星体五行生尅之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言俗術以來龍之星体、方位之五行，辨來龍來水","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153674779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅之非。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153674779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更把方隅分五行，左迴右轉别陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153691163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生方旺地求高峻，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153707547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093824629588020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪笑時師掌上尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153707547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言諸家五行，將陰陽呆裝於二十四山，再以水之","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153723931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左來右到分陰陽而立向消納者，甚屬可笑。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153723931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈有活","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153740315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潑靈動之機，隨時變易之理，硬派於二十四干支，亘","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153740315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古不移，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153740315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□寵本有生之情，死龍亦有死之形，生生死死隨龍變，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153756699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□方隅順逆行","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153756699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此辨方位五行生旺墓絶之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之生死，是言龍之形勢氣色之榮枯，精神之有無，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153756699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運之得失，而辨生死，非以方位干支而論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153756699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971126818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或取喝形來㸃穴，此是仙人留記訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153773083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好穴難將告後人。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153789467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"記取眞形揣摹合。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153805851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混沌初分卽有山，世間萬物後來添。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153822235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器物衣冠時代異，那得生成太古前，子微玉髓巧分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153838619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只爲峰變論應星，若說龍胎眞有相，後人虚揣失眞情。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153855003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辨喝形㸃穴之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喝形㸃穴之法：先識龍眞穴的，再看星體巒頭，或有","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153871387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴情與形相肖者，方喝某形。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153871387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是仙人指教後學揣","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153887771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形求穴之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153887771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人不辨龍之有無，氣之生死，情之","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153904155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向背，穴之眞假，一見山形水勢，有類龍蛇者，卽以龍","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153904155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971159586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇穴法下之；有類牛馬者，卽以牛馬穴法下之；有類","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153904155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣冠物件者，卽以衣冠物件下之，隨形下穴，執此牢","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153904155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可破之見，甚屬可笑。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153904155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫山川之情性，變化不測，穴","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153920539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情之隱顯偏正不一，豈可拘拘一形，有失山川千變","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153920539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無窮之妙耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153920539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上龍神不下水，先賢眞訣分明語。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153936923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時師𨚫把水來輪，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153953307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰旺順逆紛無己。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153953307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知水法不關山，失水乾龍會上天。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153969691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直寫直奔皆不忌，蝦鬚蠏眼莫求全。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654153986075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此辨山穴兼論水法之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍葢以山爲主，旣以山爲主，當以山爲用，是理之","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154002459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971208738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154002459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何故不用山而反以水之左來右到，衰旺病","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154018843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，紛紛無已耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154018843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲陽本是先天老，衆說紛紛如電掃。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154035227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血淚沾襟歌復泣，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154051611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機泄盡誰人曉。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154051611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卷蔣公非爲巒頭而作，謂世俗誤聽僞法，認眞爲","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154067995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假，認假爲眞，舉世若盲，迷而不悟，爲害莫有大於此","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154067995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154067995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故作此歌及辨偽諸篇，將假法之所由二指出，","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154084379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又將山水分用之法，重言以詳辨之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154084379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之二終","logicSentenceId":"7679069654154100763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971257890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元五歌闡義卷之三","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238439945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雲間蔣大鴻氏撰。古吳徐嘉榖門人，湖州陳陶生，長洲柯遠峰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同軫錫山無心道人注","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238439945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丘匱陶康吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元歌三：","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238439945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平洋子雲谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下平洋大地多，平陽龍法更如何？","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238439945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人盡失平洋訣，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238456329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨚫把山龍溷揣摹。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238456329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山有山之龍神，水有水之龍神，山有山之用法，水有","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238472713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之用法，靑囊天玉辨之已詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238472713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今因水龍之法，世人","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238489097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡失其傳，誤把山龍之法下求乎水，故此首章卽指","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238489097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093940971290658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其𡚁，而于下文申言水龍之體用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238489097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽龍法葢","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238505481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有數種：如山東一帶，水深土厚，地勢平曠，連綿數千","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238505481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百里，起伏行止，來踪去跡，無從捉摸，此謂之平原。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238505481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238521865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原取用之法，與山龍兼得水龍者相等。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238521865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟平原之水，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238538249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都是田源溝渠之類，須從隱隱微茫之際，看水之聚","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238538249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不聚，再看氣之止不止，氣止小聚，穴必結于此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238538249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238554633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原之法，雖未盡舉，實不外乎此。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238554633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種，氣勢雄徤，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238571017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屈曲㕆動，來有踪，去有跡，起有頂，伏有斷，一切行度，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238571017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有類山龍，惟不及山龍之高且大耳，此謂平㟠。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238571017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平㟠","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238587401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147674676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取用之法，亦以山水兼得爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238587401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如嘉湖地氣平薄，水","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238603785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多氣散，地形相連，遠者數里，近則一里半里而已，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238603785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其起伏高低，不過數寸之間，此謂之平洋。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238603785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋氣散","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238620169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水渙，甚難著眼，須從隱隱微茫之際，看其氣之聚不","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238620169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚，再看水之止不止，氣聚水止，是爲眞結。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238620169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋取用","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238636553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，原不異山龍，異于以水爲龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238636553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種，龍身","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238652937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濶大，地勢開陽，多縱放，少收束，收則有類平㟠，而無","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238652937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其結鍊，放則似乎平洋，又較爲稍厚，去跡來踪，亦可","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238652937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明白，此謂之平陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238652937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽尋穴之法，以氣止水交，主賓","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238669321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093831978008628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相得爲要也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238669321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽原不與山同，郭璞分明說水龍，水龍一卷從來秘。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238685705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不敢輕傳洩化工。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238702089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我代雲陽行普渡，一言萬古鑿鴻濛。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238718473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神呵鬼責甘心受，造福生民在掌中。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238734857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言水龍之法，始于郭璞，卽楊曾亦宗此法，恐洩天","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238751241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機，故前人秘而不敢言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238751241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟我雲陽一片救世之心，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238767625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竟將元機盡洩，造福生民，以廣天心仁愛之功。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238767625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼責","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238784009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神呵，亦所不計也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238784009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山形來落有根原，大地平鋪一片毡。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238800393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首尾去来無定所，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238816777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爵","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238816777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147707444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分枝過峽不須言。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238816777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫把高低尋起伏，休猜渡水復穿田。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238833161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言山水二龍形體之不同，卽下穴立向，亦山有山","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238849545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之用法，水有水之用法耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238849545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山是眞陽神在骨，地是純陰精在血。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238865929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山常葬骨不離肉，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238882313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地惟葬肉不離血。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238882313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人言生氣地中求，豈知地氣水邊流。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238898697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流利水邊逢水界，平原浩氣盡兠收，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238915081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此發明平注之穴，以水爲隴與山龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來脉","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238915081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逈異。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238915081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡龍得水則活，氣得水則聚，脉得水則淸，穴得水","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238931465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則的，水行則氣行，水止則氣止，陰陽自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238931465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238947849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147740212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到水邊，又逢水界，氣止水交，穴必結於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238947849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言骨","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238964233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不離肉，肉不離血，高山平陽，體用交盡于此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238964233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍原不異山龍，將水作山以類從。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238980617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍卽是山龍様，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238997001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支幹分行事事同。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197238997001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大江大河幹龍形，小溪小澗支龍情。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239013385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幹水溝蕩少眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239029769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶如山高無正結，支水屈曲情相得，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239046153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬若成胎有落脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239046153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山性本火主炎上，水性純水主潤下。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239062537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上高起是眞隴，潤下低蓄是朝宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239078921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山穴後高丁祿盛，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239095305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水穴後髙絶無踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239095305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自上而下山之止，自外入内水之止。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239111689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山來多止止求眞，水來多止止貴神。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239128073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是止形皆可穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239144457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347093831978090548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頑山頑水盡黃金","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239144457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言水龍行度與山龍支幹落脉一體格法，水龍與山龍取用高低之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239144457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍山龍","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239160841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各有其止。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239160841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言水龍幹枝行止與山龍一般，山龍眞結幹枝從。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239177225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍各有眞止之情形，眞情之向背，眞穴之證據如是，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239193609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有止者，皆爲我用，方是眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239193609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239209993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神者，山有","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239226377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情，水有意，體用兼得之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239226377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我有水龍眞要訣，水龍有轉是眞結。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239242761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直來直去龍之僵，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239259145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有灣有動龍之活。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239259145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一轉名爲抱穴龍，抱穴富貴在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239275529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二轉三轉貴不歇，四轉卿相不須說。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239291913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586707968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章辨山水二龍老嫩之情狀。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239308297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山以屈曲活動，土色","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239324681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精神，背面生死，及草木色澤，均以滋潤有光彩者爲","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239324681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嫩，乾枯者爲老也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239324681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍幹枝老嫩，則以大水爲幹，小","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239341065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲枝。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239341065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三轉、四轉者，言幹枝大小，生動活潑之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197239357449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如浜到止處，或鈎轉抱穴，或曲動有情，此謂之嫩，又","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405507635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之生。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405507635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如僵直淤淺，外寛内窄，愈到止處，愈狹愈淺，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405524019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂之死，又謂之老。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405524019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴不歇，總言三轉、四轉、抱穴","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405540403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲動之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405540403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉處不分，名息道，轉入分流，名漏道。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405556787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有息道，是眞龍","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405573171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586740736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405573171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種，一水從左來，一水從右來，一雌一雄，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405589555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩路相交，此是水龍之奇格，所云相吞相戀，是陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405589555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相得之情狀。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405589555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果能如是，三元不替之吉壤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405605939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水中亦有穴龍星，五曜時時現正形，五曜只求金水土。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405622323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木星有轉水之情。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405638707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直木火星皆最忌，水形吞吐露金精。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405655091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若應三垣并列宿，官堦品職自分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405671475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但取穴星親切處，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405687859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不離金土藴眞靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405687859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍星體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍有五星九星正體變體之形，水龍亦有五星九","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405704243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星正變之象，此云只求金水士者，卽寶照專取貪、巨、","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405704243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147772980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武三星是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405704243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木星有轉水形吞吐，是卽靜中求動，死","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405720627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中求生之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405720627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言三垣列宿，謂水龍形體亦有應天","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405737011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象者。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405737011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之環抱曲動有情者爲吉，直硬無情者爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405753395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火二星形象尖直，故忌","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405769779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星論定穴應裁三法千秋慧眼開。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405769779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐水騎龍爲上格，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405786163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挾龍依水亦佳哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405786163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向水攀龍非不美，後山有水始無衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405802547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掛角并兼三法定，莫親漏道損龍胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405818931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章直指水能裁穴之法，歸本于得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水，而最忌漏道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍論結體之五星，平洋論水城之五星，是認龍立","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405835315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586839040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏道多轉總成空。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405835315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉水不漏皆堪穴，不必止處求盡結，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405851699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉處不分，謂水不分流也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405851699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若分浜分枝，仍歸一處消","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405868083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，此爲發源，又爲來情，又名息道，切不可因其分浜","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405868083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分枝，謂之漏道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405868083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若分處而有水去者，此謂眞漏道。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405884467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二宅均忌","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405900851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡結，原來是龍頭轉處，腰腹亦兼收。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405900851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍頭偏側俱精妙，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405917235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰腹完全力始悠。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405917235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍，轉結真机。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡水之所聚，卽脉之所鍾，水神抱繞曲折之處，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405933619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是氣脉停畱止蓄之所，此云龍頭腰腹。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405933619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種皆是平","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405950003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147805748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洋就水立穴，飛邊弔角之捷訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405950003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求全不必水來多，一道單纒養太和。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405966387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有沓龍從外讓，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405982771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈多愈美酒添酥。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405982771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖取羣龍爲輔佐，還從一道作龍窠。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197405999155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别有雌雄兩道交，交時却似馬同槽。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406015539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是水龍奇妙格，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406031923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相呑相戀福多饒。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406031923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言水龍結穴，以內水一道爲主，又言水龍交氣之穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貼身抱穴小氷不必過多，多則易于雜亂，又恐胎神","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406048307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不固。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406048307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抱穴有情處，只須一道便吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406064691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一道，卽玉帶、乙字","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406081075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，抱穴情形，有抱養大和氣象者更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406081075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至外面護","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406097459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佐之水，則愈多而愈美。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406097459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金龍到頭處，仍以一道爲","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406113843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094212455809024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴之要訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406113843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三法卽坐向依三法，是平洋就水，立穴","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406130227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定向之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406130227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐水向水、依氷，總以得水爲先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406146611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如坐水","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406162995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而水弗得，非但不能爲福，最易發禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406162995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向水依水亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406179379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用法卽得水道分流，亦不能爲福也，總以體用均得。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406195763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406212147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：穴要窩鉗脉到宮，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406228531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘坐水、","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406244915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向水、依水，及飞邊弔角，諸般用法，總不離察血脉，認","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406244915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來龍，對三叉細認錝補救直達，兼貪兼輔者耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406244915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍胎雖固稱人心，遠水安墳死氣侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406261299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沾著水痕扦貼肉，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406277683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽交度自生春。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406277683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍下穴，貼水爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147838516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍葬不接脉，此爲脫龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406294067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋遠水安墳，便爲離血。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406310451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太近恐失穴情；太遠又恐水氣不接，必須龍水交接","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406326835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之際，陰陽相得之處爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406326835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡山水二龍，立穴之法，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406343219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴在不接不離，惟坐水及金龍到頭者，則又以愈近","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406343219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而愈妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406343219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平原春到好栽花，挹注盈虛氣脉賖。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406359603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞水短時結氣短，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406375987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞水長時實可誇。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406375987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長龍定主源源貴，短龍只許富豪家。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406392371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照穴有情者，謂之眞水，卽元辰水是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406408755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或溝渠田源","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406425139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有止蓄情形，或本身界水到穴前，韓身特朝，屈曲活","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406425139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586904576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，有照穴眞情者，亦謂之眞水。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406425139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞水者，對脉來情之","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406441523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406441523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水之來，必須深遠悠長爲貴，所謂龍來長短","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406457907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定枯榮者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406457907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平氣不如環氣足，龍逢轉處發萌芽。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406474291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有一端分别處，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406490675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深濶狹辯龍車。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406490675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辯水龍形勢、淺深、濶狹、遠近、長短裁取之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平氣環氣，是看水城之情狀，而辯力量之輕重也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406507059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406523443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"車者，屈曲活動，旋轉抱穴之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406523443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水神旣有屈動抱","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406539827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴情形，當辯某方濶，某方狭，某方向，某方背，某方來","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406539827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某方去，辯淸方位幹枝濶挾重輕、遠近長短，方可立","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406539827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094225147871284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向消納，從中趨避耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406539827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若乘車號秀龍，空車湖蕩見痴龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406556211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得運痴龍能富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406572595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外情內氣要相通，帶秀痴龍尤顯赫，痴龍後蔭福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406588979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章專言湖蕩水龍格法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散蕩無收者，謂之痴龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406605363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大幹小枝，兩水相交，屈曲活","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406621747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，有潤有狹，有收有束者，此謂痴龍鬱秀，外情言形。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406621747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局向背之情內氣言挨星得失之氣，要相通者，卽相","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406638131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女配夫，幹枝大小遠近各得其宜之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406638131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外二字，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406654515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其說有二，一以幹枝分内外，一以體用分内外，二說","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406654515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586937344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆是。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406654515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如論形勢，以幹爲外，枝爲内；如論體用，則又以","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406670899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體爲外，用爲内。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406670899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要相通者，謂形勢體用均歸一路，情","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406687283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性相通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406687283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從來水路後天成，不同山骨先天生。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406703667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山骨補培終不應，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406720051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水脈疏□引眞情。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406720051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當年無著修龍法，修著之時日夕靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406736435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道人工遜天巧，江河淮泗禹功","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406752819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言龍修補平水之法，以上論水龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巒。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406752819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭體格以下論","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406769203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍理氣作法。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406769203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍本無培補之法，今人動云接龍，甚屬不經。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406785587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406801971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疏鑿之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406801971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人設法挑修，往往取騐，然必須去來得","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406818355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350586970112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失，細心看准，當鑿則鑿，當塡則塡，自能取效於旦夕","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406818355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406818355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘不明元空之得失，水情之來去，胡開亂鑿，徒","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406834739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取目前之適觀者，是爲瞎修，非但不能求福，必見災","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406834739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍於目前也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406834739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍剖盡骨生香，人用元機不可量。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406851123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
