{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元機，卽隨時變易之元機，所謂天心是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406867507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟識此變","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406883891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易之元機，何位何宮，倒地翻天之奥，三元九運之機，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406883891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自能了了矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406883891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不識變易之元機，談八卦，論干支，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406900275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切說元說妙，都是盲言瞎論，豈能辯得失于亳釐之","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406900275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094350587002880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"際哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406900275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此總結上文數節之意，謂水龍幹枝大小曲直，動靜","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406916659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生死，俱已剖盡，惟入用元機，變化不測，毫釐千里，甚","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406916659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬元微，下文乃全露其機，宜細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406916659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八□三元并九曜，毫釐舛錯落空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406933043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章所言三元九曜，入用元機，卽靑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囊察血脉認來龍，對","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406949427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三叉缠認踪之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406949427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦是言來山來水方位干支之純雜；三元是言山","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406965811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水氣運之消長，九曜是言三元九運往來顚倒之機。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406965811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"補救直達之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406982195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三者是山龍平洋、巒頭，理氣之綱","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406998579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598700761103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"領，必須體用合宜，山水兼得，方爲盡善。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197406998579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稍有一亳舛","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407014963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯，卽是空亡，吉中有㐫，不成美器矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407014963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問君八卦如何取？","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407031347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書大數先天矩，五帝三王緯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407047731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407064115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九州九井都經紀。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407064115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章推原理氣之所由。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣公恐人不信，特舉五帝三王、九州九井，皆宗洛書，","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407080499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦推原理氣之所由來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407080499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近因世俗諸書，都從干","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407096883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支上著眼，不能領會元空，故將洛書错綜之理，九星","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407096883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變易之機，重言以申明之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407096883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：天地之化","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407113267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890666180647/1-af3240604bceb841.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=A%2FucH8KIfcxPbrHorrsb03gA2RQ%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0504/3/ref/1lg4bghzygoxg/1-af3240604bceb841.webp","fontType":1,"components":"彳七","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890666180647"},"logicSentenceId":"7679088197407113267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者過，來者續，陰陽寒暑晝夜之","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407113267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598700810255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407113267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰生陽，陽生陰，寒而暑，暑而寒，晝而夜，夜而","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407129651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晝，一道之徃來而不已也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088197407129651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其理不偏不倚，常行不易","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237135370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而成化也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237135370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理也者，形而","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237151754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之之道也，生萬物之本也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237151754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也者，形而下之之器也，生萬物之具也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237168138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以萬物","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237184522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之生，必本此理然後有性，必本此氣，然後有形。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237184522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237200906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極，理也，動靜氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237200906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣行理亦行，二者常相依而未","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237217290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗相離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237217290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理者天之體，氣者天之用。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237233674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極之動靜，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237250058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天心體用之變易也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237250058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只把九龍一卦装，莫憑三八分條理。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237266442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識得九龍龍骨眞，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237282826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094212455907328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨若不真飛不起。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237282826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章申言三元九運、五行顚倒之機，不以干支分順逆者，方眞。一卦眞則。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九曜旋飛，乃靈耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九龍卽九運一卦，卽天心正運之一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237299210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋轉乾坤，顚","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237315594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒三八，都由于此，順逆陰陽，亦由于此。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237315594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能識得天","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237331978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心一卦之端，方知隨氣變易之機，隨時而在之理矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237331978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時而在，九龍之骨方眞。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237348362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘拘于二十四山分彼","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237364746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此，辯復劣者，天心旋轉之機，何會夢見耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237364746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九龍八卦貴乘時，上下三元各有宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237381130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬著旺龍當代發，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237397514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬著平龍發跡遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237397514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬著死龍憂敗絶，縱然合格也難支。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237413898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598700843023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是八神齊到穴，出元之局莫相依。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237430282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍八卦，三元氣運衰旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九龍卽九運，八卦卽八方。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237446666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂旣有九龍八卦，自有盈","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237463050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛消長之機，往來進退之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237463050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣有往來進退，則三元","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237479434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九運各有衰旺，理之必然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237479434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云八神齊到者，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237495818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山去水，方位干支，坐山朝向，山上水禋，處處得宜","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237495818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237495818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或體或用，一有不合，切莫相依。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237512202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定局惟看貼水城，毫釐尺寸要分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237528586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉㐫得失，在乎貼身，小水毫釐尺寸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亳釐尺寸，是言貼身小水，方位、干支、遠近、長短、濶狹","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237544970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598700875791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重輕之辯，此乃平洋裁穴定向之最要者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237544970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稍有不","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237561354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，便成差鍇，其可忽乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237561354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有照神能奪氣，外洋光透失宫星。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237577738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照神者，卽登穴所見之遠水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237594122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有有水而不見者，有","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237610506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水而光不甚大者，有見水光，更兼形勢浩蕩，卦爻","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237610506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯雜者，此謂之光透，又名奪氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237610506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種都是小不勝大，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237626890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近不敵遠，輕不敵重之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237626890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用法遠近大小，一有不","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237643274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，自有吉㐫不一之患，必須大小兼收，遠近得宜爲","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237643274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要，能將五吉用於浩蕩錯雜之處者，乃爲最妙耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237643274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094713134022690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮星若重平分勢，照神若重獨持衡。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237659658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外照過多分氣亂，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237676042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必定分房運改更，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237676042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照穴有情者爲照。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237676042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登穴見幹水遠照者，卽是外照，又","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237692426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名照神。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237692426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘有此水，亦要元空得生旺爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237708810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不得生","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237725194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，恐爲外照奪氣，吉㐫牽制也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237725194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮星是言近穴小水，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237741578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽貼身界水、城門之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237741578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重輕，卽大小濶狹遠近之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237757962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如近宗小水，得情得力，并得五吉三星補救直達之","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237774346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237774346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則以內水爲主，外照爲賓，内外得宜，主賓相","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237790730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得，照神雖重，非但不爲奪氣，反有益於用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237790730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘內水","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237807114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237807114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598700908559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無情無力，僵直淤淺，獨見照神，汪洋數千頃，有權有","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237807114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢，控情於外，此又以遠水爲主，近水爲賓，大水爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237807114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小水爲賓也，取用之法，亦宜大小兼收，内外得宜爲","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237823498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237823498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若拘先到先收之見，非但不得外照之益，反受外","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237839882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照之㐫者多矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237839882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此推之，水勢之遠近大小，輕重多","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237856266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寡，可不察乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237856266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遠不逼，有規有矩，與枝水大小輕","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237872650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重相稱者，謂之照神。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237872650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照者，照穴有情之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237889034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如光茫","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237905418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奪目，散亂無收，亳無照穴眞情，而内水又無權力以","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237905418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之，則元運不一，分房更變，勢所必然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237905418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094713134055458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有水龍眞骨髓，只將對脉論來情。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237921802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來情若是眞元會，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237938186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸局參差一半輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237938186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉折短長純雜處，此中消息眼惺惺。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237954570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章言水龍宮星照神兩氣兼","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237970954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收之法，而歸重于來情對脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237970954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來情對脉，卽水來當面之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969237987338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣有眞脉，再有來情，再","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238003722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼轉折長短，却與來脉相稱，再兼宮星照神，用法得","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238003722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜，便是眞元會。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238003722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此處一得諸局之參差，無關重與輕","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238020106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238020106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元既辯龍神旺，九曜不純龍力喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238036490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是元空大五行，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238052874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲爻中應天象。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238052874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"納甲五行，是一行所造，以混挨星之眞者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598705004559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曜卽元空大卦之九曜，本無有吉，用得則吉；本無","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238069258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有㐫，用失則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238069258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此云不純者，半得半失之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238085642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天象","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238102026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云者，謂此大元空之九曜，轉移顚倒，都由六甲運行","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238102026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而如是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238102026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章直推大撓，占斗綱所建始，定干支，造","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238118410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，是三元六甲之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238118410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如初三月明于庚，納於震，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238134794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十六月魄于辛，納于巽；初八弦於丁，卽納于兌之說，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238134794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽是宗廟五行，故不書纳甲，而書六甲。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238134794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星二曜轉乾坤，禀命天樞造化根。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238151178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天北斗司元氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238167562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在地八卦顯天心，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238167562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094212455940096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立極中央，主宰七政，運幹坤輿，垂光乾紀，流通八國，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238167562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋轉四時，乃萬化之根源也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238167562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四時，地有八方，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238183946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238183946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光地德，秋落春榮，隨時變易之機，均由旋轉運行，縱","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238183946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横顚倒使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238183946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟于顚倒中推測，則在在之陰陽，在","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238200330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在之五行，天心一卦之端，自能了了矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238200330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下文所謂父","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238216714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母是變易陰陽之父母，卽天心斗柄是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238216714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四吉四㐫分順逆，父母二卦顚倒輪。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238233098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極、兩儀、四象八卦，卽一分爲二，二分爲四，四分爲","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238249482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八，此卽四象八卦之所由來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238249482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦雖分八，來往之氣","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238265866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094713134120994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則一，故將八卦分作來者四個，往者四個，來者爲順","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238265866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲吉，往者爲逆爲㐫，所云四吉四㐫分順逆者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238265866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母是變易干夫之父母二卦，卽一往一來，隨氣運","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238282250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行遷謝之二卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238282250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随時變易，自有顚倒無窮之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238298634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首一星災福柄，去來二口死生門","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238315018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星者，是向上所得之一星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238315018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上所得之一星，大","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238331402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關休咎，故謂之柄。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238331402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二口卽去水來水之二口，來有來","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238347786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之用法，去有去之用法，去來各得其宜，自能一葬便","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238347786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興，稍有不合，卽見退收田。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238347786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此推之向首之得失，水口","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238364170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094713134186530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之去來，可不加意乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238364170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑囊萬卷無非假，惟有天玉是真經。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238380554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元空洪範并三合，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238396938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曜黃泉枉問津。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238396938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤恨去來生旺墓，害人父母，絶兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238413322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此力辯諸家理氣之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗廟洪範、黃泉、八煞及三合、雙山、小元空、去來生旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238429706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種都是時師所用之僞法，爲害於世，由來已久。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238429706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238446090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公恐後人再誤，故將諸僞法一一指出。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238446090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能將九曜爲喉舌，大地乾地，一口吞","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238462474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍真訣，將大元空五行爲立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"向消納之用者，萬不失一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094212455972864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九矔，卽貪、巨、祿、文、廉、武、破、輔、弼之九曜。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238462474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此九曜上應","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238478858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗，主宰天地，化育萬物，周流六虚。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238478858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名有定名，位無","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238495242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定位，隨氣運行，隨時而在。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238495242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟能識得在在之陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238511626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238511626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在之五行，雖大荒內外，山巅水涯，古往今來，無不了","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238511626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"了矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238511626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變易在乎一卦，元機在乎六甲，縱萬法之紛","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238528010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紜，惟一理之融貫。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238528010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造之精者可以濟世，用之久者可","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238544394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以通神。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238544394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更說高原無水地，亦有隱穴在其際。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238560778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘高臨下卽江河。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238577162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬頃低田能界氣，高低數尺合三元，一且繁華諸福至。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238593546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598705053711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐低空在後山，數世箕裘常不替。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238609930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專論高原無水之處，尋龍尋穴之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238626314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬頃，甚言低平","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238642698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寬廣之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238642698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有數尺高低爲界，則氣清脉聚，立穴有據","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238659082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238659082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能坐低空在後山，更兼五吉坐歸穴後，自能富貴","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238675466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不替矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238675466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江北中原平地龍，無山切莫强尋踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238691850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是乾龍無水道，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238708234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溝渠點滴有神功。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238708234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱隱微茫看水法，葬法實與江南同。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238724618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我向乾流指眞水，能使上土開心胸。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238741002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言高低尋穴之法，及中州無山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地取乾流爲水，法，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238757386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與江南似異而實同。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969238757386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094713134252066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上節論高原無水尋穴之法，此節論平原無山無水","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392324654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取用之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392324654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又論山下平地，依水立穴定向之法，種種","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392341038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都是。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392341038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無水爲有水，無龍作有龍之一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392357422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有以低田","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392373806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低地低一寸爲水者，有以溝渠黠滴爲水者，有以池","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392373806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潭溪澗爲水者，有以高低數尺爲水者。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392373806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水雖不同，其","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392390190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用則一。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392390190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣公恐人拘泥，故將諸般取用之法，一一指","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392406574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392406574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山坦處近平田，莫作山龍一様看。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392422958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇乾流或水際，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392439342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦將此法論三元。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392439342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲陽畱得三元訣，飲向人間種善緣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392455726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094598705102863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言山脚之穴，兼論水局，三元别二格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言山下平地，依淵傍水，蝦縣","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392472110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872450957324/1-fd8b3434bfb4c418.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Ud6qw0Ui7XGjnMX%2FCrP3xlu%2BdUU%3D","uri":"read/NCM011X411999021550/4/ref/1l2lly7at1zq3/1-fd8b3434bfb4c418.webp","fontType":1,"components":"虫府","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690872450957324"},"logicSentenceId":"7679088969392472110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼及溝渠點滴之","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392472110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，亦宜山水分用。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392472110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽平原無水之地，髙一寸，低一十，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392488494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱陽微茫之水，亦要分用，卽青囊所謂山管山，水管","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392488494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392488494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語君葬水勝葬山，葬山歲久氣方還。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392504878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水葬吉龍并旺運，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392521262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三年九載透天","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392521262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"關此章撥明山水二能，應騐遲速之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言葬水葬山應騐之遲速。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392521262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云吉龍指體，旺龍指","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392537646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用，必須體用多得其宜，方能取效。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392537646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三年九載者，甚言","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392554030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952372879394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其速也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392554030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山本陽精中抱陰，陰精是水陽内存。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392570414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬陽得陰陰漸長，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392586798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬陰得陽陽驟伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392586798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山㟠雖以龍穴爲重，到眞龍結穴之際，必有眞水以","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392603182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應之；平洋雖以水爲王，到水神交會聚蓄之處，必有","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392603182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真氣結聚干其間。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392603182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽有龍自有水，有水自有龍，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392619566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽自然之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392619566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云得陰得陽，卽寶照所謂陽水","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392635950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰山，陰水陽山者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392635950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂陰陽動靜，山情水意者，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392652334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦卽此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392652334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952372912162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公昔日救貧法，但取三元龍水合，三侯將相此中求。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392668718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無著禪師親口訣，杜陵狂客不勝愁。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392685102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四十無家浪白頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392701486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冥爲尋山貪幹氣，蒼苔古道漫淹畱。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392717870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍一名贈知己，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392734254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地陽春及早收。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392734254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言水龍，本之楊公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此蔣公自言貪求幹龍正結，以至頭白身衰，正勤當","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392750638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之貪求大地者耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392750638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽一枝一泡、一鈎一曲之小地，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392767022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要得穴得用，將相公侯無不在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392767022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐人不信，","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392783406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特舉楊公以證之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392783406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之三終","logicSentenceId":"7679088969392799790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952372961314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952373010466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之四，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲間蔣大鴻氏撰，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古吳徐嘉穀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"湖州陳陶生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錫山無","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"門心道人注人長州柯遠峰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同較金匱陶康吉","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元歌四：","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽宅子雲谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生最重是陽基，卻與墳塋福力齊。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870660131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅氣不寕招禍咎，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870676515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨埋眞穴貴難期。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870676515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建國定都關治亂，築城置鎭係安危。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870692899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試看田舍豐盈者，半是陽居偶合宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870709283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"首章言陽宅與陰地並重，若建都立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邑更重於墳墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生居吉宅，死卜佳城，其理一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870725667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳之吉凶，蔭在子孫，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870742051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952373043234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋之禍福，應在一已。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870742051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故迎承生旺，取效目前，較陰基","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870758435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更爲切近。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870758435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡門户行路，通風通氣，通人往來行動者謂之堪；","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870774819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牆垣壁落，弗通風，弗通氣，并不通人往來行動者謂","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870774819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之興。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870774819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空者堪，實者輿，動者堪，靜者輿。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870791203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿二字，辯别","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870807587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸楚，再辯親疎遠近，再辯干支方位，再辯挨星得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870807587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則陰陽二宅，自能指掌瞭然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870823971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽居擇地水龍同，不厭前篇議論重。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870840355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但比陰基宜濶大，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870856739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不争秀麗喜粗雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870856739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大江大河收氣厚，涓流滴水不關風。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870873123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952373076002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得亂流如織錦，不分元運也亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870889507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽基龍法，一如水龍，故不復。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論必取形局寛大，乃可容受，宜擇水多曲折之處，卽非本元，亦可發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言陽宅之大局，比陰基稍異，惟迎神引氣之法，與","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870905891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰宅水龍一般，卽地形水勢，亦取粗雄濶大、環繞曲","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870905891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動者爲佳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870905891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅龍動地水龍裁，尤重三門八卦排。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870922275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只取三元生旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870938659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引他八室是胞胎。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870938659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一門乘旺兩門囚，少有嘉祥不可畱。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870955043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩門交慶一門休，大事歡欣小事愁。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870971427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"須用門門多吉位，全家福祿永無憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅龍者，宅向所得之星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316870987811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動地卽門户往來行動之","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871004195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952373108770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，內戸趨避之法，與宅外水法一般，故曰水龍裁也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871004195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云排八卦，辯三元，卽排向首一星。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871020579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大元空五行生","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871036963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之氣，向首得此生氣，方能引領吉氣，以進内室。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871036963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871053347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門兩門者，言内户承氣，門門須承向首之生正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871053347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三門先把正門量，後門房門一樣裝。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871069731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一宅以大門爲主，内户門路爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871086115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"量者，是定陰陽，分","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871102499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順逆，量度向首一星之休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871102499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首旣辯，再辯上房","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871118883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門路所承之氣若何也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871118883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云門門多吉位者，謂都承","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871135267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正門生旺之方位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871135267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"量者，度也，是量挨星之得失，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871151651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094952373141538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非量門之濶狹長短，讀者切莫誤㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871151651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别有旁門并側戸，一通外氣卽分張。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871168035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設若便門無好位，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871184419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一門獨出始爲强。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871184419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅門氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此專辯旁門側户。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871200803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂旣有正門，或左或右，或前或後，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871217187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從旁開門者，謂之旁門，又謂之便門，又名側門。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871217187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有可","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871233571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不由大門而從旁門出人者，此謂之通外氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871233571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871249955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁門，亦有所向。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871249955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此向所得星辰，與正門一氣者則吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871266339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在正門之吉方者亦吉，一有不合，卽爲分張。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871266339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分張","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871282723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，爲此奪氣，吉凶牽制之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871282723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586234403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門爲宅骨路爲筋，筋骨交連血脉均。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871299107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是吉門兼惡路，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871315491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酸漿入酪不堪斟。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871315491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言門路氣脉相連，趨生避尅之法，一如水龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一宅之吉凶，均由門而定，故謂之骨；一宅之盛衰，都","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871331875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從路而進，故謂之筋。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871331875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首旣得吉氣，全在吉路引進","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871348259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871348259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘門吉而路不吉，宜攺移吉位，必使筋與骨，血與","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871364643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉，一氣貫通，方爲盡善。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871364643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如吉凶夾雜者，何異酸漿之","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871381027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入酪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871381027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有門自有路，門與路宜相生比和爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871397411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871413795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以門爲主，路爲賓，來往相生爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871413795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如門得生旺，門外","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871430179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來路宜扶，門之生旺，及一切內戸，均宜從外生入，切","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871430179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144070178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌相冲相尅，使爲惡路。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871430179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此冲尅，非形勢之冲尅，是","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871446563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之冲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871446563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀者宜辯。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871462947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内路常兼外路看，宅深内路抵門闌。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871479331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外路迎神并界氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871495715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迎神界氣兩重關。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871495715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅路氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此專辯看路之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679075316871512099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外路是宅外街道田塍之類，內路","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867456552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是宅内行動之路。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867456552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外兩路，用法各殊。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867472936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外路宜扶向。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867489320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首内路宜益私門，私門氣弱，宜用内路吉氣以扶之，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867505704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂内路作外路，卽此法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867505704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅深内路自有遠近，遠","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867522088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則恐氣不呼應，又以近門內路爲用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867522088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云迎神界","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867538472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586267171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，都在遠近中分出，近則爲迎神，遠則爲界氣，卽外","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867538472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路看法亦然，都從遠近親疎而分休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867538472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有風門通八氣，牆空屋闕皆難避。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867554856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇祥風福頓增，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867571240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇煞風殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867571240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅風氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專辯城市凹風看法與水法一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867587624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矗矗高高名嶠星，樓臺殿宇一同評，或在身旁或遥應，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867604008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能迴八氣到家庭，嶠壓旺方能受蔭，嶠壓凶方鬼氣侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867604008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅嶠氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專言迴風返氣之法，必須辨清元空之得失，嶠壓一","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867620392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586316323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠近，而占驗休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867620392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城市以牆傾屋缺者爲凹風，左","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867636776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右前後鄰屋特高者謂之嶠星。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867636776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云旺方、凶方，祥風、","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867653160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞風，均不在形跡上看，須從元空上尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867653160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如村居氣散，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867669544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應驗少輕；城市氣聚，應騐最速。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867669544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言生旺是元空之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867685928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，非生延之生旺，讀者莫誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867685928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝橋衝路莫輕猜，須與元龍一例排。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867702312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝起樂宮無價寶，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867718696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝起凶宮化作灰。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867718696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言陽宅衝氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專辨衝橋衝路，取用之法，與水龍一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867735080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云樂宮是","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867751464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元空之樂宮，非天醫生延之俗說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867751464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按莫輕猜三","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867767848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144102946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字，樂宮囚位，須從元空中著想，不在形跡上尋也明","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867767848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867767848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅前逼近有奇峰，不分衰旺皆成凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867784232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擡頭咫尺巍峩起，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867800616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泰山壓倒有何功。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867800616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言陽宅逼氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咫尺甚言其逼近，巍我是言其太高。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867817000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅前高而且逼，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867833384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多凶少吉，二宅均忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867833384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"村居曠蕩無攔鎻，地水兼門一同取。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867849768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城巷稠居地水稀，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867866152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路衢門嶠並司權。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867866152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言城市、鄕村、陽宅之異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言城市鄉村宅法之不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867882536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄕居氣散水渙取用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867898920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586365475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法向與水兼得爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867915304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城市氣聚，并有鄰屋之凹凸高","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867931688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低，街道之濶狹曲直，水稀地窄，卽以凹者、低者、潤者、","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867931688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲動者爲水，直者、狹者、凸者、特高者爲山也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867931688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云司","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867948072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權者，謂高低各有其用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867948072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一到分房宅氣移，一門恒作兩門推。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867964456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時内路作外路，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867980840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入室私門是握機。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867980840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當辨親疎并遠近，抽爻換象出神奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273867997224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅分房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分居是兩三家同住一宅，或一二十家合居一宅之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868013608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分房也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868013608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看法以一家私門爲主，諸家往來之路爲用，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868029992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586398243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故云內路外路，握機、私門是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868029992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親疎卽内路遠近之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868046376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868046376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抽爻換象，卽物換星移，吉凶變遷之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868062760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨，卽辨内","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868079144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路遠近變遷之吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868079144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽近門内路亦有淸純錯雜","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868095528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868095528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠則方位必移，方位移，則所承之氣自然不一。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868111912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承氣不一，吉凶變遷，自無一定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868128296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論屋神祠理最嚴。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868144680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人營室廟爲先，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868161064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言神祠宗廟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神廟開合社之興衰，宗祠係一族之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868161064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地氣形勢、","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868177448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂局、砂水高低層進，均與住宅一般，惟向首一星尤","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868177448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲緊要也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868177448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首一星，宜得官貴文秀之氣，和平悠遠","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868193832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144152098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，兼貪兼輔，見孫自多賢良，自多孝友，切忌頑钝","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868193832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，剛燥之神到向也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868193832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽神廟仙壇亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868210216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅內神祠，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868226600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽祖堂香火，其承接之氣，關繫一家安危，當以此爲","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868226600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868226600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上房内户、門路、井竈諸般都吉，還以宅中色氣爲禍","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868242984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福之主宰。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868242984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫宅中色氣不一，畧舉其大槩而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868259368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868275752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曉亮者爲吉氣，滋潤有光彩者爲生氣，和暖淸明，有","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868275752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欣欣氣象者爲旺氣，惟淡白無光者爲退氣，黑暗陰","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868275752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒者爲死氣，冷落乾枯者爲衰氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868275752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門路雖吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868292136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向首雖","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868292136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586463779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，倘見此氣，死傷退敗之患不遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868292136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法宜修理油漆","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868308520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粉飾，亦挽回之一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868308520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦内房尤特重，陰陽配合宅根源。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868324904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言内房寢室，歸重於宅主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
