{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦内房，卽宅主之正房，此房關繫一宅之休咎，所","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868341288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承之氣，必須彼此相生，陰陽相配爲合，一見冲尅，定","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868341288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868341288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此總括上文之意，謂門戸井竈、家堂香火，諸","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868357672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"般都吉，還以上房内户承接之氣爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868357672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂根源者，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868374056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此也，配合者，亦卽此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868374056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且大門爲一宅之氣口，向首","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868390440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得失，關一宅之盛衰，内房承氣，繫一房之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868390440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宅","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868406824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144201250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主内房承氣得失，猶山龍之入首，水法之城門，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868406824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一家禍福之所，故以此爲特重也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868406824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宅因門坐向空，三元衰旺定眞踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868423208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運遇遷移宅氣改，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868439592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人家興廢巧相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868439592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅以大門朝向而定吉凶，不以坐山而論休咎，此卽氣曰反爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初之義，而歸重於遷移入宅之時，改移修造之運，而辨得失，故宅有彼此興廢之不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此專言坐空向空之宅，因俗術指明，以某是戊巳空","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868455976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，某某是龜甲空亡，陰陽二宅，都以此爲立向坐宮","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868455976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之最忌者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868455976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海内皆然，故特辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868472360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫八卦九宮，四維","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868488744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支，是日月五行氣化流行之次舍，隨氣推移，本","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868488744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144234018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無吉凶，本無彼此，何故有此吉彼凶之辨耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868488744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868505128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲中央鎭星，又爲十干之中氣，乃至陰至陽，乾坤交","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868505128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"媾之處，水火金木都藉此戊巳爲成形顯用之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868505128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868521512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火金木都不忌，而獨忌成形顯用之所，何哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868521512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴查古","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來名墓吉宅，用此山向者頗多，卽近時墓宅用之者","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦名，其中有吉有凶，有衰敗者，有發福者，有富貴無","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休者，并有卽此一宅，前人居住不吉，而轉售別姓居","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，則吉者，彼旣謂之凶而避之，此乃用之而又發福","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其故何耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868537896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是昔不曉三元衰旺之踪，隨時顚倒之。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868554280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094543810084879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機遷移變易之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868570664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢空亡之向固有斷，非此强挨","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868587048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"硬砌者所知。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868587048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全凴關天地，察元空，權輕重，考順逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868603432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868619816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐所向，雖界乎兩岐之際，左右兩爻，陰陽順逆，仍屬","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868619816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣者，此謂空而不空，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868619816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有山向雖不犯戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868636200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜甲之位，元空流行之機，𨚫界乎半陰半陽，造葬適","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868636200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢其會，此謂之不空而空，主凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868636200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種所坐所向，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868652584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖在戊巳龜甲之地，而入用元機，與水法之零正無","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868652584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一毫差錯者，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868652584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三元九曜，稍有一毫差錯則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868668968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽戊巳龜甲之說所由來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868685352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂差錯，是水口","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868701736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586496547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"零正挨星五行合不合之差錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868701736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇此等，先將向首","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868718120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽五行辨別淸楚，或當順排，或當逆挨，再查水之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868718120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正神若何，零神若何，自曉其所以錯不錯之故。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868718120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868734504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有差錯，挨星五行𨚫合其宜，此卽五行當分別者","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868734504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868734504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是周公眞八宅，無著大士流傳的。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868750888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天醫福德莫安排，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868767272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只好遊年斷時曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868767272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上二句推原元空大卦之所自來，下二句申言遊年","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868767272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦例之非。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868767272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊年卦例，本是一行所造，以混挨星之眞","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868783656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095239586529315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868783656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢興鬼絶更昌隆，遇替生延皆困迫。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868800040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章力辨生延鬼絶之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星顚倒，八國轉移，是鬼絶非鬼絶，非鬼絶是鬼絶，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868816424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從横顚倒，在在有興有替，斷非天醫福德，新舊八法","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868816424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之挨砌者可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868816424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲煞神若加臨，禍福當關如霹靂門内間間有宅神，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868832808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値神値星交互測，此是遊年剖斷機，不合三元總虚擲。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868832808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辨小遊年翻卦之非，必以挨星之得失，乃斷吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲臨方到向，人人共曉。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868849192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如向上所得之星，每間所","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868865576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094543810150415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之神，世所不知。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868865576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣曉向首一星之休咎，再將値年","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868881960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値月之紫白，加臨向首，吉則助吉，凶則助凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868881960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應驗如","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868881960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，方知向首得失之眞消息矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868881960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値星者，是向上所得","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868898344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之星也；値神者，是値年値月之紫白也。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868898344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此紫白若與","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868914728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上所得之星，與毎間所得之星，相生比和者吉，相","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868914728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅相剝者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868914728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則某年吉，某年凶，過去未來均可","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868931112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猜測而得。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868931112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽上文所言遊年翻卦只好占時日之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868947496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，恐人再誤，故將占騐一一指明。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868947496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九星層進論高低，間架先天卦數推。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868963880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有書傳皆不騐，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868980264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095393731117091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漫勞大匠用心機。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868980264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辨層進九星，□架卦數之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高低層進俗術皆以水火木金而定高低，乾一兌三，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868996648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天卦數而分間架。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273868996648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註書立說，言之鑿鑿，如此呆板，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869013032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則元空活潑之機，從何窺其消息耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869013032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫高低層進之","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869029416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，必須細揣五行之生死，方位之宜忌，高低相稱，層","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869029416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進合宜，總不離生旺宜高，衰敗宜低，官貴宜高，陰賤","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869029416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜低之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869029416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先將八方五行布就，再將宅向所得何","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869045800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星查準，再辨五行之情性，再辨星辰之陰陽貴賤，氣","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869045800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運之往來進退，如是而論，高低層進，無所不當矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869045800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095393731166243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山龍宅法有何功，四面山圍亦辨風。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869062184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有山溪來界合，","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869078568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼風兼水兩相從。","logicSentenceId":"7679076273869078568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論來龍休論結，結龍藏穴不藏宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081637391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使皇都並都會，只審開陽不審龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081653775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言山龍宅法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比節專論山居宅法。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081670159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡山有低凹，卽有風水來去，其","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081686543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間用法，風與水一般，若半山半水者，用法則異。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081686543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081702927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽知山龍兼得水龍之法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081702927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗言龍去結陽基，此是時師俗見庸。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081719311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲取陽居釀家福，","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081735695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山居不及澤居雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081735695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此兩節總言山居澤居，不在乎穴之得弗得，在乎水","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081752079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094543810183183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之聚不聚耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081752079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽在萬山之中，亦以得水爲先也。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081768463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰居蔭骨及兒孫，陽宅氤氲養此身，偶爾喬居并客館。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081784847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"菴堂香火有神靈，關著三元輸轉氣，吉凶如響不容情。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081801231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透明此卷天元宅，一到人家識廢興。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081817615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言陽宅陰生，人，視陰地更速凡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有棲身不","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081833999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081833999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰地蔭及兒孫，陽居應在一己。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081850383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽偶爾喬居客館，蓭","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081866767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂香火之間，關著三元消長之機者，吉凶如響也。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081866767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡二宅之前後左右，有見村庄者，有見土堆高墩者，","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081883151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有見屋角橋梁者，有見神廟紅牆者，有見城樓寶塔","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081883151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095393731215395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081883151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在陰宅爲空氣，在陽宅卽爲嶠星，種種多能迴風","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081899535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返氣，用得用失，應驗最速。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081899535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等先要辨淸方位干支，","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081915919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高低遠近，再辨元空之得失，從中趨避，自無不當矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081915919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟紅牆與塔，趨避之法稍異，紅牆宜尅宜洩，并宜粗","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081932303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頑之氣；塔宜生宜扶，并利官貴文秀之神，此卽因物","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081932303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"付物之一法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081932303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌閻義卷之四終","logicSentenceId":"7679077896081948687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095393731297315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之五","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908813352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雲間蔣大鴻氏撰，古吳徐嘉榖門，湖川陳陶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908813352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生長州柯遠峰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同較","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908813352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錫山無心道人注。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908813352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱陶康吉","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908829736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元歌五：","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908829736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"選擇子雲谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理天時古聖言，堪輿二字義相連。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908829736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浪說江南無大地，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908846120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但取年月日時利。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908846120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞龍大地遍江南，也要天時一力參。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908862504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初年禍福天時騐，歲久方知地有權。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908878888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"首章言時日雖不及地氣，亦司初年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禍福故當兼重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得龍得穴得砂水，輿道也；得日得時得七政，堪道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908895272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095393731330083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪與輿，卽天與地。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908911656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰天時不如地利，實則地理天","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908928040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時二者不可偏廢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908928040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得地而不得天，猶播種不得","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908944424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其時，定有枯稿之患；如得天而不得地，猶男子無室，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908944424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自無發生之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908944424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此推之，時日之關繫更爲切近，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908960808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不加意細察乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908960808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家尅擇最紛紜，拘忌多端誤殺人。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908977192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此家言吉彼家凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908993576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對盡諸書總不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878908993576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五載三年精一日，萬般福曜總成空。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909009960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古來天子七月葬，士庶踰月禮不曠。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909026344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月何曾有廢興。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909042728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時只好論孤旺，春秋葬日滿經書，但辨剛柔内外宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909059112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347094543810215951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禆竈择愼俱博物，豈昧陰陽誤萬機。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909075496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家選擇盡荒唐，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909091880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗首元辰失主張。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909091880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇遁演禽皆倒亂，不經神授莫猜詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909108264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人尅擇重干支，生命亡命苦相持，致使子孫冲犯衆，","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909124648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多年不葬孝心違。","logicSentenceId":"7679085878909124648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章歴辨諸家選擇之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴举春秋葬日，辨剛柔，分内外，論孤旺，以證七政趨","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102920744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避之法，由來已久，恐人不信，又舉梓愼、裨竈、古之博","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102920744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物以證之。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102920744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無奈諸家雜出，以僞亂眞，但曉子平，竟忘","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102937128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七政，呆執干支。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102937128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生命亡命，苦若相持，此吉彼凶，紛紛","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102953512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不一，竟有誤人數十年，不能得一吉日安葬其親者。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102953512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095025144332322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悲乎！","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102969896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知死者己無命，反氣入地爲復命，復命能司造化權。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267102986280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者命從葬者定。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103002664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有仙人造命訣，不是干支子平法。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103019048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渾天寶照候天星，此是楊公親口訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103035432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不怕三煞太歲神，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103051816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰府空亡俱抹煞，年尅壓命有何妨，退煞金神皆亂發。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103051816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卷","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103068200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天元烏兔經，畱與人間作寶筏。此章直指選擇造命之法，歸重於天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星可廢一切神煞之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103068200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造命天星","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103084584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣合，再道一切神煞，豈不更妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103084584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103100968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反氣入地謂葬埋以入土時日爲復命。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103100968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入土時刻，猶","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103117352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之生下時刻一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103117352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨吉凶，定盛衰，都在此一時一","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103133736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315096611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻之間。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103133736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一時一刻，闗繫兒孫禍福，故曰生者命從，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103150120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬者定是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103150120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"烏兔經有僞本，如俗所傳每月初一、","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103166504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初二，用羅、計等排去者，卽是僞本，不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103166504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推原天地混沌成，惟有日月是眞精。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103182888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金烏玉兔本一物，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103199272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星四炁從此生。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103199272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生稟受太陽氣，萬物皆是陰陽萌。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103215656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人觀象演歴法，干支甲子作天經。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103232040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱是陽中氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103248424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞何曾另有名。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103248424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只將日月司元化，萬物森羅在掌心。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103264808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言造命天星，以日月時刻爲主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金烏玉兔卽日月，五星，卽水火金木之五星，與日月","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103281192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315145763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共爲七政。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103281192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四炁卽水火木、土之四餘。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103297576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四餘有氣無","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103313960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，黙行於天。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103313960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從此生者，謂此五星四炁及一切萬物，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103330344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱由日月往來而生。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103330344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地無心，聖人無意，作干支甲","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103346728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，範圍天地而不過，曲成萬物而不遺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103346728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世間萬物各有命，不但生人男女定，造物制器可同推，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103363112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"修造葬埋咸取證。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103363112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月五星大象同，一時八刻一移宮，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103379496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造命元機時作主，毫釐千里不相通。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103379496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言萬物各有命，其機在時刻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人以生下日時爲命，造制以成器時刻爲命，葬埋","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103395880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以入地時日爲命，葢物各有命，自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103395880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一時一","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103412264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315211299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻者，謂七政之行度有遲有速，一時一宮，是言其大","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103412264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"槩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103412264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此申言造命之元機在乎時刻。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103428648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一分一秒者，謂。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103445032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月五星，無一息之停，稍有差錯，星移度改，自有毫","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103461416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釐千里之謬。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103461416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先將晝夜别陰陽，晝夜晨昏出没詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103477800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宮中三十度，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103494184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大約六度是分疆。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103494184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈縮授時亳末細，量天廣尺未能量。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103510568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿七政明。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103526952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論宮論度要分明，深則論宮淺論度，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103543336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一分一秒不容情。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103543336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命人躔宫變五氣，日月隨命分五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103559720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜四餘扶日月，生尅衰旺凖天枰。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103576104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最取用星爲福曜，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103592488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315244067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有恩有用作千城。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103592488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用若奪權爲上格，忌星一雜福斯輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103608872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言十二宮分度及躔命宮五行，而歸重於恩用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論用日月之法，先分畫夜，晝用太陽，夜用太陰，晨","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103625256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏出没，分至不同，亦宜詳辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103625256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇天十二宮，毎宮三十","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103641640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度，六度分疆者，謂此六度界於十二宮交界之間。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103641640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103658024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郭守敬作授時歴，今量天尺盈縮其度，緣歲久不能","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103658024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無差故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103658024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿分布四方，分隷七政，有宮主，有","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103674408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度主，論深淺，算分秒，絲毫不容差錯者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103674408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命入𨇠宮","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103690792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，是言命主入𨂷於何宮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103690792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命主入𨇠於何宮，卽知","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103707176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315276835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命主之所屬。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103707176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知命主之所屬，則四餘之恩用，自隨命","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103723560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主而更變，卽日月亦隨命主之五行而分者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103723560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103739944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘，有生尅衰旺、恩難仇用之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103739944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如恩用星得生旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103756328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽爲福曜，又爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103756328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌星者，卽難仇相剋之星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103772712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103789096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有夾雜，其力自減。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103789096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用曜一星落何處，陽時陰候分邊際。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103805480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬夏二至隂陽極，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103821864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋二分是平氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103821864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平氣陰陽用可兼。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103838248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶看晝夜與宮垣，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103854632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畧過平氣陰陽别。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103854632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當極之時禍福耑。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103871016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽令惟求金孛水，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103887400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰令惟用羅與火。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103887400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋本獨宜水兼孛，春土火羅金、計、土。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103903784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315358755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春在分後須陰助，秋在分後宜陽輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103920168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章論四時星曜用忌禍福之變機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至一陰生，是陽極而生陰；冬至一陽生，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103936552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是陰極而","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103936552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生陽，自交冬至到春分，九十日有零，陰陽各居其半，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103936552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲陽中之平氣，畧過則陽勝，是當陰助。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103936552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自交夏至","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103952936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到秋分，亦九十日有零，陰陽各居其半，此爲陰中之","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103952936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平氣，畧過則陰勝，是當陽輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103952936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云陽令陰令，是言氣","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103969320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"候之徧勝也；火羅水孛，是言隨時之取用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103969320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種輔","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103985704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助之法，在乎陰陽和而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267103985704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且水火爲中天之大用，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104002088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令以水爲用神，冬今以火爲用神，乃得中和之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104002088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095661315407907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反是則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104018472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫辰星體兩兼收，度前度後要深求。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104034856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶向五星探伏現，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104051240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆來順去并遲畱，三方對照紧相隨，同宫隔宮一例推。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104051240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱夾有情權力大，日月交受格猶奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104067624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章□言宮星，思用諸格正變之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看宮辰星體，再求度前度後。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104084008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日光半經八度半，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104100392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月光半經朔五度，望七度半，弦六度三十四分。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104100392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所用","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104116776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時刻與所坐所向之宮度，其光果照得到否？","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104116776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星光","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104133160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半經大小不等，亦宜詳辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104133160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之不拘三合、六合、拱照","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104149544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾照及到山到向等，須在日月五星光所照及之度，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104149544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095853632356386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度前度後，尤當深究。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104149544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次察其伏現退畱若何，相冲相","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104165928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會若何。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104165928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如子宮安命，先查子午宮，次察申辰宮，三","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104182312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方對照者若何，以推休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104182312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則星有同宮而異度","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104198696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，有隔宮而同度者，重度不重宮，故曰一例推也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104198696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104215080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱夾星曜有情，權力更大，果能日月雨曜交受其光，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104215080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤爲奇格。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104215080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身當旺令不須恩，但將用曜作根源。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104231464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平令獨恩難發達，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104247848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰時得令尙無愆。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104247848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以恩爲用眞至寶，以難爲用多顚倒。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104264232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以恩爲忌，壽而貧，以難爲忌身不保","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104280616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言恩用離合之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095853632405538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身者，卽安命之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104280616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺令卽合時合令之星辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104297000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104313384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當旺令，何用生扶，惟取用星爲最妙耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104313384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在平令，專","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104329768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用一個恩星，孤立無助，亦難爲福，必須諸吉扶佐爲","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104329768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104329768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如衰時得一恩星，尙爲可取。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104346152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如冬令以火爲用","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104362536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，命立子丑土宮，火又爲恩星，是以恩爲用，最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104362536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104378920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命立辰酉金宮，火變爲難星，是以難爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104378920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時起時倒，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104395304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興廢不常，須得一土星化之方妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104395304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如夏令以木爲恩，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104411688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命立土宮，是以恩爲忌者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104411688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬令以土爲難神，命","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104428072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立水宮，此卽以難爲忌者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104428072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種均忌安命之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104444456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095853632438306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以太陽加時順行逢卯卽爲命宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104460840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：生造以逢","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104477224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲命宮，葬埋以逢酉爲命宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104477224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104493608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮端的管初年，宮若不經須舍㫋。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104509992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必取宮身俱妙合，","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104526376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長安花滿任揚鞭。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104526376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就中暗曜最難知，空地翻同實地司。","logicSentenceId":"7679086267104542760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌兩宫光在午，丑亥二曜子中依。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697325583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論宮星並重之法，兼言暗曜變格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮指坐山而言，如戌山辰向火爲宮主星身者，卽","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697341967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命宮主星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697341967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山所得星辰與命宮所得星辰，均要","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697358351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶旺相爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697358351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非但本宫要合，卽三合、六合、拱夾暗","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697374735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，度前度後，短長多寡，亦要得宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697374735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所言光在午子中","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697391119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095281147609140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依者，此皆用曜之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697391119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻同實地云者，如本宮在午，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697407503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午宮無吉星，寅、戌兩宮有吉星，其光卽射午地。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697407503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697423887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮無吉星，丑亥兩宮有吉星，其光卽夾注於子地是","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697423887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697423887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有橫天交氣法，寅申","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697440271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九十度有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜亥中思，己丑卯宮","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697440271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二十度，亥未西，短長多寡度中移。此章論橫天交氣法，而借亥、卯、酉三宮爲例也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫天交氣，卽弦照、夾照、拱照、三合、六合照之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697440271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所云","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697456655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申亥未，種種是用時刻前後以凑天星之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697456655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果老星宗此的傳，星書卷卷失真詮。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697473039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸般格局皆虚假，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697489423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095853632503842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"升殿入垣莫掛牽。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697489423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章辨星書諸格之非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗傳果老星宗，升殿入垣，諸般格局都假，惟此乃是","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697505807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697505807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日逢晦朔皆爲福，何必蟾光三五圓。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697522191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但忌陰陽當薄蝕，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697538575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七曰之內勿争光。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697538575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太白晝見經天日，難思洪災恩失權。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697554959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章言薄蝕經天宜忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月無光，借日之光爲光，故不以晦朔辨優劣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697571343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽日","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697587727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月之食，在天行度使然，無關禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697587727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然爲地球所間隔","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697604111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而掩其光，是太陽、太陰極否之象，故當避太白。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697604111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽金","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095263837765647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，其氣肅殺，其性陰慘，在東方，在太陽之前，爲太陽","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制服，亦能爲福；如在西方，在太陽之後，到午卽爲經","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天，其氣縱放，最易爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697620495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并忌與火公之照及同宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697636879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日魂月魄命之根，五德五星應五倫。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697653263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌握亁坤惟此理，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697669647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"璿璣經緯治斯民。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697669647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劉公昔日佐眞主，建國行軍掃大荒。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697686031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無奈歴官多失學，增添宜忌漫平章。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697702415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元秘寶今朝啟，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697718799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳與羲和佐盛唐。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697718799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章推原造命法，本於天官歴法，有大作用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自雨漢以來，星書實多有得有失。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697735183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖朝採用西法，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095263837831183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御定數理精藴、七政經緯，","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頑行天下，考之已往，傳之將來，洵可爲萬世不易之良法。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697751567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。宗陽五曲號天元，雖是人爲實至言，普願智愚咸解悟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故將俚句廣流傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697767951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一句一聯包數義，通之便是地行仙。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697784335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中奥旨須尋味，愼勿差訛累後賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697800719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此章總論五篇，致其可屬吿戒之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此總結上文，謂此五歌淺者極淺，深者極深，處處聞","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697817103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發天玉靑囊之至理，必須細心參考，方能由淺而及","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697817103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深，由近而及遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697817103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7347095281147641908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元五歌闡義卷之五，終","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697833487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇","logicSentenceId":"7679087940697833487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
